  30: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  31:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  32:   if (!match) return uci;

  39:     });
  40:     return move.san;
  41:   } catch {

  43:   }

 484:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 485:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);

 488:   function toggleEngine() {
 489:     if (engineEnabled) {
 490:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 491:       engineRef.current = null;
 492:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 493:       setEngineStatus("off");
 494:       setEngineScore(null);
 495:       setEngineMessage("");
 496:       return;
 497:     }
 498:     try {
 499:       setEngineScore(null);
 500:       setEngineMessage("");
 501:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 502:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 503:         (status, message) => {
 504:           setEngineStatus(status);
 505:           if (status === "error") {
 506:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 507:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 508:             setEngineScore(null);
 509:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 510:             engineRef.current = null;
 511:           }
 512:         },
 513:         setEngineScore,
 514:       );
 515:       engineRef.current = client;
 516:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 517:     } catch (cause) {
 518:       setEngineStatus("error");
 519:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 520:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 521:     }
 522:   }

 524:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 525:     setSession((current) => {
 526:       if (!current) return current;
 527:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 528:     });
 529:   }

 531:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 532:     if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 533:       return;
 534:     }
 535: 
 536:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 537:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 538:     } else if (workspaceMode === "opening-prep") {
 539:       setOpeningPrepBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 540:     } else if (studyMode) {
 541:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 542:     } else {
 543:       patchSession(change);
 544:     }
 545:   }
 546:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 547:     if (!studyMode) {
 548:       if (!session) {
 549:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 550:         return;
 551:       }
 552:       setStudyBoard({
 553:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 554:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 555:         moves: [...session.moves],
 556:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 557:         flipped: session.flipped,
 558:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 559:       });
 560:       setStudyMode(true);
 561:     } else {
 562:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 563:       if (studyBoard) {
 564:         patchSession({
 565:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 566:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 567:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 568:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 569:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 570:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 571:         });
 572:       }
 573:       setStudyMode(false);
 574:     }
 575:     setLastMove(null);
 576:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 577:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 578: 
 579:     try {
 580:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 581:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 582:       } else {
 583:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 584:       }
 585:     } catch {
 586:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 587:     }
 588: }

 590:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 591:     try {
 592:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 593:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 594:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 595:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 596:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 597:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 598:       setBook(opened);
 599:       setSession(nextSession);
 600:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 601:       setError("");
 602:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 603:     } catch (cause) {
 604:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 605:     }
 606:   }

 608:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 609:     if (!file) return;
 610:     try {
 611:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 612:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 613:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 614:       const now = Date.now();
 615:       const created: BookRecord = {
 616:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 617:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 618:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 619:         byteLength: file.size,
 620:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 621:         addedAt: now,
 622:       };
 623:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 624:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 625:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 626:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 627:       setBook(created);
 628:       setSession(blank);
 629:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 630:       setError("");
 631:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 632:     } catch (cause) {
 633:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 634:     }
 635:   }
 636: 
 637:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 638:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 639: 
 640:     try {
 641:       await removeBook(item.id);
 642:       await removeSession(item.id);
 643: 
 644:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 645:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 646:         const next = { ...current };
 647:         delete next[item.id];
 648:         return next;
 649:       });
 650: 
 651:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 652:         setBook(null);
 653:         setSession(null);
 654:         setPdf(null);
 655:       }
 656: 
 657:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 658:       setError("");
 659:     } catch (cause) {
 660:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 661:     }
 662:   }
 663:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 664:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 665:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 666:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 667:     try {
 668:       await putBook(renamed);
 669:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 670:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 671:     } catch (cause) {
 672:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 673:     }
 674:   }

 686:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 687:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 688:     try {
 689:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 690:       setSession({
 691:         ...activeSession,
 692:         originalFen: fen,
 693:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 694:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 695:         moves: [],
 696:         moveIndex: 0,
 697:       });
 698:       setLastMove(null);
 699:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 700:       setUserArrows([]);
 701:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 702:       return true;
 703:     } catch (cause) {
 704:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 705:       return false;
 706:     }
 707:   }

 719:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");

 772:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 773:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 774:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 775:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 776:       return;
 777:     }
 778:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 779:     try {
 780:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 781:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 782:       preview.width = crop.width;
 783:       preview.height = crop.height;
 784:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 785:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 786:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 787:     } catch (cause) {
 788:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 789:       return;
 790:     }
 791:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 792:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 793:     setTransferFen("");
 794:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 795:         setRecognitionError("");
 796:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 797:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 798:     try {
 799:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 800:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 801:       });
 802:       const form = new FormData();
 803:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 804:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 805:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 806:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 807:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 808:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 809:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 810:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 811:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 812:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 813:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 814:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 815:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 816:       }
 817:     } catch (cause) {
 818:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 819:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 820:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 821:     }
 822:   }
 823: 
 824:   function closeTransfer() {
 825:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 826:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 827:     setTransferPreview("");
 828:     setTransferFen("");
 829:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 830:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 831:     setRecognitionError("");
 832:       }

 835:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 836:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 837:       setGameEndOverlay({
 838:         title: "Checkmate",
 839:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 840:       });
 841:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 842:       setGameEndOverlay({
 843:         title: "Stalemate",
 844:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 845:       });
 846:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 847:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 848:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 849:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 850:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 851:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 852:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 853:     } else {
 854:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 855:     }
 856:   }
 857: 
 858:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 859:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 860:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 861:     try {
 862:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 863:       const result = currentGame.move({
 864:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 865:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 866:         promotion: piece,
 867:       });
 868:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 869:       patchBoardSession({
 870:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 871:         moves: nextMoves,
 872:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 873:       });
 874:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 875:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 876:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 877:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 878:       setError("");
 879:     } catch {
 880:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 881:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 882:     }
 883:   }
 884: 
 885:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 886:     if (!boardSession) return;
 887:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 888:     try {
 889:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 890:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 891:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 892:       if (promote) {
 893:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 894:         return;
 895:       }
 896:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 897:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 898:       if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 899:         const line = nextMoves
 900:           .map((move, index) => index % 2 === 0 ? `${Math.floor(index / 2) + 1}. ${move}` : move)
 901:           .join(" ");
 902:         setOpeningExplorerInput(line);
 903:         setOpeningExplorerPly(nextMoves.length);
 904:       } else {
 905:         patchBoardSession({
 906:           currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 907:           moves: nextMoves,
 908:           moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 909:         });
 910:       }
 911:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 912:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 913:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 914:       setError("");
 915:     } catch {
 916:       const piece = game.get(to);
 917:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 918:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 919:     }
 920:   }
 921: 
 922:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 923:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 924:     setRedSquares([]);
 925: 
 926:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 927:       setUserArrows([]);
 928:       setArrowStart(null);
 929:       setArrowHover(null);
 930:       return;
 931:     }
 932: if (!boardSession) return;
 933:     if (annotationMode) {
 934:       if (!arrowStart) {
 935:         setArrowStart(square);
 936:         return;
 937:       }
 938:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 939:       setArrowStart(null);
 940:       setArrowHover(null);
 941:       return;
 942:     }
 943:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 944:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 945:       return;
 946:     }
 947:     const piece = game.get(square);
 948:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 949:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 950:   }

 952:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 953:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 954:

 956: 
 957:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 958:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 959:     event.clientX,
 960:     event.clientY,
 961:     bounds,
 962:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 963:   );
 964:

 966:

 968:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;

 970:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 971:   setArrowStart(square);
 972:   setArrowHover(square);
 973:

 975: }

 977:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 978:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 979:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 980:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 981:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 982:     setArrowHover(square);

 985:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 986:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 987: 
 988:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 989: 
 990:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 991:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 992:     event.clientX,
 993:     event.clientY,
 994:     bounds,
 995:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 996:   );
 997: 
 998:   if (to && to !== from) {
 999:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
1000:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
1001:   } else {
1002:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
1003:   }
1004: 
1005:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
1006:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
1007:   setArrowStart(null);
1008:   setArrowHover(null);
1009: }

1017:   function loadPgnText(source: string) {
1018:     try {
1019:       const imported = parsePgn(source);
1020:       const replay = new Chess(imported.lineBaseFen);
1021: 
1022:       for (const san of imported.moves) {
1023:         replay.move(san);
1024:       }
1025: 
1026:       const last = replay.history({ verbose: true }).at(-1);
1027: 
1028:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({
1029:         ...current,
1030:         lineBaseFen: imported.lineBaseFen,
1031:         currentFen: imported.finalFen,
1032:         moves: imported.moves,
1033:         moveIndex: imported.moves.length,
1034:       }));
1035: 
1036:       setWorkspaceMode("analysis");
1037:       setStudyMode(false);
1038:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
1039:       setSelectedSquare(null);
1040: 
1041:       const white = imported.headers.White || "White";
1042:       const black = imported.headers.Black || "Black";
1043:       setNotice(`PGN loaded: ${white} vs ${black} · ${imported.moves.length} plies.`);
1044:       setError("");
1045:     } catch (cause) {
1046:       setError(`PGN import failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1047:     }
1048:   }

1073:     }

1100:       },

1107:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
1108:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1109: 
1110:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
1111:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;

1115:     setManualMode(false);
1116:     setDragSelection(null);
1117:     setCropEditingId(null);
1118:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1119:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1120: 
1121:     patchSession((current) => ({
1122:       ...current,
1123:       candidatesByPage: {
1124:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1125:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1126:       },
1127:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1128:     }));
1129:

1133:   async function detectBoards() {
1134:     if (detecting) {
1135:       stopBoardScan();
1136:       return;
1137:     }
1138: 
1139:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
1140:     if (!API_BASE) {
1141:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1142:       return;
1143:     }
1144: 
1145:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1146:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1147:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1148:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1149: 
1150:     setDetecting(true);
1151:     setError("");
1152:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1153:     patchSession((current) => ({
1154:       ...current,
1155:       candidatesByPage: {
1156:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1157:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1158:       },
1159:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1160:     }));
1161: 
1162:     try {
1163:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1164:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1165:           (blob) => blob
1166:             ? resolve(blob)
1167:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1168:           "image/png",
1169:         );
1170:       });
1171: 
1172:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1173: 
1174:       const form = new FormData();
1175:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1176: 
1177:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1178:         method: "POST",
1179:         body: form,
1180:         signal: abortController.signal,
1181:       });
1182: 
1183:       if (!response.ok) {
1184:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1185:       }
1186: 
1187:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1188:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1189:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1190:       );
1191: 
1192:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1193: 
1194:       patchSession((current) => ({
1195:         ...current,
1196:         candidatesByPage: {
1197:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1198:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1199:         },
1200:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1201:       }));
1202: 
1203:       setNotice(
1204:         candidates.length
1205:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1206:           : "No board candidates found.",
1207:       );
1208:     } catch (cause) {
1209:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1210: 
1211:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1212:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1213:       } else {
1214:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1215:       }
1216:     } finally {
1217:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1218:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1219:         setDetecting(false);
1220:       }
1221:     }
1222:   }

1241:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1242:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1243:     if (!manualMode) return;
1244: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1245: if (!canvas) return;
1246: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1247: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1248: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1249: if (
1250:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1251:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1252:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1253:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1254: ) return;
1255:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1256:     if (!point) return;
1257:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1258:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1259:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1260:     setDragSelection(selection);
1261:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1262:   }

1264:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1265:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1266:     if (edit) {
1267:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1268:       if (!point || !session) return;
1269:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1270:       patchSession((current) => {
1271:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1272:         return {
1273:           ...current,
1274:           candidatesByPage: {
1275:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1276:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1277:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1278:           },
1279:         };
1280:       });
1281:       return;
1282:     }
1283:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1284:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1285:     if (point) {
1286:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1287:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1288:       setDragSelection(selection);
1289:     }
1290:   }

1292:   function finishRegion() {
1293:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1294:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1295:       return;
1296:     }
1297:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1298:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1299:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1300:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1301:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1302:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1303:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1304:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1305:     setDragSelection(null);
1306:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1307:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1308:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1309:       x, y, width, height,
1310:       relativeScore: 1,
1311:       source: "manual",
1312:     };
1313:     patchSession((current) => ({
1314:       ...current,
1315:       candidatesByPage: {
1316:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1317:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1318:       },
1319:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1320:     }));
1321:     setManualMode(false);
1322:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1323:   }

1326:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1327:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1328:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1329:     setDragSelection(null);
1330:   }

1332:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1333:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1334:     try {
1335:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1336:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1337:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1338:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1339:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1340:       const scale = mode === "width"
1341:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1342:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1343:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1344:     } catch (cause) {
1345:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1346:     }
1347:   }

1357:         : [...current.bookmarks, current.page].sort((a, b) => a - b),

 320:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 321:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);

 324:   function toggleEngine() {
 325:     if (engineEnabled) {
 326:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 327:       engineRef.current = null;
 328:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 329:       setEngineStatus("off");
 330:       setEngineScore(null);
 331:       setEngineMessage("");
 332:       return;
 333:     }
 334:     try {
 335:       setEngineScore(null);
 336:       setEngineMessage("");
 337:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 338:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 339:         (status, message) => {
 340:           setEngineStatus(status);
 341:           if (status === "error") {
 342:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 343:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 344:             setEngineScore(null);
 345:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 346:             engineRef.current = null;
 347:           }
 348:         },
 349:         setEngineScore,
 350:       );
 351:       engineRef.current = client;
 352:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 353:     } catch (cause) {
 354:       setEngineStatus("error");
 355:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 356:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 357:     }
 358:   }

 360:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 361:     setSession((current) => {
 362:       if (!current) return current;
 363:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 364:     });
 365:   }

 367:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 368:     try {
 369:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 370:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 371:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 372:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 373:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 374:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 375:       setBook(opened);
 376:       setSession(nextSession);
 377:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 378:       setError("");
 379:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 380:     } catch (cause) {
 381:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 382:     }
 383:   }

 385:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 386:     if (!file) return;
 387:     try {
 388:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 389:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 390:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 391:       const now = Date.now();
 392:       const created: BookRecord = {
 393:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 394:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 395:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 396:         byteLength: file.size,
 397:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 398:         addedAt: now,
 399:       };
 400:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 401:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 402:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 403:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 404:       setBook(created);
 405:       setSession(blank);
 406:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 407:       setError("");
 408:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 409:     } catch (cause) {
 410:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 411:     }
 412:   }

 414:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 415:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 416: 
 417:     try {
 418:       await removeBook(item.id);
 419:       await removeSession(item.id);
 420: 
 421:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 422:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 423:         const next = { ...current };
 424:         delete next[item.id];
 425:         return next;
 426:       });
 427: 
 428:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 429:         setBook(null);
 430:         setSession(null);
 431:         setPdf(null);
 432:       }
 433: 
 434:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 435:       setError("");
 436:     } catch (cause) {
 437:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 438:     }
 439:   }
 440:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 441:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 442:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 443:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 444:     try {
 445:       await putBook(renamed);
 446:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 447:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 448:     } catch (cause) {
 449:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 450:     }
 451:   }

 463:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 464:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 465:     try {
 466:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 467:       setSession({
 468:         ...activeSession,
 469:         originalFen: fen,
 470:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 471:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 472:         moves: [],
 473:         moveIndex: 0,
 474:       });
 475:       setLastMove(null);
 476:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 477:       setUserArrows([]);
 478:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 479:       return true;
 480:     } catch (cause) {
 481:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 482:       return false;
 483:     }
 484:   }

 549:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 550:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 551:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 552:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 553:       return;
 554:     }
 555:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 556:     try {
 557:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 558:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 559:       preview.width = crop.width;
 560:       preview.height = crop.height;
 561:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 562:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 563:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 564:     } catch (cause) {
 565:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 566:       return;
 567:     }
 568:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 569:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 570:     setTransferFen("");
 571:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 572:         setRecognitionError("");
 573:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 574:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 575:     try {
 576:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 577:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 578:       });
 579:       const form = new FormData();
 580:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 581:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 582:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 583:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 584:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 585:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 586:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 587:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 588:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 589:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 590:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 591:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 592:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 593:       }
 594:     } catch (cause) {
 595:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 596:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 597:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 598:     }
 599:   }
 600: 
 601:   function closeTransfer() {
 602:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 603:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 604:     setTransferPreview("");
 605:     setTransferFen("");
 606:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 607:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 608:     setRecognitionError("");
 609:       }

 612:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 613:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 614:       setGameEndOverlay({
 615:         title: "Checkmate",
 616:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 617:       });
 618:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 619:       setGameEndOverlay({
 620:         title: "Stalemate",
 621:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 622:       });
 623:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 624:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 625:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 626:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 627:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 629:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 630:     } else {
 631:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 632:     }
 633:   }

 635:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 636:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 637:     try {
 638:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 639:       const result = currentGame.move({
 640:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 641:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 642:         promotion: piece,
 643:       });
 644:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 645:       patchSession({
 646:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 647:         moves: nextMoves,
 648:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 649:       });
 650:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 651:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 652:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 653:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 654:       setError("");
 655:     } catch {
 656:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 657:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 658:     }
 659:   }
 660: 
 661:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 662:     if (!session) return;
 663:     try {
 664:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 665:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 666:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 667:       if (promote) {
 668:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 669:         return;
 670:       }
 671:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 672:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 673:       patchSession({
 674:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 675:         moves: nextMoves,
 676:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 677:       });
 678:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 679:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 680:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 681:       setError("");
 682:     } catch {
 683:       const piece = game.get(to);
 684:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 685:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 686:     }
 687:   }
 688: 
 689:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 690:     
 691:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 692:       setUserArrows([]);
 693:       setArrowStart(null);
 694:       setArrowHover(null);
 695:       return;
 696:     }
 697: if (!session) return;
 698:     if (annotationMode) {
 699:       if (!arrowStart) {
 700:         setArrowStart(square);
 701:         return;
 702:       }
 703:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 704:       setArrowStart(null);
 705:       setArrowHover(null);
 706:       return;
 707:     }
 708:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 709:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 710:       return;
 711:     }
 712:     const piece = game.get(square);
 713:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 714:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 715:   }

 717:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 718:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;

 728:   );

 731:

 733:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 734:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 735:   setArrowStart(square);
 736:   setArrowHover(square);

 739: }

 747:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 748:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;

 750:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 751: 
 752:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

 754:     event.clientX,
 755:     event.clientY,
 756:     bounds,
 757:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 758:   );

 761:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 762:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 763:   } else {
 764:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 765:   }
 766:

 769:   setArrowHover(null);

 848:   async function detectBoards() {
 849:     if (detecting) {
 850:       stopBoardScan();
 851:       return;
 852:     }
 853: 
 854:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 855:     if (!API_BASE) {
 856:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 857:       return;
 858:     }
 859: 
 860:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 861:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 862:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 863:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 864: 
 865:     setDetecting(true);
 866:     setError("");
 867:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 868:     patchSession((current) => ({
 869:       ...current,
 870:       candidatesByPage: {
 871:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 872:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 873:       },
 874:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 875:     }));
 876: 
 877:     try {
 878:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 879:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 880:           (blob) => blob
 881:             ? resolve(blob)
 882:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 883:           "image/png",
 884:         );
 885:       });
 886: 
 887:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 888: 
 889:       const form = new FormData();
 890:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 891: 
 892:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 893:         method: "POST",
 894:         body: form,
 895:         signal: abortController.signal,
 896:       });
 897: 
 898:       if (!response.ok) {
 899:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 900:       }
 901: 
 902:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 903:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 904:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 905:       );
 906: 
 907:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 908: 
 909:       patchSession((current) => ({
 910:         ...current,
 911:         candidatesByPage: {
 912:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 913:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 914:         },
 915:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 916:       }));
 917: 
 918:       setNotice(
 919:         candidates.length
 920:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 921:           : "No board candidates found.",
 922:       );
 923:     } catch (cause) {
 924:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 925: 
 926:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 927:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 928:       } else {
 929:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 930:       }
 931:     } finally {
 932:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 933:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 934:         setDetecting(false);
 935:       }
 936:     }
 937:   }

 956:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 957:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 958:     if (!manualMode) return;
 959: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 960: if (!canvas) return;
 961: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 962: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 963: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 964: if (
 965:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 966:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 967:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 968:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 969: ) return;
 970:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 971:     if (!point) return;
 972:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 973:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 974:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;

 979:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 980:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 981:     if (edit) {
 982:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 983:       if (!point || !session) return;
 984:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 985:       patchSession((current) => {
 986:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 987:         return {
 988:           ...current,
 989:           candidatesByPage: {
 990:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 991:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 992:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 993:           },
 994:         };
 995:       });
 996:       return;
 997:     }
 998:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 999:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1000:     if (point) {
1001:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1002:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1003:       setDragSelection(selection);
1004:     }
1005:   }

1007:   function finishRegion() {
1008:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1009:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1010:       return;
1011:     }
1012:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1013:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1014:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1015:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1016:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1017:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1018:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1019:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1020:     setDragSelection(null);
1021:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1022:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1023:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1024:       x, y, width, height,
1025:       relativeScore: 1,
1026:       source: "manual",
1027:     };
1028:     patchSession((current) => ({
1029:       ...current,
1030:       candidatesByPage: {
1031:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1032:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1033:       },
1034:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1035:     }));
1036:     setManualMode(false);
1037:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1038:   }

1047:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1048:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1049:     try {
1050:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1051:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1052:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1053:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1054:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1055:       const scale = mode === "width"
1056:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1057:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1058:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1059:     } catch (cause) {
1060:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1061:     }
1062:   }

1526:   if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${Math.max(1, Math.round(bytes / 1024))} KB`;

  30: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  31:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  32:   if (!match) return uci;
  33:   try {
  34:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  35:     const move = position.move({
  36:       from: match[1] as Square,
  37:       to: match[2] as Square,
  38:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  39:     });
  40:     return move.san;
  41:   } catch {
  42:     return uci;
  43:   }
  44: }
  45: 
  46: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  47:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  48:   const san: string[] = [];
  49:   for (const uci of pv) {
  50:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  51:     if (!match) break;
  52:     try {
  53:       const move = position.move({
  54:         from: match[1] as Square,
  55:         to: match[2] as Square,
  56:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  57:       });
  58:       san.push(move.san);
  59:     } catch {
  60:       break;
  61:     }
  62:   }
  63:   return san.join(" ");
  64: }

  86: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  87:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  88:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  89:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  90:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;
  91:   if (elapsed < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 3_600_000)}h ago`;
  92:   return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  93: }
  94: 
  95: function squareName(fileIndex: number, rankIndex: number): Square {
  96:   return `${"abcdefgh"[fileIndex]}${rankIndex + 1}` as Square;
  97: }
  98: 
  99: function normalizedCandidate(value: CandidateInput, index: number): Candidate {
 100:   const { relative_score, confidence, ...candidate } = value;
 101:   return {
 102:     ...candidate,
 103:     id: candidate.id || `candidate-${index + 1}`,
 104:     source: candidate.source ?? "automatic",
 105:     relativeScore: candidate.relativeScore ?? relative_score ?? confidence ?? 0,
 106:   };
 107: }

 338:     function onKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {

 482:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 483:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 484:   }

 486:   function toggleEngine() {
 487:     if (engineEnabled) {
 488:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 489:       engineRef.current = null;
 490:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 491:       setEngineStatus("off");
 492:       setEngineScore(null);
 493:       setEngineMessage("");
 494:       return;
 495:     }
 496:     try {
 497:       setEngineScore(null);
 498:       setEngineMessage("");
 499:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 500:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 501:         (status, message) => {
 502:           setEngineStatus(status);
 503:           if (status === "error") {
 504:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 505:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 506:             setEngineScore(null);
 507:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 508:             engineRef.current = null;
 509:           }
 510:         },
 511:         setEngineScore,
 512:       );
 513:       engineRef.current = client;
 514:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 515:     } catch (cause) {
 516:       setEngineStatus("error");
 517:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 518:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 519:     }
 520:   }

 522:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 523:     setSession((current) => {
 524:       if (!current) return current;
 525:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 526:     });
 527:   }
 528: 
 529:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 530:     if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 531:       return;
 532:     }
 533: 
 534:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 535:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 536:     } else if (workspaceMode === "opening-prep") {
 537:       setOpeningPrepBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 538:     } else if (studyMode) {
 539:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 540:     } else {
 541:       patchSession(change);
 542:     }
 543:   }
 544:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 545:     if (!studyMode) {
 546:       if (!session) {
 547:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 548:         return;
 549:       }
 550:       setStudyBoard({
 551:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 552:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 553:         moves: [...session.moves],
 554:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 555:         flipped: session.flipped,
 556:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 557:       });
 558:       setStudyMode(true);
 559:     } else {
 560:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 561:       if (studyBoard) {
 562:         patchSession({
 563:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 564:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 565:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 566:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 567:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 568:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 569:         });
 570:       }
 571:       setStudyMode(false);
 572:     }
 573:     setLastMove(null);
 574:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 575:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 576: 
 577:     try {
 578:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 579:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 580:       } else {
 581:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 582:       }
 583:     } catch {
 584:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 585:     }
 586: }

 588:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 589:     try {
 590:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 591:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 592:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 593:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 594:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 595:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 596:       setBook(opened);
 597:       setSession(nextSession);
 598:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 599:       setError("");
 600:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 601:     } catch (cause) {
 602:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 603:     }
 604:   }
 605: 
 606:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 607:     if (!file) return;
 608:     try {
 609:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 610:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 611:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 612:       const now = Date.now();
 613:       const created: BookRecord = {
 614:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 615:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 616:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 617:         byteLength: file.size,
 618:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 619:         addedAt: now,
 620:       };
 621:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 622:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 623:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 624:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 625:       setBook(created);
 626:       setSession(blank);
 627:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 628:       setError("");
 629:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 630:     } catch (cause) {
 631:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 632:     }
 633:   }
 634: 
 635:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 636:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 637: 
 638:     try {
 639:       await removeBook(item.id);
 640:       await removeSession(item.id);
 641: 
 642:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 643:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 644:         const next = { ...current };
 645:         delete next[item.id];
 646:         return next;
 647:       });
 648: 
 649:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 650:         setBook(null);
 651:         setSession(null);
 652:         setPdf(null);
 653:       }
 654: 
 655:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 656:       setError("");
 657:     } catch (cause) {
 658:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 659:     }
 660:   }
 661:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 662:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 663:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 664:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 665:     try {
 666:       await putBook(renamed);
 667:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 668:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 669:     } catch (cause) {
 670:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 671:     }
 672:   }

 676:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });

 681:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 682:   }

 684:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 685:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 686:     try {
 687:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 688:       setSession({
 689:         ...activeSession,
 690:         originalFen: fen,
 691:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 692:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 693:         moves: [],
 694:         moveIndex: 0,
 695:       });
 696:       setLastMove(null);
 697:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 698:       setUserArrows([]);
 699:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 700:       return true;
 701:     } catch (cause) {
 702:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 703:       return false;
 704:     }
 705:   }

 711:     setEngineMessage("");
 712:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 713:       toggleEngine();

 715:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 716:     }
 717:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 718:     return true;
 719:   }

 770:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 771:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 772:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 773:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 774:       return;
 775:     }
 776:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 777:     try {
 778:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 779:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 780:       preview.width = crop.width;
 781:       preview.height = crop.height;
 782:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 783:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 784:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 785:     } catch (cause) {
 786:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 787:       return;
 788:     }
 789:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 790:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 791:     setTransferFen("");
 792:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 793:         setRecognitionError("");
 794:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 795:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 796:     try {
 797:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 798:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 799:       });
 800:       const form = new FormData();
 801:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 802:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 803:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 804:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 805:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 806:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 807:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 808:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 809:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 810:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 811:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 812:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 813:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 814:       }
 815:     } catch (cause) {
 816:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 817:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 818:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 819:     }
 820:   }
 821: 
 822:   function closeTransfer() {
 823:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 824:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 825:     setTransferPreview("");
 826:     setTransferFen("");
 827:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 828:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 829:     setRecognitionError("");
 830:       }

 833:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 834:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 835:       setGameEndOverlay({
 836:         title: "Checkmate",
 837:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 838:       });
 839:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 840:       setGameEndOverlay({
 841:         title: "Stalemate",
 842:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 843:       });
 844:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 845:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 846:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 847:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 848:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 849:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 850:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 851:     } else {
 852:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 853:     }
 854:   }

 856:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 857:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 858:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 859:     try {
 860:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 861:       const result = currentGame.move({
 862:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 863:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 864:         promotion: piece,
 865:       });
 866:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 867:       patchBoardSession({
 868:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 869:         moves: nextMoves,
 870:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 871:       });
 872:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 873:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 874:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 875:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 876:       setError("");
 877:     } catch {
 878:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 879:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 880:     }
 881:   }
 882: 
 883:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 884:     if (!boardSession) return;
 885:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 886:     try {
 887:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 888:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 889:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 890:       if (promote) {
 891:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 892:         return;
 893:       }
 894:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 895:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 896:       if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 897:         const line = nextMoves
 898:           .map((move, index) => index % 2 === 0 ? `${Math.floor(index / 2) + 1}. ${move}` : move)
 899:           .join(" ");
 900:         setOpeningExplorerInput(line);
 901:         setOpeningExplorerPly(nextMoves.length);
 902:       } else {
 903:         patchBoardSession({
 904:           currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 905:           moves: nextMoves,
 906:           moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 907:         });
 908:       }
 909:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 910:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 911:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 912:       setError("");
 913:     } catch {
 914:       const piece = game.get(to);
 915:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 916:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 917:     }
 918:   }
 919: 
 920:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 921:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 922:     setRedSquares([]);
 923: 
 924:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 925:       setUserArrows([]);
 926:       setArrowStart(null);
 927:       setArrowHover(null);
 928:       return;
 929:     }
 930: if (!boardSession) return;
 931:     if (annotationMode) {
 932:       if (!arrowStart) {
 933:         setArrowStart(square);
 934:         return;
 935:       }
 936:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 937:       setArrowStart(null);
 938:       setArrowHover(null);
 939:       return;
 940:     }
 941:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 942:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 943:       return;
 944:     }
 945:     const piece = game.get(square);
 946:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 947:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 948:   }

 950:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 951:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 952: 
 953:   event.preventDefault();
 954: 
 955:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 956:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 957:     event.clientX,
 958:     event.clientY,
 959:     bounds,
 960:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 961:   );
 962: 
 963:   if (!square) return;
 964: 
 965:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 966:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 967:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 968:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 969:   setArrowStart(square);
 970:   setArrowHover(square);
 971: 
 972:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 973: }
 974: 
 975:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 976:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 977:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 978:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 979:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 980:     setArrowHover(square);
 981:   }
 982: 
 983:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 984:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 985: 
 986:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 987: 
 988:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 989:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 990:     event.clientX,
 991:     event.clientY,
 992:     bounds,
 993:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 994:   );
 995: 
 996:   if (to && to !== from) {
 997:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 998:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 999:   } else {
1000:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
1001:   }
1002: 
1003:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
1004:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
1005:   setArrowStart(null);
1006:   setArrowHover(null);
1007: }

1015:   function loadPgnText(source: string) {
1016:     try {
1017:       const imported = parsePgn(source);
1018:       const replay = new Chess(imported.lineBaseFen);
1019: 
1020:       for (const san of imported.moves) {
1021:         replay.move(san);
1022:       }
1023: 
1024:       const last = replay.history({ verbose: true }).at(-1);
1025: 
1026:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({
1027:         ...current,
1028:         lineBaseFen: imported.lineBaseFen,
1029:         currentFen: imported.finalFen,
1030:         moves: imported.moves,
1031:         moveIndex: imported.moves.length,
1032:       }));
1033: 
1034:       setWorkspaceMode("analysis");
1035:       setStudyMode(false);
1036:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
1037:       setSelectedSquare(null);
1038: 
1039:       const white = imported.headers.White || "White";
1040:       const black = imported.headers.Black || "Black";
1041:       setNotice(`PGN loaded: ${white} vs ${black} · ${imported.moves.length} plies.`);
1042:       setError("");
1043:     } catch (cause) {
1044:       setError(`PGN import failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1045:     }
1046:   }

1129:     setNotice("Board detection cleared.");

1131:   async function detectBoards() {
1132:     if (detecting) {
1133:       stopBoardScan();
1134:       return;
1135:     }
1136: 
1137:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
1138:     if (!API_BASE) {
1139:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1140:       return;
1141:     }
1142: 
1143:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1144:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1145:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1146:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1147: 
1148:     setDetecting(true);
1149:     setError("");
1150:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1151:     patchSession((current) => ({
1152:       ...current,
1153:       candidatesByPage: {
1154:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1155:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1156:       },
1157:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1158:     }));
1159: 
1160:     try {
1161:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1162:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1163:           (blob) => blob
1164:             ? resolve(blob)
1165:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1166:           "image/png",
1167:         );
1168:       });
1169: 
1170:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1171: 
1172:       const form = new FormData();
1173:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1174: 
1175:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1176:         method: "POST",
1177:         body: form,
1178:         signal: abortController.signal,
1179:       });
1180: 
1181:       if (!response.ok) {
1182:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1183:       }
1184: 
1185:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1186:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1187:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1188:       );
1189: 
1190:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1191: 
1192:       patchSession((current) => ({
1193:         ...current,
1194:         candidatesByPage: {
1195:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1196:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1197:         },
1198:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1199:       }));
1200: 
1201:       setNotice(
1202:         candidates.length
1203:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1204:           : "No board candidates found.",
1205:       );
1206:     } catch (cause) {
1207:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1208: 
1209:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1210:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1211:       } else {
1212:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1213:       }
1214:     } finally {
1215:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1216:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1217:         setDetecting(false);
1218:       }
1219:     }
1220:   }
1221:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
1222:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
1223:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;

1226:   function startCropEdit(
1227:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
1228:     candidate: Candidate,
1229:     handle: CropHandle,
1230:   ) {
1231:     event.stopPropagation();
1232:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1233:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
1234:     if (!point || !stage) return;

1239:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1240:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1241:     if (!manualMode) return;
1242: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1243: if (!canvas) return;
1244: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1245: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1246: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1247: if (
1248:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1249:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1250:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1251:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1252: ) return;
1253:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1254:     if (!point) return;
1255:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1256:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1257:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1258:     setDragSelection(selection);
1259:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1260:   }

1262:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1263:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1264:     if (edit) {
1265:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1266:       if (!point || !session) return;
1267:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1268:       patchSession((current) => {
1269:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1270:         return {
1271:           ...current,
1272:           candidatesByPage: {
1273:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1274:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1275:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1276:           },
1277:         };
1278:       });
1279:       return;
1280:     }
1281:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1282:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1283:     if (point) {
1284:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1285:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1286:       setDragSelection(selection);
1287:     }
1288:   }
