  34:   orientation: "normal" | "flipped" | "unknown";
  35:   board_confidence: number;
  36:   mean_piece_confidence: number | null;
  37:   piece_count: number;
  38:   warnings: string[];
  39: };
  40: type RecognitionStatus = "idle" | "loading" | "complete" | "failed";
  41: 
  42: const PIECE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  43:   "": "Empty square", P: "White pawn", N: "White knight", B: "White bishop",
  44:   R: "White rook", Q: "White queen", K: "White king", p: "Black pawn",
  45:   n: "Black knight", b: "Black bishop", r: "Black rook", q: "Black queen", k: "Black king",
  46: };
  47: const PIECE_ASSETS: Record<string, string> = {
  48:   P: "wp", N: "wn", B: "wb", R: "wr", Q: "wq", K: "wk",
  49:   p: "bp", n: "bn", b: "bb", r: "br", q: "bq", k: "bk",
  50: };
  51: 
  52: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  53:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  54:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  55:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  56:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;
  57:   if (elapsed < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 3_600_000)}h ago`;
  58:   return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  59: }
  60: 
  61: function squareName(fileIndex: number, rankIndex: number): Square {
  62:   return `${"abcdefgh"[fileIndex]}${rankIndex + 1}` as Square;
  63: }
  64: 
  65: function normalizedCandidate(value: CandidateInput, index: number): Candidate {
  66:   const { relative_score, confidence, ...candidate } = value;
  67:   return {
  68:     ...candidate,
  69:     id: candidate.id || `candidate-${index + 1}`,
  70:     source: candidate.source ?? "automatic",
  71:     relativeScore: candidate.relativeScore ?? relative_score ?? confidence ?? 0,
  72:   };
  73: }

 369:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 370:     setSession((current) => {

 394:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 395:     if (!file) return;
 396:     try {
 397:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 398:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 399:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 400:       const now = Date.now();
 401:       const created: BookRecord = {
 402:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 403:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 404:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 405:         byteLength: file.size,
 406:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 407:         addedAt: now,
 408:       };
 409:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 410:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 411:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 412:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 413:       setBook(created);
 414:       setSession(blank);
 415:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 416:       setError("");
 417:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 418:     } catch (cause) {
 419:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 420:     }
 421:   }

 444:       setError("");

 449:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {

 454:       await putBook(renamed);

 456:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);

 458:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 459:     }

 542:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 543:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 544:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 545:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 546:       return;
 547:     }
 548:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 549:     try {
 550:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 551:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 552:       preview.width = crop.width;
 553:       preview.height = crop.height;
 554:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 555:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 556:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 557:     } catch (cause) {
 558:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 559:       return;
 560:     }
 561:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 562:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 563:     setTransferFen("");
 564:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 565:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 566:     setRecognitionError("");
 567:     setTransferPiece("P");
 568:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 569:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 570:     try {
 571:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 572:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 573:       });
 574:       const form = new FormData();
 575:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 576:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 577:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 578:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 579:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 580:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 581:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 582:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 583:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 584:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 585:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 586:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 587:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 588:       }
 589:     } catch (cause) {
 590:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 591:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 592:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 593:     }
 594:   }
 595: 
 596:   function closeTransfer() {
 597:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 598:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 599:     setTransferPreview("");
 600:     setTransferFen("");
 601:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 602:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 603:     setRecognitionError("");
 604:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 605:   }

 607:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 608:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 609:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 610:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 611:       return;
 612:     }
 613:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 614:     if (!board) {
 615:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 616:       return;
 617:     }
 618:     const row = displayRow;
 619:     const col = displayCol;
 620:     try {
 621:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 622:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 623:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 624:       setRecognitionError("");
 625:     } catch (cause) {
 626:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 627:     }
 628:   }
 629: 
 630:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 631:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 632:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 633:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 634:       return;
 635:     }
 636:     try {
 637:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 638:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 639:       setRecognitionError("");
 640:     } catch (cause) {
 641:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 642:     }
 643:   }
 644: 
 645:   function confirmTransfer() {
 646:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 647:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 648:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 649:       return;
 650:     }
 651:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 652:       closeTransfer();
 653:     }
 654:   }
 655: 
 656:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 657:     if (!session) return;
 658:     try {
 659:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 660:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 661:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 662:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 663:       if (promote) {
 664:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 665:         if (!choice) return;
 666:         switch (choice) {
 667:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 668:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 669:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 670:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 671:           default:
 672:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 673:             return;
 674:         }
 675:       }
 676:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 677:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 678:       patchSession({
 679:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 680:         moves: nextMoves,
 681:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 682:       });
 683:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 684:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 685:       setError("");
 686:     } catch {
 687:       const piece = game.get(to);
 688:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 689:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 690:     }
 691:   }
 692: 
 693:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 694:     if (!session) return;
 695:     if (annotationMode) {
 696:       if (!arrowStart) {
 697:         setArrowStart(square);
 698:         return;
 699:       }
 700:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 701:       setArrowStart(null);
 702:       setArrowHover(null);
 703:       return;
 704:     }
 705:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 706:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 707:       return;
 708:     }
 709:     const piece = game.get(square);
 710:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 711:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 712:   }

 777:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;

 781:

 792:   async function detectBoards() {
 793:     if (detecting) {
 794:       stopBoardScan();
 795:       return;
 796:     }
 797: 
 798:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 799:     if (!API_BASE) {
 800:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 801:       return;
 802:     }
 803: 
 804:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 805:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 806:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 807:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 808: 
 809:     setDetecting(true);
 810:     setError("");
 811:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 812:     patchSession((current) => ({
 813:       ...current,
 814:       candidatesByPage: {
 815:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 816:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 817:       },
 818:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 819:     }));
 820: 
 821:     try {
 822:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 823:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 824:           (blob) => blob
 825:             ? resolve(blob)
 826:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 827:           "image/png",
 828:         );
 829:       });
 830: 
 831:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 832: 
 833:       const form = new FormData();
 834:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 835: 
 836:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 837:         method: "POST",
 838:         body: form,
 839:         signal: abortController.signal,
 840:       });
 841: 
 842:       if (!response.ok) {
 843:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 844:       }
 845: 
 846:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 847:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 848:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 849:       );
 850: 
 851:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 852: 
 853:       patchSession((current) => ({
 854:         ...current,
 855:         candidatesByPage: {
 856:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 857:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 858:         },
 859:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 860:       }));
 861: 
 862:       setNotice(
 863:         candidates.length
 864:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 865:           : "No board candidates found.",
 866:       );
 867:     } catch (cause) {
 868:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 869: 
 870:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 871:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 872:       } else {
 873:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 874:       }
 875:     } finally {
 876:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 877:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 878:         setDetecting(false);
 879:       }
 880:     }
 881:   }

 888:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,

 892:     event.stopPropagation();

 900:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 901:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 902:     if (!manualMode) return;
 903: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 904: if (!canvas) return;
 905: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 906: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 907: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 908: if (
 909:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 910:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 911:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 912:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 913: ) return;
 914:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 915:     if (!point) return;
 916:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 917:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 918:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 919:     setDragSelection(selection);
 920:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 921:   }
 922: 
 923:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 924:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 925:     if (edit) {
 926:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 927:       if (!point || !session) return;
 928:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 929:       patchSession((current) => {
 930:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 931:         return {
 932:           ...current,
 933:           candidatesByPage: {
 934:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 935:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 936:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 937:           },
 938:         };
 939:       });
 940:       return;
 941:     }
 942:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 943:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 944:     if (point) {
 945:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 946:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 947:       setDragSelection(selection);
 948:     }
 949:   }
 950: 
 951:   function finishRegion() {
 952:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 953:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 954:       return;
 955:     }
 956:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 957:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 958:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 959:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 960:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 961:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 962:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 963:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 964:     setDragSelection(null);
 965:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 966:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 967:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 968:       x, y, width, height,
 969:       relativeScore: 1,
 970:       source: "manual",
 971:     };
 972:     patchSession((current) => ({
 973:       ...current,
 974:       candidatesByPage: {
 975:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 976:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 977:       },
 978:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 979:     }));
 980:     setManualMode(false);
 981:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 982:   }
 983: 
 984:   function cancelRegion() {
 985:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 986:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 987:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 988:     setDragSelection(null);
 989:   }

 991:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 992:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 993:     try {
 994:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 995:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 996:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 997:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 998:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 999:       const scale = mode === "width"
1000:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1001:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1002:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1003:     } catch (cause) {
1004:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1005:     }
1006:   }

 451:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 452:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 453:     try {
 454:       await putBook(renamed);
 455:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 456:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 457:     } catch (cause) {
 458:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 459:     }
 460:   }

 463:     if (!session) return;
 464:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 465:   }

 469:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });

 472:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 473:     if (!session) return false;
 474:     try {
 475:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 476:       patchSession({
 477:         originalFen: fen,
 478:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 479:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 480:         moves: [],
 481:         moveIndex: 0,
 482:       });
 483:       setLastMove(null);
 484:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 485:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 486:       return true;
 487:     } catch (cause) {
 488:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 489:       return false;
 490:     }

 542:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 543:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 544:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 545:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 546:       return;
 547:     }
 548:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 549:     try {
 550:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 551:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 552:       preview.width = crop.width;
 553:       preview.height = crop.height;
 554:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 555:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 556:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 557:     } catch (cause) {
 558:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 559:       return;
 560:     }
 561:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 562:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 563:     setTransferFen("");
 564:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 565:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 566:     setRecognitionError("");
 567:     setTransferPiece("P");
 568:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 569:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 570:     try {
 571:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 572:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 573:       });
 574:       const form = new FormData();
 575:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 576:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 577:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 578:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 579:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 580:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 581:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 582:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 583:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 584:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 585:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 586:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 587:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 588:       }
 589:     } catch (cause) {
 590:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 591:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 592:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 593:     }
 594:   }
 595: 
 596:   function closeTransfer() {
 597:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 598:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 599:     setTransferPreview("");
 600:     setTransferFen("");
 601:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 602:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 603:     setRecognitionError("");
 604:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 605:   }

 607:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 608:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 609:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 610:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 611:       return;
 612:     }
 613:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 614:     if (!board) {
 615:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 616:       return;
 617:     }
 618:     const row = displayRow;
 619:     const col = displayCol;
 620:     try {
 621:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 622:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 623:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 624:       setRecognitionError("");
 625:     } catch (cause) {
 626:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 627:     }
 628:   }
 629: 
 630:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 631:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 632:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 633:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 634:       return;
 635:     }
 636:     try {
 637:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 638:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 639:       setRecognitionError("");
 640:     } catch (cause) {
 641:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 642:     }
 643:   }
 644: 
 645:   function confirmTransfer() {
 646:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 647:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 648:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 649:       return;
 650:     }
 651:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 652:       closeTransfer();
 653:     }
 654:   }
 655: 
 656:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 657:     if (!session) return;
 658:     try {
 659:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 660:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 661:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 662:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 663:       if (promote) {
 664:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 665:         if (!choice) return;
 666:         switch (choice) {
 667:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 668:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 669:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 670:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 671:           default:
 672:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 673:             return;
 674:         }
 675:       }
 676:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 677:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 678:       patchSession({
 679:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 680:         moves: nextMoves,
 681:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 682:       });
 683:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 684:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 685:       setError("");
 686:     } catch {
 687:       const piece = game.get(to);
 688:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 689:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 690:     }
 691:   }
 692: 
 693:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 694:     if (!session) return;
 695:     if (annotationMode) {
 696:       if (!arrowStart) {
 697:         setArrowStart(square);
 698:         return;
 699:       }
 700:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 701:       setArrowStart(null);
 702:       setArrowHover(null);
 703:       return;
 704:     }
 705:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 706:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 707:       return;
 708:     }
 709:     const piece = game.get(square);
 710:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 711:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 712:   }

 772:   function stopBoardScan() {
 773:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 774:     if (!controller) return;
 775: 
 776:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 777:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 778:     controller.abort();
 779:     setDetecting(false);
 780:     setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 781: 
 782:     patchSession((current) => ({
 783:       ...current,
 784:       candidatesByPage: {
 785:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 786:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 787:       },
 788:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 789:     }));
 790:   }

 792:   async function detectBoards() {
 793:     if (detecting) {
 794:       stopBoardScan();
 795:       return;
 796:     }
 797: 
 798:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 799:     if (!API_BASE) {
 800:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 801:       return;
 802:     }
 803: 
 804:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 805:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 806:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 807:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 808: 
 809:     setDetecting(true);
 810:     setError("");
 811:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 812:     patchSession((current) => ({
 813:       ...current,
 814:       candidatesByPage: {
 815:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 816:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 817:       },
 818:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 819:     }));
 820: 
 821:     try {
 822:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 823:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 824:           (blob) => blob
 825:             ? resolve(blob)
 826:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 827:           "image/png",
 828:         );
 829:       });
 830: 
 831:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 832: 
 833:       const form = new FormData();
 834:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 835: 
 836:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 837:         method: "POST",
 838:         body: form,
 839:         signal: abortController.signal,
 840:       });
 841: 
 842:       if (!response.ok) {
 843:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 844:       }
 845: 
 846:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 847:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 848:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 849:       );
 850: 
 851:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 852: 
 853:       patchSession((current) => ({
 854:         ...current,
 855:         candidatesByPage: {
 856:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 857:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 858:         },
 859:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 860:       }));
 861: 
 862:       setNotice(
 863:         candidates.length
 864:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 865:           : "No board candidates found.",
 866:       );
 867:     } catch (cause) {
 868:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 869: 
 870:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 871:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 872:       } else {
 873:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 874:       }
 875:     } finally {
 876:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 877:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 878:         setDetecting(false);
 879:       }
 880:     }
 881:   }

 884:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;

 888:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 889:     candidate: Candidate,

 892:     event.stopPropagation();

 900:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 901:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 902:     if (!manualMode) return;
 903: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 904: if (!canvas) return;
 905: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 906: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 907: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 908: if (
 909:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 910:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 911:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 912:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 913: ) return;
 914:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 915:     if (!point) return;
 916:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 917:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 918:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 919:     setDragSelection(selection);
 920:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 921:   }
 922: 
 923:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 924:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 925:     if (edit) {
 926:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 927:       if (!point || !session) return;
 928:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 929:       patchSession((current) => {
 930:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 931:         return {
 932:           ...current,
 933:           candidatesByPage: {
 934:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 935:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 936:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 937:           },
 938:         };
 939:       });
 940:       return;
 941:     }
 942:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 943:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 944:     if (point) {
 945:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 946:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 947:       setDragSelection(selection);
 948:     }
 949:   }
 950: 
 951:   function finishRegion() {
 952:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 953:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 954:       return;
 955:     }
 956:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 957:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 958:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 959:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 960:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 961:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 962:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 963:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 964:     setDragSelection(null);
 965:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 966:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 967:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 968:       x, y, width, height,
 969:       relativeScore: 1,
 970:       source: "manual",
 971:     };
 972:     patchSession((current) => ({
 973:       ...current,
 974:       candidatesByPage: {
 975:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 976:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 977:       },
 978:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 979:     }));
 980:     setManualMode(false);
 981:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 982:   }
 983: 
 984:   function cancelRegion() {
 985:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 986:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 987:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 988:     setDragSelection(null);
 989:   }

 991:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 992:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 993:     try {
 994:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 995:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 996:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 997:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 998:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 999:       const scale = mode === "width"
1000:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1001:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1002:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1003:     } catch (cause) {
1004:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1005:     }
1006:   }

1042:   function resetBoard() {
1043:     if (!session) return;
1044:     const original = new Chess(session.originalFen);

 343:     try {
 344:       setEngineScore(null);
 345:       setEngineMessage("");
 346:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 347:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 348:         (status, message) => {
 349:           setEngineStatus(status);
 350:           if (status === "error") {
 351:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 352:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 353:             setEngineScore(null);
 354:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 355:             engineRef.current = null;
 356:           }
 357:         },
 358:         setEngineScore,
 359:       );
 360:       engineRef.current = client;
 361:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 362:     } catch (cause) {
 363:       setEngineStatus("error");
 364:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 365:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 366:     }
 367:   }
 368: 
 369:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 370:     setSession((current) => {
 371:       if (!current) return current;
 372:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 373:     });
 374:   }

 376:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 377:     try {
 378:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 379:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 380:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 381:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 382:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 383:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 384:       setBook(opened);
 385:       setSession(nextSession);
 386:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 387:       setError("");
 388:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 389:     } catch (cause) {
 390:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 391:     }
 392:   }
 393: 
 394:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 395:     if (!file) return;
 396:     try {
 397:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 398:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 399:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 400:       const now = Date.now();
 401:       const created: BookRecord = {
 402:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 403:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 404:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 405:         byteLength: file.size,
 406:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 407:         addedAt: now,
 408:       };
 409:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 410:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 411:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 412:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 413:       setBook(created);
 414:       setSession(blank);
 415:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 416:       setError("");
 417:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 418:     } catch (cause) {
 419:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 420:     }
 421:   }

 423:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 424:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove "${item.title}" from your library?`)) return;
 425: 
 426:     try {
 427:       await removeBook(item.id);
 428:       await removeSession(item.id);
 429: 
 430:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 431:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 432:         const next = { ...current };
 433:         delete next[item.id];
 434:         return next;
 435:       });
 436: 
 437:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 438:         setBook(null);
 439:         setSession(null);
 440:         setPdf(null);
 441:       }
 442: 
 443:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 444:       setError("");
 445:     } catch (cause) {
 446:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 447:     }
 448:   }
 449:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 450:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 451:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 452:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 453:     try {
 454:       await putBook(renamed);
 455:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 456:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 457:     } catch (cause) {
 458:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 459:     }
 460:   }

 542:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 543:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 544:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 545:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 546:       return;
 547:     }
 548:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 549:     try {
 550:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 551:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 552:       preview.width = crop.width;
 553:       preview.height = crop.height;
 554:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 555:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 556:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 557:     } catch (cause) {
 558:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 559:       return;
 560:     }
 561:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 562:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 563:     setTransferFen("");
 564:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 565:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 566:     setRecognitionError("");
 567:     setTransferPiece("P");
 568:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 569:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 570:     try {
 571:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 572:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 573:       });
 574:       const form = new FormData();
 575:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 576:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 577:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 578:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 579:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 580:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 581:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 582:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 583:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 584:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 585:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 586:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 587:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 588:       }
 589:     } catch (cause) {
 590:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 591:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 592:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 593:     }
 594:   }
 595: 
 596:   function closeTransfer() {
 597:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 598:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 599:     setTransferPreview("");
 600:     setTransferFen("");
 601:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 602:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 603:     setRecognitionError("");
 604:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 605:   }

 607:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 608:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 609:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 610:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 611:       return;
 612:     }
 613:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 614:     if (!board) {
 615:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 616:       return;
 617:     }
 618:     const row = displayRow;
 619:     const col = displayCol;
 620:     try {
 621:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 622:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 623:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 624:       setRecognitionError("");
 625:     } catch (cause) {
 626:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 627:     }
 628:   }
 629: 
 630:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 631:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 632:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 633:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 634:       return;
 635:     }
 636:     try {
 637:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 638:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 639:       setRecognitionError("");
 640:     } catch (cause) {
 641:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 642:     }
 643:   }

 645:   function confirmTransfer() {
 646:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 647:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 648:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 649:       return;
 650:     }
 651:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 652:       closeTransfer();
 653:     }
 654:   }
 655: 
 656:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 657:     if (!session) return;
 658:     try {
 659:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 660:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 661:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 662:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 663:       if (promote) {
 664:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 665:         if (!choice) return;
 666:         switch (choice) {
 667:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 668:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 669:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 670:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 671:           default:
 672:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 673:             return;
 674:         }
 675:       }
 676:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 677:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 678:       patchSession({
 679:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 680:         moves: nextMoves,
 681:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 682:       });
 683:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 684:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 685:       setError("");
 686:     } catch {
 687:       const piece = game.get(to);
 688:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 689:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 690:     }
 691:   }
 692: 
 693:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 694:     if (!session) return;
 695:     if (annotationMode) {
 696:       if (!arrowStart) {
 697:         setArrowStart(square);
 698:         return;
 699:       }
 700:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 701:       setArrowStart(null);
 702:       setArrowHover(null);
 703:       return;
 704:     }
 705:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 706:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 707:       return;
 708:     }
 709:     const piece = game.get(square);
 710:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 711:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 712:   }

 787:       },

 793:   function clearBoardScan() {
 794:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 795:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 796: 
 797:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 798:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 799:     controller?.abort();
 800: 
 801:     setDetecting(false);
 802:     setManualMode(false);
 803:     setDragSelection(null);
 804:     setCropEditingId(null);
 805:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 806:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 807: 
 808:     patchSession((current) => ({
 809:       ...current,
 810:       candidatesByPage: {
 811:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 812:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 813:       },
 814:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 815:     }));
 816: 
 817:     setError("");
 818:     setNotice("Board detection cleared.");

 820:   async function detectBoards() {
 821:     if (detecting) {
 822:       stopBoardScan();
 823:       return;
 824:     }
 825: 
 826:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 827:     if (!API_BASE) {
 828:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 829:       return;
 830:     }
 831: 
 832:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 833:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 834:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 835:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 836: 
 837:     setDetecting(true);
 838:     setError("");
 839:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 840:     patchSession((current) => ({
 841:       ...current,
 842:       candidatesByPage: {
 843:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 844:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 845:       },
 846:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 847:     }));
 848: 
 849:     try {
 850:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 851:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 852:           (blob) => blob
 853:             ? resolve(blob)
 854:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 855:           "image/png",
 856:         );
 857:       });
 858: 
 859:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 860: 
 861:       const form = new FormData();
 862:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 863: 
 864:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 865:         method: "POST",
 866:         body: form,
 867:         signal: abortController.signal,
 868:       });
 869: 
 870:       if (!response.ok) {
 871:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 872:       }
 873: 
 874:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 875:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 876:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 877:       );
 878: 
 879:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 880: 
 881:       patchSession((current) => ({
 882:         ...current,
 883:         candidatesByPage: {
 884:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 885:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 886:         },
 887:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 888:       }));
 889: 
 890:       setNotice(
 891:         candidates.length
 892:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 893:           : "No board candidates found.",
 894:       );
 895:     } catch (cause) {
 896:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 897: 
 898:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 899:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 900:       } else {
 901:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 902:       }
 903:     } finally {
 904:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 905:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 906:         setDetecting(false);
 907:       }
 908:     }
 909:   }
 910:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
 911:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
 912:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 913:   }

 928:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 929:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 930:     if (!manualMode) return;
 931: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 932: if (!canvas) return;
 933: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 934: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 935: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 936: if (
 937:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 938:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 939:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 940:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 941: ) return;
 942:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 943:     if (!point) return;
 944:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 945:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 946:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 947:     setDragSelection(selection);
 948:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 949:   }

 951:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 952:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 953:     if (edit) {
 954:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 955:       if (!point || !session) return;
 956:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 957:       patchSession((current) => {
 958:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 959:         return {
 960:           ...current,
 961:           candidatesByPage: {
 962:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 963:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 964:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 965:           },
 966:         };
 967:       });
 968:       return;
 969:     }
 970:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 971:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 972:     if (point) {
 973:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 974:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 975:       setDragSelection(selection);
 976:     }
 977:   }
 978: 
 979:   function finishRegion() {
 980:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 981:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 982:       return;
 983:     }
 984:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 985:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 986:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 987:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 988:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 989:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 990:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 991:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 992:     setDragSelection(null);
 993:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 994:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 995:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 996:       x, y, width, height,
 997:       relativeScore: 1,
 998:       source: "manual",
 999:     };
1000:     patchSession((current) => ({
1001:       ...current,
1002:       candidatesByPage: {
1003:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1004:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1005:       },
1006:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1007:     }));
1008:     setManualMode(false);
1009:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1010:   }
1011: 
1012:   function cancelRegion() {
1013:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1014:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1015:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1016:     setDragSelection(null);
1017:   }

1019:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1020:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1021:     try {
1022:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1023:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1024:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1025:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1026:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1027:       const scale = mode === "width"
1028:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1029:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1030:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1031:     } catch (cause) {
1032:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1033:     }
1034:   }

 217:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 218:     setRendering(true);
 219:     pdf.getPage(session.page).then((page) => {
 220:       if (cancelled) return;
 221:       const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: session.zoom * Math.min(1.4, 1100 / page.getViewport({ scale: 1 }).width) });
 222:       const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
 223:       if (!context) throw new Error("Canvas rendering is unavailable in this browser.");
 224:       canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width);
 225:       canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height);
 226:       const task = page.render({ canvas, canvasContext: context, viewport });
 227:       renderTaskRef.current = task;
 228:       return task.promise;
 229:     }).then(() => {
 230:       if (!cancelled) setRendering(false);
 231:     }).catch((cause: unknown) => {
 232:       if (!cancelled && !(cause instanceof Error && cause.name === "RenderingCancelledException")) {
 233:         setRendering(false);
 234:         setError(`Could not render page ${session.page}: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 235:       }
 236:     });
 237:     return () => {
 238:       cancelled = true;
 239:       renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
 240:     };
 241:   }, [pdf, session?.page, session?.zoom]);
 242: 
 243:   useEffect(() => {
 244:     function onKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 245:       if (!session || !book || isTypingTarget(event.target)) return;
 246:       if (cropEditingId && ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key)) {
 247:         const candidate = (session.candidatesByPage[String(session.page)] ?? []).find((item) => item.id === cropEditingId);
 248:         if (!candidate) return;
 249:         const step = event.shiftKey ? 0.01 : 0.002;
 250:         const x = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
 251:         const y = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
 252:         const next = editCrop(candidate, "move", x, y);
 253:         patchSession((current) => {
 254:           const pageKey = String(current.page);
 255:           return {
 256:             ...current,
 257:             candidatesByPage: {
 258:               ...current.candidatesByPage,
 259:               [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((item) =>
 260:                 item.id === candidate.id ? { ...item, ...next } : item),
 261:             },
 262:           };
 263:         });
 264:         event.preventDefault();
 265:         return;
 266:       }
 267:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 268:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 269:     }
 270:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 271:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 272:   });

 276:     engineRef.current = null;

 279:   const sortedBooks = useMemo(() => [...books].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt), [books]);
 280:   const visibleBooks = useMemo(() => {
 281:     const needle = bookSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
 282:     return sortedBooks.filter((item) => {
 283:       const saved = sessionIndex[item.id];

 287:         (libraryTab === "positions" && (saved?.positions.length ?? 0) > 0) ||
 288:         (libraryTab === "progress" && (saved?.page ?? 1) > 1);
 289:       return matchesTab && item.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle);
 290:     });

 293:   const game = useMemo(() => {
 294:     if (!session) return new Chess();
 295:     try {
 296:       return makePosition(session.lineBaseFen, session.moves, session.moveIndex);
 297:     } catch {
 298:       try { return new Chess(session.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 299:     }

 304:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);

 306:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 307:     try { return makePosition(session?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, session?.moves ?? [], session?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 308:     catch { return []; }
 309:   }, [session]);

 311:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 312:     : null);

 329:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 330:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 331:   }

 333:   function toggleEngine() {
 334:     if (engineEnabled) {
 335:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 336:       engineRef.current = null;
 337:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 338:       setEngineStatus("off");
 339:       setEngineScore(null);
 340:       setEngineMessage("");
 341:       return;
 342:     }
 343:     try {
 344:       setEngineScore(null);
 345:       setEngineMessage("");
 346:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 347:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 348:         (status, message) => {
 349:           setEngineStatus(status);
 350:           if (status === "error") {
 351:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 352:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 353:             setEngineScore(null);
 354:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 355:             engineRef.current = null;
 356:           }
 357:         },
 358:         setEngineScore,
 359:       );
 360:       engineRef.current = client;
 361:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 362:     } catch (cause) {
 363:       setEngineStatus("error");
 364:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 365:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 366:     }
 367:   }

 369:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 370:     setSession((current) => {
 371:       if (!current) return current;
 372:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 373:     });
 374:   }

 376:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 377:     try {
 378:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 379:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 380:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 381:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 382:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 383:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 384:       setBook(opened);
 385:       setSession(nextSession);
 386:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 387:       setError("");
 388:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 389:     } catch (cause) {
 390:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 391:     }
 392:   }

 394:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 395:     if (!file) return;
 396:     try {
 397:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 398:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 399:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 400:       const now = Date.now();
 401:       const created: BookRecord = {
 402:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 403:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 404:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 405:         byteLength: file.size,
 406:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 407:         addedAt: now,
 408:       };
 409:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 410:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 411:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 412:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 413:       setBook(created);
 414:       setSession(blank);
 415:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 416:       setError("");
 417:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 418:     } catch (cause) {
 419:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 420:     }
 421:   }

 423:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 424:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 425: 
 426:     try {
 427:       await removeBook(item.id);
 428:       await removeSession(item.id);
 429: 
 430:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 431:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 432:         const next = { ...current };
 433:         delete next[item.id];
 434:         return next;
 435:       });
 436: 
 437:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 438:         setBook(null);
 439:         setSession(null);
 440:         setPdf(null);
 441:       }
 442: 
 443:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 444:       setError("");
 445:     } catch (cause) {
 446:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 447:     }
 448:   }
 449:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 450:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 451:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 452:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 453:     try {
 454:       await putBook(renamed);
 455:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 456:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 457:     } catch (cause) {
 458:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 459:     }
 460:   }

 473:     if (!session) return false;

 481:         moveIndex: 0,

 483:       setLastMove(null);

 485:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 486:       return true;
 487:     } catch (cause) {
 488:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 489:       return false;
 490:     }

 542:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 543:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 544:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 545:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 546:       return;
 547:     }
 548:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 549:     try {
 550:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 551:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 552:       preview.width = crop.width;
 553:       preview.height = crop.height;
 554:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 555:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 556:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 557:     } catch (cause) {
 558:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 559:       return;
 560:     }
 561:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 562:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 563:     setTransferFen("");
 564:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 565:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 566:     setRecognitionError("");
 567:     setTransferPiece("P");
 568:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 569:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 570:     try {
 571:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 572:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 573:       });
 574:       const form = new FormData();
 575:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 576:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 577:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 578:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 579:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 580:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 581:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 582:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 583:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 584:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 585:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 586:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 587:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 588:       }
 589:     } catch (cause) {
 590:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 591:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 592:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 593:     }
 594:   }
 595: 
 596:   function closeTransfer() {
 597:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 598:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 599:     setTransferPreview("");
 600:     setTransferFen("");
 601:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 602:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 603:     setRecognitionError("");
 604:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 605:   }

 607:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 608:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 609:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 610:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 611:       return;
 612:     }
 613:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 614:     if (!board) {
 615:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 616:       return;
 617:     }
 618:     const row = displayRow;
 619:     const col = displayCol;
 620:     try {
 621:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 622:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 623:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 624:       setRecognitionError("");
 625:     } catch (cause) {
 626:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 627:     }
 628:   }
 629: 
 630:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 631:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 632:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 633:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 634:       return;
 635:     }
 636:     try {
 637:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 638:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 639:       setRecognitionError("");
 640:     } catch (cause) {
 641:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 642:     }
 643:   }
 644: 
 645:   function confirmTransfer() {
 646:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 647:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 648:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 649:       return;
 650:     }
 651:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 652:       closeTransfer();
 653:     }
 654:   }
 655: 
 656:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 657:     if (!session) return;
 658:     try {
 659:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 660:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 661:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 662:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 663:       if (promote) {
 664:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 665:         if (!choice) return;
 666:         switch (choice) {
 667:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 668:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 669:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 670:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 671:           default:
 672:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 673:             return;
 674:         }
 675:       }
 676:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 677:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 678:       patchSession({
 679:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 680:         moves: nextMoves,
 681:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 682:       });
 683:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 684:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 685:       setError("");
 686:     } catch {
 687:       const piece = game.get(to);
 688:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 689:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 690:     }
 691:   }
 692: 
 693:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 694:     if (!session) return;
 695:     if (annotationMode) {
 696:       if (!arrowStart) {
 697:         setArrowStart(square);
 698:         return;
 699:       }
 700:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 701:       setArrowStart(null);
 702:       setArrowHover(null);
 703:       return;
 704:     }
 705:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 706:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 707:       return;
 708:     }
 709:     const piece = game.get(square);
 710:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 711:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 712:   }

 714:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 715:     if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 716:     event.preventDefault();
 717:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 718:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 719:     if (!square) return;
 720:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 721:     arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 722:     setArrowStart(square);
 723:     setArrowHover(square);
 724:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 725:   }

 727:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 728:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 729:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 730:     setArrowHover(boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped)));
 731:   }
 732: 
 733:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 734:     const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 735:     if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 736:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 737:     const to = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 738:     if (to && to !== from) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 739:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 740:     setArrowStart(null);
 741:     setArrowHover(null);
 742:   }

 757:       setSelectedSquare(null);

 793:   function clearBoardScan() {
 794:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 795:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 796: 
 797:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 798:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
