 820:   async function detectBoards() {
 821:     if (detecting) {
 822:       stopBoardScan();
 823:       return;
 824:     }
 825: 
 826:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 827:     if (!API_BASE) {
 828:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 829:       return;
 830:     }
 831: 
 832:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 833:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 834:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 835:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 836: 
 837:     setDetecting(true);
 838:     setError("");
 839:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 840:     patchSession((current) => ({
 841:       ...current,
 842:       candidatesByPage: {
 843:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 844:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 845:       },
 846:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 847:     }));
 848: 
 849:     try {
 850:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 851:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 852:           (blob) => blob
 853:             ? resolve(blob)
 854:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 855:           "image/png",
 856:         );
 857:       });
 858: 
 859:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 860: 
 861:       const form = new FormData();
 862:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 863: 
 864:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 865:         method: "POST",
 866:         body: form,
 867:         signal: abortController.signal,
 868:       });
 869: 
 870:       if (!response.ok) {
 871:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 872:       }
 873: 
 874:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 875:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 876:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 877:       );
 878: 
 879:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 880: 
 881:       patchSession((current) => ({
 882:         ...current,
 883:         candidatesByPage: {
 884:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 885:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 886:         },
 887:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 888:       }));
 889: 
 890:       setNotice(
 891:         candidates.length
 892:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 893:           : "No board candidates found.",
 894:       );
 895:     } catch (cause) {
 896:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 897: 
 898:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 899:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 900:       } else {
 901:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 902:       }
 903:     } finally {
 904:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 905:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 906:         setDetecting(false);
 907:       }
 908:     }
 909:   }
 910:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
 911:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
 912:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 913:   }

 915:   function startCropEdit(
 916:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 917:     candidate: Candidate,
 918:     handle: CropHandle,
 919:   ) {
 920:     event.stopPropagation();
 921:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 922:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
 923:     if (!point || !stage) return;
 924:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
 925:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 926:   }

 928:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 929:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 930:     if (!manualMode) return;
 931: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 932: if (!canvas) return;
 933: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 934: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 935: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 936: if (
 937:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 938:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 939:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 940:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 941: ) return;
 942:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 943:     if (!point) return;
 944:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 945:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 946:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 947:     setDragSelection(selection);
 948:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 949:   }
 950: 
 951:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 952:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 953:     if (edit) {
 954:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 955:       if (!point || !session) return;
 956:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 957:       patchSession((current) => {
 958:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 959:         return {
 960:           ...current,
 961:           candidatesByPage: {
 962:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 963:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 964:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 965:           },
 966:         };
 967:       });
 968:       return;
 969:     }
 970:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 971:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 972:     if (point) {
 973:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 974:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 975:       setDragSelection(selection);
 976:     }
 977:   }
 978: 
 979:   function finishRegion() {
 980:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 981:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 982:       return;
 983:     }
 984:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 985:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 986:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 987:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 988:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 989:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 990:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 991:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 992:     setDragSelection(null);
 993:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 994:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 995:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 996:       x, y, width, height,
 997:       relativeScore: 1,
 998:       source: "manual",
 999:     };
1000:     patchSession((current) => ({
1001:       ...current,
1002:       candidatesByPage: {
1003:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1004:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1005:       },
1006:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1007:     }));
1008:     setManualMode(false);
1009:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1010:   }

1013:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1014:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1015:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1016:     setDragSelection(null);
1017:   }

1019:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1020:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1021:     try {
1022:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1023:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1024:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1025:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1026:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1027:       const scale = mode === "width"
1028:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1029:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1030:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1031:     } catch (cause) {
1032:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1033:     }
1034:   }

 333:   function toggleEngine() {
 334:     if (engineEnabled) {
 335:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 336:       engineRef.current = null;
 337:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 338:       setEngineStatus("off");
 339:       setEngineScore(null);
 340:       setEngineMessage("");
 341:       return;
 342:     }
 343:     try {
 344:       setEngineScore(null);
 345:       setEngineMessage("");
 346:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 347:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 348:         (status, message) => {
 349:           setEngineStatus(status);
 350:           if (status === "error") {
 351:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 352:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 353:             setEngineScore(null);
 354:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 355:             engineRef.current = null;
 356:           }
 357:         },
 358:         setEngineScore,
 359:       );
 360:       engineRef.current = client;
 361:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 362:     } catch (cause) {
 363:       setEngineStatus("error");
 364:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 365:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 366:     }
 367:   }

 369:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 370:     setSession((current) => {
 371:       if (!current) return current;
 372:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 373:     });
 374:   }

 376:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 377:     try {
 378:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 379:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 380:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 381:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 382:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 383:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 384:       setBook(opened);
 385:       setSession(nextSession);
 386:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 387:       setError("");
 388:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 389:     } catch (cause) {
 390:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 391:     }
 392:   }

 394:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 395:     if (!file) return;
 396:     try {
 397:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 398:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 399:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 400:       const now = Date.now();
 401:       const created: BookRecord = {
 402:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 403:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 404:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 405:         byteLength: file.size,
 406:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 407:         addedAt: now,
 408:       };
 409:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 410:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 411:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 412:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 413:       setBook(created);
 414:       setSession(blank);
 415:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 416:       setError("");
 417:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 418:     } catch (cause) {
 419:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 420:     }
 421:   }

 423:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 424:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 425: 
 426:     try {
 427:       await removeBook(item.id);
 428:       await removeSession(item.id);
 429: 
 430:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 431:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 432:         const next = { ...current };
 433:         delete next[item.id];
 434:         return next;
 435:       });
 436: 
 437:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 438:         setBook(null);
 439:         setSession(null);
 440:         setPdf(null);
 441:       }
 442: 
 443:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 444:       setError("");
 445:     } catch (cause) {
 446:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 447:     }
 448:   }
 449:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 450:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 451:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 452:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 453:     try {
 454:       await putBook(renamed);
 455:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 456:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 457:     } catch (cause) {
 458:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 459:     }
 460:   }

 473:     if (!session) return false;

 475:       const next = new Chess(fen);

 481:         moveIndex: 0,

 483:       setLastMove(null);

 486:       return true;

 488:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 489:       return false;
 490:     }
 491:   }

 542:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 543:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 544:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 545:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 546:       return;
 547:     }
 548:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 549:     try {
 550:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 551:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 552:       preview.width = crop.width;
 553:       preview.height = crop.height;
 554:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 555:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 556:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 557:     } catch (cause) {
 558:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 559:       return;
 560:     }
 561:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 562:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 563:     setTransferFen("");
 564:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 565:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 566:     setRecognitionError("");
 567:     setTransferPiece("P");
 568:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 569:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 570:     try {
 571:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 572:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 573:       });
 574:       const form = new FormData();
 575:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 576:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 577:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 578:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 579:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 580:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 581:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 582:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 583:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 584:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 585:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 586:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 587:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 588:       }
 589:     } catch (cause) {
 590:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 591:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 592:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 593:     }
 594:   }
 595: 
 596:   function closeTransfer() {
 597:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 598:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 599:     setTransferPreview("");
 600:     setTransferFen("");
 601:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 602:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 603:     setRecognitionError("");
 604:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 605:   }
 606: 
 607:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 608:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 609:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 610:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 611:       return;
 612:     }
 613:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 614:     if (!board) {
 615:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 616:       return;
 617:     }
 618:     const row = displayRow;
 619:     const col = displayCol;
 620:     try {
 621:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 622:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 623:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 624:       setRecognitionError("");
 625:     } catch (cause) {
 626:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 627:     }
 628:   }
 629: 
 630:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 631:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 632:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 633:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 634:       return;
 635:     }
 636:     try {
 637:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 638:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 639:       setRecognitionError("");
 640:     } catch (cause) {
 641:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 642:     }
 643:   }
 644: 
 645:   function confirmTransfer() {
 646:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 647:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 648:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 649:       return;
 650:     }
 651:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 652:       closeTransfer();
 653:     }
 654:   }

 656:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 657:     if (!session) return;
 658:     try {
 659:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 660:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 661:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 662:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 663:       if (promote) {
 664:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 665:         if (!choice) return;
 666:         switch (choice) {
 667:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 668:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 669:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 670:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 671:           default:
 672:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 673:             return;
 674:         }
 675:       }
 676:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 677:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 678:       patchSession({
 679:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 680:         moves: nextMoves,
 681:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 682:       });
 683:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 684:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 685:       setError("");
 686:     } catch {
 687:       const piece = game.get(to);
 688:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 689:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 690:     }
 691:   }
 692: 
 693:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 694:     if (!session) return;
 695:     if (annotationMode) {
 696:       if (!arrowStart) {
 697:         setArrowStart(square);
 698:         return;
 699:       }
 700:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 701:       setArrowStart(null);
 702:       setArrowHover(null);
 703:       return;
 704:     }
 705:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 706:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 707:       return;
 708:     }
 709:     const piece = game.get(square);
 710:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 711:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 712:   }

 820:   async function detectBoards() {
 821:     if (detecting) {
 822:       stopBoardScan();
 823:       return;
 824:     }
 825: 
 826:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 827:     if (!API_BASE) {
 828:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 829:       return;
 830:     }
 831: 
 832:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 833:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 834:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 835:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 836: 
 837:     setDetecting(true);
 838:     setError("");
 839:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 840:     patchSession((current) => ({
 841:       ...current,
 842:       candidatesByPage: {
 843:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 844:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 845:       },
 846:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 847:     }));
 848: 
 849:     try {
 850:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 851:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 852:           (blob) => blob
 853:             ? resolve(blob)
 854:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 855:           "image/png",
 856:         );
 857:       });
 858: 
 859:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 860: 
 861:       const form = new FormData();
 862:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 863: 
 864:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 865:         method: "POST",
 866:         body: form,
 867:         signal: abortController.signal,
 868:       });
 869: 
 870:       if (!response.ok) {
 871:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 872:       }
 873: 
 874:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 875:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 876:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 877:       );
 878: 
 879:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 880: 
 881:       patchSession((current) => ({
 882:         ...current,
 883:         candidatesByPage: {
 884:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 885:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 886:         },
 887:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 888:       }));
 889: 
 890:       setNotice(
 891:         candidates.length
 892:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 893:           : "No board candidates found.",
 894:       );
 895:     } catch (cause) {
 896:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 897: 
 898:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 899:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 900:       } else {
 901:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 902:       }
 903:     } finally {
 904:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 905:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 906:         setDetecting(false);
 907:       }
 908:     }
 909:   }

 929:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;

 951:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 952:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 953:     if (edit) {
 954:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 955:       if (!point || !session) return;
 956:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 957:       patchSession((current) => {
 958:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 959:         return {
 960:           ...current,
 961:           candidatesByPage: {

 964:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 965:           },
 966:         };
 967:       });
 968:       return;
 969:     }
 970:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 971:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 972:     if (point) {
 973:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 974:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 975:       setDragSelection(selection);

 979:   function finishRegion() {
 980:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 981:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 982:       return;
 983:     }
 984:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 985:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 986:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 987:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 988:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 989:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 990:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 991:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 992:     setDragSelection(null);
 993:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 994:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 995:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 996:       x, y, width, height,
 997:       relativeScore: 1,
 998:       source: "manual",
 999:     };
1000:     patchSession((current) => ({
1001:       ...current,
1002:       candidatesByPage: {
1003:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1004:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1005:       },
1006:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1007:     }));
1008:     setManualMode(false);
1009:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1010:   }

1019:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1020:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;

1022:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1023:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1024:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1025:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1026:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1027:       const scale = mode === "width"
1028:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1029:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1030:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1031:     } catch (cause) {
1032:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1033:     }
1034:   }

1483: function LibraryNavItem({ active, onClick, icon, label }: { active: boolean; onClick: () => void; icon: string; label: string }) {
1484:   return <button className={`library-nav-item ${active ? "nav-active" : ""}`} onClick={onClick}><span>{icon}</span>{label}</button>;

1487: function formatSize(bytes: number): string {
1488:   if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${Math.max(1, Math.round(bytes / 1024))} KB`;
1489:   return `${(bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB`;
1490: }

1492: function isTypingTarget(target: EventTarget | null): boolean {
1493:   return target instanceof HTMLElement && (target.isContentEditable || ["INPUT", "TEXTAREA", "SELECT"].includes(target.tagName));
1494: }

  52: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  53:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  54:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  55:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  56:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;
  57:   if (elapsed < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 3_600_000)}h ago`;
  58:   return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  59: }

 392:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 393:     if (!file) return;
 394:     try {
 395:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 396:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 397:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 398:       const now = Date.now();
 399:       const created: BookRecord = {
 400:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 401:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 402:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 403:         byteLength: file.size,
 404:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 405:         addedAt: now,
 406:       };
 407:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 408:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 409:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 410:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 411:       setBook(created);
 412:       setSession(blank);
 413:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 414:       setError("");
 415:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 416:     } catch (cause) {
 417:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 418:     }

 518:     if (baseline && session) {
 519:       patchSession((current) => {

 521:         return {
 522:           ...current,
 523:           candidatesByPage: {
 524:             ...current.candidatesByPage,

 526:               candidate.id === baseline.id ? baseline : candidate),

 536:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 537:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 538:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 539:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 540:       return;
 541:     }
 542:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 543:     try {
 544:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 545:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 546:       preview.width = crop.width;
 547:       preview.height = crop.height;
 548:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 549:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 550:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 551:     } catch (cause) {
 552:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 553:       return;
 554:     }
 555:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 556:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 557:     setTransferFen("");
 558:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 559:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 560:     setRecognitionError("");
 561:     setTransferPiece("P");
 562:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 563:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 564:     try {
 565:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 566:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 567:       });
 568:       const form = new FormData();
 569:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 570:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 571:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 572:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 573:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 574:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 575:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 576:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 577:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 578:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 579:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 580:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 581:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 582:       }
 583:     } catch (cause) {
 584:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 585:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 586:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 587:     }
 588:   }
 589: 
 590:   function closeTransfer() {
 591:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 592:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 593:     setTransferPreview("");
 594:     setTransferFen("");
 595:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 596:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 597:     setRecognitionError("");
 598:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 599:   }

 601:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 602:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 603:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 604:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 605:       return;
 606:     }
 607:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 608:     if (!board) {
 609:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 610:       return;
 611:     }
 612:     const row = displayRow;
 613:     const col = displayCol;
 614:     try {
 615:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 616:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 617:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 618:       setRecognitionError("");
 619:     } catch (cause) {
 620:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 621:     }
 622:   }
 623: 
 624:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 625:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 626:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 627:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 628:       return;
 629:     }
 630:     try {
 631:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 632:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 633:       setRecognitionError("");
 634:     } catch (cause) {
 635:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 636:     }
 637:   }
 638: 
 639:   function confirmTransfer() {
 640:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 641:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 642:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 643:       return;
 644:     }
 645:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 646:       closeTransfer();
 647:     }
 648:   }

 650:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 651:     if (!session) return;
 652:     try {
 653:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 654:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 655:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 656:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 657:       if (promote) {
 658:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 659:         if (!choice) return;
 660:         switch (choice) {
 661:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 662:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 663:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 664:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 665:           default:
 666:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 667:             return;
 668:         }
 669:       }
 670:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 671:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 672:       patchSession({
 673:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 674:         moves: nextMoves,
 675:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 676:       });
 677:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 678:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 679:       setError("");
 680:     } catch {
 681:       const piece = game.get(to);
 682:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 683:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 684:     }
 685:   }
 686: 
 687:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 688:     if (!session) return;
 689:     if (annotationMode) {
 690:       if (!arrowStart) {
 691:         setArrowStart(square);
 692:         return;
 693:       }
 694:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 695:       setArrowStart(null);
 696:       setArrowHover(null);
 697:       return;
 698:     }
 699:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 700:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 701:       return;
 702:     }
 703:     const piece = game.get(square);
 704:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 705:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 706:   }

 708:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 709:     if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 710:     event.preventDefault();
 711:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 712:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 713:     if (!square) return;
 714:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 715:     arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 716:     setArrowStart(square);
 717:     setArrowHover(square);
 718:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 719:   }

 727:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {

 733:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 734:     setArrowStart(null);
 735:     setArrowHover(null);

 744:   function jumpToMove(index: number) {
 745:     if (!session) return;
 746:     try {

 749:       patchSession({ moveIndex: index, currentFen: next.fen() });
 750:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
 751:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 752:     } catch (cause) {
 753:       setError(`Could not navigate to move: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 754:     }

 766:   async function detectBoards() {
 767:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 768:     if (!API_BASE) {
 769:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Start the optional CV service and set VITE_API_BASE_URL, or draw a board region manually.");
 770:       return;
 771:     }
 772:     setDetecting(true);
 773:     setError("");
 774:     try {
 775:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 776:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")), "image/png");
 777:       });
 778:       const form = new FormData();
 779:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 780:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 781:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 782:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 783:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map((item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index));
 784:       patchSession((current) => ({
 785:         ...current,
 786:         candidatesByPage: { ...current.candidatesByPage, [String(current.page)]: candidates },
 787:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 788:       }));
 789:       setNotice(candidates.length ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Review each candidate; recognition is manual.` : "No board candidates found. You can draw a region manually.");
 790:     } catch (cause) {
 791:       setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 792:     } finally {
 793:       setDetecting(false);
 794:     }
 795:   }

 803:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,

 815:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 816:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 817:     if (!manualMode || event.target !== canvasRef.current) return;
 818:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 819:     if (!point) return;
 820:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 821:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 822:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 823:     setDragSelection(selection);
 824:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 825:   }
 826: 
 827:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 828:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 829:     if (edit) {
 830:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 831:       if (!point || !session) return;
 832:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 833:       patchSession((current) => {
 834:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 835:         return {
 836:           ...current,
 837:           candidatesByPage: {
 838:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 839:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 840:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 841:           },
 842:         };
 843:       });
 844:       return;
 845:     }
 846:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 847:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 848:     if (point) {
 849:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 850:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 851:       setDragSelection(selection);
 852:     }
 853:   }
 854: 
 855:   function finishRegion() {
 856:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 857:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 858:       return;
 859:     }
 860:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 861:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 862:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 863:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 864:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 865:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 866:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 867:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 868:     setDragSelection(null);
 869:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 870:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 871:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 872:       x, y, width, height,
 873:       relativeScore: 1,
 874:       source: "manual",
 875:     };
 876:     patchSession((current) => ({
 877:       ...current,
 878:       candidatesByPage: {
 879:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 880:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 881:       },
 882:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 883:     }));
 884:     setManualMode(false);
 885:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 886:   }
 887: 
 888:   function cancelRegion() {
 889:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 890:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 891:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 892:     setDragSelection(null);
 893:   }

 895:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 896:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 897:     try {
 898:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 899:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 900:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 901:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 902:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 903:       const scale = mode === "width"
 904:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 905:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 906:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 907:     } catch (cause) {
 908:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 909:     }
 910:   }

  30: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  31:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  32:   if (!match) return uci;
  33:   try {
  34:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  35:     const move = position.move({
  36:       from: match[1] as Square,
  37:       to: match[2] as Square,
  38:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  39:     });
  40:     return move.san;
  41:   } catch {
  42:     return uci;
  43:   }
  44: }
  45: 
  46: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  47:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  48:   const san: string[] = [];
  49:   for (const uci of pv) {
  50:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  51:     if (!match) break;
  52:     try {
  53:       const move = position.move({
  54:         from: match[1] as Square,
  55:         to: match[2] as Square,
  56:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  57:       });
  58:       san.push(move.san);
  59:     } catch {
  60:       break;
  61:     }
  62:   }
  63:   return san.join(" ");
  64: }

  88: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  89:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  90:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  91:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  92:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;
  93:   if (elapsed < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 3_600_000)}h ago`;
  94:   return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  95: }

 460:     try { return makePosition(boardSession?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, boardSession?.moves ?? [], boardSession?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 461:     catch { return []; }
 462:   }, [boardSession]);
 463:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 464:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 465:     : null);
 466:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 467:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 468:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 469:   );
 470: 
 471:   useEffect(() => {
 472:     setUserArrows([]);
 473:     setArrowStart(null);
 474:     setArrowHover(null);
 475:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 476:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 477: 
 478:   useEffect(() => {
 479:     if (engineEnabled && boardSession) {
 480:       engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 481:     }
 482:   }, [engineEnabled, boardSession?.currentFen, boardSession?.moveIndex, game, engineDepth]);
 483: 
 484:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 485:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 486:   }
 487: 
 488:   function toggleEngine() {
 489:     if (engineEnabled) {
 490:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 491:       engineRef.current = null;
 492:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 493:       setEngineStatus("off");
 494:       setEngineScore(null);
 495:       setEngineMessage("");
 496:       return;
 497:     }
 498:     try {
 499:       setEngineScore(null);
 500:       setEngineMessage("");
 501:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 502:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 503:         (status, message) => {
 504:           setEngineStatus(status);
 505:           if (status === "error") {
 506:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 507:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 508:             setEngineScore(null);
 509:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 510:             engineRef.current = null;
 511:           }
 512:         },
 513:         setEngineScore,
 514:       );
 515:       engineRef.current = client;
 516:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 517:     } catch (cause) {
 518:       setEngineStatus("error");
 519:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 520:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 521:     }
 522:   }
 523: 
 524:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 525:     setSession((current) => {
 526:       if (!current) return current;
 527:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 528:     });
 529:   }
 530: 
 531:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 532:     if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 533:       return;
 534:     }
 535: 
 536:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 537:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 538:     } else if (workspaceMode === "opening-prep") {
 539:       setOpeningPrepBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 540:     } else if (studyMode) {
 541:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 542:     } else {
 543:       patchSession(change);
 544:     }
 545:   }
 546:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 547:     if (!studyMode) {
 548:       if (!session) {
 549:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 550:         return;
 551:       }
 552:       setStudyBoard({
 553:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 554:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 555:         moves: [...session.moves],
 556:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 557:         flipped: session.flipped,
 558:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 559:       });
 560:       setStudyMode(true);
 561:     } else {
 562:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 563:       if (studyBoard) {
 564:         patchSession({
 565:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 566:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 567:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 568:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 569:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 570:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 571:         });
 572:       }
 573:       setStudyMode(false);
 574:     }
 575:     setLastMove(null);
 576:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 577:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 578: 
 579:     try {
 580:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 581:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 582:       } else {
 583:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 584:       }
 585:     } catch {
 586:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 587:     }
 588: }

 590:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 591:     try {
 592:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 593:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 594:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 595:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 596:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 597:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 598:       setBook(opened);
 599:       setSession(nextSession);
 600:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 601:       setError("");
 602:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 603:     } catch (cause) {
 604:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 605:     }
 606:   }
 607: 
 608:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 609:     if (!file) return;
 610:     try {
 611:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 612:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 613:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 614:       const now = Date.now();
 615:       const created: BookRecord = {
 616:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 617:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 618:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 619:         byteLength: file.size,
 620:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 621:         addedAt: now,
 622:       };
 623:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 624:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 625:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 626:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 627:       setBook(created);
 628:       setSession(blank);
 629:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 630:       setError("");
 631:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 632:     } catch (cause) {
 633:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 634:     }
 635:   }
 636: 
 637:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 638:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 639: 
 640:     try {
 641:       await removeBook(item.id);
 642:       await removeSession(item.id);
 643: 
 644:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 645:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 646:         const next = { ...current };
 647:         delete next[item.id];
 648:         return next;
 649:       });
 650: 
 651:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 652:         setBook(null);
 653:         setSession(null);
 654:         setPdf(null);
 655:       }
 656: 
 657:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 658:       setError("");
 659:     } catch (cause) {
 660:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 661:     }
 662:   }
 663:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 664:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 665:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 666:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 667:     try {
 668:       await putBook(renamed);
 669:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 670:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 671:     } catch (cause) {
 672:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 673:     }
 674:   }

 676:   function changePage(delta: number) {
 677:     if (!session) return;
 678:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 679:   }

 681:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 682:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 683:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 684:   }

 686:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 687:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 688:     try {
 689:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 690:       setSession({
 691:         ...activeSession,
 692:         originalFen: fen,
 693:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 694:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 695:         moves: [],
 696:         moveIndex: 0,
 697:       });
 698:       setLastMove(null);
 699:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 700:       setUserArrows([]);
 701:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 702:       return true;
 703:     } catch (cause) {
 704:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 705:       return false;
 706:     }
 707:   }

 709:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 710:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 711:     if (!loaded) return false;
 712:     setEngineScore(null);
 713:     setEngineMessage("");
 714:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 715:       toggleEngine();
 716:     } else {
 717:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 718:     }
 719:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 720:     return true;
 721:   }

 772:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 773:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 774:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 775:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 776:       return;
 777:     }
 778:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 779:     try {
 780:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 781:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 782:       preview.width = crop.width;
 783:       preview.height = crop.height;
 784:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 785:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 786:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 787:     } catch (cause) {
 788:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 789:       return;
 790:     }
 791:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 792:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 793:     setTransferFen("");
 794:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 795:         setRecognitionError("");
 796:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 797:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 798:     try {
 799:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 800:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 801:       });
 802:       const form = new FormData();
 803:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 804:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 805:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 806:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 807:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 808:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 809:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 810:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 811:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 812:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 813:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 814:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 815:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 816:       }
 817:     } catch (cause) {
 818:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 819:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 820:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 821:     }
 822:   }
 823: 
 824:   function closeTransfer() {
 825:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 826:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 827:     setTransferPreview("");
 828:     setTransferFen("");
 829:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 830:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 831:     setRecognitionError("");
 832:       }

 835:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 836:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 837:       setGameEndOverlay({
 838:         title: "Checkmate",
 839:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 840:       });
 841:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 842:       setGameEndOverlay({
 843:         title: "Stalemate",
 844:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 845:       });
 846:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 847:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 848:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 849:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 850:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 851:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 852:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 853:     } else {
 854:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 855:     }
 856:   }
 857: 
 858:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 859:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 860:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 861:     try {
 862:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 863:       const result = currentGame.move({
 864:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 865:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 866:         promotion: piece,
 867:       });
 868:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 869:       patchBoardSession({
 870:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 871:         moves: nextMoves,
 872:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 873:       });
 874:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 875:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 876:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 877:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 878:       setError("");
 879:     } catch {
 880:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 881:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 882:     }
 883:   }
 884: 
 885:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 886:     if (!boardSession) return;
 887:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 888:     try {
 889:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 890:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 891:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 892:       if (promote) {
 893:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 894:         return;
 895:       }
 896:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 897:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 898:       if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 899:         const line = nextMoves
 900:           .map((move, index) => index % 2 === 0 ? `${Math.floor(index / 2) + 1}. ${move}` : move)
 901:           .join(" ");
 902:         setOpeningExplorerInput(line);
 903:         setOpeningExplorerPly(nextMoves.length);
 904:       } else {
 905:         patchBoardSession({
 906:           currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 907:           moves: nextMoves,
 908:           moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 909:         });
 910:       }
 911:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 912:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 913:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 914:       setError("");
 915:     } catch {
 916:       const piece = game.get(to);
 917:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 918:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 919:     }
 920:   }
 921: 
 922:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 923:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 924:     setRedSquares([]);
 925: 
 926:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 927:       setUserArrows([]);
 928:       setArrowStart(null);
 929:       setArrowHover(null);
 930:       return;
 931:     }
 932: if (!boardSession) return;
 933:     if (annotationMode) {
 934:       if (!arrowStart) {
 935:         setArrowStart(square);
 936:         return;
 937:       }
 938:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 939:       setArrowStart(null);
 940:       setArrowHover(null);
 941:       return;
 942:     }
 943:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 944:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 945:       return;
 946:     }
 947:     const piece = game.get(square);
 948:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 949:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 950:   }

 952:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 953:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 954: 
 955:   event.preventDefault();
 956: 
 957:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 958:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 959:     event.clientX,
 960:     event.clientY,
 961:     bounds,
 962:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 963:   );
 964: 
 965:   if (!square) return;
 966: 
 967:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 968:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 969:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 970:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 971:   setArrowStart(square);
 972:   setArrowHover(square);
 973: 
 974:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 975: }
 976: 
 977:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 978:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 979:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 980:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 981:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 982:     setArrowHover(square);
 983:   }
 984: 
 985:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 986:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 987: 
 988:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 989: 
 990:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 991:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 992:     event.clientX,
 993:     event.clientY,
 994:     bounds,
 995:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 996:   );
 997: 
 998:   if (to && to !== from) {
 999:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
1000:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
1001:   } else {
1002:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
1003:   }
1004: 
1005:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
1006:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
1007:   setArrowStart(null);
1008:   setArrowHover(null);
1009: }

1011:   function cancelBoardArrowGesture() {
1012:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
1013:     setArrowStart(null);
1014:     setArrowHover(null);
1015:   }

1017:   function loadPgnText(source: string) {
1018:     try {
1019:       const imported = parsePgn(source);
1020:       const replay = new Chess(imported.lineBaseFen);
1021: 
1022:       for (const san of imported.moves) {
1023:         replay.move(san);
1024:       }
1025: 
1026:       const last = replay.history({ verbose: true }).at(-1);
1027: 
1028:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({
1029:         ...current,
1030:         lineBaseFen: imported.lineBaseFen,
1031:         currentFen: imported.finalFen,
1032:         moves: imported.moves,
1033:         moveIndex: imported.moves.length,
1034:       }));
1035: 
1036:       setWorkspaceMode("analysis");
1037:       setStudyMode(false);
1038:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
1039:       setSelectedSquare(null);
1040: 
1041:       const white = imported.headers.White || "White";
1042:       const black = imported.headers.Black || "Black";
1043:       setNotice(`PGN loaded: ${white} vs ${black} · ${imported.moves.length} plies.`);
1044:       setError("");
1045:     } catch (cause) {
1046:       setError(`PGN import failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1047:     }
1048:   }
1049: 
1050:   async function importPgnFile(file: File) {
1051:     try {
1052:       const source = await file.text();
1053:       loadPgnText(source);
1054:     } catch (cause) {
1055:       setError(`Could not read PGN file: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1056:     }
1057:   }

1133:   async function detectBoards() {
1134:     if (detecting) {
1135:       stopBoardScan();
1136:       return;
1137:     }
1138: 
1139:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
1140:     if (!API_BASE) {
1141:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1142:       return;
1143:     }
1144: 
1145:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1146:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1147:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1148:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1149: 
1150:     setDetecting(true);
1151:     setError("");
1152:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1153:     patchSession((current) => ({
1154:       ...current,
1155:       candidatesByPage: {
1156:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1157:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1158:       },
1159:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1160:     }));
1161: 
1162:     try {
1163:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1164:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1165:           (blob) => blob
1166:             ? resolve(blob)
1167:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1168:           "image/png",
1169:         );
1170:       });
1171: 
1172:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1173: 
1174:       const form = new FormData();
1175:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1176: 
1177:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1178:         method: "POST",
1179:         body: form,
1180:         signal: abortController.signal,
1181:       });
1182: 
1183:       if (!response.ok) {
1184:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1185:       }
1186: 
1187:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1188:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1189:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1190:       );
1191: 
1192:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1193: 
1194:       patchSession((current) => ({
1195:         ...current,
1196:         candidatesByPage: {
1197:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1198:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1199:         },
1200:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1201:       }));
1202: 
1203:       setNotice(
1204:         candidates.length
1205:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1206:           : "No board candidates found.",
1207:       );
1208:     } catch (cause) {
1209:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1210: 
1211:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1212:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1213:       } else {
1214:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1215:       }
1216:     } finally {
1217:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1218:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1219:         setDetecting(false);
1220:       }
1221:     }
1222:   }

1241:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1242:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1243:     if (!manualMode) return;
1244: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1245: if (!canvas) return;
1246: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1247: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1248: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1249: if (
1250:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1251:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1252:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1253:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1254: ) return;
1255:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1256:     if (!point) return;
1257:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1258:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1259:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1260:     setDragSelection(selection);
1261:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1262:   }

1264:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1265:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1266:     if (edit) {
1267:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1268:       if (!point || !session) return;
1269:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1270:       patchSession((current) => {
1271:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1272:         return {
1273:           ...current,
1274:           candidatesByPage: {
1275:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1276:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1277:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1278:           },
1279:         };
1280:       });
1281:       return;
1282:     }
1283:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1284:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1285:     if (point) {
1286:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1287:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1288:       setDragSelection(selection);
1289:     }
1290:   }

1292:   function finishRegion() {
1293:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1294:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1295:       return;
1296:     }
1297:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1298:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1299:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1300:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1301:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1302:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1303:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1304:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1305:     setDragSelection(null);
1306:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1307:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1308:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1309:       x, y, width, height,
1310:       relativeScore: 1,
1311:       source: "manual",
1312:     };
1313:     patchSession((current) => ({
1314:       ...current,
1315:       candidatesByPage: {
1316:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1317:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1318:       },
1319:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1320:     }));
1321:     setManualMode(false);
1322:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1323:   }

1326:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1327:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1328:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1329:     setDragSelection(null);
1330:   }

1332:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1333:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1334:     try {
1335:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1336:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1337:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1338:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1339:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1340:       const scale = mode === "width"
1341:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1342:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1343:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1344:     } catch (cause) {
1345:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1346:     }
1347:   }

 312:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 313:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 314:   );
 315: 
 316:   useEffect(() => {
 317:     setUserArrows([]);
 318:     setArrowStart(null);
 319:     setArrowHover(null);
 320:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 321:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 322: 
 323:   useEffect(() => {
 324:     if (engineEnabled) engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 325:   }, [engineEnabled, session?.currentFen, session?.moveIndex, engineDepth]);
 326: 
 327:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 328:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 329:   }

 331:   function toggleEngine() {
 332:     if (engineEnabled) {
 333:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 334:       engineRef.current = null;
 335:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 336:       setEngineStatus("off");
 337:       setEngineScore(null);
 338:       setEngineMessage("");
 339:       return;
 340:     }
 341:     try {
 342:       setEngineScore(null);
 343:       setEngineMessage("");
 344:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 345:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 346:         (status, message) => {
 347:           setEngineStatus(status);
 348:           if (status === "error") {
 349:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 350:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 351:             setEngineScore(null);
 352:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 353:             engineRef.current = null;
 354:           }
 355:         },
 356:         setEngineScore,
 357:       );
 358:       engineRef.current = client;
 359:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 360:     } catch (cause) {
 361:       setEngineStatus("error");
 362:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 363:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 364:     }
 365:   }

 367:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 368:     setSession((current) => {
 369:       if (!current) return current;
 370:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 371:     });
 372:   }
