 374:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 375:     try {
 376:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 377:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 378:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 379:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 380:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 381:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 382:       setBook(opened);
 383:       setSession(nextSession);
 384:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 385:       setError("");
 386:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 387:     } catch (cause) {
 388:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 389:     }
 390:   }

 392:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 393:     if (!file) return;
 394:     try {
 395:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 396:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 397:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 398:       const now = Date.now();
 399:       const created: BookRecord = {
 400:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 401:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 402:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 403:         byteLength: file.size,
 404:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 405:         addedAt: now,
 406:       };
 407:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 408:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 409:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 410:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 411:       setBook(created);
 412:       setSession(blank);
 413:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 414:       setError("");
 415:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 416:     } catch (cause) {
 417:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 418:     }
 419:   }

 421:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 422:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove Ã¢â‚¬Å“${item.title}Ã¢â‚¬Â and its local PDF from this browser? Cloud copies are not affected.`)) return;
 423:     try {
 424:       await Promise.all([removeBook(item.id), removeSession(item.id)]);
 425:       const remaining = books.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== item.id).sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt);
 426:       setBooks(remaining);
 427:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 428:         const next = { ...current };
 429:         delete next[item.id];
 430:         return next;
 431:       });
 432:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 433:         const nextBook = remaining[0] ?? null;
 434:         setBook(nextBook);
 435:         setSession(nextBook ? sessionIndex[nextBook.id] ?? newSession(nextBook.id) : null);
 436:         await setActiveBookId(nextBook?.id ?? null);
 437:       }
 438:     } catch (cause) {
 439:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 440:     }
 441:   }

 443:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 444:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 445:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 446:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 447:     try {
 448:       await putBook(renamed);
 449:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 450:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 451:     } catch (cause) {
 452:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 453:     }
 454:   }

 536:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 537:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 538:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 539:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 540:       return;
 541:     }
 542:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 543:     try {
 544:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 545:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 546:       preview.width = crop.width;
 547:       preview.height = crop.height;
 548:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 549:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 550:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 551:     } catch (cause) {
 552:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 553:       return;
 554:     }
 555:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 556:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 557:     setTransferFen("");
 558:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 559:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 560:     setRecognitionError("");
 561:     setTransferPiece("P");
 562:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 563:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 564:     try {
 565:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 566:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 567:       });
 568:       const form = new FormData();
 569:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 570:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 571:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 572:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 573:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 574:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 575:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 576:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 577:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 578:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 579:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 580:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 581:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 582:       }
 583:     } catch (cause) {
 584:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 585:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 586:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 587:     }
 588:   }
 589: 
 590:   function closeTransfer() {
 591:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 592:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 593:     setTransferPreview("");
 594:     setTransferFen("");
 595:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 596:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 597:     setRecognitionError("");
 598:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 599:   }

 601:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 602:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 603:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 604:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 605:       return;
 606:     }
 607:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 608:     if (!board) {
 609:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 610:       return;
 611:     }
 612:     const row = displayRow;
 613:     const col = displayCol;
 614:     try {
 615:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 616:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 617:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 618:       setRecognitionError("");
 619:     } catch (cause) {
 620:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 621:     }
 622:   }
 623: 
 624:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 625:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 626:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 627:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 628:       return;
 629:     }
 630:     try {
 631:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 632:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 633:       setRecognitionError("");
 634:     } catch (cause) {
 635:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 636:     }
 637:   }

 639:   function confirmTransfer() {
 640:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 641:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 642:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 643:       return;
 644:     }
 645:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 646:       closeTransfer();
 647:     }
 648:   }
 649: 
 650:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 651:     if (!session) return;
 652:     try {
 653:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 654:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 655:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 656:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 657:       if (promote) {
 658:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 659:         if (!choice) return;
 660:         switch (choice) {
 661:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 662:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 663:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 664:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 665:           default:
 666:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 667:             return;
 668:         }
 669:       }
 670:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 671:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 672:       patchSession({
 673:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 674:         moves: nextMoves,
 675:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 676:       });
 677:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 678:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 679:       setError("");
 680:     } catch {
 681:       const piece = game.get(to);
 682:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 683:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 684:     }
 685:   }
 686: 
 687:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 688:     if (!session) return;
 689:     if (annotationMode) {
 690:       if (!arrowStart) {
 691:         setArrowStart(square);
 692:         return;
 693:       }
 694:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 695:       setArrowStart(null);
 696:       setArrowHover(null);
 697:       return;
 698:     }
 699:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 700:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 701:       return;
 702:     }
 703:     const piece = game.get(square);
 704:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 705:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 706:   }

 766:   async function detectBoards() {
 767:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 768:     if (!API_BASE) {
 769:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Start the optional CV service and set VITE_API_BASE_URL, or draw a board region manually.");
 770:       return;
 771:     }
 772:     setDetecting(true);
 773:     setError("");
 774:     try {
 775:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 776:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")), "image/png");
 777:       });
 778:       const form = new FormData();
 779:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 780:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 781:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 782:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 783:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map((item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index));
 784:       patchSession((current) => ({
 785:         ...current,
 786:         candidatesByPage: { ...current.candidatesByPage, [String(current.page)]: candidates },
 787:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 788:       }));
 789:       setNotice(candidates.length ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.` : "No board candidates found. You can draw a region manually.");
 790:     } catch (cause) {
 791:       setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 792:     } finally {
 793:       setDetecting(false);
 794:     }
 795:   }

 802:   function startCropEdit(
 803:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,

 815:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 816:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 817:     if (!manualMode) return;
 818: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 819: if (!canvas) return;
 820: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 821: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 822: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 823: if (
 824:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 825:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 826:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 827:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 828: ) return;
 829:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 830:     if (!point) return;
 831:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 832:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 833:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 834:     setDragSelection(selection);
 835:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 836:   }

 838:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 839:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 840:     if (edit) {
 841:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 842:       if (!point || !session) return;
 843:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 844:       patchSession((current) => {
 845:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 846:         return {
 847:           ...current,
 848:           candidatesByPage: {
 849:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 850:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 851:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 852:           },
 853:         };
 854:       });
 855:       return;
 856:     }
 857:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 858:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 859:     if (point) {
 860:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 861:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 862:       setDragSelection(selection);
 863:     }
 864:   }
 865: 
 866:   function finishRegion() {
 867:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 868:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 869:       return;
 870:     }
 871:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 872:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 873:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 874:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 875:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 876:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 877:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 878:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 879:     setDragSelection(null);
 880:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 881:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 882:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 883:       x, y, width, height,

 906:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 907:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 908:     try {
 909:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 910:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 911:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 912:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 913:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 914:       const scale = mode === "width"
 915:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 916:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 917:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 918:     } catch (cause) {
 919:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 920:     }
 921:   }

 240: 
 241:   useEffect(() => {
 242:     function onKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 243:       if (!session || !book || isTypingTarget(event.target)) return;
 244:       if (cropEditingId && ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key)) {
 245:         const candidate = (session.candidatesByPage[String(session.page)] ?? []).find((item) => item.id === cropEditingId);
 246:         if (!candidate) return;
 247:         const step = event.shiftKey ? 0.01 : 0.002;
 248:         const x = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
 249:         const y = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
 250:         const next = editCrop(candidate, "move", x, y);
 251:         patchSession((current) => {
 252:           const pageKey = String(current.page);
 253:           return {
 254:             ...current,
 255:             candidatesByPage: {
 256:               ...current.candidatesByPage,
 257:               [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((item) =>
 258:                 item.id === candidate.id ? { ...item, ...next } : item),
 259:             },
 260:           };
 261:         });
 262:         event.preventDefault();
 263:         return;
 264:       }
 265:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 266:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 267:     }
 268:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 269:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 270:   });
 271: 
 272:   useEffect(() => () => {
 273:     engineRef.current?.dispose();
 274:     engineRef.current = null;
 275:   }, []);
 276: 
 277:   const sortedBooks = useMemo(() => [...books].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt), [books]);
 278:   const visibleBooks = useMemo(() => {
 279:     const needle = bookSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
 280:     return sortedBooks.filter((item) => {
 281:       const saved = sessionIndex[item.id];
 282:       const matchesTab =
 283:         libraryTab === "all" || libraryTab === "recent" || libraryTab === "local" ||
 284:         (libraryTab === "bookmarks" && (saved?.bookmarks.length ?? 0) > 0) ||
 285:         (libraryTab === "positions" && (saved?.positions.length ?? 0) > 0) ||
 286:         (libraryTab === "progress" && (saved?.page ?? 1) > 1);
 287:       return matchesTab && item.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle);
 288:     });
 289:   }, [bookSearch, libraryTab, sessionIndex, sortedBooks]);
 290: 
 291:   const game = useMemo(() => {
 292:     if (!session) return new Chess();
 293:     try {
 294:       return makePosition(session.lineBaseFen, session.moves, session.moveIndex);
 295:     } catch {
 296:       try { return new Chess(session.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 297:     }
 298:   }, [session]);
 299:   const legalTargets = useMemo(() => {
 300:     if (!selectedSquare) return new Set<string>();
 301:     return new Set(game.moves({ square: selectedSquare, verbose: true }).map((move) => move.to));
 302:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 303:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 304:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 305:     try { return makePosition(session?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, session?.moves ?? [], session?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 306:     catch { return []; }
 307:   }, [session]);
 308:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 309:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 310:     : null);
 311:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 312:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 313:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 314:   );
 315: 
 316:   useEffect(() => {
 317:     setUserArrows([]);
 318:     setArrowStart(null);
 319:     setArrowHover(null);
 320:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 321:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 322: 
 323:   useEffect(() => {
 324:     if (engineEnabled) engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 325:   }, [engineEnabled, session?.currentFen, session?.moveIndex, engineDepth]);

 327:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 328:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 329:   }

 331:   function toggleEngine() {
 332:     if (engineEnabled) {
 333:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 334:       engineRef.current = null;
 335:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 336:       setEngineStatus("off");
 337:       setEngineScore(null);
 338:       setEngineMessage("");
 339:       return;
 340:     }
 341:     try {
 342:       setEngineScore(null);
 343:       setEngineMessage("");
 344:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 345:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 346:         (status, message) => {
 347:           setEngineStatus(status);
 348:           if (status === "error") {
 349:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 350:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 351:             setEngineScore(null);
 352:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 353:             engineRef.current = null;
 354:           }
 355:         },
 356:         setEngineScore,
 357:       );
 358:       engineRef.current = client;
 359:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 360:     } catch (cause) {
 361:       setEngineStatus("error");
 362:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 363:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 364:     }
 365:   }

 367:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 368:     setSession((current) => {
 369:       if (!current) return current;
 370:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 371:     });
 372:   }

 374:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 375:     try {
 376:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 377:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 378:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 379:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 380:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 381:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 382:       setBook(opened);
 383:       setSession(nextSession);
 384:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 385:       setError("");
 386:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 387:     } catch (cause) {
 388:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 389:     }
 390:   }

 392:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 393:     if (!file) return;
 394:     try {
 395:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 396:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 397:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 398:       const now = Date.now();
 399:       const created: BookRecord = {
 400:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 401:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 402:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 403:         byteLength: file.size,
 404:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 405:         addedAt: now,
 406:       };
 407:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 408:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 409:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 410:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 411:       setBook(created);
 412:       setSession(blank);
 413:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 414:       setError("");
 415:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 416:     } catch (cause) {
 417:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 418:     }
 419:   }

 421:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 422:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove "${item.title}" from your library?`)) return;
 423: 
 424:     try {
 425:       await removeBook(item.id);
 426:       await removeSession(item.id);
 427: 
 428:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 429:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 430:         const next = { ...current };
 431:         delete next[item.id];
 432:         return next;
 433:       });
 434: 
 435:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 436:         setBook(null);
 437:         setSession(null);
 438:         setPdf(null);
 439:       }
 440: 
 441:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 442:       setError("");
 443:     } catch (cause) {
 444:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 445:     }
 446:   }
 447:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 448:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 449:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 450:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 451:     try {
 452:       await putBook(renamed);
 453:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 454:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 455:     } catch (cause) {
 456:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 457:     }
 458:   }

 481:       setLastMove(null);

 486:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 487:       return false;
 488:     }

 540:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 541:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 542:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 543:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 544:       return;
 545:     }
 546:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 547:     try {
 548:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 549:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 550:       preview.width = crop.width;
 551:       preview.height = crop.height;
 552:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 553:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 554:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 555:     } catch (cause) {
 556:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 557:       return;
 558:     }
 559:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 560:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 561:     setTransferFen("");
 562:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 563:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 564:     setRecognitionError("");
 565:     setTransferPiece("P");
 566:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 567:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 568:     try {
 569:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 570:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 571:       });
 572:       const form = new FormData();
 573:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 574:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 575:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 576:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 577:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 578:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 579:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 580:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 581:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 582:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 583:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 584:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 585:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 586:       }
 587:     } catch (cause) {
 588:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 589:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 590:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 591:     }
 592:   }
 593: 
 594:   function closeTransfer() {
 595:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 596:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 597:     setTransferPreview("");
 598:     setTransferFen("");
 599:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 600:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 601:     setRecognitionError("");
 602:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 603:   }

 605:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 606:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 607:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 608:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 609:       return;
 610:     }
 611:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 612:     if (!board) {
 613:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 614:       return;
 615:     }
 616:     const row = displayRow;
 617:     const col = displayCol;
 618:     try {
 619:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 620:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 621:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 622:       setRecognitionError("");
 623:     } catch (cause) {
 624:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 625:     }
 626:   }
 627: 
 628:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 629:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 630:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 631:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 632:       return;
 633:     }
 634:     try {
 635:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 636:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 637:       setRecognitionError("");
 638:     } catch (cause) {
 639:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 640:     }
 641:   }
 642: 
 643:   function confirmTransfer() {
 644:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 645:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 646:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 647:       return;
 648:     }
 649:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 650:       closeTransfer();
 651:     }
 652:   }
 653: 
 654:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 655:     if (!session) return;
 656:     try {
 657:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 658:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 659:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 660:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 661:       if (promote) {
 662:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 663:         if (!choice) return;
 664:         switch (choice) {
 665:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 666:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 667:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 668:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 669:           default:
 670:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 671:             return;
 672:         }
 673:       }
 674:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 675:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 676:       patchSession({
 677:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 678:         moves: nextMoves,
 679:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 680:       });
 681:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 682:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 683:       setError("");
 684:     } catch {
 685:       const piece = game.get(to);
 686:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 687:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 688:     }
 689:   }
 690: 
 691:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 692:     if (!session) return;
 693:     if (annotationMode) {
 694:       if (!arrowStart) {
 695:         setArrowStart(square);
 696:         return;
 697:       }
 698:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 699:       setArrowStart(null);
 700:       setArrowHover(null);
 701:       return;
 702:     }
 703:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 704:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 705:       return;
 706:     }
 707:     const piece = game.get(square);
 708:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 709:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 710:   }

 712:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 713:     if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;

 716:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 717:     if (!square) return;
 718:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 719:     arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 720:     setArrowStart(square);
 721:     setArrowHover(square);
 722:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 723:   }

 731:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {

 734:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

 736:     if (to && to !== from) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 737:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 738:     setArrowStart(null);
 739:     setArrowHover(null);

 770:   async function detectBoards() {
 771:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 772:     if (!API_BASE) {
 773:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Start the optional CV service and set VITE_API_BASE_URL, or draw a board region manually.");
 774:       return;
 775:     }
 776:     setDetecting(true);
 777:     setError("");
 778:     try {
 779:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 780:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")), "image/png");
 781:       });
 782:       const form = new FormData();
 783:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 784:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 785:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 786:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 787:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map((item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index));
 788:       patchSession((current) => ({
 789:         ...current,
 790:         candidatesByPage: { ...current.candidatesByPage, [String(current.page)]: candidates },
 791:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 792:       }));
 793:       setNotice(candidates.length ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.` : "No board candidates found. You can draw a region manually.");
 794:     } catch (cause) {
 795:       setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 796:     } finally {
 797:       setDetecting(false);
 798:     }
 799:   }

 806:   function startCropEdit(
 807:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 808:     candidate: Candidate,
 809:     handle: CropHandle,
 810:   ) {
 811:     event.stopPropagation();
 812:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 813:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
 814:     if (!point || !stage) return;
 815:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
 816:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 817:   }
 818: 
 819:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 820:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 821:     if (!manualMode) return;
 822: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 823: if (!canvas) return;
 824: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 825: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 826: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 827: if (
 828:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 829:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 830:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 831:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 832: ) return;
 833:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 834:     if (!point) return;
 835:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 836:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 837:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 838:     setDragSelection(selection);
 839:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 840:   }
 841: 
 842:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 843:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 844:     if (edit) {
 845:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 846:       if (!point || !session) return;
 847:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 848:       patchSession((current) => {
 849:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 850:         return {
 851:           ...current,
 852:           candidatesByPage: {
 853:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 854:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 855:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 856:           },
 857:         };
 858:       });
 859:       return;
 860:     }
 861:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 862:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 863:     if (point) {
 864:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 865:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 866:       setDragSelection(selection);
 867:     }
 868:   }
 869: 
 870:   function finishRegion() {
 871:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 872:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 873:       return;
 874:     }
 875:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 876:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 877:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 878:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 879:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 880:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 881:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 882:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 883:     setDragSelection(null);
 884:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 885:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 886:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 887:       x, y, width, height,
 888:       relativeScore: 1,
 889:       source: "manual",
 890:     };
 891:     patchSession((current) => ({
 892:       ...current,
 893:       candidatesByPage: {
 894:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 895:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 896:       },
 897:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 898:     }));
 899:     setManualMode(false);
 900:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 901:   }
 902: 
 903:   function cancelRegion() {
 904:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 905:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 906:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 907:     setDragSelection(null);
 908:   }

 910:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 911:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 912:     try {
 913:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 914:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 915:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 916:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 917:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 918:       const scale = mode === "width"
 919:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 920:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 921:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 922:     } catch (cause) {
 923:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 924:     }
 925:   }

 331:   function toggleEngine() {
 332:     if (engineEnabled) {
 333:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 334:       engineRef.current = null;
 335:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 336:       setEngineStatus("off");
 337:       setEngineScore(null);
 338:       setEngineMessage("");
 339:       return;
 340:     }
 341:     try {
 342:       setEngineScore(null);
 343:       setEngineMessage("");
 344:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 345:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 346:         (status, message) => {
 347:           setEngineStatus(status);
 348:           if (status === "error") {
 349:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 350:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 351:             setEngineScore(null);
 352:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 353:             engineRef.current = null;
 354:           }
 355:         },
 356:         setEngineScore,
 357:       );
 358:       engineRef.current = client;
 359:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 360:     } catch (cause) {
 361:       setEngineStatus("error");
 362:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 363:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 364:     }
 365:   }

 367:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 368:     setSession((current) => {
 369:       if (!current) return current;
 370:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 371:     });
 372:   }

 374:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 375:     try {
 376:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 377:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 378:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 379:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 380:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 381:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 382:       setBook(opened);
 383:       setSession(nextSession);
 384:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 385:       setError("");
 386:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 387:     } catch (cause) {
 388:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 389:     }
 390:   }

 392:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 393:     if (!file) return;
 394:     try {
 395:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 396:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 397:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 398:       const now = Date.now();
 399:       const created: BookRecord = {
 400:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 401:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 402:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 403:         byteLength: file.size,
 404:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 405:         addedAt: now,
 406:       };
 407:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 408:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 409:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 410:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 411:       setBook(created);
 412:       setSession(blank);
 413:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 414:       setError("");
 415:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 416:     } catch (cause) {
 417:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 418:     }
 419:   }

 421:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 422:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove â€œ${item.title}â€ and its local PDF from this browser? Cloud copies are not affected.`)) return;
 423:     try {
 424:       await Promise.all([removeBook(item.id), removeSession(item.id)]);
 425:       const remaining = books.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== item.id).sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt);
 426:       setBooks(remaining);
 427:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 428:         const next = { ...current };
 429:         delete next[item.id];
 430:         return next;
 431:       });
 432:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 433:         const nextBook = remaining[0] ?? null;
 434:         setBook(nextBook);
 435:         setSession(nextBook ? sessionIndex[nextBook.id] ?? newSession(nextBook.id) : null);
 436:         await setActiveBookId(nextBook?.id ?? null);
 437:       }
 438:     } catch (cause) {
 439:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 440:     }
 441:   }

 443:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 444:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();

 446:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 447:     try {
 448:       await putBook(renamed);
 449:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 450:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 451:     } catch (cause) {
 452:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 453:     }
 454:   }

 536:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 537:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 538:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 539:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 540:       return;
 541:     }
 542:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 543:     try {
 544:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 545:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 546:       preview.width = crop.width;
 547:       preview.height = crop.height;
 548:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 549:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 550:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 551:     } catch (cause) {
 552:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 553:       return;
 554:     }
 555:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 556:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 557:     setTransferFen("");
 558:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 559:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 560:     setRecognitionError("");
 561:     setTransferPiece("P");
 562:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 563:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 564:     try {
 565:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 566:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 567:       });
 568:       const form = new FormData();
 569:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 570:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 571:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 572:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 573:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 574:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 575:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 576:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 577:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 578:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 579:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 580:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 581:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 582:       }
 583:     } catch (cause) {
 584:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 585:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 586:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 587:     }
 588:   }
 589: 
 590:   function closeTransfer() {
 591:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 592:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 593:     setTransferPreview("");
 594:     setTransferFen("");
 595:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 596:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 597:     setRecognitionError("");
 598:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 599:   }

 601:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 602:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 603:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 604:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 605:       return;
 606:     }
 607:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 608:     if (!board) {
 609:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 610:       return;
 611:     }
 612:     const row = displayRow;
 613:     const col = displayCol;
 614:     try {
 615:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 616:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 617:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 618:       setRecognitionError("");
 619:     } catch (cause) {
 620:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 621:     }
 622:   }
 623: 
 624:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 625:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 626:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 627:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 628:       return;
 629:     }
 630:     try {
 631:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 632:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 633:       setRecognitionError("");
 634:     } catch (cause) {
 635:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 636:     }
 637:   }
 638: 
 639:   function confirmTransfer() {
 640:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 641:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 642:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 643:       return;
 644:     }
 645:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 646:       closeTransfer();
 647:     }
 648:   }
 649: 
 650:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 651:     if (!session) return;
 652:     try {
 653:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 654:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 655:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 656:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 657:       if (promote) {
 658:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 659:         if (!choice) return;
 660:         switch (choice) {
 661:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 662:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 663:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 664:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 665:           default:
 666:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 667:             return;
 668:         }
 669:       }
 670:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 671:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 672:       patchSession({
 673:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 674:         moves: nextMoves,
 675:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 676:       });
 677:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 678:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 679:       setError("");
 680:     } catch {
 681:       const piece = game.get(to);
 682:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 683:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 684:     }
 685:   }
 686: 
 687:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 688:     if (!session) return;
 689:     if (annotationMode) {
 690:       if (!arrowStart) {
 691:         setArrowStart(square);
 692:         return;
 693:       }
 694:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 695:       setArrowStart(null);
 696:       setArrowHover(null);
 697:       return;
 698:     }
 699:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 700:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 701:       return;
 702:     }
 703:     const piece = game.get(square);
 704:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 705:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 706:   }

 708:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 709:     if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 710:     event.preventDefault();
 711:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 712:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 713:     if (!square) return;
 714:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 715:     arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 716:     setArrowStart(square);
 717:     setArrowHover(square);
 718:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 719:   }
 720: 
 721:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 722:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 723:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 724:     setArrowHover(boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped)));
 725:   }
 726: 
 727:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 728:     const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 729:     if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 730:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 731:     const to = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 732:     if (to && to !== from) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 733:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 734:     setArrowStart(null);
 735:     setArrowHover(null);
 736:   }

 738:   function cancelBoardArrowGesture() {
 739:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 740:     setArrowStart(null);
 741:     setArrowHover(null);
 742:   }

 744:   function jumpToMove(index: number) {
 745:     if (!session) return;
 746:     try {
 747:       const next = makePosition(session.lineBaseFen, session.moves, index);
 748:       const last = next.history({ verbose: true }).at(-1);
 749:       patchSession({ moveIndex: index, currentFen: next.fen() });
 750:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
 751:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 752:     } catch (cause) {
 753:       setError(`Could not navigate to move: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 754:     }
 755:   }

 758:     try {
 759:       await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
 760:       setNotice("Copied to clipboard.");
 761:     } catch (cause) {
 762:       setError(`Clipboard access failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 763:     }
 764:   }

 766:   async function detectBoards() {
 767:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 768:     if (!API_BASE) {
 769:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Start the optional CV service and set VITE_API_BASE_URL, or draw a board region manually.");
 770:       return;
 771:     }
 772:     setDetecting(true);
 773:     setError("");
 774:     try {
 775:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 776:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")), "image/png");
 777:       });
 778:       const form = new FormData();
 779:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 780:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 781:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 782:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 783:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map((item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index));
 784:       patchSession((current) => ({
 785:         ...current,
 786:         candidatesByPage: { ...current.candidatesByPage, [String(current.page)]: candidates },
 787:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 788:       }));
 789:       setNotice(candidates.length ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.` : "No board candidates found. You can draw a region manually.");
 790:     } catch (cause) {
 791:       setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 792:     } finally {
 793:       setDetecting(false);
 794:     }
 795:   }

 797:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {

 799:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 800:   }

 802:   function startCropEdit(
 803:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 804:     candidate: Candidate,
 805:     handle: CropHandle,
 806:   ) {
 807:     event.stopPropagation();
 808:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 809:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
 810:     if (!point || !stage) return;
 811:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
 812:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 813:   }
 814: 
 815:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 816:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 817:     if (!manualMode || event.target !== canvasRef.current) return;
 818:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 819:     if (!point) return;
 820:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 821:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 822:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 823:     setDragSelection(selection);
 824:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 825:   }
 826: 
 827:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 828:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 829:     if (edit) {
 830:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 831:       if (!point || !session) return;
 832:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 833:       patchSession((current) => {
 834:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 835:         return {
 836:           ...current,
 837:           candidatesByPage: {
 838:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 839:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 840:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 841:           },
 842:         };
 843:       });
 844:       return;
 845:     }
 846:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 847:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 848:     if (point) {
 849:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 850:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 851:       setDragSelection(selection);
 852:     }
 853:   }
 854: 
 855:   function finishRegion() {
 856:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 857:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 858:       return;
 859:     }
 860:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 861:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 862:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 863:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 864:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 865:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 866:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 867:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 868:     setDragSelection(null);
 869:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 870:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 871:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 872:       x, y, width, height,
 873:       relativeScore: 1,
 874:       source: "manual",
 875:     };
 876:     patchSession((current) => ({
 877:       ...current,
 878:       candidatesByPage: {
 879:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 880:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 881:       },
 882:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 883:     }));
 884:     setManualMode(false);
 885:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 886:   }
 887: 
 888:   function cancelRegion() {
 889:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 890:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 891:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 892:     setDragSelection(null);
 893:   }

 895:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 896:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 897:     try {
 898:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 899:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 900:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 901:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 902:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 903:       const scale = mode === "width"
 904:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 905:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 906:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 907:     } catch (cause) {
 908:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 909:     }
 910:   }

 327:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {

 331:   function toggleEngine() {
 332:     if (engineEnabled) {
 333:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 334:       engineRef.current = null;
 335:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 336:       setEngineStatus("off");
 337:       setEngineScore(null);
 338:       setEngineMessage("");
 339:       return;
 340:     }
 341:     try {
 342:       setEngineScore(null);
 343:       setEngineMessage("");
 344:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 345:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 346:         (status, message) => {
 347:           setEngineStatus(status);
 348:           if (status === "error") {
 349:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 350:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 351:             setEngineScore(null);
 352:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 353:             engineRef.current = null;
 354:           }
 355:         },
 356:         setEngineScore,
 357:       );
 358:       engineRef.current = client;
 359:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 360:     } catch (cause) {
 361:       setEngineStatus("error");
 362:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 363:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 364:     }
 365:   }

 367:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 368:     setSession((current) => {
 369:       if (!current) return current;
 370:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 371:     });
 372:   }

 374:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 375:     try {
 376:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 377:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 378:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 379:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 380:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 381:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 382:       setBook(opened);
 383:       setSession(nextSession);
 384:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 385:       setError("");
 386:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 387:     } catch (cause) {
 388:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 389:     }
 390:   }

 392:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 393:     if (!file) return;
 394:     try {
 395:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 396:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 397:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 398:       const now = Date.now();
 399:       const created: BookRecord = {
 400:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 401:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 402:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 403:         byteLength: file.size,
 404:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 405:         addedAt: now,
 406:       };
 407:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 408:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 409:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 410:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 411:       setBook(created);
 412:       setSession(blank);
 413:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 414:       setError("");
 415:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 416:     } catch (cause) {
 417:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 418:     }
 419:   }

 421:     async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 422:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove "${item.title}" from your library?`)) return;
 423: 
 424:     try {
 425:       await removeBook(item.id);
 426:       await removeSession(item.id);
 427: 
 428:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 429:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 430:         const next = { ...current };
 431:         delete next[item.id];
 432:         return next;
 433:       });
 434: 
 435:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 436:         setBook(null);
 437:         setSession(null);
 438:         setPdf(null);
 439:       }
 440: 
 441:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 442:       setError("");
 443:     } catch (cause) {
 444:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 445:     }
 446:   }

 448:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 449:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 450:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 451:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 452:     try {
 453:       await putBook(renamed);
 454:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 455:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 456:     } catch (cause) {
 457:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 458:     }
 459:   }

 462:     if (!session) return;
 463:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 464:   }

 466:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 467:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 468:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 469:   }

 471:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 472:     if (!session) return false;
 473:     try {
 474:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 475:       patchSession({
 476:         originalFen: fen,
 477:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 478:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 479:         moves: [],
 480:         moveIndex: 0,
 481:       });
 482:       setLastMove(null);
 483:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 484:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 485:       return true;
 486:     } catch (cause) {
 487:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 488:       return false;
 489:     }
 490:   }

 541:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 542:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 543:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 544:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 545:       return;
 546:     }
 547:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 548:     try {
 549:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 550:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 551:       preview.width = crop.width;
 552:       preview.height = crop.height;
 553:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 554:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 555:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 556:     } catch (cause) {
 557:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 558:       return;
 559:     }
 560:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 561:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 562:     setTransferFen("");
 563:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 564:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 565:     setRecognitionError("");
 566:     setTransferPiece("P");
 567:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 568:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 569:     try {
 570:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 571:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 572:       });
 573:       const form = new FormData();
 574:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 575:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 576:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 577:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 578:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 579:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 580:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 581:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 582:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 583:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 584:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 585:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 586:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 587:       }
 588:     } catch (cause) {
 589:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 590:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 591:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 592:     }
 593:   }
 594: 
 595:   function closeTransfer() {
 596:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 597:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 598:     setTransferPreview("");
 599:     setTransferFen("");
 600:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 601:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 602:     setRecognitionError("");
 603:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 604:   }
 605: 
 606:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 607:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 608:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 609:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 610:       return;
 611:     }
 612:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 613:     if (!board) {
 614:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 615:       return;
 616:     }
 617:     const row = displayRow;
 618:     const col = displayCol;
 619:     try {
 620:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 621:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 622:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 623:       setRecognitionError("");
 624:     } catch (cause) {
 625:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 626:     }
 627:   }
 628: 
 629:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 630:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 631:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 632:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 633:       return;
 634:     }
 635:     try {
 636:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 637:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 638:       setRecognitionError("");
 639:     } catch (cause) {
 640:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 641:     }
 642:   }
 643: 
 644:   function confirmTransfer() {
 645:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 646:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 647:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 648:       return;
 649:     }
 650:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 651:       closeTransfer();
 652:     }
 653:   }
 654: 
 655:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 656:     if (!session) return;
 657:     try {
 658:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 659:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 660:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 661:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 662:       if (promote) {
 663:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 664:         if (!choice) return;
 665:         switch (choice) {
 666:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 667:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 668:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 669:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 670:           default:
 671:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 672:             return;
 673:         }
 674:       }
 675:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 676:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 677:       patchSession({
 678:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 679:         moves: nextMoves,
 680:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 681:       });
 682:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 683:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 684:       setError("");
 685:     } catch {
 686:       const piece = game.get(to);
 687:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 688:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 689:     }
 690:   }
 691: 
 692:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 693:     if (!session) return;
 694:     if (annotationMode) {
 695:       if (!arrowStart) {
 696:         setArrowStart(square);
 697:         return;
 698:       }
 699:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 700:       setArrowStart(null);
 701:       setArrowHover(null);
 702:       return;
 703:     }
 704:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 705:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 706:       return;
 707:     }
 708:     const piece = game.get(square);
 709:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 710:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 711:   }

 713:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 714:     if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 715:     event.preventDefault();
 716:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 717:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 718:     if (!square) return;
 719:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 720:     arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 721:     setArrowStart(square);
 722:     setArrowHover(square);
 723:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 724:   }

 732:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {

 737:     if (to && to !== from) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 738:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 739:     setArrowStart(null);
 740:     setArrowHover(null);
 741:   }

 749:   function jumpToMove(index: number) {
 750:     if (!session) return;
 751:     try {
 752:       const next = makePosition(session.lineBaseFen, session.moves, index);
 753:       const last = next.history({ verbose: true }).at(-1);
 754:       patchSession({ moveIndex: index, currentFen: next.fen() });
 755:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
 756:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 757:     } catch (cause) {
 758:       setError(`Could not navigate to move: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 759:     }
 760:   }
