 802:   function startCropEdit(
 803:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 804:     candidate: Candidate,
 805:     handle: CropHandle,
 806:   ) {
 807:     event.stopPropagation();
 808:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 809:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
 810:     if (!point || !stage) return;
 811:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
 812:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 813:   }
 814: 
 815:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 816:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 817:     if (!manualMode) return;
 818: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 819: if (!canvas) return;
 820: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 821: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 822: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 823: if (
 824:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 825:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 826:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 827:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 828: ) return;
 829:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 830:     if (!point) return;
 831:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 832:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 833:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 834:     setDragSelection(selection);
 835:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 836:   }
 837: 
 838:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 839:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 840:     if (edit) {
 841:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 842:       if (!point || !session) return;
 843:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 844:       patchSession((current) => {
 845:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 846:         return {
 847:           ...current,
 848:           candidatesByPage: {
 849:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 850:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 851:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 852:           },
 853:         };
 854:       });
 855:       return;
 856:     }
 857:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 858:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 859:     if (point) {
 860:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 861:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 862:       setDragSelection(selection);
 863:     }
 864:   }
 865: 
 866:   function finishRegion() {
 867:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 868:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 869:       return;
 870:     }
 871:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 872:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 873:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 874:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 875:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 876:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 877:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 878:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 879:     setDragSelection(null);
 880:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 881:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 882:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 883:       x, y, width, height,
 884:       relativeScore: 1,
 885:       source: "manual",
 886:     };
 887:     patchSession((current) => ({
 888:       ...current,
 889:       candidatesByPage: {
 890:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 891:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 892:       },
 893:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 894:     }));
 895:     setManualMode(false);
 896:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 897:   }
 898: 
 899:   function cancelRegion() {
 900:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 901:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 902:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 903:     setDragSelection(null);
 904:   }

 906:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 907:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 908:     try {
 909:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 910:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 911:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 912:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 913:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 914:       const scale = mode === "width"
 915:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 916:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 917:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 918:     } catch (cause) {
 919:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 920:     }
 921:   }

  52: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  53:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  54:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  55:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";

 331:   function toggleEngine() {
 332:     if (engineEnabled) {
 333:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 334:       engineRef.current = null;
 335:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 336:       setEngineStatus("off");
 337:       setEngineScore(null);
 338:       setEngineMessage("");
 339:       return;
 340:     }
 341:     try {
 342:       setEngineScore(null);
 343:       setEngineMessage("");
 344:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 345:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 346:         (status, message) => {
 347:           setEngineStatus(status);
 348:           if (status === "error") {
 349:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 350:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 351:             setEngineScore(null);
 352:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 353:             engineRef.current = null;
 354:           }
 355:         },
 356:         setEngineScore,
 357:       );
 358:       engineRef.current = client;
 359:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 360:     } catch (cause) {
 361:       setEngineStatus("error");
 362:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 363:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 364:     }
 365:   }

 367:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 368:     setSession((current) => {
 369:       if (!current) return current;
 370:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 371:     });
 372:   }

 374:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 375:     try {
 376:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 377:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 378:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 379:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 380:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 381:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 382:       setBook(opened);
 383:       setSession(nextSession);
 384:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 385:       setError("");
 386:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 387:     } catch (cause) {
 388:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 389:     }
 390:   }

 392:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 393:     if (!file) return;
 394:     try {
 395:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 396:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 397:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 398:       const now = Date.now();
 399:       const created: BookRecord = {
 400:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 401:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 402:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 403:         byteLength: file.size,
 404:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 405:         addedAt: now,
 406:       };
 407:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 408:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 409:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 410:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 411:       setBook(created);
 412:       setSession(blank);
 413:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 414:       setError("");
 415:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 416:     } catch (cause) {
 417:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 418:     }
 419:   }

 421:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 422:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove "${item.title}" from your library?`)) return;
 423: 
 424:     try {
 425:       await removeBook(item.id);
 426:       await removeSession(item.id);
 427: 
 428:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 429:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 430:         const next = { ...current };
 431:         delete next[item.id];
 432:         return next;
 433:       });
 434: 
 435:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 436:         setBook(null);
 437:         setSession(null);
 438:         setPdf(null);
 439:       }
 440: 
 441:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 442:       setError("");
 443:     } catch (cause) {
 444:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 445:     }
 446:   }
 447:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 448:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 449:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 450:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 451:     try {
 452:       await putBook(renamed);
 453:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 454:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 455:     } catch (cause) {
 456:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 457:     }
 458:   }

 540:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 541:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 542:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 543:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 544:       return;
 545:     }
 546:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 547:     try {
 548:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 549:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 550:       preview.width = crop.width;
 551:       preview.height = crop.height;
 552:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 553:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 554:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 555:     } catch (cause) {
 556:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 557:       return;
 558:     }
 559:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 560:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 561:     setTransferFen("");
 562:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 563:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 564:     setRecognitionError("");
 565:     setTransferPiece("P");
 566:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 567:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 568:     try {
 569:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 570:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 571:       });
 572:       const form = new FormData();
 573:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 574:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 575:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 576:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 577:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 578:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 579:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 580:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 581:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 582:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 583:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 584:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 585:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 586:       }
 587:     } catch (cause) {
 588:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 589:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 590:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 591:     }
 592:   }
 593: 
 594:   function closeTransfer() {
 595:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 596:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 597:     setTransferPreview("");
 598:     setTransferFen("");
 599:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 600:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 601:     setRecognitionError("");
 602:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 603:   }
 604: 
 605:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 606:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 607:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 608:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 609:       return;
 610:     }
 611:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 612:     if (!board) {
 613:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 614:       return;
 615:     }
 616:     const row = displayRow;
 617:     const col = displayCol;
 618:     try {
 619:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 620:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 621:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 622:       setRecognitionError("");
 623:     } catch (cause) {
 624:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 625:     }
 626:   }
 627: 
 628:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 629:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 630:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 631:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 632:       return;
 633:     }
 634:     try {
 635:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 636:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 637:       setRecognitionError("");
 638:     } catch (cause) {
 639:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 640:     }
 641:   }
 642: 
 643:   function confirmTransfer() {
 644:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 645:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 646:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 647:       return;
 648:     }
 649:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 650:       closeTransfer();
 651:     }
 652:   }

 654:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 655:     if (!session) return;
 656:     try {
 657:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 658:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 659:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 660:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 661:       if (promote) {
 662:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 663:         if (!choice) return;
 664:         switch (choice) {
 665:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 666:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 667:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 668:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 669:           default:
 670:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 671:             return;
 672:         }
 673:       }
 674:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 675:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 676:       patchSession({
 677:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 678:         moves: nextMoves,
 679:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 680:       });
 681:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 682:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 683:       setError("");
 684:     } catch {
 685:       const piece = game.get(to);
 686:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 687:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 688:     }
 689:   }
 690: 
 691:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 692:     if (!session) return;
 693:     if (annotationMode) {
 694:       if (!arrowStart) {
 695:         setArrowStart(square);
 696:         return;
 697:       }
 698:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 699:       setArrowStart(null);
 700:       setArrowHover(null);
 701:       return;
 702:     }
 703:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 704:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 705:       return;
 706:     }
 707:     const piece = game.get(square);
 708:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 709:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 710:   }

 712:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 713:     if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 714:     event.preventDefault();
 715:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 716:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 717:     if (!square) return;
 718:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 719:     arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 720:     setArrowStart(square);
 721:     setArrowHover(square);
 722:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 723:   }

 727:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

 731:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {

 733:     if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 734:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

 736:     if (to && to !== from) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 737:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 738:     setArrowStart(null);
 739:     setArrowHover(null);
 740:   }

 748:   function jumpToMove(index: number) {
 749:     if (!session) return;
 750:     try {
 751:       const next = makePosition(session.lineBaseFen, session.moves, index);
 752:       const last = next.history({ verbose: true }).at(-1);
 753:       patchSession({ moveIndex: index, currentFen: next.fen() });
 754:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
 755:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 756:     } catch (cause) {
 757:       setError(`Could not navigate to move: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 758:     }
 759:   }

 770:   async function detectBoards() {
 771:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 772:     if (!API_BASE) {
 773:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Start the optional CV service and set VITE_API_BASE_URL, or draw a board region manually.");
 774:       return;
 775:     }
 776:     setDetecting(true);
 777:     setError("");
 778:     try {
 779:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 780:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")), "image/png");
 781:       });
 782:       const form = new FormData();
 783:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 784:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 785:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 786:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 787:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map((item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index));
 788:       patchSession((current) => ({
 789:         ...current,
 790:         candidatesByPage: { ...current.candidatesByPage, [String(current.page)]: candidates },
 791:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 792:       }));
 793:       setNotice(candidates.length ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.` : "No board candidates found. You can draw a region manually.");
 794:     } catch (cause) {
 795:       setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 796:     } finally {
 797:       setDetecting(false);
 798:     }
 799:   }

 819:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 820:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 821:     if (!manualMode) return;
 822: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 823: if (!canvas) return;
 824: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 825: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 826: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 827: if (
 828:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 829:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 830:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 831:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 832: ) return;
 833:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 834:     if (!point) return;
 835:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 836:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 837:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 838:     setDragSelection(selection);
 839:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 840:   }

 842:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 843:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 844:     if (edit) {
 845:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 846:       if (!point || !session) return;
 847:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 848:       patchSession((current) => {
 849:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 850:         return {
 851:           ...current,
 852:           candidatesByPage: {
 853:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 854:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 855:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 856:           },
 857:         };
 858:       });
 859:       return;
 860:     }
 861:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 862:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 863:     if (point) {
 864:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 865:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 866:       setDragSelection(selection);
 867:     }
 868:   }
 869: 
 870:   function finishRegion() {
 871:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 872:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 873:       return;
 874:     }
 875:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 876:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 877:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 878:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 879:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 880:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 881:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 882:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 883:     setDragSelection(null);
 884:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 885:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 886:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 887:       x, y, width, height,
 888:       relativeScore: 1,
 889:       source: "manual",
 890:     };
 891:     patchSession((current) => ({
 892:       ...current,
 893:       candidatesByPage: {
 894:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 895:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 896:       },
 897:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 898:     }));
 899:     setManualMode(false);
 900:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 901:   }

 903:   function cancelRegion() {
 904:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 905:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 906:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 907:     setDragSelection(null);
 908:   }

 910:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 911:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 912:     try {
 913:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 914:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 915:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 916:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 917:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 918:       const scale = mode === "width"
 919:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 920:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 921:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 922:     } catch (cause) {
 923:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 924:     }
 925:   }

 479:         moveIndex: 0,
 480:       });
 481:       setLastMove(null);
 482:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 483:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 484:       return true;
 485:     } catch (cause) {
 486:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 487:       return false;
 488:     }
 489:   }

 496:     setNotice("Region selected. The current chess position is unchanged; use Adjust Crop or Use on Board to continue.");

 540:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 541:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 542:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 543:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 544:       return;
 545:     }
 546:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 547:     try {
 548:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 549:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 550:       preview.width = crop.width;
 551:       preview.height = crop.height;
 552:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 553:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 554:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 555:     } catch (cause) {
 556:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 557:       return;
 558:     }
 559:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 560:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 561:     setTransferFen("");
 562:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 563:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 564:     setRecognitionError("");
 565:     setTransferPiece("P");
 566:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 567:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 568:     try {
 569:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 570:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 571:       });
 572:       const form = new FormData();
 573:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 574:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 575:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 576:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 577:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 578:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 579:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 580:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 581:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 582:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 583:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 584:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 585:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 586:       }
 587:     } catch (cause) {
 588:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 589:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 590:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 591:     }
 592:   }
 593: 
 594:   function closeTransfer() {
 595:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 596:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 597:     setTransferPreview("");
 598:     setTransferFen("");
 599:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 600:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 601:     setRecognitionError("");
 602:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 603:   }

 605:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 606:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 607:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 608:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 609:       return;
 610:     }
 611:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 612:     if (!board) {
 613:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 614:       return;
 615:     }
 616:     const row = displayRow;
 617:     const col = displayCol;
 618:     try {
 619:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 620:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 621:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 622:       setRecognitionError("");
 623:     } catch (cause) {
 624:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 625:     }
 626:   }
 627: 
 628:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 629:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 630:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 631:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 632:       return;
 633:     }
 634:     try {
 635:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 636:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 637:       setRecognitionError("");
 638:     } catch (cause) {
 639:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 640:     }
 641:   }
 642: 
 643:   function confirmTransfer() {
 644:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 645:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 646:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 647:       return;
 648:     }
 649:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 650:       closeTransfer();
 651:     }
 652:   }
 653: 
 654:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 655:     if (!session) return;
 656:     try {
 657:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 658:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 659:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 660:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 661:       if (promote) {
 662:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 663:         if (!choice) return;
 664:         switch (choice) {
 665:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 666:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 667:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 668:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 669:           default:
 670:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 671:             return;
 672:         }
 673:       }
 674:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 675:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 676:       patchSession({
 677:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 678:         moves: nextMoves,
 679:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 680:       });
 681:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 682:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 683:       setError("");
 684:     } catch {
 685:       const piece = game.get(to);
 686:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 687:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 688:     }
 689:   }
 690: 
 691:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 692:     if (!session) return;
 693:     if (annotationMode) {
 694:       if (!arrowStart) {
 695:         setArrowStart(square);
 696:         return;
 697:       }
 698:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 699:       setArrowStart(null);
 700:       setArrowHover(null);
 701:       return;
 702:     }
 703:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 704:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 705:       return;
 706:     }
 707:     const piece = game.get(square);
 708:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 709:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 710:   }

 738:     setArrowStart(null);
 739:     setArrowHover(null);

 770:   async function detectBoards() {
 771:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 772:     if (!API_BASE) {
 773:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Start the optional CV service and set VITE_API_BASE_URL, or draw a board region manually.");
 774:       return;
 775:     }
 776:     setDetecting(true);
 777:     setError("");
 778:     try {
 779:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 780:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")), "image/png");
 781:       });
 782:       const form = new FormData();
 783:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 784:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 785:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 786:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 787:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map((item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index));
 788:       patchSession((current) => ({
 789:         ...current,
 790:         candidatesByPage: { ...current.candidatesByPage, [String(current.page)]: candidates },
 791:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 792:       }));
 793:       setNotice(candidates.length ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.` : "No board candidates found. You can draw a region manually.");
 794:     } catch (cause) {
 795:       setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 796:     } finally {
 797:       setDetecting(false);
 798:     }
 799:   }

 819:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 820:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 821:     if (!manualMode) return;
 822: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 823: if (!canvas) return;
 824: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 825: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 826: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 827: if (
 828:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 829:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 830:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 831:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 832: ) return;
 833:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 834:     if (!point) return;
 835:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 836:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 837:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 838:     setDragSelection(selection);
 839:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 840:   }

 842:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 843:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 844:     if (edit) {
 845:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 846:       if (!point || !session) return;
 847:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 848:       patchSession((current) => {
 849:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 850:         return {
 851:           ...current,
 852:           candidatesByPage: {
 853:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 854:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 855:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 856:           },
 857:         };
 858:       });
 859:       return;
 860:     }
 861:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 862:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 863:     if (point) {
 864:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 865:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 866:       setDragSelection(selection);
 867:     }
 868:   }
 869: 
 870:   function finishRegion() {
 871:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 872:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 873:       return;
 874:     }
 875:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 876:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 877:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 878:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 879:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 880:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 881:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 882:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 883:     setDragSelection(null);
 884:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 885:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 886:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 887:       x, y, width, height,
 888:       relativeScore: 1,
 889:       source: "manual",
 890:     };
 891:     patchSession((current) => ({
 892:       ...current,
 893:       candidatesByPage: {
 894:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 895:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 896:       },
 897:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 898:     }));
 899:     setManualMode(false);
 900:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 901:   }

 904:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 905:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 906:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 907:     setDragSelection(null);
 908:   }

 910:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 911:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 912:     try {
 913:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 914:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 915:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 916:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 917:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 918:       const scale = mode === "width"
 919:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 920:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 921:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 922:     } catch (cause) {
 923:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 924:     }
 925:   }

  55:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";

 306:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 307:     try { return makePosition(session?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, session?.moves ?? [], session?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 308:     catch { return []; }
 309:   }, [session]);
 310:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 311:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 312:     : null);
 313:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 314:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 315:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 316:   );
 317: 
 318:   useEffect(() => {
 319:     setUserArrows([]);
 320:     setArrowStart(null);
 321:     setArrowHover(null);
 322:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 323:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 324: 
 325:   useEffect(() => {
 326:     if (engineEnabled) engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 327:   }, [engineEnabled, session?.currentFen, session?.moveIndex, engineDepth]);
 328: 
 329:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 330:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 331:   }
 332: 
 333:   function toggleEngine() {
 334:     if (engineEnabled) {
 335:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 336:       engineRef.current = null;
 337:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 338:       setEngineStatus("off");
 339:       setEngineScore(null);
 340:       setEngineMessage("");
 341:       return;
 342:     }
 343:     try {
 344:       setEngineScore(null);
 345:       setEngineMessage("");
 346:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 347:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 348:         (status, message) => {
 349:           setEngineStatus(status);
 350:           if (status === "error") {
 351:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 352:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 353:             setEngineScore(null);
 354:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 355:             engineRef.current = null;
 356:           }
 357:         },
 358:         setEngineScore,
 359:       );
 360:       engineRef.current = client;
 361:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 362:     } catch (cause) {
 363:       setEngineStatus("error");
 364:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 365:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 366:     }
 367:   }

 369:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 370:     setSession((current) => {
 371:       if (!current) return current;
 372:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 373:     });
 374:   }

 376:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 377:     try {
 378:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 379:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 380:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 381:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 382:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 383:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 384:       setBook(opened);
 385:       setSession(nextSession);
 386:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 387:       setError("");
 388:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 389:     } catch (cause) {
 390:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 391:     }
 392:   }
 393: 
 394:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 395:     if (!file) return;
 396:     try {
 397:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 398:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 399:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 400:       const now = Date.now();
 401:       const created: BookRecord = {
 402:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 403:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 404:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 405:         byteLength: file.size,
 406:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 407:         addedAt: now,
 408:       };
 409:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 410:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 411:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 412:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 413:       setBook(created);
 414:       setSession(blank);
 415:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 416:       setError("");
 417:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 418:     } catch (cause) {
 419:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 420:     }
 421:   }

 423:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 424:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove "${item.title}" from your library?`)) return;
 425: 
 426:     try {
 427:       await removeBook(item.id);
 428:       await removeSession(item.id);
 429: 
 430:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 431:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 432:         const next = { ...current };
 433:         delete next[item.id];
 434:         return next;
 435:       });
 436: 
 437:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 438:         setBook(null);
 439:         setSession(null);
 440:         setPdf(null);
 441:       }
 442: 
 443:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 444:       setError("");
 445:     } catch (cause) {
 446:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 447:     }
 448:   }
 449:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 450:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 451:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 452:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 453:     try {
 454:       await putBook(renamed);
 455:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 456:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 457:     } catch (cause) {
 458:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 459:     }
 460:   }

 489:       return false;

 542:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 543:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 544:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 545:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 546:       return;
 547:     }
 548:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 549:     try {
 550:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 551:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 552:       preview.width = crop.width;
 553:       preview.height = crop.height;
 554:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 555:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 556:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 557:     } catch (cause) {
 558:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 559:       return;
 560:     }
 561:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 562:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 563:     setTransferFen("");
 564:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 565:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 566:     setRecognitionError("");
 567:     setTransferPiece("P");
 568:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 569:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 570:     try {
 571:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 572:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 573:       });
 574:       const form = new FormData();
 575:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 576:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 577:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 578:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 579:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 580:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 581:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 582:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 583:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 584:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 585:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 586:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 587:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 588:       }
 589:     } catch (cause) {
 590:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 591:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 592:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 593:     }
 594:   }
 595: 
 596:   function closeTransfer() {
 597:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 598:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 599:     setTransferPreview("");
 600:     setTransferFen("");
 601:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 602:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 603:     setRecognitionError("");
 604:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 605:   }

 607:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 608:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 609:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 610:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 611:       return;
 612:     }
 613:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 614:     if (!board) {
 615:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 616:       return;
 617:     }
 618:     const row = displayRow;
 619:     const col = displayCol;
 620:     try {
 621:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 622:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 623:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 624:       setRecognitionError("");
 625:     } catch (cause) {
 626:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 627:     }
 628:   }
 629: 
 630:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 631:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 632:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 633:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 634:       return;
 635:     }
 636:     try {
 637:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 638:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 639:       setRecognitionError("");
 640:     } catch (cause) {
 641:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 642:     }
 643:   }
 644: 
 645:   function confirmTransfer() {
 646:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 647:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 648:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 649:       return;
 650:     }
 651:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 652:       closeTransfer();
 653:     }
 654:   }
 655: 
 656:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 657:     if (!session) return;
 658:     try {
 659:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 660:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 661:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 662:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 663:       if (promote) {
 664:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 665:         if (!choice) return;
 666:         switch (choice) {
 667:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 668:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 669:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 670:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 671:           default:
 672:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 673:             return;
 674:         }
 675:       }
 676:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 677:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 678:       patchSession({
 679:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 680:         moves: nextMoves,
 681:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 682:       });
 683:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 684:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 685:       setError("");
 686:     } catch {
 687:       const piece = game.get(to);
 688:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 689:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 690:     }
 691:   }
 692: 
 693:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 694:     if (!session) return;
 695:     if (annotationMode) {
 696:       if (!arrowStart) {
 697:         setArrowStart(square);
 698:         return;
 699:       }
 700:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 701:       setArrowStart(null);
 702:       setArrowHover(null);
 703:       return;
 704:     }
 705:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 706:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 707:       return;
 708:     }
 709:     const piece = game.get(square);
 710:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 711:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 712:   }

 772:   async function detectBoards() {
 773:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 774:     if (!API_BASE) {
 775:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Start the optional CV service and set VITE_API_BASE_URL, or draw a board region manually.");
 776:       return;
 777:     }
 778:     // Abort any previous scan
 779:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 780:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 781:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 782:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 783:     setDetecting(true);
 784:     setError("");
 785:     try {
 786:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 787:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")), "image/png");
 788:       });
 789:       const form = new FormData();
 790:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 791:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, { method: "POST", body: form, signal: abortController.signal });
 792:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 793:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 794:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map((item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index));
 795:       // Only update state if this is the latest request
 796:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 797:       patchSession((current) => ({
 798:         ...current,
 799:         candidatesByPage: { ...current.candidatesByPage, [String(current.page)]: candidates },
 800:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 801:       }));
 802:       setNotice(candidates.length ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.` : "No board candidates found. You can draw a region manually.");
 803:     } catch (cause) {
 804:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 805:         // Scan cancelled â€“ silent handling
 806:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 807:       } else {
 808:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 809:       }
 810:     } finally {
 811:       // Ensure detecting flag cleared only for the latest request
 812:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 813:         setDetecting(false);
 814:       }
 815:     }
 816:   }

 836:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 837:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 838:     if (!manualMode) return;
 839: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 840: if (!canvas) return;
 841: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 842: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 843: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 844: if (
 845:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 846:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 847:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 848:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 849: ) return;
 850:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 851:     if (!point) return;
 852:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 853:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 854:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 855:     setDragSelection(selection);
 856:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 857:   }

 859:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 860:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 861:     if (edit) {
 862:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 863:       if (!point || !session) return;
 864:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 865:       patchSession((current) => {
 866:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 867:         return {
 868:           ...current,
 869:           candidatesByPage: {
 870:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 871:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 872:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 873:           },
 874:         };
 875:       });
 876:       return;
 877:     }
 878:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 879:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 880:     if (point) {
 881:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 882:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;

 887:   function finishRegion() {
 888:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 889:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 890:       return;
 891:     }
 892:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 893:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 894:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 895:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 896:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 897:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 898:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 899:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 900:     setDragSelection(null);
 901:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 902:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 903:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 904:       x, y, width, height,
 905:       relativeScore: 1,
 906:       source: "manual",
 907:     };
 908:     patchSession((current) => ({
 909:       ...current,
 910:       candidatesByPage: {
 911:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 912:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 913:       },
 914:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 915:     }));
 916:     setManualMode(false);
 917:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 918:   }
 919: 
 920:   function cancelRegion() {
 921:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 922:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 923:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 924:     setDragSelection(null);
 925:   }

 927:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 928:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 929:     try {
 930:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 931:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 932:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 933:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 934:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 935:       const scale = mode === "width"
 936:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 937:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 938:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 939:     } catch (cause) {
 940:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 941:     }
 942:   }

 154:           setBooks(ordered);
 155:         }
 156:       } catch (cause) {
 157:         if (!cancelled) setError(`Could not restore the local library: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 158:       } finally {
 159:         if (!cancelled) setReady(true);
 160:       }
 161:     }
 162:     void initialize();
 163:     return () => { cancelled = true; };
 164:   }, []);
 165: 
 166:   useEffect(() => {
 167:     if (!ready || !book || !session) return;
 168:     const snapshot = session;
 169:     void Promise.all([putSession(snapshot), setActiveBookId(book.id)])
 170:       .then(() => setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [snapshot.bookId]: snapshot })))
 171:       .catch((cause: unknown) => setError(`Could not save reading session: ${messageOf(cause)}`));
 172:   }, [ready, book, session]);
 173: 
 174:   useEffect(() => {
 175:     pdfRef.current?.cleanup();
 176:     void loadingTaskRef.current?.destroy();
 177:     setPdf(null);
 178:     if (!book) {
 179:       pdfRef.current = null;
 180:       loadingTaskRef.current = null;
 181:       return;
 182:     }
 183:     let cancelled = false;
 184:     let loadingTask: PDFDocumentLoadingTask | null = null;
 185:     setPdfLoading(true);
 186:     setError("");
 187:     book.file.slice(0).arrayBuffer().then((data) => {
 188:       if (cancelled) return;
 189:       loadingTask = getDocument({ data });
 190:       loadingTaskRef.current = loadingTask;
 191:       return loadingTask.promise;
 192:     }).then((document) => {
 193:       if (!document) return;
 194:       if (cancelled) {
 195:         void document.cleanup();
 196:         return;
 197:       }
 198:       pdfRef.current = document;
 199:       setPdf(document);
 200:       setPdfLoading(false);
 201:       setSession((current) => current ? { ...current, pageCount: document.numPages } : current);
 202:     }).catch((cause: unknown) => {
 203:       if (!cancelled) {
 204:         setPdfLoading(false);
 205:         setError(`Could not open this PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 206:       }
 207:     });
 208:     return () => {
 209:       cancelled = true;
 210:       if (loadingTask) void loadingTask.destroy();
 211:     };
 212:   }, [book]);
 213: 
 214:   useEffect(() => {
 215:     if (!pdf || !session || !canvasRef.current) return;
 216:     let cancelled = false;
 217:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 218:     setRendering(true);
 219:     pdf.getPage(session.page).then((page) => {
 220:       if (cancelled) return;
 221:       const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: session.zoom * Math.min(1.4, 1100 / page.getViewport({ scale: 1 }).width) });
 222:       const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
 223:       if (!context) throw new Error("Canvas rendering is unavailable in this browser.");
 224:       canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width);
 225:       canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height);
 226:       const task = page.render({ canvas, canvasContext: context, viewport });
 227:       renderTaskRef.current = task;
 228:       return task.promise;
 229:     }).then(() => {
 230:       if (!cancelled) setRendering(false);
 231:     }).catch((cause: unknown) => {
 232:       if (!cancelled && !(cause instanceof Error && cause.name === "RenderingCancelledException")) {
 233:         setRendering(false);
 234:         setError(`Could not render page ${session.page}: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 235:       }
 236:     });
 237:     return () => {
 238:       cancelled = true;
 239:       renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
 240:     };
 241:   }, [pdf, session?.page, session?.zoom]);
 242: 
 243:   useEffect(() => {
 244:     function onKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 245:       if (!session || !book || isTypingTarget(event.target)) return;
 246:       if (cropEditingId && ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key)) {
 247:         const candidate = (session.candidatesByPage[String(session.page)] ?? []).find((item) => item.id === cropEditingId);
 248:         if (!candidate) return;
 249:         const step = event.shiftKey ? 0.01 : 0.002;
 250:         const x = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
 251:         const y = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
 252:         const next = editCrop(candidate, "move", x, y);
 253:         patchSession((current) => {
 254:           const pageKey = String(current.page);
 255:           return {
 256:             ...current,
 257:             candidatesByPage: {
 258:               ...current.candidatesByPage,
 259:               [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((item) =>
 260:                 item.id === candidate.id ? { ...item, ...next } : item),
 261:             },
 262:           };
 263:         });
 264:         event.preventDefault();
 265:         return;
 266:       }
 267:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 268:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 269:     }
 270:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 271:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 272:   });

 274:   useEffect(() => () => {
 275:     engineRef.current?.dispose();
 276:     engineRef.current = null;
 277:   }, []);

 279:   const sortedBooks = useMemo(() => [...books].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt), [books]);
 280:   const visibleBooks = useMemo(() => {
 281:     const needle = bookSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
 282:     return sortedBooks.filter((item) => {
 283:       const saved = sessionIndex[item.id];
 284:       const matchesTab =
 285:         libraryTab === "all" || libraryTab === "recent" || libraryTab === "local" ||
 286:         (libraryTab === "bookmarks" && (saved?.bookmarks.length ?? 0) > 0) ||
 287:         (libraryTab === "positions" && (saved?.positions.length ?? 0) > 0) ||
 288:         (libraryTab === "progress" && (saved?.page ?? 1) > 1);
 289:       return matchesTab && item.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle);
 290:     });
 291:   }, [bookSearch, libraryTab, sessionIndex, sortedBooks]);
 292: 
 293:   const game = useMemo(() => {
 294:     if (!session) return new Chess();
 295:     try {
 296:       return makePosition(session.lineBaseFen, session.moves, session.moveIndex);
 297:     } catch {
 298:       try { return new Chess(session.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 299:     }

 304:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);

 306:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 307:     try { return makePosition(session?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, session?.moves ?? [], session?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 308:     catch { return []; }
 309:   }, [session]);
 310:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 311:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 312:     : null);
 313:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 314:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 315:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],

 321:     setArrowHover(null);

 324:

 327:   }, [engineEnabled, session?.currentFen, session?.moveIndex, engineDepth]);

 329:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 330:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 331:   }

 333:   function toggleEngine() {
 334:     if (engineEnabled) {
 335:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 336:       engineRef.current = null;
 337:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 338:       setEngineStatus("off");
 339:       setEngineScore(null);
 340:       setEngineMessage("");
 341:       return;
 342:     }
 343:     try {
 344:       setEngineScore(null);
 345:       setEngineMessage("");
 346:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 347:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 348:         (status, message) => {
 349:           setEngineStatus(status);
 350:           if (status === "error") {
 351:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 352:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 353:             setEngineScore(null);
 354:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 355:             engineRef.current = null;
 356:           }
 357:         },
 358:         setEngineScore,
 359:       );
 360:       engineRef.current = client;
 361:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 362:     } catch (cause) {
 363:       setEngineStatus("error");
 364:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 365:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 366:     }
 367:   }

 369:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 370:     setSession((current) => {
 371:       if (!current) return current;
 372:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 373:     });
 374:   }

 376:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 377:     try {
 378:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 379:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 380:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 381:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 382:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 383:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 384:       setBook(opened);
 385:       setSession(nextSession);
 386:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 387:       setError("");
 388:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 389:     } catch (cause) {
 390:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 391:     }
 392:   }

 394:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 395:     if (!file) return;
 396:     try {
 397:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 398:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 399:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 400:       const now = Date.now();
 401:       const created: BookRecord = {
 402:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 403:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 404:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 405:         byteLength: file.size,
 406:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 407:         addedAt: now,
 408:       };
 409:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 410:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 411:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 412:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 413:       setBook(created);
 414:       setSession(blank);
 415:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 416:       setError("");
 417:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 418:     } catch (cause) {
 419:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 420:     }
 421:   }

 423:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 424:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove "${item.title}" from your library?`)) return;
 425: 
 426:     try {
 427:       await removeBook(item.id);
 428:       await removeSession(item.id);
 429: 
 430:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 431:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 432:         const next = { ...current };
 433:         delete next[item.id];
 434:         return next;
 435:       });
 436: 
 437:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 438:         setBook(null);
 439:         setSession(null);
 440:         setPdf(null);
 441:       }
 442: 
 443:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 444:       setError("");
 445:     } catch (cause) {
 446:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 447:     }
 448:   }
 449:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 450:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 451:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 452:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 453:     try {
 454:       await putBook(renamed);
 455:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 456:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 457:     } catch (cause) {
 458:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 459:     }
 460:   }

 463:     if (!session) return;
 464:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 465:   }

 467:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 468:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 469:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 470:   }

 472:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 473:     if (!session) return false;
 474:     try {
 475:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 476:       patchSession({
 477:         originalFen: fen,
 478:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 479:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 480:         moves: [],
 481:         moveIndex: 0,
 482:       });
 483:       setLastMove(null);
 484:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 485:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 486:       return true;
 487:     } catch (cause) {
 488:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 489:       return false;
 490:     }
 491:   }

 542:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 543:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 544:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 545:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 546:       return;
 547:     }
 548:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 549:     try {
 550:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 551:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 552:       preview.width = crop.width;
 553:       preview.height = crop.height;
 554:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 555:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 556:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 557:     } catch (cause) {
 558:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 559:       return;
 560:     }
 561:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 562:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 563:     setTransferFen("");
 564:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 565:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 566:     setRecognitionError("");
 567:     setTransferPiece("P");
 568:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 569:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 570:     try {
 571:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 572:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 573:       });
 574:       const form = new FormData();
 575:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 576:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 577:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 578:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 579:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 580:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 581:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 582:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 583:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 584:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 585:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 586:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 587:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 588:       }
 589:     } catch (cause) {
 590:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 591:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 592:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 593:     }
 594:   }
 595: 
 596:   function closeTransfer() {
 597:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 598:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 599:     setTransferPreview("");
 600:     setTransferFen("");
 601:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 602:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 603:     setRecognitionError("");
 604:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 605:   }
