 295:     return new Set(game.moves({ square: selectedSquare, verbose: true }).map((move) => move.to));
 296:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 297:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 298:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 299:     try { return makePosition(session?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, session?.moves ?? [], session?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 300:     catch { return []; }
 301:   }, [session]);
 302:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 303:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 304:     : null);
 305:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 306:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 307:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 308:   );
 309: 
 310:   useEffect(() => {
 311:     setUserArrows([]);
 312:     setArrowStart(null);
 313:     setArrowHover(null);
 314:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 315:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 316: 
 317:   useEffect(() => {
 318:     if (engineEnabled) engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 319:   }, [engineEnabled, session?.currentFen, session?.moveIndex, engineDepth]);
 320: 
 321:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 322:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 323:   }
 324: 
 325:   function toggleEngine() {
 326:     if (engineEnabled) {
 327:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 328:       engineRef.current = null;
 329:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 330:       setEngineStatus("off");
 331:       setEngineScore(null);
 332:       setEngineMessage("");
 333:       return;
 334:     }
 335:     try {
 336:       setEngineScore(null);
 337:       setEngineMessage("");
 338:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 339:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 340:         (status, message) => {
 341:           setEngineStatus(status);
 342:           if (status === "error") {
 343:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 344:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 345:             setEngineScore(null);
 346:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 347:             engineRef.current = null;
 348:           }
 349:         },
 350:         setEngineScore,
 351:       );
 352:       engineRef.current = client;
 353:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 354:     } catch (cause) {
 355:       setEngineStatus("error");
 356:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 357:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 358:     }
 359:   }
 360: 
 361:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 362:     setSession((current) => {
 363:       if (!current) return current;
 364:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 365:     });
 366:   }

 368:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 369:     try {
 370:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 371:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 372:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 373:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 374:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 375:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 376:       setBook(opened);
 377:       setSession(nextSession);
 378:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 379:       setError("");
 380:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 381:     } catch (cause) {
 382:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 383:     }
 384:   }
 385: 
 386:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 387:     if (!file) return;
 388:     try {
 389:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 390:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 391:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 392:       const now = Date.now();
 393:       const created: BookRecord = {
 394:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 395:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 396:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 397:         byteLength: file.size,
 398:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 399:         addedAt: now,
 400:       };
 401:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 402:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 403:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 404:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 405:       setBook(created);
 406:       setSession(blank);
 407:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 408:       setError("");
 409:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 410:     } catch (cause) {
 411:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 412:     }
 413:   }
 414: 
 415:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 416:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 417: 
 418:     try {
 419:       await removeBook(item.id);
 420:       await removeSession(item.id);
 421: 
 422:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 423:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 424:         const next = { ...current };
 425:         delete next[item.id];
 426:         return next;
 427:       });
 428: 
 429:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 430:         setBook(null);
 431:         setSession(null);
 432:         setPdf(null);
 433:       }
 434: 
 435:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 436:       setError("");
 437:     } catch (cause) {
 438:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 439:     }
 440:   }
 441:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 442:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 443:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 444:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 445:     try {
 446:       await putBook(renamed);
 447:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 448:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 449:     } catch (cause) {
 450:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 451:     }
 452:   }

 454:   function changePage(delta: number) {
 455:     if (!session) return;
 456:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 457:   }

 459:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 460:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 461:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 462:   }

 464:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 465:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 466:     try {
 467:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 468:       setSession({
 469:         ...activeSession,
 470:         originalFen: fen,
 471:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 472:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 473:         moves: [],
 474:         moveIndex: 0,
 475:       });
 476:       setLastMove(null);
 477:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 478:       setUserArrows([]);
 479:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 480:       return true;
 481:     } catch (cause) {
 482:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 483:       return false;
 484:     }
 485:   }

 487:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 488:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 489:     if (!loaded) return false;
 490:     setEngineScore(null);
 491:     setEngineMessage("");
 492:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 493:       toggleEngine();
 494:     } else {
 495:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 496:     }
 497:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 498:     return true;
 499:   }

 514:   function resetSelectedCrop() {
 515:     const baseline = cropBaselineRef.current;
 516:     if (!baseline || !session) return;

 535:         return {
 536:           ...current,
 537:           candidatesByPage: {

 539:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 540:               candidate.id === baseline.id ? baseline : candidate),

 550:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 551:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 552:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 553:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 554:       return;
 555:     }
 556:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 557:     try {
 558:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 559:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 560:       preview.width = crop.width;
 561:       preview.height = crop.height;
 562:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 563:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 564:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 565:     } catch (cause) {
 566:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 567:       return;
 568:     }
 569:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 570:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 571:     setTransferFen("");
 572:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 573:         setRecognitionError("");
 574:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 575:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 576:     try {
 577:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 578:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 579:       });
 580:       const form = new FormData();
 581:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 582:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 583:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 584:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 585:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 586:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 587:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 588:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 589:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 590:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 591:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 592:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 593:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 594:       }
 595:     } catch (cause) {
 596:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 597:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 598:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 599:     }
 600:   }

 602:   function closeTransfer() {
 603:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 604:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 605:     setTransferPreview("");
 606:     setTransferFen("");
 607:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 608:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 609:     setRecognitionError("");
 610:       }

 613:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 614:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 615:       setGameEndOverlay({
 616:         title: "Checkmate",
 617:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 618:       });
 619:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 620:       setGameEndOverlay({
 621:         title: "Stalemate",
 622:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 623:       });
 624:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 625:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 626:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 627:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 629:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 630:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 631:     } else {
 632:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 633:     }
 634:   }

 636:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 637:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 638:     try {
 639:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 640:       const result = currentGame.move({
 641:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 642:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 643:         promotion: piece,
 644:       });
 645:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 646:       patchSession({
 647:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 648:         moves: nextMoves,
 649:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 650:       });
 651:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 652:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 653:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 654:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 655:       setError("");
 656:     } catch {
 657:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 658:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 659:     }
 660:   }
 661: 
 662:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 663:     if (!session) return;
 664:     try {
 665:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 666:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 667:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 668:       if (promote) {
 669:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 670:         return;
 671:       }
 672:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 673:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 674:       patchSession({
 675:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 676:         moves: nextMoves,
 677:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 678:       });
 679:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 680:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 681:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 682:       setError("");
 683:     } catch {
 684:       const piece = game.get(to);
 685:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 686:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 687:     }
 688:   }

 690:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 691:     
 692:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 693:       setUserArrows([]);
 694:       setArrowStart(null);
 695:       setArrowHover(null);
 696:       return;
 697:     }
 698: if (!session) return;
 699:     if (annotationMode) {
 700:       if (!arrowStart) {
 701:         setArrowStart(square);
 702:         return;
 703:       }
 704:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 705:       setArrowStart(null);
 706:       setArrowHover(null);
 707:       return;
 708:     }
 709:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 710:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 711:       return;
 712:     }
 713:     const piece = game.get(square);
 714:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 715:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 716:   }

 718:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 719:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 720: 
 721:   event.preventDefault();
 722: 
 723:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 724:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 725:     event.clientX,
 726:     event.clientY,
 727:     bounds,
 728:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 729:   );
 730: 
 731:   if (!square) return;
 732: 
 733:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 734:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 735:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 736:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 737:   setArrowStart(square);
 738:   setArrowHover(square);
 739: 
 740:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 741: }
 742: 
 743:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 744:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 745:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 746:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 747:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 748:     setArrowHover(square);
 749:   }
 750: 
 751:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 752:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 753: 
 754:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 755: 
 756:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 757:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 758:     event.clientX,
 759:     event.clientY,
 760:     bounds,
 761:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 762:   );
 763: 
 764:   if (to && to !== from) {
 765:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 766:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 767:   } else {
 768:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 769:   }
 770: 
 771:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 772:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 773:   setArrowStart(null);
 774:   setArrowHover(null);
 775: }

 779:     setArrowStart(null);
 780:     setArrowHover(null);

 826:   function clearBoardScan() {
 827:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 828:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 829: 
 830:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 831:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 832:     controller?.abort();
 833:

 835:     setManualMode(false);
 836:     setDragSelection(null);
 837:     setCropEditingId(null);
 838:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 839:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 840: 
 841:     patchSession((current) => ({
 842:       ...current,
 843:       candidatesByPage: {
 844:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 845:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 846:       },
 847:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 848:     }));
 849: 
 850:     setError("");
 851:     setNotice("Board detection cleared.");

 853:   async function detectBoards() {
 854:     if (detecting) {
 855:       stopBoardScan();
 856:       return;
 857:     }
 858: 
 859:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 860:     if (!API_BASE) {
 861:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 862:       return;
 863:     }
 864: 
 865:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 866:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 867:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 868:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 869: 
 870:     setDetecting(true);
 871:     setError("");
 872:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 873:     patchSession((current) => ({
 874:       ...current,
 875:       candidatesByPage: {
 876:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 877:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 878:       },
 879:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 880:     }));
 881: 
 882:     try {
 883:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 884:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 885:           (blob) => blob
 886:             ? resolve(blob)
 887:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 888:           "image/png",
 889:         );
 890:       });
 891: 
 892:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 893: 
 894:       const form = new FormData();
 895:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 896: 
 897:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 898:         method: "POST",
 899:         body: form,
 900:         signal: abortController.signal,
 901:       });
 902: 
 903:       if (!response.ok) {
 904:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 905:       }
 906: 
 907:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 908:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 909:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 910:       );
 911: 
 912:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 913: 
 914:       patchSession((current) => ({
 915:         ...current,
 916:         candidatesByPage: {
 917:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 918:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 919:         },
 920:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 921:       }));
 922: 
 923:       setNotice(
 924:         candidates.length
 925:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 926:           : "No board candidates found.",
 927:       );
 928:     } catch (cause) {
 929:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 930: 
 931:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 932:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 933:       } else {
 934:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 935:       }
 936:     } finally {
 937:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 938:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 939:         setDetecting(false);
 940:       }
 941:     }
 942:   }
 943:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
 944:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
 945:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 946:   }

 948:   function startCropEdit(
 949:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 950:     candidate: Candidate,
 951:     handle: CropHandle,
 952:   ) {
 953:     event.stopPropagation();
 954:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 955:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
 956:     if (!point || !stage) return;
 957:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
 958:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 959:   }

 961:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 962:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 963:     if (!manualMode) return;
 964: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 965: if (!canvas) return;
 966: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 967: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 968: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 969: if (
 970:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 971:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 972:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 973:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 974: ) return;
 975:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 976:     if (!point) return;
 977:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 978:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 979:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 980:     setDragSelection(selection);
 981:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 982:   }
 983: 
 984:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 985:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 986:     if (edit) {
 987:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 988:       if (!point || !session) return;
 989:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 990:       patchSession((current) => {
 991:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 992:         return {
 993:           ...current,
 994:           candidatesByPage: {
 995:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 996:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 997:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 998:           },
 999:         };
1000:       });
1001:       return;
1002:     }
1003:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1004:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1005:     if (point) {
1006:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1007:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1008:       setDragSelection(selection);
1009:     }
1010:   }
1011: 
1012:   function finishRegion() {
1013:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1014:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1015:       return;
1016:     }
1017:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1018:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1019:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1020:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1021:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1022:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1023:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1024:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1025:     setDragSelection(null);
1026:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1027:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1028:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1029:       x, y, width, height,
1030:       relativeScore: 1,
1031:       source: "manual",
1032:     };
1033:     patchSession((current) => ({
1034:       ...current,
1035:       candidatesByPage: {
1036:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1037:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1038:       },
1039:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1040:     }));
1041:     setManualMode(false);
1042:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1043:   }
1044: 
1045:   function cancelRegion() {
1046:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1047:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1048:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1049:     setDragSelection(null);
1050:   }

1052:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1053:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1054:     try {
1055:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1056:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1057:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1058:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1059:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1060:       const scale = mode === "width"
1061:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1062:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1063:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1064:     } catch (cause) {
1065:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1066:     }
1067:   }

 141:           await putBook(resumed);
 142:           setBooks([resumed, ...ordered.filter((item) => item.id !== resumed.id)]);
 143:           setBook(resumed);
 144:           setSession(storedSessions[activeBook.id] ?? newSession(activeBook.id));
 145:           if (activeBook.id !== activeId) await setActiveBookId(activeBook.id);
 146:         } else {
 147:           setBooks(ordered);
 148:         }
 149:       } catch (cause) {
 150:         if (!cancelled) setError(`Could not restore the local library: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 151:       } finally {
 152:         if (!cancelled) setReady(true);
 153:       }
 154:     }
 155:     void initialize();
 156:     return () => { cancelled = true; };
 157:   }, []);
 158: 
 159:   useEffect(() => {
 160:     if (!ready || !book || !session) return;

 162:     void Promise.all([putSession(snapshot), setActiveBookId(book.id)])
 163:       .then(() => setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [snapshot.bookId]: snapshot })))
 164:       .catch((cause: unknown) => setError(`Could not save reading session: ${messageOf(cause)}`));

 215:       const context = canvas.getContext("2d");

 226:         setRendering(false);
 227:         setError(`Could not render page ${session.page}: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 228:       }
 229:     });

 232:       renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
 233:     };

 235: 
 236:   useEffect(() => {
 237:     function onKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 238:       if (!session || !book || isTypingTarget(event.target)) return;
 239:       if (cropEditingId && ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key)) {
 240:         const candidate = (session.candidatesByPage[String(session.page)] ?? []).find((item) => item.id === cropEditingId);
 241:         if (!candidate) return;
 242:         const step = event.shiftKey ? 0.01 : 0.002;
 243:         const x = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
 244:         const y = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
 245:         const next = editCrop(candidate, "move", x, y);
 246:         patchSession((current) => {
 247:           const pageKey = String(current.page);
 248:           return {
 249:             ...current,
 250:             candidatesByPage: {

 253:                 item.id === candidate.id ? { ...item, ...next } : item),
 254:             },
 255:           };
 256:         });
 257:         event.preventDefault();
 258:         return;
 259:       }
 260:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 261:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 262:     }
 263:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 264:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 265:   });

 272:   const sortedBooks = useMemo(() => [...books].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt), [books]);

 322:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 323:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 324:   }

 326:   function toggleEngine() {
 327:     if (engineEnabled) {
 328:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 329:       engineRef.current = null;
 330:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 331:       setEngineStatus("off");
 332:       setEngineScore(null);
 333:       setEngineMessage("");
 334:       return;
 335:     }
 336:     try {
 337:       setEngineScore(null);
 338:       setEngineMessage("");
 339:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 340:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 341:         (status, message) => {
 342:           setEngineStatus(status);
 343:           if (status === "error") {
 344:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 345:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 346:             setEngineScore(null);
 347:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 348:             engineRef.current = null;
 349:           }
 350:         },
 351:         setEngineScore,
 352:       );
 353:       engineRef.current = client;
 354:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 355:     } catch (cause) {
 356:       setEngineStatus("error");
 357:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 358:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 359:     }
 360:   }

 362:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 363:     setSession((current) => {
 364:       if (!current) return current;
 365:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 366:     });
 367:   }

 369:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 370:     try {
 371:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 372:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 373:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 374:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 375:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 376:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 377:       setBook(opened);
 378:       setSession(nextSession);
 379:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 380:       setError("");
 381:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 382:     } catch (cause) {
 383:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 384:     }
 385:   }

 387:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 388:     if (!file) return;
 389:     try {
 390:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 391:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 392:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 393:       const now = Date.now();
 394:       const created: BookRecord = {
 395:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 396:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 397:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 398:         byteLength: file.size,
 399:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 400:         addedAt: now,
 401:       };
 402:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 403:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 404:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 405:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 406:       setBook(created);
 407:       setSession(blank);
 408:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 409:       setError("");
 410:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 411:     } catch (cause) {
 412:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 413:     }
 414:   }

 416:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 417:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 418: 
 419:     try {
 420:       await removeBook(item.id);
 421:       await removeSession(item.id);
 422: 
 423:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 424:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 425:         const next = { ...current };
 426:         delete next[item.id];
 427:         return next;
 428:       });
 429: 
 430:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 431:         setBook(null);
 432:         setSession(null);
 433:         setPdf(null);
 434:       }
 435: 
 436:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 437:       setError("");
 438:     } catch (cause) {
 439:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 440:     }
 441:   }
 442:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 443:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 444:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 445:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 446:     try {
 447:       await putBook(renamed);
 448:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 449:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 450:     } catch (cause) {
 451:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 452:     }
 453:   }

 456:     if (!session) return;
 457:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });

 465:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 466:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 467:     try {
 468:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 469:       setSession({
 470:         ...activeSession,
 471:         originalFen: fen,
 472:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 473:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 474:         moves: [],
 475:         moveIndex: 0,
 476:       });
 477:       setLastMove(null);
 478:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 479:       setUserArrows([]);
 480:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 481:       return true;
 482:     } catch (cause) {
 483:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 484:       return false;
 485:     }
 486:   }

 498:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 499:     return true;

 551:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 552:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 553:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 554:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 555:       return;
 556:     }
 557:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 558:     try {
 559:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 560:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 561:       preview.width = crop.width;
 562:       preview.height = crop.height;
 563:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 564:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 565:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 566:     } catch (cause) {
 567:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 568:       return;
 569:     }
 570:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 571:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 572:     setTransferFen("");
 573:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 574:         setRecognitionError("");
 575:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 576:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 577:     try {
 578:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 579:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 580:       });
 581:       const form = new FormData();
 582:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 583:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 584:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 585:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 586:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 587:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 588:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 589:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 590:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 591:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 592:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 593:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 594:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 595:       }
 596:     } catch (cause) {
 597:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 598:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 599:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 600:     }
 601:   }

 603:   function closeTransfer() {
 604:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 605:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 606:     setTransferPreview("");
 607:     setTransferFen("");
 608:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 609:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 610:     setRecognitionError("");
 611:       }

 614:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 615:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 616:       setGameEndOverlay({
 617:         title: "Checkmate",
 618:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 619:       });
 620:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 621:       setGameEndOverlay({
 622:         title: "Stalemate",
 623:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 624:       });
 625:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 626:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 627:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 629:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 630:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 631:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 632:     } else {
 633:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 634:     }
 635:   }

 637:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 638:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 639:     try {
 640:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 641:       const result = currentGame.move({
 642:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 643:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 644:         promotion: piece,
 645:       });
 646:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 647:       patchSession({
 648:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 649:         moves: nextMoves,
 650:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 651:       });
 652:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 653:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 654:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 655:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 656:       setError("");
 657:     } catch {
 658:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 659:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 660:     }
 661:   }
 662: 
 663:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 664:     if (!session) return;
 665:     try {
 666:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 667:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 668:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 669:       if (promote) {
 670:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 671:         return;
 672:       }
 673:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 674:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 675:       patchSession({
 676:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 677:         moves: nextMoves,
 678:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 679:       });
 680:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 681:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 682:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 683:       setError("");
 684:     } catch {
 685:       const piece = game.get(to);
 686:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 687:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 688:     }
 689:   }
 690: 
 691:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 692:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 693:     setRedSquares((current) => current.filter((item) => item !== square));
 694:     
 695:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 696:       setUserArrows([]);
 697:       setArrowStart(null);
 698:       setArrowHover(null);
 699:       return;
 700:     }
 701: if (!session) return;
 702:     if (annotationMode) {
 703:       if (!arrowStart) {
 704:         setArrowStart(square);
 705:         return;
 706:       }
 707:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 708:       setArrowStart(null);
 709:       setArrowHover(null);
 710:       return;
 711:     }
 712:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 713:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 714:       return;
 715:     }
 716:     const piece = game.get(square);
 717:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 718:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 719:   }
 720: 
 721:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 722:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 723: 
 724:   event.preventDefault();
 725: 
 726:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 727:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 728:     event.clientX,
 729:     event.clientY,
 730:     bounds,
 731:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 732:   );

 740:   setArrowStart(square);

 742:

 744: }

 746:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 747:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;

 754:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {

 757:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 758: 
 759:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

 761:     event.clientX,
 762:     event.clientY,
 763:     bounds,
 764:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 765:   );
 766: 
 767:   if (to && to !== from) {
 768:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));

 770:   } else {
 771:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 772:   }

 777:   setArrowHover(null);

 856:   async function detectBoards() {
 857:     if (detecting) {
 858:       stopBoardScan();
 859:       return;
 860:     }
 861: 
 862:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 863:     if (!API_BASE) {
 864:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 865:       return;
 866:     }
 867: 
 868:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 869:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 870:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 871:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 872: 
 873:     setDetecting(true);
 874:     setError("");
 875:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 876:     patchSession((current) => ({
 877:       ...current,
 878:       candidatesByPage: {
 879:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 880:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 881:       },
 882:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 883:     }));
 884: 
 885:     try {
 886:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 887:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 888:           (blob) => blob
 889:             ? resolve(blob)
 890:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 891:           "image/png",
 892:         );
 893:       });
 894: 
 895:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 896: 
 897:       const form = new FormData();
 898:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 899: 
 900:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 901:         method: "POST",
 902:         body: form,
 903:         signal: abortController.signal,
 904:       });
 905: 
 906:       if (!response.ok) {
 907:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 908:       }
 909: 
 910:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 911:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 912:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 913:       );
 914: 
 915:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 916: 
 917:       patchSession((current) => ({
 918:         ...current,
 919:         candidatesByPage: {
 920:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 921:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 922:         },
 923:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 924:       }));
 925: 
 926:       setNotice(
 927:         candidates.length
 928:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 929:           : "No board candidates found.",
 930:       );
 931:     } catch (cause) {
 932:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 933: 
 934:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 935:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 936:       } else {
 937:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 938:       }
 939:     } finally {
 940:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 941:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 942:         setDetecting(false);
 943:       }
 944:     }
 945:   }
 946:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {

 964:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 965:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 966:     if (!manualMode) return;
 967: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 968: if (!canvas) return;
 969: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 970: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 971: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 972: if (
 973:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 974:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 975:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 976:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 977: ) return;
 978:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 979:     if (!point) return;
 980:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 981:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 982:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;

 987:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 988:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 989:     if (edit) {
 990:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 991:       if (!point || !session) return;
 992:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 993:       patchSession((current) => {
 994:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 995:         return {
 996:           ...current,
 997:           candidatesByPage: {
 998:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 999:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1000:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1001:           },
1002:         };
1003:       });
1004:       return;
1005:     }
1006:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1007:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1008:     if (point) {
1009:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1010:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1011:       setDragSelection(selection);
1012:     }
1013:   }

1015:   function finishRegion() {
1016:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1017:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1018:       return;
1019:     }
1020:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1021:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1022:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1023:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1024:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1025:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1026:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1027:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1028:     setDragSelection(null);
1029:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1030:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1031:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1032:       x, y, width, height,
1033:       relativeScore: 1,
1034:       source: "manual",
1035:     };
1036:     patchSession((current) => ({
1037:       ...current,
1038:       candidatesByPage: {
1039:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1040:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1041:       },
1042:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1043:     }));
1044:     setManualMode(false);
1045:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1046:   }

1051:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1052:     setDragSelection(null);

1055:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1056:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1057:     try {
1058:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1059:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1060:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1061:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1062:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1063:       const scale = mode === "width"
1064:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1065:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1066:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1067:     } catch (cause) {
1068:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1069:     }
1070:   }

  30: type CandidateInput = Omit<Candidate, "id" | "source" | "relativeScore"> &
  31:   Partial<Pick<Candidate, "id" | "source" | "relativeScore">> & { relative_score?: number; confidence?: number };
  32: type RecognitionResult = {
  33:   fen: string;
  34:   orientation: "normal" | "flipped" | "unknown";
  35:   board_confidence: number;
  36:   mean_piece_confidence: number | null;

  38:   warnings: string[];
  39: };
  40: type RecognitionStatus = "idle" | "loading" | "complete" | "failed";

  42: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  43:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  44:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  45:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  46:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;
  47:   if (elapsed < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 3_600_000)}h ago`;
  48:   return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  49: }
  50: 
  51: function squareName(fileIndex: number, rankIndex: number): Square {
  52:   return `${"abcdefgh"[fileIndex]}${rankIndex + 1}` as Square;
  53: }
  54: 
  55: function normalizedCandidate(value: CandidateInput, index: number): Candidate {
  56:   const { relative_score, confidence, ...candidate } = value;
  57:   return {
  58:     ...candidate,
  59:     id: candidate.id || `candidate-${index + 1}`,
  60:     source: candidate.source ?? "automatic",
  61:     relativeScore: candidate.relativeScore ?? relative_score ?? confidence ?? 0,
  62:   };
  63: }

 320:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 321:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);

 324:   function toggleEngine() {
 325:     if (engineEnabled) {
 326:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 327:       engineRef.current = null;
 328:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 329:       setEngineStatus("off");
 330:       setEngineScore(null);
 331:       setEngineMessage("");
 332:       return;
 333:     }
 334:     try {
 335:       setEngineScore(null);
 336:       setEngineMessage("");
 337:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 338:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 339:         (status, message) => {
 340:           setEngineStatus(status);
 341:           if (status === "error") {
 342:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 343:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 344:             setEngineScore(null);
 345:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 346:             engineRef.current = null;
 347:           }
 348:         },
 349:         setEngineScore,
 350:       );
 351:       engineRef.current = client;
 352:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 353:     } catch (cause) {
 354:       setEngineStatus("error");
 355:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 356:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 357:     }
 358:   }

 360:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 361:     setSession((current) => {
 362:       if (!current) return current;
 363:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 364:     });
 365:   }

 367:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 368:     try {
 369:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 370:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 371:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 372:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 373:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 374:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 375:       setBook(opened);
 376:       setSession(nextSession);
 377:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 378:       setError("");
 379:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 380:     } catch (cause) {
 381:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 382:     }
 383:   }

 385:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 386:     if (!file) return;
 387:     try {
 388:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 389:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 390:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 391:       const now = Date.now();
 392:       const created: BookRecord = {
 393:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 394:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 395:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 396:         byteLength: file.size,
 397:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 398:         addedAt: now,
 399:       };
 400:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 401:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 402:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 403:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 404:       setBook(created);
 405:       setSession(blank);
 406:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 407:       setError("");
 408:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 409:     } catch (cause) {
 410:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 411:     }
 412:   }

 414:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 415:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 416: 
 417:     try {
 418:       await removeBook(item.id);
 419:       await removeSession(item.id);
 420: 
 421:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 422:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 423:         const next = { ...current };
 424:         delete next[item.id];
 425:         return next;
 426:       });
 427: 
 428:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 429:         setBook(null);
 430:         setSession(null);
 431:         setPdf(null);
 432:       }
 433: 
 434:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 435:       setError("");
 436:     } catch (cause) {
 437:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 438:     }
 439:   }
 440:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 441:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 442:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 443:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 444:     try {
 445:       await putBook(renamed);
 446:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 447:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 448:     } catch (cause) {
 449:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 450:     }
 451:   }

 453:   function changePage(delta: number) {
 454:     if (!session) return;
 455:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 456:   }

 458:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 459:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 460:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 461:   }

 463:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 464:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 465:     try {
 466:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 467:       setSession({
 468:         ...activeSession,
 469:         originalFen: fen,
 470:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 471:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 472:         moves: [],
 473:         moveIndex: 0,
 474:       });
 475:       setLastMove(null);
 476:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 477:       setUserArrows([]);
 478:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 479:       return true;
 480:     } catch (cause) {
 481:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 482:       return false;
 483:     }
 484:   }

 486:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 487:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 488:     if (!loaded) return false;
 489:     setEngineScore(null);
 490:     setEngineMessage("");
 491:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 492:       toggleEngine();
 493:     } else {
 494:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 495:     }
 496:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 497:     return true;
 498:   }

 523:             candidate.id === baseline.id ? baseline : candidate),
 524:         },
 525:       };

 549:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 550:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 551:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 552:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 553:       return;
 554:     }
 555:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 556:     try {
 557:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 558:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 559:       preview.width = crop.width;
 560:       preview.height = crop.height;
 561:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 562:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 563:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 564:     } catch (cause) {
 565:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 566:       return;
 567:     }
 568:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 569:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 570:     setTransferFen("");
 571:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 572:         setRecognitionError("");
 573:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 574:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 575:     try {
 576:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 577:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 578:       });
 579:       const form = new FormData();
 580:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 581:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 582:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 583:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 584:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 585:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 586:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 587:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 588:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 589:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 590:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 591:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 592:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 593:       }
 594:     } catch (cause) {
 595:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 596:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 597:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 598:     }
 599:   }
 600: 
 601:   function closeTransfer() {
 602:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 603:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 604:     setTransferPreview("");
 605:     setTransferFen("");
 606:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 607:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 608:     setRecognitionError("");
 609:       }

 612:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 613:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 614:       setGameEndOverlay({
 615:         title: "Checkmate",
 616:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 617:       });
 618:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 619:       setGameEndOverlay({
 620:         title: "Stalemate",
 621:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 622:       });
 623:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 624:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 625:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 626:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 627:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 629:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 630:     } else {
 631:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 632:     }
 633:   }
 634: 
 635:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 636:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 637:     try {
 638:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 639:       const result = currentGame.move({
 640:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 641:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 642:         promotion: piece,
 643:       });
 644:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 645:       patchSession({
 646:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 647:         moves: nextMoves,
 648:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 649:       });
 650:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 651:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 652:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 653:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 654:       setError("");
 655:     } catch {
 656:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 657:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 658:     }
 659:   }
 660: 
 661:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 662:     if (!session) return;
 663:     try {
 664:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 665:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 666:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 667:       if (promote) {
 668:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 669:         return;
 670:       }
 671:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 672:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 673:       patchSession({
 674:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 675:         moves: nextMoves,
 676:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 677:       });
 678:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 679:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 680:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 681:       setError("");
 682:     } catch {
 683:       const piece = game.get(to);
 684:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 685:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 686:     }
 687:   }

 689:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 690:     
 691:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 692:       setUserArrows([]);
 693:       setArrowStart(null);
 694:       setArrowHover(null);
 695:       return;
 696:     }
 697: if (!session) return;
 698:     if (annotationMode) {
 699:       if (!arrowStart) {
 700:         setArrowStart(square);
 701:         return;
 702:       }
 703:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 704:       setArrowStart(null);
 705:       setArrowHover(null);
 706:       return;
 707:     }
 708:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 709:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 710:       return;
 711:     }
 712:     const piece = game.get(square);
 713:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 714:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 715:   }

 726:     bounds,
 727:     Boolean(session?.flipped),

 731:

 747:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 748:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 749: 
 750:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 751: 
 752:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

 754:     event.clientX,
 755:     event.clientY,
 756:     bounds,
 757:     Boolean(session?.flipped),

 762:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 763:   } else {
 764:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 765:   }
 766:

 768:   setArrowStart(null);
 769:   setArrowHover(null);

 778:   function jumpToMove(index: number) {
 779:     if (!session) return;
 780:     try {

 785:       setSelectedSquare(null);

 848:   async function detectBoards() {
 849:     if (detecting) {
 850:       stopBoardScan();
 851:       return;
 852:     }
 853: 
 854:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 855:     if (!API_BASE) {
 856:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 857:       return;
 858:     }
 859: 
 860:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 861:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 862:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 863:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 864: 
 865:     setDetecting(true);
 866:     setError("");
 867:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 868:     patchSession((current) => ({
 869:       ...current,
 870:       candidatesByPage: {
 871:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 872:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 873:       },
 874:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 875:     }));
 876: 
 877:     try {
 878:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 879:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 880:           (blob) => blob
 881:             ? resolve(blob)
 882:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 883:           "image/png",
 884:         );
 885:       });
 886: 
 887:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 888: 
 889:       const form = new FormData();
 890:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 891: 
 892:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 893:         method: "POST",
 894:         body: form,
 895:         signal: abortController.signal,
 896:       });
 897: 
 898:       if (!response.ok) {
 899:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 900:       }
 901: 
 902:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 903:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 904:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 905:       );
 906: 
 907:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 908: 
 909:       patchSession((current) => ({
 910:         ...current,
 911:         candidatesByPage: {
 912:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 913:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 914:         },
 915:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 916:       }));
 917: 
 918:       setNotice(
 919:         candidates.length
 920:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 921:           : "No board candidates found.",
 922:       );
 923:     } catch (cause) {
 924:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 925: 
 926:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 927:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 928:       } else {
 929:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 930:       }
 931:     } finally {
 932:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 933:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 934:         setDetecting(false);
 935:       }
 936:     }
 937:   }

 956:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 957:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 958:     if (!manualMode) return;
 959: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 960: if (!canvas) return;
 961: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 962: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 963: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 964: if (
 965:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 966:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 967:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 968:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 969: ) return;
 970:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 971:     if (!point) return;
 972:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 973:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 974:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 975:     setDragSelection(selection);
 976:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 977:   }

 979:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 980:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 981:     if (edit) {
 982:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 983:       if (!point || !session) return;
 984:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 985:       patchSession((current) => {
 986:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 987:         return {
 988:           ...current,
 989:           candidatesByPage: {
 990:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 991:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 992:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 993:           },
 994:         };
 995:       });
 996:       return;
 997:     }
 998:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 999:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1000:     if (point) {
1001:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1002:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1003:       setDragSelection(selection);
1004:     }
1005:   }

1007:   function finishRegion() {
1008:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1009:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1010:       return;
1011:     }
1012:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1013:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1014:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1015:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1016:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1017:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1018:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1019:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1020:     setDragSelection(null);
1021:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1022:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1023:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1024:       x, y, width, height,
1025:       relativeScore: 1,
1026:       source: "manual",
1027:     };
1028:     patchSession((current) => ({
1029:       ...current,
1030:       candidatesByPage: {
1031:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1032:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1033:       },
1034:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1035:     }));
1036:     setManualMode(false);
1037:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1038:   }

1047:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1048:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1049:     try {
1050:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1051:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1052:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1053:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1054:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1055:       const scale = mode === "width"
1056:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1057:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1058:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1059:     } catch (cause) {
1060:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1061:     }
1062:   }

  28: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  29:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  30:   if (!match) return uci;
  31:   try {

  34:       from: match[1] as Square,
  35:       to: match[2] as Square,
  36:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  37:     });
  38:     return move.san;
  39:   } catch {
  40:     return uci;
  41:   }

  44: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  45:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  46:   const san: string[] = [];
  47:   for (const uci of pv) {
  48:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  49:     if (!match) break;

  51:       const move = position.move({
  52:         from: match[1] as Square,
  53:         to: match[2] as Square,
  54:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  55:       });
  56:       san.push(move.san);
  57:     } catch {
  58:       break;
  59:     }
  60:   }
  61:   return san.join(" ");

  84: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  85:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  86:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  87:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  88:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;
  89:   if (elapsed < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 3_600_000)}h ago`;
