1006:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1007:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1008:     if (!manualMode) return;
1009: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1010: if (!canvas) return;
1011: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1012: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1013: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1014: if (
1015:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1016:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1017:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1018:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1019: ) return;
1020:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1021:     if (!point) return;
1022:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1023:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1024:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1025:     setDragSelection(selection);
1026:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1027:   }
1028: 
1029:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1030:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1031:     if (edit) {
1032:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1033:       if (!point || !session) return;
1034:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1035:       patchSession((current) => {
1036:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1037:         return {
1038:           ...current,
1039:           candidatesByPage: {
1040:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1041:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1042:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1043:           },
1044:         };
1045:       });
1046:       return;
1047:     }
1048:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1049:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1050:     if (point) {
1051:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1052:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1053:       setDragSelection(selection);
1054:     }
1055:   }

1057:   function finishRegion() {

1065:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1066:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);

1068:     dragStartRef.current = null;

1070:     setDragSelection(null);

1075:       relativeScore: 1,
1076:       source: "manual",
1077:     };

1080:       candidatesByPage: {

1083:       },

1097:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {

1102:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1103:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1104:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1105:       const scale = mode === "width"
1106:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1107:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1108:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1109:     } catch (cause) {
1110:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1111:     }

 200:       setSession((current) => current ? { ...current, pageCount: document.numPages } : current);
 201:     }).catch((cause: unknown) => {
 202:       if (!cancelled) {
 203:         setPdfLoading(false);
 204:         setError(`Could not open this PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 205:       }
 206:     });
 207:     return () => {
 208:       cancelled = true;
 209:       if (loadingTask) void loadingTask.destroy();
 210:     };
 211:   }, [book]);
 212: 
 213:   useEffect(() => {
 214:     if (!pdf || !session || !canvasRef.current) return;
 215:     let cancelled = false;
 216:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 217:     setRendering(true);
 218:     pdf.getPage(session.page).then((page) => {
 219:       if (cancelled) return;

 221:       const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
 222:       if (!context) throw new Error("Canvas rendering is unavailable in this browser.");
 223:       canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width);
 224:       canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height);
 225:       const task = page.render({ canvas, canvasContext: context, viewport });
 226:       renderTaskRef.current = task;
 227:       return task.promise;

 230:     }).catch((cause: unknown) => {
 231:       if (!cancelled && !(cause instanceof Error && cause.name === "RenderingCancelledException")) {
 232:         setRendering(false);
 233:         setError(`Could not render page ${session.page}: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 234:       }
 235:     });
 236:     return () => {
 237:       cancelled = true;
 238:       renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
 239:     };

 241: 
 242:   useEffect(() => {
 243:     function onKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 244:       if (!session || !book || isTypingTarget(event.target)) return;
 245:       if (cropEditingId && ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key)) {
 246:         const candidate = (session.candidatesByPage[String(session.page)] ?? []).find((item) => item.id === cropEditingId);
 247:         if (!candidate) return;
 248:         const step = event.shiftKey ? 0.01 : 0.002;
 249:         const x = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
 250:         const y = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
 251:         const next = editCrop(candidate, "move", x, y);
 252:         patchSession((current) => {
 253:           const pageKey = String(current.page);
 254:           return {
 255:             ...current,
 256:             candidatesByPage: {
 257:               ...current.candidatesByPage,
 258:               [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((item) =>
 259:                 item.id === candidate.id ? { ...item, ...next } : item),
 260:             },
 261:           };
 262:         });
 263:         event.preventDefault();
 264:         return;
 265:       }
 266:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 267:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 268:     }
 269:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 270:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 271:   });

 275:     engineRef.current = null;

 307:     : null);

 324:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 325:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);

 328:   function toggleEngine() {
 329:     if (engineEnabled) {
 330:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 331:       engineRef.current = null;
 332:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 333:       setEngineStatus("off");
 334:       setEngineScore(null);
 335:       setEngineMessage("");
 336:       return;
 337:     }
 338:     try {
 339:       setEngineScore(null);
 340:       setEngineMessage("");
 341:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 342:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 343:         (status, message) => {
 344:           setEngineStatus(status);
 345:           if (status === "error") {
 346:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 347:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 348:             setEngineScore(null);
 349:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 350:             engineRef.current = null;
 351:           }
 352:         },
 353:         setEngineScore,
 354:       );
 355:       engineRef.current = client;
 356:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 357:     } catch (cause) {
 358:       setEngineStatus("error");
 359:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 360:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 361:     }
 362:   }

 364:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 365:     setSession((current) => {
 366:       if (!current) return current;
 367:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 368:     });
 369:   }

 372:     if (studyMode) setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 373:     else patchSession(change);

 384:         currentFen: session.currentFen,

 386:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 387:         flipped: session.flipped,
 388:         coordinates: session.coordinates,

 390:       setStudyMode(true);

 392:       setStudyMode(false);

 399:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 400:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 401:       } else {
 402:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 403:       }
 404:     } catch {
 405:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 406:     }

 409:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 410:     try {
 411:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 412:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 413:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 414:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 415:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 416:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 417:       setBook(opened);
 418:       setSession(nextSession);
 419:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 420:       setError("");
 421:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 422:     } catch (cause) {
 423:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 424:     }
 425:   }

 427:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 428:     if (!file) return;
 429:     try {
 430:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 431:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 432:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 433:       const now = Date.now();
 434:       const created: BookRecord = {
 435:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 436:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 437:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 438:         byteLength: file.size,
 439:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 440:         addedAt: now,
 441:       };
 442:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 443:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 444:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 445:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 446:       setBook(created);
 447:       setSession(blank);
 448:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 449:       setError("");
 450:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 451:     } catch (cause) {
 452:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 453:     }
 454:   }

 456:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 457:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 458: 
 459:     try {
 460:       await removeBook(item.id);
 461:       await removeSession(item.id);
 462: 
 463:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 464:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 465:         const next = { ...current };
 466:         delete next[item.id];
 467:         return next;
 468:       });
 469: 
 470:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 471:         setBook(null);
 472:         setSession(null);
 473:         setPdf(null);
 474:       }
 475: 
 476:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 477:       setError("");
 478:     } catch (cause) {
 479:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 480:     }
 481:   }
 482:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 483:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 484:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 485:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 486:     try {
 487:       await putBook(renamed);
 488:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 489:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 490:     } catch (cause) {
 491:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 492:     }
 493:   }

 505:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 506:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 507:     try {
 508:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 509:       setSession({
 510:         ...activeSession,
 511:         originalFen: fen,
 512:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 513:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 514:         moves: [],
 515:         moveIndex: 0,
 516:       });
 517:       setLastMove(null);
 518:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 519:       setUserArrows([]);
 520:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 521:       return true;
 522:     } catch (cause) {
 523:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 524:       return false;
 525:     }
 526:   }

 591:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 592:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 593:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 594:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 595:       return;
 596:     }
 597:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 598:     try {
 599:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 600:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 601:       preview.width = crop.width;
 602:       preview.height = crop.height;
 603:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 604:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 605:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 606:     } catch (cause) {
 607:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 608:       return;
 609:     }
 610:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 611:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 612:     setTransferFen("");
 613:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 614:         setRecognitionError("");
 615:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 616:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 617:     try {
 618:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 619:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 620:       });
 621:       const form = new FormData();
 622:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 623:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 624:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 625:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 626:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 627:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 628:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 629:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 630:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 631:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 632:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 633:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 634:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 635:       }
 636:     } catch (cause) {
 637:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 638:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 639:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 640:     }
 641:   }

 643:   function closeTransfer() {
 644:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 645:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 646:     setTransferPreview("");
 647:     setTransferFen("");
 648:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 649:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 650:     setRecognitionError("");
 651:       }

 654:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 655:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 656:       setGameEndOverlay({
 657:         title: "Checkmate",
 658:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 659:       });
 660:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 661:       setGameEndOverlay({
 662:         title: "Stalemate",
 663:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 664:       });
 665:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 666:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 667:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 668:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 669:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 670:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 671:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 672:     } else {
 673:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 674:     }
 675:   }

 677:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 678:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 679:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 680:     try {
 681:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 682:       const result = currentGame.move({
 683:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 684:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 685:         promotion: piece,
 686:       });
 687:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 688:       patchBoardSession({
 689:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 690:         moves: nextMoves,
 691:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 692:       });
 693:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 694:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 695:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 696:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 697:       setError("");
 698:     } catch {
 699:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 700:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 701:     }
 702:   }
 703: 
 704:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 705:     if (!boardSession) return;
 706:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 707:     try {
 708:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 709:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 710:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 711:       if (promote) {
 712:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 713:         return;
 714:       }
 715:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 716:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 717:       patchBoardSession({
 718:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 719:         moves: nextMoves,
 720:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 721:       });
 722:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 723:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 724:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 725:       setError("");
 726:     } catch {
 727:       const piece = game.get(to);
 728:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 729:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 730:     }
 731:   }
 732: 
 733:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 734:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 735:     setRedSquares([]);
 736: 
 737:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 738:       setUserArrows([]);
 739:       setArrowStart(null);
 740:       setArrowHover(null);
 741:       return;
 742:     }
 743: if (!boardSession) return;
 744:     if (annotationMode) {
 745:       if (!arrowStart) {
 746:         setArrowStart(square);
 747:         return;
 748:       }
 749:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 750:       setArrowStart(null);
 751:       setArrowHover(null);
 752:       return;
 753:     }
 754:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 755:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 756:       return;
 757:     }
 758:     const piece = game.get(square);
 759:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 760:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 761:   }

 763:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 764:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 765: 
 766:   event.preventDefault();
 767: 
 768:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 769:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 770:     event.clientX,
 771:     event.clientY,
 772:     bounds,
 773:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 774:   );
 775: 
 776:   if (!square) return;
 777: 
 778:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 779:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 780:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 781:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 782:   setArrowStart(square);
 783:   setArrowHover(square);
 784: 
 785:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 786: }
 787: 
 788:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 789:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 790:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 791:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));

 898:   async function detectBoards() {
 899:     if (detecting) {
 900:       stopBoardScan();
 901:       return;
 902:     }
 903: 
 904:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 905:     if (!API_BASE) {
 906:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 907:       return;
 908:     }
 909: 
 910:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 911:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 912:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 913:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 914: 
 915:     setDetecting(true);
 916:     setError("");
 917:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 918:     patchSession((current) => ({
 919:       ...current,
 920:       candidatesByPage: {
 921:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 922:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 923:       },
 924:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 925:     }));
 926: 
 927:     try {
 928:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 929:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 930:           (blob) => blob
 931:             ? resolve(blob)
 932:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 933:           "image/png",
 934:         );
 935:       });
 936: 
 937:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 938: 
 939:       const form = new FormData();
 940:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 941: 
 942:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 943:         method: "POST",
 944:         body: form,
 945:         signal: abortController.signal,
 946:       });
 947: 
 948:       if (!response.ok) {
 949:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 950:       }
 951: 
 952:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 953:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 954:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 955:       );
 956: 
 957:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 958: 
 959:       patchSession((current) => ({
 960:         ...current,
 961:         candidatesByPage: {
 962:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 963:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 964:         },
 965:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 966:       }));
 967: 
 968:       setNotice(
 969:         candidates.length
 970:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 971:           : "No board candidates found.",
 972:       );
 973:     } catch (cause) {
 974:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 975: 
 976:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 977:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 978:       } else {
 979:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 980:       }
 981:     } finally {
 982:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 983:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 984:         setDetecting(false);
 985:       }
 986:     }
 987:   }

1006:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1007:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1008:     if (!manualMode) return;
1009: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1010: if (!canvas) return;
1011: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1012: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1013: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1014: if (
1015:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1016:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1017:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1018:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1019: ) return;
1020:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1021:     if (!point) return;

1023:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1024:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1025:     setDragSelection(selection);

1029:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1030:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1031:     if (edit) {
1032:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1033:       if (!point || !session) return;
1034:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1035:       patchSession((current) => {
1036:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1037:         return {
1038:           ...current,
1039:           candidatesByPage: {
1040:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1041:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1042:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1043:           },
1044:         };
1045:       });
1046:       return;
1047:     }
1048:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1049:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1050:     if (point) {
1051:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1052:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1053:       setDragSelection(selection);
1054:     }
1055:   }

1057:   function finishRegion() {
1058:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1059:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1060:       return;
1061:     }
1062:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1063:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1064:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1065:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1066:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1067:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1068:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1069:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1070:     setDragSelection(null);
1071:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1072:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1073:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1074:       x, y, width, height,
1075:       relativeScore: 1,
1076:       source: "manual",
1077:     };
1078:     patchSession((current) => ({
1079:       ...current,
1080:       candidatesByPage: {
1081:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1082:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1083:       },
1084:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1085:     }));
1086:     setManualMode(false);
1087:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1088:   }

1091:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1092:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1093:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1094:     setDragSelection(null);
1095:   }

1097:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1098:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1099:     try {
1100:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1101:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1102:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1103:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1104:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1105:       const scale = mode === "width"
1106:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1107:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1108:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1109:     } catch (cause) {
1110:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1111:     }
1112:   }

  32: type CandidateInput = Omit<Candidate, "id" | "source" | "relativeScore"> &
  33:   Partial<Pick<Candidate, "id" | "source" | "relativeScore">> & { relative_score?: number; confidence?: number };
  34: type RecognitionResult = {
  35:   fen: string;
  36:   orientation: "normal" | "flipped" | "unknown";
  37:   board_confidence: number;
  38:   mean_piece_confidence: number | null;
  39:   piece_count: number;
  40:   warnings: string[];
  41: };
  42: type RecognitionStatus = "idle" | "loading" | "complete" | "failed";

  44: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  45:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  46:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  47:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  48:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;
  49:   if (elapsed < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 3_600_000)}h ago`;
  50:   return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  51: }
  52: 
  53: function squareName(fileIndex: number, rankIndex: number): Square {
  54:   return `${"abcdefgh"[fileIndex]}${rankIndex + 1}` as Square;
  55: }
  56: 
  57: function normalizedCandidate(value: CandidateInput, index: number): Candidate {
  58:   const { relative_score, confidence, ...candidate } = value;
  59:   return {
  60:     ...candidate,
  61:     id: candidate.id || `candidate-${index + 1}`,
  62:     source: candidate.source ?? "automatic",
  63:     relativeScore: candidate.relativeScore ?? relative_score ?? confidence ?? 0,
  64:   };
  65: }

 330:   function toggleEngine() {
 331:     if (engineEnabled) {
 332:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 333:       engineRef.current = null;
 334:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 335:       setEngineStatus("off");
 336:       setEngineScore(null);
 337:       setEngineMessage("");
 338:       return;
 339:     }
 340:     try {
 341:       setEngineScore(null);
 342:       setEngineMessage("");
 343:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 344:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 345:         (status, message) => {
 346:           setEngineStatus(status);
 347:           if (status === "error") {
 348:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 349:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 350:             setEngineScore(null);
 351:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 352:             engineRef.current = null;
 353:           }
 354:         },
 355:         setEngineScore,
 356:       );
 357:       engineRef.current = client;
 358:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 359:     } catch (cause) {
 360:       setEngineStatus("error");
 361:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 362:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 363:     }
 364:   }

 366:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 367:     setSession((current) => {
 368:       if (!current) return current;
 369:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 370:     });
 371:   }

 411:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 412:     try {
 413:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 414:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 415:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 416:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 417:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 418:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 419:       setBook(opened);
 420:       setSession(nextSession);
 421:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 422:       setError("");
 423:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 424:     } catch (cause) {
 425:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 426:     }
 427:   }

 429:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 430:     if (!file) return;
 431:     try {
 432:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 433:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 434:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 435:       const now = Date.now();
 436:       const created: BookRecord = {
 437:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 438:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 439:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 440:         byteLength: file.size,
 441:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 442:         addedAt: now,
 443:       };
 444:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 445:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 446:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 447:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 448:       setBook(created);
 449:       setSession(blank);
 450:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 451:       setError("");
 452:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 453:     } catch (cause) {
 454:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 455:     }
 456:   }

 458:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 459:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 460: 
 461:     try {
 462:       await removeBook(item.id);
 463:       await removeSession(item.id);
 464: 
 465:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 466:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 467:         const next = { ...current };
 468:         delete next[item.id];
 469:         return next;
 470:       });
 471: 
 472:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 473:         setBook(null);
 474:         setSession(null);
 475:         setPdf(null);
 476:       }
 477: 
 478:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 479:       setError("");
 480:     } catch (cause) {
 481:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 482:     }
 483:   }
 484:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 485:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 486:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 487:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 488:     try {
 489:       await putBook(renamed);
 490:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 491:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 492:     } catch (cause) {
 493:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 494:     }
 495:   }

 497:   function changePage(delta: number) {
 498:     if (!session) return;
 499:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 500:   }

 502:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 503:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 504:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 505:   }

 507:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 508:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 509:     try {
 510:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 511:       setSession({
 512:         ...activeSession,
 513:         originalFen: fen,
 514:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 515:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 516:         moves: [],
 517:         moveIndex: 0,
 518:       });
 519:       setLastMove(null);
 520:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 521:       setUserArrows([]);
 522:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 523:       return true;
 524:     } catch (cause) {
 525:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 526:       return false;
 527:     }
 528:   }

 530:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 531:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 532:     if (!loaded) return false;
 533:     setEngineScore(null);
 534:     setEngineMessage("");
 535:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 536:       toggleEngine();
 537:     } else {
 538:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 539:     }
 540:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 541:     return true;
 542:   }

 549:     setNotice("Region selected. The current chess position is unchanged; use Adjust Crop or Use on Board to continue.");

 552:   function adjustSelectedCrop(candidate: Candidate) {

 593:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 594:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 595:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 596:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 597:       return;
 598:     }
 599:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 600:     try {
 601:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 602:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 603:       preview.width = crop.width;
 604:       preview.height = crop.height;
 605:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 606:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 607:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 608:     } catch (cause) {
 609:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 610:       return;
 611:     }
 612:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 613:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 614:     setTransferFen("");
 615:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 616:         setRecognitionError("");
 617:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 618:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 619:     try {
 620:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 621:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 622:       });
 623:       const form = new FormData();
 624:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 625:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 626:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 627:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 628:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 629:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 630:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 631:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 632:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 633:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 634:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 635:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 636:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 637:       }
 638:     } catch (cause) {
 639:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 640:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 641:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 642:     }
 643:   }
 644: 
 645:   function closeTransfer() {
 646:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 647:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 648:     setTransferPreview("");
 649:     setTransferFen("");
 650:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 651:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 652:     setRecognitionError("");
 653:       }

 656:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 657:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 658:       setGameEndOverlay({
 659:         title: "Checkmate",
 660:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 661:       });
 662:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 663:       setGameEndOverlay({
 664:         title: "Stalemate",
 665:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 666:       });
 667:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 668:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 669:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 670:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 671:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 672:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 673:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 674:     } else {
 675:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 676:     }
 677:   }

 679:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 680:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 681:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 682:     try {
 683:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 684:       const result = currentGame.move({
 685:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 686:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 687:         promotion: piece,
 688:       });
 689:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 690:       patchBoardSession({
 691:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 692:         moves: nextMoves,
 693:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 694:       });
 695:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 696:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 697:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 698:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 699:       setError("");
 700:     } catch {
 701:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 702:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 703:     }
 704:   }
 705: 
 706:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 707:     if (!boardSession) return;
 708:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 709:     try {
 710:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 711:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 712:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 713:       if (promote) {
 714:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 715:         return;
 716:       }
 717:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 718:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 719:       patchBoardSession({
 720:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 721:         moves: nextMoves,
 722:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 723:       });
 724:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 725:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 726:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 727:       setError("");
 728:     } catch {
 729:       const piece = game.get(to);
 730:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 731:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 732:     }
 733:   }

 735:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 736:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 737:     setRedSquares([]);
 738: 
 739:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 740:       setUserArrows([]);
 741:       setArrowStart(null);
 742:       setArrowHover(null);
 743:       return;
 744:     }
 745: if (!boardSession) return;
 746:     if (annotationMode) {
 747:       if (!arrowStart) {
 748:         setArrowStart(square);
 749:         return;
 750:       }
 751:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 752:       setArrowStart(null);
 753:       setArrowHover(null);
 754:       return;
 755:     }
 756:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 757:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 758:       return;
 759:     }
 760:     const piece = game.get(square);
 761:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 762:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 763:   }

 765:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 766:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 767: 
 768:   event.preventDefault();
 769: 
 770:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 771:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 772:     event.clientX,
 773:     event.clientY,
 774:     bounds,
 775:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 776:   );
 777: 
 778:   if (!square) return;
 779: 
 780:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 781:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 782:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 783:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 784:   setArrowStart(square);
 785:   setArrowHover(square);
 786: 
 787:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 788: }

 790:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 791:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 792:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 793:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 794:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;

 798:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 799:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 800: 
 801:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 802: 
 803:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 804:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 805:     event.clientX,
 806:     event.clientY,
 807:     bounds,
 808:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 809:   );
 810: 
 811:   if (to && to !== from) {
 812:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 813:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 814:   } else {
 815:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 816:   }
 817: 
 818:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 819:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 820:   setArrowStart(null);
 821:   setArrowHover(null);
 822: }

 837:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 838:     } catch (cause) {
 839:       setError(`Could not navigate to move: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 840:     }
 841:   }

 874:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 875:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 876: 
 877:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 878:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 879:     controller?.abort();
 880:

 882:     setManualMode(false);
 883:     setDragSelection(null);
 884:     setCropEditingId(null);
 885:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 886:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 887: 
 888:     patchSession((current) => ({
 889:       ...current,
 890:       candidatesByPage: {
 891:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 892:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 893:       },
 894:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 895:     }));
 896: 
 897:     setError("");
 898:     setNotice("Board detection cleared.");

 900:   async function detectBoards() {
 901:     if (detecting) {
 902:       stopBoardScan();
 903:       return;
 904:     }
 905: 
 906:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 907:     if (!API_BASE) {
 908:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 909:       return;
 910:     }
 911: 
 912:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 913:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 914:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 915:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 916: 
 917:     setDetecting(true);
 918:     setError("");
 919:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 920:     patchSession((current) => ({
 921:       ...current,
 922:       candidatesByPage: {
 923:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 924:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 925:       },
 926:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 927:     }));
 928: 
 929:     try {
 930:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 931:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 932:           (blob) => blob
 933:             ? resolve(blob)
 934:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 935:           "image/png",
 936:         );
 937:       });
 938: 
 939:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 940: 
 941:       const form = new FormData();
 942:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 943: 
 944:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 945:         method: "POST",
 946:         body: form,
 947:         signal: abortController.signal,
 948:       });
 949: 
 950:       if (!response.ok) {
 951:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 952:       }
 953: 
 954:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 955:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 956:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 957:       );
 958: 
 959:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 960: 
 961:       patchSession((current) => ({
 962:         ...current,
 963:         candidatesByPage: {
 964:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 965:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 966:         },
 967:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 968:       }));
 969: 
 970:       setNotice(
 971:         candidates.length
 972:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 973:           : "No board candidates found.",
 974:       );
 975:     } catch (cause) {
 976:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 977: 
 978:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 979:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 980:       } else {
 981:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 982:       }
 983:     } finally {
 984:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 985:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 986:         setDetecting(false);
 987:       }
 988:     }
 989:   }
 990:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {

 992:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 993:   }

1008:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1009:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1010:     if (!manualMode) return;
1011: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1012: if (!canvas) return;
1013: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1014: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1015: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1016: if (
1017:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1018:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1019:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1020:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1021: ) return;
1022:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1023:     if (!point) return;
1024:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1025:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1026:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1027:     setDragSelection(selection);
1028:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1029:   }

1031:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1032:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1033:     if (edit) {
1034:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1035:       if (!point || !session) return;
1036:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1037:       patchSession((current) => {
1038:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1039:         return {
1040:           ...current,
1041:           candidatesByPage: {
1042:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1043:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1044:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1045:           },
1046:         };
1047:       });
1048:       return;
1049:     }
1050:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1051:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1052:     if (point) {
1053:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1054:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1055:       setDragSelection(selection);
1056:     }
1057:   }

1059:   function finishRegion() {
1060:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1061:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1062:       return;
1063:     }
1064:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1065:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1066:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1067:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1068:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1069:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1070:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1071:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1072:     setDragSelection(null);
1073:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1074:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1075:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1076:       x, y, width, height,
1077:       relativeScore: 1,
1078:       source: "manual",
1079:     };
1080:     patchSession((current) => ({
1081:       ...current,
1082:       candidatesByPage: {
1083:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1084:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1085:       },
1086:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1087:     }));
1088:     setManualMode(false);
1089:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1090:   }

1092:   function cancelRegion() {
1093:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1094:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1095:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1096:     setDragSelection(null);
1097:   }

1099:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1100:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1101:     try {
1102:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1103:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1104:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1105:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1106:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1107:       const scale = mode === "width"
1108:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1109:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1110:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1111:     } catch (cause) {
1112:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1113:     }
1114:   }

1123:         ? current.bookmarks.filter((page) => page !== current.page)
1124:         : [...current.bookmarks, current.page].sort((a, b) => a - b),
1125:     }));
1126:   }

1141:   function resetBoard() {
1142:     if (studyMode) {
1143:       if (!studyBoard) return;
1144:       const original = new Chess(studyBoard.lineBaseFen);
1145:       patchBoardSession({
1146:         lineBaseFen: original.fen(),
1147:         currentFen: original.fen(),
1148:         moves: [],
1149:         moveIndex: 0,

1151:     } else {
1152:       if (!session) return;
1153:       const original = new Chess(session.originalFen);
1154:       patchSession({

 294:     }
 295:   }, [boardSession]);
 296:   const legalTargets = useMemo(() => {
 297:     if (!selectedSquare) return new Set<string>();
 298:     return new Set(game.moves({ square: selectedSquare, verbose: true }).map((move) => move.to));
 299:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 300:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 301:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 302:     try { return makePosition(boardSession?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, boardSession?.moves ?? [], boardSession?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 303:     catch { return []; }
 304:   }, [boardSession]);
 305:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 306:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 307:     : null);
 308:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 309:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 310:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 311:   );
 312: 
 313:   useEffect(() => {
 314:     setUserArrows([]);
 315:     setArrowStart(null);
 316:     setArrowHover(null);
 317:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 318:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 319: 
 320:   useEffect(() => {
 321:     if (engineEnabled) engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 322:   }, [engineEnabled, session?.currentFen, session?.moveIndex, engineDepth]);
 323: 
 324:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 325:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 326:   }
 327: 
 328:   function toggleEngine() {
 329:     if (engineEnabled) {
 330:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 331:       engineRef.current = null;
 332:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 333:       setEngineStatus("off");
 334:       setEngineScore(null);
 335:       setEngineMessage("");
 336:       return;
 337:     }
 338:     try {
 339:       setEngineScore(null);
 340:       setEngineMessage("");
 341:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 342:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 343:         (status, message) => {
 344:           setEngineStatus(status);
 345:           if (status === "error") {
 346:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 347:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 348:             setEngineScore(null);
 349:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 350:             engineRef.current = null;
 351:           }
 352:         },
 353:         setEngineScore,
 354:       );
 355:       engineRef.current = client;
 356:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 357:     } catch (cause) {
 358:       setEngineStatus("error");
 359:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 360:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 361:     }
 362:   }
 363: 
 364:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 365:     setSession((current) => {
 366:       if (!current) return current;
 367:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 368:     });
 369:   }

 371:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 372:     if (studyMode) setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 373:     else patchSession(change);
 374:   }

 376:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 377:     if (!studyMode) {
 378:       if (!session) {
 379:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 380:         return;
 381:       }
 382:       setStudyBoard({
 383:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 384:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 385:         moves: [...session.moves],
 386:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 387:         flipped: session.flipped,
 388:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 389:       });
 390:       setStudyMode(true);
 391:     } else {
 392:       setStudyMode(false);
 393:     }
 394:     setLastMove(null);
 395:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 396:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 397:   
 398:     try {
 399:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 400:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 401:       } else {
 402:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 403:       }
 404:     } catch {
 405:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 406:     }
 407: }

 409:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 410:     try {
 411:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 412:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 413:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 414:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 415:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 416:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 417:       setBook(opened);
 418:       setSession(nextSession);
 419:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 420:       setError("");
 421:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 422:     } catch (cause) {
 423:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 424:     }
 425:   }
 426: 
 427:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 428:     if (!file) return;
 429:     try {
 430:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 431:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 432:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 433:       const now = Date.now();
 434:       const created: BookRecord = {
 435:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 436:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 437:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 438:         byteLength: file.size,
 439:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 440:         addedAt: now,
 441:       };
 442:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 443:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 444:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 445:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 446:       setBook(created);
 447:       setSession(blank);
 448:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 449:       setError("");
 450:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 451:     } catch (cause) {
 452:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 453:     }
 454:   }

 456:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 457:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 458: 
 459:     try {
 460:       await removeBook(item.id);
 461:       await removeSession(item.id);
 462: 
 463:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 464:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 465:         const next = { ...current };
 466:         delete next[item.id];
 467:         return next;
 468:       });
 469: 
 470:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 471:         setBook(null);
 472:         setSession(null);
 473:         setPdf(null);
 474:       }
 475: 
 476:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 477:       setError("");
 478:     } catch (cause) {
 479:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 480:     }
 481:   }
 482:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 483:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 484:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 485:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 486:     try {
 487:       await putBook(renamed);
 488:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 489:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 490:     } catch (cause) {
 491:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 492:     }
 493:   }

 495:   function changePage(delta: number) {
 496:     if (!session) return;
 497:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 498:   }

 500:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 501:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 502:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 503:   }

 505:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 506:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 507:     try {
 508:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 509:       setSession({
 510:         ...activeSession,
 511:         originalFen: fen,
 512:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 513:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 514:         moves: [],
 515:         moveIndex: 0,
 516:       });
 517:       setLastMove(null);
 518:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 519:       setUserArrows([]);
 520:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 521:       return true;
 522:     } catch (cause) {
 523:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 524:       return false;
 525:     }
 526:   }

 529:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 530:     if (!loaded) return false;
 531:     setEngineScore(null);
 532:     setEngineMessage("");

 534:       toggleEngine();
 535:     } else {
 536:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 537:     }
 538:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 539:     return true;
 540:   }

 591:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 592:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 593:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 594:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 595:       return;
 596:     }
 597:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 598:     try {
 599:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 600:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 601:       preview.width = crop.width;
 602:       preview.height = crop.height;
 603:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 604:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 605:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 606:     } catch (cause) {
 607:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 608:       return;
 609:     }
 610:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 611:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 612:     setTransferFen("");
 613:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 614:         setRecognitionError("");
 615:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 616:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 617:     try {
 618:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 619:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 620:       });
 621:       const form = new FormData();
 622:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 623:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 624:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 625:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 626:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 627:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 628:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 629:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 630:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 631:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 632:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 633:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 634:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 635:       }
 636:     } catch (cause) {
 637:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 638:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 639:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 640:     }
 641:   }
 642: 
 643:   function closeTransfer() {
 644:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 645:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 646:     setTransferPreview("");
 647:     setTransferFen("");
 648:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 649:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 650:     setRecognitionError("");
 651:       }

 654:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 655:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 656:       setGameEndOverlay({
 657:         title: "Checkmate",
 658:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 659:       });
 660:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 661:       setGameEndOverlay({
 662:         title: "Stalemate",
 663:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 664:       });
 665:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 666:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 667:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 668:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 669:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 670:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 671:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 672:     } else {
 673:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 674:     }
 675:   }

 677:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 678:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 679:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 680:     try {
 681:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 682:       const result = currentGame.move({
 683:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 684:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 685:         promotion: piece,
 686:       });
 687:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 688:       patchBoardSession({
 689:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 690:         moves: nextMoves,
 691:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 692:       });
 693:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 694:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 695:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 696:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 697:       setError("");
 698:     } catch {
 699:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 700:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 701:     }
 702:   }
 703: 
 704:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 705:     if (!boardSession) return;
 706:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 707:     try {
 708:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 709:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 710:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 711:       if (promote) {
 712:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 713:         return;
 714:       }
 715:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 716:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 717:       patchBoardSession({
 718:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 719:         moves: nextMoves,
 720:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 721:       });
 722:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 723:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 724:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 725:       setError("");
 726:     } catch {
 727:       const piece = game.get(to);
 728:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 729:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 730:     }
 731:   }
 732: 
 733:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 734:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 735:     setRedSquares([]);
 736: 
 737:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 738:       setUserArrows([]);
 739:       setArrowStart(null);
 740:       setArrowHover(null);
 741:       return;
 742:     }
 743: if (!boardSession) return;
 744:     if (annotationMode) {
 745:       if (!arrowStart) {
 746:         setArrowStart(square);
 747:         return;
 748:       }
 749:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 750:       setArrowStart(null);
 751:       setArrowHover(null);
 752:       return;
 753:     }
 754:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 755:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 756:       return;
 757:     }
 758:     const piece = game.get(square);
 759:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 760:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 761:   }

 763:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 764:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 765: 
 766:   event.preventDefault();
 767: 
 768:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 769:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 770:     event.clientX,
 771:     event.clientY,
 772:     bounds,
 773:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 774:   );
 775: 
 776:   if (!square) return;
 777: 
 778:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 779:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 780:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 781:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 782:   setArrowStart(square);
 783:   setArrowHover(square);
 784: 
 785:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 786: }
 787: 
 788:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 789:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 790:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 791:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 792:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 793:     setArrowHover(square);
 794:   }
 795: 
 796:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 797:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 798: 
 799:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 800: 
 801:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 802:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 803:     event.clientX,
 804:     event.clientY,
 805:     bounds,
 806:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 807:   );
 808: 
 809:   if (to && to !== from) {
 810:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 811:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 812:   } else {
 813:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 814:   }
 815: 
 816:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 817:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 818:   setArrowStart(null);
 819:   setArrowHover(null);
 820: }

 824:     setArrowStart(null);
 825:     setArrowHover(null);
 826:   }

 874:

 876:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;

 885:

 887:       ...current,
 888:       candidatesByPage: {
 889:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 890:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 891:       },
 892:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 893:     }));
 894: 
 895:     setError("");
 896:     setNotice("Board detection cleared.");
