 908:     }
 909: 
 910:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 911:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 912:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 913:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 914: 
 915:     setDetecting(true);
 916:     setError("");
 917:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 918:     patchSession((current) => ({
 919:       ...current,
 920:       candidatesByPage: {
 921:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 922:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 923:       },
 924:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 925:     }));
 926: 
 927:     try {
 928:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 929:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 930:           (blob) => blob
 931:             ? resolve(blob)
 932:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 933:           "image/png",
 934:         );
 935:       });
 936: 
 937:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 938: 
 939:       const form = new FormData();
 940:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 941: 
 942:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 943:         method: "POST",
 944:         body: form,
 945:         signal: abortController.signal,
 946:       });
 947: 
 948:       if (!response.ok) {
 949:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 950:       }
 951: 
 952:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 953:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 954:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 955:       );
 956: 
 957:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 958: 
 959:       patchSession((current) => ({
 960:         ...current,
 961:         candidatesByPage: {
 962:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 963:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 964:         },
 965:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 966:       }));
 967: 
 968:       setNotice(
 969:         candidates.length
 970:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 971:           : "No board candidates found.",
 972:       );
 973:     } catch (cause) {
 974:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 975: 
 976:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 977:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 978:       } else {
 979:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 980:       }
 981:     } finally {
 982:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 983:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 984:         setDetecting(false);
 985:       }
 986:     }
 987:   }
 988:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
 989:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
 990:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 991:   }

 993:   function startCropEdit(
 994:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 995:     candidate: Candidate,
 996:     handle: CropHandle,
 997:   ) {
 998:     event.stopPropagation();
 999:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1000:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
1001:     if (!point || !stage) return;
1002:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
1003:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1004:   }
1005: 
1006:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1007:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1008:     if (!manualMode) return;
1009: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1010: if (!canvas) return;
1011: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1012: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1013: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1014: if (
1015:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1016:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1017:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1018:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1019: ) return;
1020:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1021:     if (!point) return;
1022:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1023:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1024:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1025:     setDragSelection(selection);
1026:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1027:   }
1028: 
1029:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1030:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1031:     if (edit) {
1032:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1033:       if (!point || !session) return;
1034:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1035:       patchSession((current) => {
1036:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1037:         return {
1038:           ...current,
1039:           candidatesByPage: {
1040:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1041:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1042:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1043:           },
1044:         };
1045:       });
1046:       return;
1047:     }
1048:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1049:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1050:     if (point) {
1051:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1052:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1053:       setDragSelection(selection);
1054:     }
1055:   }
1056: 
1057:   function finishRegion() {
1058:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1059:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1060:       return;
1061:     }
1062:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1063:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1064:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1065:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1066:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1067:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1068:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1069:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1070:     setDragSelection(null);
1071:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1072:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1073:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1074:       x, y, width, height,
1075:       relativeScore: 1,
1076:       source: "manual",
1077:     };
1078:     patchSession((current) => ({
1079:       ...current,
1080:       candidatesByPage: {
1081:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1082:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1083:       },
1084:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1085:     }));
1086:     setManualMode(false);
1087:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1088:   }
1089: 
1090:   function cancelRegion() {
1091:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1092:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1093:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1094:     setDragSelection(null);
1095:   }

1097:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1098:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1099:     try {
1100:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1101:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1102:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1103:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1104:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1105:       const scale = mode === "width"
1106:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1107:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1108:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1109:     } catch (cause) {
1110:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1111:     }
1112:   }

1346:                     const dx = to.x - from.x;

1348:                     const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
1349:                     if (length < 0.001) return null;
1350:

1352:                     const uy = dy / length;
1353:                     const px = -uy;

1357:                     const headHalfWidth = 0.19;
1358:                     const shaftHalfWidth = kind === "preview" ? 0.045 : 0.055;
1359:                     const tipX = to.x - ux * 0.04;
1360:                     const tipY = to.y - uy * 0.04;
1361:                     const baseX = tipX - ux * headLength;
1362:                     const baseY = tipY - uy * headLength;
1363:                     const startX = from.x + ux * 0.12;
1364:                     const startY = from.y + uy * 0.12;
1365: 
1366:                     const points = [
1367:                       [startX + px * shaftHalfWidth, startY + py * shaftHalfWidth],
1368:                       [baseX + px * shaftHalfWidth, baseY + py * shaftHalfWidth],
1369:                       [baseX + px * headHalfWidth, baseY + py * headHalfWidth],
1370:                       [tipX, tipY],

 328:   function toggleEngine() {
 329:     if (engineEnabled) {
 330:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 331:       engineRef.current = null;
 332:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 333:       setEngineStatus("off");
 334:       setEngineScore(null);
 335:       setEngineMessage("");
 336:       return;
 337:     }
 338:     try {
 339:       setEngineScore(null);
 340:       setEngineMessage("");
 341:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 342:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 343:         (status, message) => {
 344:           setEngineStatus(status);
 345:           if (status === "error") {
 346:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 347:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 348:             setEngineScore(null);
 349:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 350:             engineRef.current = null;
 351:           }
 352:         },
 353:         setEngineScore,
 354:       );
 355:       engineRef.current = client;
 356:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 357:     } catch (cause) {
 358:       setEngineStatus("error");
 359:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 360:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 361:     }
 362:   }

 368:     });

 399:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 400:     try {
 401:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 402:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 403:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 404:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 405:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 406:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 407:       setBook(opened);
 408:       setSession(nextSession);
 409:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 410:       setError("");
 411:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 412:     } catch (cause) {
 413:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 414:     }
 415:   }

 417:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 418:     if (!file) return;
 419:     try {
 420:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 421:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 422:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 423:       const now = Date.now();
 424:       const created: BookRecord = {
 425:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 426:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 427:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 428:         byteLength: file.size,
 429:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 430:         addedAt: now,
 431:       };
 432:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 433:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 434:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 435:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 436:       setBook(created);
 437:       setSession(blank);
 438:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 439:       setError("");
 440:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 441:     } catch (cause) {
 442:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 443:     }
 444:   }

 446:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 447:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 448: 
 449:     try {
 450:       await removeBook(item.id);
 451:       await removeSession(item.id);
 452: 
 453:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 454:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 455:         const next = { ...current };
 456:         delete next[item.id];
 457:         return next;
 458:       });
 459: 
 460:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 461:         setBook(null);
 462:         setSession(null);
 463:         setPdf(null);
 464:       }
 465: 
 466:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 467:       setError("");
 468:     } catch (cause) {
 469:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 470:     }
 471:   }
 472:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 473:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 474:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 475:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 476:     try {
 477:       await putBook(renamed);
 478:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 479:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 480:     } catch (cause) {
 481:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 482:     }
 483:   }

 495:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 496:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 497:     try {
 498:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 499:       setSession({
 500:         ...activeSession,
 501:         originalFen: fen,
 502:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 503:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 504:         moves: [],
 505:         moveIndex: 0,
 506:       });
 507:       setLastMove(null);
 508:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 509:       setUserArrows([]);
 510:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 511:       return true;
 512:     } catch (cause) {
 513:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 514:       return false;
 515:     }
 516:   }

 581:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 582:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 583:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 584:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 585:       return;
 586:     }
 587:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 588:     try {
 589:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 590:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 591:       preview.width = crop.width;
 592:       preview.height = crop.height;
 593:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 594:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 595:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 596:     } catch (cause) {
 597:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 598:       return;
 599:     }
 600:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 601:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 602:     setTransferFen("");
 603:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 604:         setRecognitionError("");
 605:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 606:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 607:     try {
 608:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 609:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 610:       });
 611:       const form = new FormData();
 612:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 613:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 614:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 615:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 616:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 617:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 618:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 619:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 620:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 621:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 622:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 623:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 624:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 625:       }
 626:     } catch (cause) {
 627:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 628:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 629:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 630:     }
 631:   }
 632: 
 633:   function closeTransfer() {
 634:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 635:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 636:     setTransferPreview("");
 637:     setTransferFen("");
 638:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 639:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 640:     setRecognitionError("");
 641:       }

 644:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 645:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 646:       setGameEndOverlay({
 647:         title: "Checkmate",
 648:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 649:       });
 650:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 651:       setGameEndOverlay({
 652:         title: "Stalemate",
 653:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 654:       });
 655:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 656:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 657:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 658:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 659:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 660:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 661:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 662:     } else {
 663:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 664:     }
 665:   }
 666: 
 667:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 668:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 669:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 670:     try {
 671:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 672:       const result = currentGame.move({
 673:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 674:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 675:         promotion: piece,
 676:       });
 677:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 678:       patchBoardSession({
 679:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 680:         moves: nextMoves,
 681:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 682:       });
 683:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 684:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 685:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 686:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 687:       setError("");
 688:     } catch {
 689:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 690:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 691:     }
 692:   }
 693: 
 694:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 695:     if (!boardSession) return;
 696:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 697:     try {
 698:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 699:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 700:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 701:       if (promote) {
 702:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 703:         return;
 704:       }
 705:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 706:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 707:       patchBoardSession({
 708:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 709:         moves: nextMoves,
 710:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 711:       });
 712:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 713:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 714:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 715:       setError("");
 716:     } catch {
 717:       const piece = game.get(to);
 718:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 719:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 720:     }
 721:   }

 723:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 724:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 725:     setRedSquares([]);
 726: 
 727:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 728:       setUserArrows([]);
 729:       setArrowStart(null);
 730:       setArrowHover(null);
 731:       return;
 732:     }
 733: if (!boardSession) return;
 734:     if (annotationMode) {
 735:       if (!arrowStart) {
 736:         setArrowStart(square);
 737:         return;
 738:       }
 739:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 740:       setArrowStart(null);
 741:       setArrowHover(null);
 742:       return;
 743:     }
 744:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 745:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 746:       return;
 747:     }
 748:     const piece = game.get(square);
 749:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 750:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 751:   }

 888:   async function detectBoards() {
 889:     if (detecting) {
 890:       stopBoardScan();
 891:       return;
 892:     }
 893: 
 894:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 895:     if (!API_BASE) {
 896:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 897:       return;
 898:     }
 899: 
 900:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 901:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 902:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 903:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 904: 
 905:     setDetecting(true);
 906:     setError("");
 907:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 908:     patchSession((current) => ({
 909:       ...current,
 910:       candidatesByPage: {
 911:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 912:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 913:       },
 914:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 915:     }));
 916: 
 917:     try {
 918:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 919:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 920:           (blob) => blob
 921:             ? resolve(blob)
 922:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 923:           "image/png",
 924:         );
 925:       });
 926: 
 927:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 928: 
 929:       const form = new FormData();
 930:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 931: 
 932:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 933:         method: "POST",
 934:         body: form,
 935:         signal: abortController.signal,
 936:       });
 937: 
 938:       if (!response.ok) {
 939:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 940:       }
 941: 
 942:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 943:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 944:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 945:       );
 946: 
 947:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 948: 
 949:       patchSession((current) => ({
 950:         ...current,
 951:         candidatesByPage: {
 952:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 953:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 954:         },
 955:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 956:       }));
 957: 
 958:       setNotice(
 959:         candidates.length
 960:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 961:           : "No board candidates found.",
 962:       );
 963:     } catch (cause) {
 964:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 965: 
 966:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 967:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 968:       } else {
 969:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 970:       }
 971:     } finally {
 972:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 973:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 974:         setDetecting(false);
 975:       }
 976:     }
 977:   }

 996:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 997:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 998:     if (!manualMode) return;
 999: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1000: if (!canvas) return;
1001: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1002: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1003: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1004: if (
1005:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1006:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1007:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1008:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1009: ) return;
1010:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1011:     if (!point) return;
1012:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1013:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1014:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;

1019:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1020:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1021:     if (edit) {
1022:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1023:       if (!point || !session) return;
1024:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1025:       patchSession((current) => {
1026:         const pageKey = String(current.page);

1028:           ...current,
1029:           candidatesByPage: {
1030:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1031:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1032:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1033:           },
1034:         };
1035:       });
1036:       return;
1037:     }
1038:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1039:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1040:     if (point) {
1041:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1042:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1043:       setDragSelection(selection);

1047:   function finishRegion() {
1048:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1049:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1050:       return;
1051:     }
1052:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1053:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1054:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1055:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1056:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1057:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1058:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1059:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1060:     setDragSelection(null);
1061:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1062:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1063:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1064:       x, y, width, height,
1065:       relativeScore: 1,
1066:       source: "manual",
1067:     };
1068:     patchSession((current) => ({
1069:       ...current,
1070:       candidatesByPage: {
1071:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1072:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1073:       },
1074:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1075:     }));
1076:     setManualMode(false);
1077:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1078:   }

1087:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1088:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1089:     try {
1090:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1091:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1092:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1093:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1094:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1095:       const scale = mode === "width"
1096:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1097:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1098:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1099:     } catch (cause) {
1100:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1101:     }
1102:   }

 407:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 408:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 409:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 410:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 411:       setBook(created);
 412:       setSession(blank);
 413:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 414:       setError("");
 415:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 416:     } catch (cause) {
 417:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 418:     }
 419:   }
 420: 
 421:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 422:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove "${item.title}" from your library?`)) return;
 423: 
 424:     try {
 425:       await removeBook(item.id);
 426:       await removeSession(item.id);
 427: 
 428:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 429:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 430:         const next = { ...current };
 431:         delete next[item.id];
 432:         return next;
 433:       });
 434: 
 435:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 436:         setBook(null);
 437:         setSession(null);
 438:         setPdf(null);
 439:       }
 440: 
 441:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 442:       setError("");
 443:     } catch (cause) {
 444:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 445:     }
 446:   }
 447:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 448:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 449:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 450:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 451:     try {
 452:       await putBook(renamed);
 453:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 454:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 455:     } catch (cause) {
 456:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 457:     }
 458:   }

 470:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {

 479:         moveIndex: 0,

 481:       setLastMove(null);
 482:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 483:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 484:       return true;
 485:     } catch (cause) {
 486:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 487:       return false;
 488:     }

 540:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 541:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 542:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 543:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 544:       return;
 545:     }
 546:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 547:     try {
 548:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 549:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 550:       preview.width = crop.width;
 551:       preview.height = crop.height;
 552:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 553:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 554:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 555:     } catch (cause) {
 556:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 557:       return;
 558:     }
 559:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 560:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 561:     setTransferFen("");
 562:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 563:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 564:     setRecognitionError("");
 565:     setTransferPiece("P");
 566:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 567:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 568:     try {
 569:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 570:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 571:       });
 572:       const form = new FormData();
 573:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 574:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 575:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 576:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 577:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 578:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 579:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 580:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 581:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 582:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 583:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 584:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 585:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 586:       }
 587:     } catch (cause) {
 588:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 589:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 590:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 591:     }
 592:   }
 593: 
 594:   function closeTransfer() {
 595:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 596:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 597:     setTransferPreview("");
 598:     setTransferFen("");
 599:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 600:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 601:     setRecognitionError("");
 602:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 603:   }

 605:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 606:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 607:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 608:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 609:       return;
 610:     }
 611:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 612:     if (!board) {
 613:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 614:       return;
 615:     }
 616:     const row = displayRow;
 617:     const col = displayCol;
 618:     try {
 619:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 620:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 621:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 622:       setRecognitionError("");
 623:     } catch (cause) {
 624:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 625:     }
 626:   }
 627: 
 628:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 629:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 630:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 631:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 632:       return;
 633:     }
 634:     try {
 635:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 636:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 637:       setRecognitionError("");
 638:     } catch (cause) {
 639:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 640:     }
 641:   }
 642: 
 643:   function confirmTransfer() {
 644:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 645:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 646:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 647:       return;
 648:     }
 649:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 650:       closeTransfer();
 651:     }
 652:   }
 653: 
 654:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 655:     if (!session) return;
 656:     try {
 657:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 658:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 659:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 660:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 661:       if (promote) {
 662:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 663:         if (!choice) return;
 664:         switch (choice) {
 665:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 666:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 667:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 668:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 669:           default:
 670:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 671:             return;
 672:         }
 673:       }
 674:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 675:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 676:       patchSession({
 677:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 678:         moves: nextMoves,
 679:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 680:       });
 681:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 682:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 683:       setError("");
 684:     } catch {
 685:       const piece = game.get(to);
 686:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 687:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 688:     }
 689:   }
 690: 
 691:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 692:     if (!session) return;
 693:     if (annotationMode) {
 694:       if (!arrowStart) {
 695:         setArrowStart(square);
 696:         return;
 697:       }
 698:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 699:       setArrowStart(null);
 700:       setArrowHover(null);
 701:       return;
 702:     }
 703:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 704:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 705:       return;
 706:     }
 707:     const piece = game.get(square);
 708:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 709:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 710:   }

 738:     setArrowStart(null);
 739:     setArrowHover(null);

 770:   async function detectBoards() {
 771:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 772:     if (!API_BASE) {
 773:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Start the optional CV service and set VITE_API_BASE_URL, or draw a board region manually.");
 774:       return;
 775:     }
 776:     setDetecting(true);
 777:     setError("");
 778:     try {
 779:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 780:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")), "image/png");
 781:       });
 782:       const form = new FormData();
 783:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 784:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 785:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 786:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 787:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map((item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index));
 788:       patchSession((current) => ({
 789:         ...current,
 790:         candidatesByPage: { ...current.candidatesByPage, [String(current.page)]: candidates },
 791:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 792:       }));
 793:       setNotice(candidates.length ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.` : "No board candidates found. You can draw a region manually.");
 794:     } catch (cause) {
 795:       setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 796:     } finally {
 797:       setDetecting(false);
 798:     }
 799:   }

 806:   function startCropEdit(
 807:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 808:     candidate: Candidate,
 809:     handle: CropHandle,
 810:   ) {
 811:     event.stopPropagation();
 812:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 813:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;

 819:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 820:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 821:     if (!manualMode) return;
 822: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 823: if (!canvas) return;
 824: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 825: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 826: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 827: if (
 828:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 829:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 830:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 831:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 832: ) return;
 833:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 834:     if (!point) return;
 835:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 836:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 837:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 838:     setDragSelection(selection);
 839:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 840:   }
 841: 
 842:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 843:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 844:     if (edit) {
 845:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 846:       if (!point || !session) return;
 847:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 848:       patchSession((current) => {
 849:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 850:         return {
 851:           ...current,
 852:           candidatesByPage: {
 853:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 854:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 855:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 856:           },
 857:         };
 858:       });
 859:       return;
 860:     }
 861:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 862:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 863:     if (point) {
 864:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 865:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 866:       setDragSelection(selection);
 867:     }
 868:   }
 869: 
 870:   function finishRegion() {
 871:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 872:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 873:       return;
 874:     }
 875:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 876:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 877:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 878:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 879:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 880:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 881:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 882:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 883:     setDragSelection(null);
 884:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 885:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 886:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 887:       x, y, width, height,
 888:       relativeScore: 1,
 889:       source: "manual",
 890:     };
 891:     patchSession((current) => ({
 892:       ...current,
 893:       candidatesByPage: {
 894:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 895:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 896:       },
 897:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 898:     }));
 899:     setManualMode(false);
 900:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 901:   }
 902: 
 903:   function cancelRegion() {
 904:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 905:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 906:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 907:     setDragSelection(null);
 908:   }

 910:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 911:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 912:     try {
 913:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 914:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 915:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 916:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 917:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 918:       const scale = mode === "width"
 919:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 920:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 921:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 922:     } catch (cause) {
 923:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 924:     }
 925:   }

 935:     }
 936:   }

 961:   function resetBoard() {
 962:     if (!session) return;
 963:     const original = new Chess(session.originalFen);
 964:     patchSession({
 965:       lineBaseFen: original.fen(),
 966:       currentFen: original.fen(),
 967:       moves: [],
 968:       moveIndex: 0,
 969:     });
 970:     setLastMove(null);
 971:     setSelectedSquare(null);

 973: 
 974:   const currentCandidates = session?.candidatesByPage[String(session.page)] ?? [];
 975:   const detectionAttempted = Boolean(session && Object.hasOwn(session.candidatesByPage, String(session.page)));
 976:   const currentDiagram = currentCandidates.find((candidate) => candidate.id === session?.selectedDiagramId);

  28: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  29:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  30:   if (!match) return uci;
  31:   try {
  32:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  33:     const move = position.move({
  34:       from: match[1] as Square,
  35:       to: match[2] as Square,
  36:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  37:     });
  38:     return move.san;
  39:   } catch {
  40:     return uci;
  41:   }

  44: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {

 286:       const task = page.render({ canvas, canvasContext: context, viewport });
 287:       renderTaskRef.current = task;
 288:       return task.promise;
 289:     }).then(() => {
 290:       if (!cancelled) setRendering(false);
 291:     }).catch((cause: unknown) => {
 292:       if (!cancelled && !(cause instanceof Error && cause.name === "RenderingCancelledException")) {
 293:         setRendering(false);
 294:         setError(`Could not render page ${session.page}: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 295:       }
 296:     });
 297:     return () => {
 298:       cancelled = true;
 299:       renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
 300:     };
 301:   }, [pdf, session?.page, session?.zoom]);
 302: 
 303:   useEffect(() => {
 304:     function onKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 305:       if (!session || !book || isTypingTarget(event.target)) return;
 306:       if (cropEditingId && ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key)) {
 307:         const candidate = (session.candidatesByPage[String(session.page)] ?? []).find((item) => item.id === cropEditingId);
 308:         if (!candidate) return;
 309:         const step = event.shiftKey ? 0.01 : 0.002;
 310:         const x = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
 311:         const y = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
 312:         const next = editCrop(candidate, "move", x, y);
 313:         patchSession((current) => {
 314:           const pageKey = String(current.page);
 315:           return {
 316:             ...current,
 317:             candidatesByPage: {
 318:               ...current.candidatesByPage,
 319:               [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((item) =>
 320:                 item.id === candidate.id ? { ...item, ...next } : item),
 321:             },
 322:           };
 323:         });
 324:         event.preventDefault();
 325:         return;
 326:       }
 327:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 328:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 329:     }
 330:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 331:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 332:   });

 443:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 444:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);

 447:   function toggleEngine() {
 448:     if (engineEnabled) {
 449:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 450:       engineRef.current = null;
 451:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 452:       setEngineStatus("off");
 453:       setEngineScore(null);
 454:       setEngineMessage("");
 455:       return;
 456:     }
 457:     try {
 458:       setEngineScore(null);
 459:       setEngineMessage("");
 460:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 461:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 462:         (status, message) => {
 463:           setEngineStatus(status);
 464:           if (status === "error") {
 465:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 466:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 467:             setEngineScore(null);
 468:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 469:             engineRef.current = null;
 470:           }
 471:         },
 472:         setEngineScore,
 473:       );
 474:       engineRef.current = client;
 475:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 476:     } catch (cause) {
 477:       setEngineStatus("error");
 478:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 479:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 480:     }
 481:   }

 483:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 484:     setSession((current) => {
 485:       if (!current) return current;
 486:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 487:     });
 488:   }
 489: 
 490:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 491:     if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 492:       return;
 493:     }
 494: 
 495:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 496:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 497:     } else if (workspaceMode === "opening-prep") {
 498:       setOpeningPrepBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 499:     } else if (studyMode) {
 500:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 501:     } else {
 502:       patchSession(change);
 503:     }
 504:   }
 505:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 506:     if (!studyMode) {
 507:       if (!session) {
 508:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 509:         return;
 510:       }
 511:       setStudyBoard({
 512:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 513:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 514:         moves: [...session.moves],
 515:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 516:         flipped: session.flipped,
 517:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 518:       });
 519:       setStudyMode(true);
 520:     } else {
 521:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 522:       if (studyBoard) {
 523:         patchSession({
 524:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 525:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 526:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 527:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 528:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 529:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 530:         });
 531:       }
 532:       setStudyMode(false);
 533:     }
 534:     setLastMove(null);
 535:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 536:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 537:   
 538:     try {
 539:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 540:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 541:       } else {
 542:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 543:       }
 544:     } catch {
 545:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 546:     }
 547: }

 549:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 550:     try {
 551:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 552:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 553:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 554:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 555:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 556:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 557:       setBook(opened);
 558:       setSession(nextSession);
 559:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 560:       setError("");
 561:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 562:     } catch (cause) {
 563:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 564:     }
 565:   }

 567:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 568:     if (!file) return;
 569:     try {
 570:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 571:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 572:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 573:       const now = Date.now();
 574:       const created: BookRecord = {
 575:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 576:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 577:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 578:         byteLength: file.size,
 579:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 580:         addedAt: now,
 581:       };
 582:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 583:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 584:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 585:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 586:       setBook(created);
 587:       setSession(blank);
 588:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 589:       setError("");
 590:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 591:     } catch (cause) {
 592:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 593:     }
 594:   }

 596:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 597:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 598: 
 599:     try {
 600:       await removeBook(item.id);
 601:       await removeSession(item.id);
 602: 
 603:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 604:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 605:         const next = { ...current };
 606:         delete next[item.id];
 607:         return next;
 608:       });
 609: 
 610:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 611:         setBook(null);
 612:         setSession(null);
 613:         setPdf(null);
 614:       }
 615: 
 616:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 617:       setError("");
 618:     } catch (cause) {
 619:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 620:     }
 621:   }
 622:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 623:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 624:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 625:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 626:     try {
 627:       await putBook(renamed);
 628:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 629:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 630:     } catch (cause) {
 631:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 632:     }
 633:   }

 656:       });

 658:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 659:       setUserArrows([]);

 661:       return true;
 662:     } catch (cause) {
 663:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 664:       return false;
 665:     }
 666:   }

 731:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 732:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 733:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 734:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 735:       return;
 736:     }
 737:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 738:     try {
 739:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 740:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 741:       preview.width = crop.width;
 742:       preview.height = crop.height;
 743:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 744:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 745:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 746:     } catch (cause) {
 747:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 748:       return;
 749:     }
 750:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 751:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 752:     setTransferFen("");
 753:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 754:         setRecognitionError("");
 755:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 756:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 757:     try {
 758:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 759:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 760:       });
 761:       const form = new FormData();
 762:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 763:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 764:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 765:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 766:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 767:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 768:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 769:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 770:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 771:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 772:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 773:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 774:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 775:       }
 776:     } catch (cause) {
 777:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 778:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 779:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 780:     }
 781:   }
 782: 
 783:   function closeTransfer() {
 784:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 785:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 786:     setTransferPreview("");
 787:     setTransferFen("");
 788:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 789:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 790:     setRecognitionError("");
 791:       }

 794:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 795:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 796:       setGameEndOverlay({
 797:         title: "Checkmate",
 798:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 799:       });
 800:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 801:       setGameEndOverlay({
 802:         title: "Stalemate",
 803:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 804:       });
 805:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 806:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 807:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 808:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 809:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 810:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 811:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 812:     } else {
 813:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 814:     }
 815:   }
 816: 
 817:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 818:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 819:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 820:     try {
 821:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 822:       const result = currentGame.move({
 823:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 824:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 825:         promotion: piece,
 826:       });
 827:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 828:       patchBoardSession({
 829:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 830:         moves: nextMoves,
 831:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 832:       });
 833:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 834:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 835:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 836:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 837:       setError("");
 838:     } catch {
 839:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 840:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 841:     }
 842:   }
 843: 
 844:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 845:     if (!boardSession) return;
 846:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 847:     try {
 848:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 849:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 850:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 851:       if (promote) {
 852:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 853:         return;
 854:       }
 855:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 856:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 857:       if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 858:         const line = nextMoves
 859:           .map((move, index) => index % 2 === 0 ? `${Math.floor(index / 2) + 1}. ${move}` : move)
 860:           .join(" ");
 861:         setOpeningExplorerInput(line);
 862:         setOpeningExplorerPly(nextMoves.length);
 863:       } else {
 864:         patchBoardSession({
 865:           currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 866:           moves: nextMoves,
 867:           moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 868:         });
 869:       }
 870:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 871:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 872:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 873:       setError("");
 874:     } catch {
 875:       const piece = game.get(to);
 876:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 877:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 878:     }
 879:   }
 880: 
 881:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 882:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 883:     setRedSquares([]);
 884: 
 885:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 886:       setUserArrows([]);
 887:       setArrowStart(null);
 888:       setArrowHover(null);
 889:       return;
 890:     }
 891: if (!boardSession) return;
 892:     if (annotationMode) {
 893:       if (!arrowStart) {
 894:         setArrowStart(square);
 895:         return;
 896:       }
 897:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 898:       setArrowStart(null);
 899:       setArrowHover(null);
 900:       return;
 901:     }
 902:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 903:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 904:       return;
 905:     }
 906:     const piece = game.get(square);
 907:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 908:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 909:   }

 911:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 912:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 913: 
 914:   event.preventDefault();
 915: 
 916:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 917:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 918:     event.clientX,
 919:     event.clientY,
 920:     bounds,
 921:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 922:   );
 923: 
 924:   if (!square) return;
 925: 
 926:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 927:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 928:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 929:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 930:   setArrowStart(square);
 931:   setArrowHover(square);
 932: 
 933:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 934: }
 935: 
 936:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 937:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 938:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 939:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 940:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 941:     setArrowHover(square);
 942:   }
 943: 
 944:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 945:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 946: 
 947:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 948: 
 949:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 950:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 951:     event.clientX,
 952:     event.clientY,
 953:     bounds,
 954:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 955:   );
 956: 
 957:   if (to && to !== from) {
 958:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 959:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 960:   } else {
 961:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 962:   }
 963: 
 964:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 965:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 966:   setArrowStart(null);
 967:   setArrowHover(null);
 968: }

 976:   function jumpToMove(index: number) {
 977:     if (!boardSession) return;

 979:       const next = makePosition(boardSession.lineBaseFen, boardSession.moves, index);

 982:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
 983:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 984:     } catch (cause) {
 985:       setError(`Could not navigate to move: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 986:     }
 987:   }

1046:   async function detectBoards() {
1047:     if (detecting) {
1048:       stopBoardScan();
1049:       return;
1050:     }
1051: 
1052:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
1053:     if (!API_BASE) {
1054:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1055:       return;
1056:     }
1057: 
1058:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1059:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1060:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1061:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1062: 
1063:     setDetecting(true);
1064:     setError("");
1065:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1066:     patchSession((current) => ({
1067:       ...current,
1068:       candidatesByPage: {
1069:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1070:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1071:       },
1072:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1073:     }));
1074: 
1075:     try {
1076:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1077:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1078:           (blob) => blob
1079:             ? resolve(blob)
1080:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1081:           "image/png",
1082:         );
1083:       });
1084: 
1085:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1086: 
1087:       const form = new FormData();
1088:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1089: 
1090:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1091:         method: "POST",
1092:         body: form,
1093:         signal: abortController.signal,
1094:       });
1095: 
1096:       if (!response.ok) {
1097:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1098:       }
1099: 
1100:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1101:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1102:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1103:       );
1104: 
1105:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1106: 
1107:       patchSession((current) => ({
1108:         ...current,
1109:         candidatesByPage: {
1110:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1111:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1112:         },
1113:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1114:       }));
1115: 
1116:       setNotice(
1117:         candidates.length
1118:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1119:           : "No board candidates found.",
1120:       );
1121:     } catch (cause) {
1122:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1123: 
1124:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1125:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1126:       } else {
1127:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1128:       }
1129:     } finally {
1130:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1131:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1132:         setDetecting(false);
1133:       }
1134:     }
1135:   }

1154:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1155:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1156:     if (!manualMode) return;
1157: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1158: if (!canvas) return;
1159: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1160: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1161: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1162: if (
1163:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1164:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1165:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1166:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1167: ) return;
1168:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1169:     if (!point) return;
1170:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1171:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1172:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1173:     setDragSelection(selection);
1174:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1175:   }

1177:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1178:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1179:     if (edit) {
1180:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1181:       if (!point || !session) return;
1182:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1183:       patchSession((current) => {
1184:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1185:         return {
1186:           ...current,
1187:           candidatesByPage: {
1188:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1189:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1190:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1191:           },
1192:         };
1193:       });
1194:       return;
1195:     }
1196:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1197:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1198:     if (point) {
1199:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1200:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1201:       setDragSelection(selection);
1202:     }
1203:   }

1205:   function finishRegion() {
1206:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1207:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1208:       return;
1209:     }
1210:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1211:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1212:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1213:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1214:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1215:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1216:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1217:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1218:     setDragSelection(null);
1219:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1220:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1221:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1222:       x, y, width, height,
1223:       relativeScore: 1,
1224:       source: "manual",
1225:     };
1226:     patchSession((current) => ({
1227:       ...current,
1228:       candidatesByPage: {
1229:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1230:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1231:       },
1232:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1233:     }));
1234:     setManualMode(false);
1235:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1236:   }

1239:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1240:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1241:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1242:     setDragSelection(null);
1243:   }

1245:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1246:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1247:     try {
1248:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1249:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1250:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1251:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1252:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1253:       const scale = mode === "width"
1254:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1255:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1256:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1257:     } catch (cause) {
1258:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1259:     }
1260:   }

  26: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  27:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  28:   if (!match) return uci;
  29:   try {
  30:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  31:     const move = position.move({
  32:       from: match[1] as Square,
  33:       to: match[2] as Square,
  34:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  35:     });
  36:     return move.san;
  37:   } catch {
  38:     return uci;
  39:   }
  40: }
  41: 
  42: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  43:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  44:   const san: string[] = [];
  45:   for (const uci of pv) {
  46:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  47:     if (!match) break;
  48:     try {
  49:       const move = position.move({
  50:         from: match[1] as Square,
  51:         to: match[2] as Square,
  52:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  53:       });
  54:       san.push(move.san);
  55:     } catch {
  56:       break;
  57:     }
  58:   }
  59:   return san.join(" ");
  60: }

  82: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  83:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";

  85:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
