 921:   function clearBoardScan() {
 922:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 923:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 924: 
 925:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 926:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 927:     controller?.abort();
 928: 
 929:     setDetecting(false);
 930:     setManualMode(false);
 931:     setDragSelection(null);
 932:     setCropEditingId(null);
 933:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 934:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 935: 
 936:     patchSession((current) => ({
 937:       ...current,
 938:       candidatesByPage: {
 939:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 940:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 941:       },
 942:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 943:     }));
 944: 
 945:     setError("");
 946:     setNotice("Board detection cleared.");

 948:   async function detectBoards() {
 949:     if (detecting) {
 950:       stopBoardScan();
 951:       return;
 952:     }
 953: 
 954:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 955:     if (!API_BASE) {
 956:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 957:       return;
 958:     }
 959: 
 960:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 961:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 962:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 963:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 964: 
 965:     setDetecting(true);
 966:     setError("");
 967:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 968:     patchSession((current) => ({
 969:       ...current,
 970:       candidatesByPage: {
 971:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 972:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 973:       },
 974:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 975:     }));
 976: 
 977:     try {
 978:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 979:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 980:           (blob) => blob
 981:             ? resolve(blob)
 982:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 983:           "image/png",
 984:         );
 985:       });
 986: 
 987:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 988: 
 989:       const form = new FormData();
 990:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 991: 
 992:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 993:         method: "POST",
 994:         body: form,
 995:         signal: abortController.signal,
 996:       });
 997: 
 998:       if (!response.ok) {
 999:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1000:       }
1001: 
1002:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1003:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1004:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1005:       );
1006: 
1007:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1008: 
1009:       patchSession((current) => ({
1010:         ...current,
1011:         candidatesByPage: {
1012:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1013:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1014:         },
1015:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1016:       }));
1017: 
1018:       setNotice(
1019:         candidates.length
1020:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1021:           : "No board candidates found.",
1022:       );
1023:     } catch (cause) {
1024:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1025: 
1026:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1027:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1028:       } else {
1029:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1030:       }
1031:     } finally {
1032:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1033:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1034:         setDetecting(false);
1035:       }
1036:     }
1037:   }
1038:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
1039:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
1040:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
1041:   }

1043:   function startCropEdit(
1044:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
1045:     candidate: Candidate,
1046:     handle: CropHandle,
1047:   ) {
1048:     event.stopPropagation();
1049:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1050:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
1051:     if (!point || !stage) return;
1052:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
1053:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);

1056:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1057:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1058:     if (!manualMode) return;
1059: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1060: if (!canvas) return;
1061: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1062: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1063: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1064: if (
1065:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1066:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1067:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1068:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1069: ) return;
1070:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1071:     if (!point) return;
1072:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1073:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1074:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1075:     setDragSelection(selection);
1076:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1077:   }
1078: 
1079:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1080:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1081:     if (edit) {
1082:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1083:       if (!point || !session) return;
1084:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1085:       patchSession((current) => {
1086:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1087:         return {
1088:           ...current,
1089:           candidatesByPage: {
1090:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1091:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1092:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1093:           },
1094:         };
1095:       });
1096:       return;
1097:     }
1098:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1099:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1100:     if (point) {
1101:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1102:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1103:       setDragSelection(selection);
1104:     }
1105:   }
1106: 
1107:   function finishRegion() {
1108:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1109:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1110:       return;
1111:     }
1112:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1113:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1114:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1115:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1116:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1117:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1118:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1119:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1120:     setDragSelection(null);
1121:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1122:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1123:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1124:       x, y, width, height,
1125:       relativeScore: 1,
1126:       source: "manual",
1127:     };
1128:     patchSession((current) => ({
1129:       ...current,
1130:       candidatesByPage: {
1131:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1132:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1133:       },
1134:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1135:     }));
1136:     setManualMode(false);
1137:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1138:   }
1139: 
1140:   function cancelRegion() {
1141:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1142:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1143:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1144:     setDragSelection(null);
1145:   }

1147:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1148:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1149:     try {
1150:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1151:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1152:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1153:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1154:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1155:       const scale = mode === "width"
1156:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1157:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1158:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1159:     } catch (cause) {
1160:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1161:     }
1162:   }

  42: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  43:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  44:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  45:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  46:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;
  47:   if (elapsed < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 3_600_000)}h ago`;
  48:   return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  49: }
  50: 
  51: function squareName(fileIndex: number, rankIndex: number): Square {
  52:   return `${"abcdefgh"[fileIndex]}${rankIndex + 1}` as Square;
  53: }
  54: 
  55: function normalizedCandidate(value: CandidateInput, index: number): Candidate {
  56:   const { relative_score, confidence, ...candidate } = value;
  57:   return {
  58:     ...candidate,
  59:     id: candidate.id || `candidate-${index + 1}`,
  60:     source: candidate.source ?? "automatic",
  61:     relativeScore: candidate.relativeScore ?? relative_score ?? confidence ?? 0,
  62:   };
  63: }

 326:   function toggleEngine() {
 327:     if (engineEnabled) {
 328:       engineRef.current?.dispose();

 331:       setEngineStatus("off");
 332:       setEngineScore(null);

 335:     }

 337:       setEngineScore(null);
 338:       setEngineMessage("");

 340:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 341:         (status, message) => {
 342:           setEngineStatus(status);
 343:           if (status === "error") {
 344:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 345:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 346:             setEngineScore(null);
 347:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 348:             engineRef.current = null;
 349:           }
 350:         },
 351:         setEngineScore,
 352:       );
 353:       engineRef.current = client;
 354:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 355:     } catch (cause) {
 356:       setEngineStatus("error");
 357:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 358:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 359:     }

 362:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {

 380:       setError("");

 387:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 388:     if (!file) return;
 389:     try {
 390:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 391:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 392:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 393:       const now = Date.now();
 394:       const created: BookRecord = {
 395:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 396:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 397:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 398:         byteLength: file.size,
 399:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 400:         addedAt: now,
 401:       };
 402:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 403:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 404:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 405:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 406:       setBook(created);
 407:       setSession(blank);
 408:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 409:       setError("");
 410:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 411:     } catch (cause) {
 412:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 413:     }
 414:   }

 442:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {

 551:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 552:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 553:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 554:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 555:       return;
 556:     }
 557:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 558:     try {
 559:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 560:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 561:       preview.width = crop.width;
 562:       preview.height = crop.height;
 563:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 564:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 565:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 566:     } catch (cause) {
 567:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 568:       return;
 569:     }
 570:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 571:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 572:     setTransferFen("");
 573:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 574:         setRecognitionError("");
 575:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 576:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 577:     try {
 578:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 579:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 580:       });
 581:       const form = new FormData();
 582:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 583:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 584:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 585:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 586:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 587:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 588:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 589:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 590:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 591:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 592:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 593:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 594:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 595:       }
 596:     } catch (cause) {
 597:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 598:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 599:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 600:     }
 601:   }

 603:   function closeTransfer() {
 604:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 605:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 606:     setTransferPreview("");
 607:     setTransferFen("");
 608:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 609:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 610:     setRecognitionError("");
 611:       }

 614:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 615:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 616:       setGameEndOverlay({
 617:         title: "Checkmate",
 618:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 619:       });
 620:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 621:       setGameEndOverlay({
 622:         title: "Stalemate",
 623:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 624:       });
 625:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 626:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 627:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 629:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 630:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 631:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 632:     } else {
 633:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 634:     }
 635:   }
 636: 
 637:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 638:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 639:     try {
 640:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 641:       const result = currentGame.move({
 642:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 643:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 644:         promotion: piece,
 645:       });
 646:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 647:       patchSession({
 648:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 649:         moves: nextMoves,
 650:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 651:       });
 652:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 653:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 654:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 655:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 656:       setError("");
 657:     } catch {
 658:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 659:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 660:     }
 661:   }
 662: 
 663:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 664:     if (!session) return;
 665:     try {
 666:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 667:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 668:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 669:       if (promote) {
 670:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 671:         return;
 672:       }
 673:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 674:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 675:       patchSession({
 676:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 677:         moves: nextMoves,
 678:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 679:       });
 680:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 681:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 682:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 683:       setError("");
 684:     } catch {
 685:       const piece = game.get(to);
 686:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 687:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 688:     }
 689:   }

 691:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 692:     
 693:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 694:       setUserArrows([]);
 695:       setArrowStart(null);
 696:       setArrowHover(null);
 697:       return;
 698:     }
 699: if (!session) return;
 700:     if (annotationMode) {
 701:       if (!arrowStart) {
 702:         setArrowStart(square);
 703:         return;
 704:       }
 705:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 706:       setArrowStart(null);
 707:       setArrowHover(null);
 708:       return;
 709:     }
 710:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 711:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 712:       return;
 713:     }
 714:     const piece = game.get(square);
 715:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 716:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 717:   }

 745:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 746:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

 752:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 753:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 754: 
 755:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 756: 
 757:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 758:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 759:     event.clientX,
 760:     event.clientY,
 761:     bounds,
 762:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 763:   );
 764: 
 765:   if (to && to !== from) {
 766:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 767:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 768:   } else {
 769:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 770:   }
 771: 
 772:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 773:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 774:   setArrowStart(null);
 775:   setArrowHover(null);

 854:   async function detectBoards() {
 855:     if (detecting) {
 856:       stopBoardScan();
 857:       return;
 858:     }
 859: 
 860:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 861:     if (!API_BASE) {
 862:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 863:       return;
 864:     }
 865: 
 866:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 867:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 868:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 869:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 870: 
 871:     setDetecting(true);
 872:     setError("");
 873:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 874:     patchSession((current) => ({
 875:       ...current,
 876:       candidatesByPage: {
 877:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 878:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 879:       },
 880:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 881:     }));
 882: 
 883:     try {
 884:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 885:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 886:           (blob) => blob
 887:             ? resolve(blob)
 888:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 889:           "image/png",
 890:         );
 891:       });
 892: 
 893:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 894: 
 895:       const form = new FormData();
 896:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 897: 
 898:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 899:         method: "POST",
 900:         body: form,
 901:         signal: abortController.signal,
 902:       });
 903: 
 904:       if (!response.ok) {
 905:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 906:       }
 907: 
 908:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 909:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 910:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 911:       );
 912: 
 913:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 914: 
 915:       patchSession((current) => ({
 916:         ...current,
 917:         candidatesByPage: {
 918:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 919:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 920:         },
 921:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 922:       }));
 923: 
 924:       setNotice(
 925:         candidates.length
 926:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 927:           : "No board candidates found.",
 928:       );
 929:     } catch (cause) {
 930:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 931: 
 932:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 933:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 934:       } else {
 935:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 936:       }
 937:     } finally {
 938:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 939:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 940:         setDetecting(false);
 941:       }
 942:     }
 943:   }

 962:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 963:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 964:     if (!manualMode) return;
 965: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 966: if (!canvas) return;
 967: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 968: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 969: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 970: if (
 971:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 972:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 973:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 974:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 975: ) return;
 976:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 977:     if (!point) return;
 978:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 979:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 980:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 981:     setDragSelection(selection);
 982:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 983:   }

 985:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 986:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 987:     if (edit) {
 988:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 989:       if (!point || !session) return;
 990:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 991:       patchSession((current) => {
 992:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 993:         return {
 994:           ...current,
 995:           candidatesByPage: {
 996:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 997:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 998:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 999:           },
1000:         };
1001:       });
1002:       return;
1003:     }
1004:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1005:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1006:     if (point) {
1007:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1008:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1009:       setDragSelection(selection);
1010:     }
1011:   }

1013:   function finishRegion() {
1014:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1015:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1016:       return;
1017:     }
1018:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1019:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1020:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1021:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1022:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1023:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1024:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1025:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1026:     setDragSelection(null);
1027:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1028:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1029:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1030:       x, y, width, height,
1031:       relativeScore: 1,
1032:       source: "manual",
1033:     };
1034:     patchSession((current) => ({
1035:       ...current,
1036:       candidatesByPage: {
1037:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1038:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1039:       },
1040:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1041:     }));
1042:     setManualMode(false);
1043:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1044:   }

1051:   }

1053:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1054:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1055:     try {
1056:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1057:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1058:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1059:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1060:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1061:       const scale = mode === "width"
1062:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1063:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1064:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1065:     } catch (cause) {
1066:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1067:     }
1068:   }

  28: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  29:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  30:   if (!match) return uci;
  31:   try {
  32:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  33:     const move = position.move({
  34:       from: match[1] as Square,
  35:       to: match[2] as Square,
  36:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  37:     });
  38:     return move.san;
  39:   } catch {
  40:     return uci;
  41:   }
  42: }

  44: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  45:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  46:   const san: string[] = [];
  47:   for (const uci of pv) {

  49:     if (!match) break;

  52:         from: match[1] as Square,
  53:         to: match[2] as Square,

  55:       });
  56:       san.push(move.san);
  57:     } catch {
  58:       break;
  59:     }
  60:   }
  61:   return san.join(" ");

  84: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  85:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  86:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;
  87:   if (elapsed < 60_000) return "Just now";
  88:   if (elapsed < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(elapsed / 60_000)}m ago`;

 370:         .then((result) => {
 371:           setOpeningStats(result);
 372:           setOpeningStatsStatus("ready");
 373:         })
 374:         .catch(() => {
 375:           if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
 376:             setOpeningStats(null);
 377:             setOpeningStatsStatus("error");
 378:           }
 379:         });
 380:     }, 500);
 381: 
 382:     return () => {
 383:       window.clearTimeout(timer);
 384:       controller.abort();
 385:     };
 386:   }, [workspaceMode, openingPosition, openingExplorerPly]);
 387: 
 388:   const boardSession: StudyBoardState | null =
 389:     workspaceMode === "analysis"
 390:       ? analysisBoard
 391:       : workspaceMode === "opening-prep"
 392:         ? openingPrepBoard
 393:         : workspaceMode === "opening-explorer"
 394:           ? {
 395:               lineBaseFen: START_FEN,
 396:               currentFen: openingPosition.fen,
 397:               moves: openingPosition.sanMoves,
 398:               moveIndex: openingPosition.sanMoves.length,
 399:               flipped: false,
 400:               coordinates: true,
 401:             }
 402:           : studyMode
 403:             ? studyBoard
 404:             : session;
 405:   const game = useMemo(() => {
 406:     if (!boardSession) return new Chess();
 407:     try {
 408:       return makePosition(boardSession.lineBaseFen, boardSession.moves, boardSession.moveIndex);
 409:     } catch {
 410:       try { return new Chess(boardSession.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 411:     }
 412:   }, [boardSession]);
 413:   const legalTargets = useMemo(() => {
 414:     if (!selectedSquare) return new Set<string>();
 415:     return new Set(game.moves({ square: selectedSquare, verbose: true }).map((move) => move.to));
 416:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 417:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 418:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 419:     try { return makePosition(boardSession?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, boardSession?.moves ?? [], boardSession?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 420:     catch { return []; }
 421:   }, [boardSession]);
 422:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 423:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 424:     : null);
 425:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 426:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 427:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 428:   );
 429: 
 430:   useEffect(() => {
 431:     setUserArrows([]);
 432:     setArrowStart(null);
 433:     setArrowHover(null);
 434:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 435:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 436: 
 437:   useEffect(() => {
 438:     if (engineEnabled && boardSession) {
 439:       engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 440:     }
 441:   }, [engineEnabled, boardSession?.currentFen, boardSession?.moveIndex, game, engineDepth]);
 442: 
 443:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 444:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 445:   }
 446: 
 447:   function toggleEngine() {
 448:     if (engineEnabled) {
 449:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 450:       engineRef.current = null;
 451:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 452:       setEngineStatus("off");
 453:       setEngineScore(null);
 454:       setEngineMessage("");
 455:       return;
 456:     }
 457:     try {
 458:       setEngineScore(null);
 459:       setEngineMessage("");
 460:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 461:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 462:         (status, message) => {
 463:           setEngineStatus(status);
 464:           if (status === "error") {
 465:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 466:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 467:             setEngineScore(null);
 468:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 469:             engineRef.current = null;
 470:           }
 471:         },
 472:         setEngineScore,
 473:       );
 474:       engineRef.current = client;
 475:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 476:     } catch (cause) {
 477:       setEngineStatus("error");
 478:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 479:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 480:     }
 481:   }
 482: 
 483:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 484:     setSession((current) => {
 485:       if (!current) return current;
 486:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 487:     });
 488:   }
 489: 
 490:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 491:     if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 492:       return;
 493:     }
 494: 
 495:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 496:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 497:     } else if (workspaceMode === "opening-prep") {
 498:       setOpeningPrepBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 499:     } else if (studyMode) {
 500:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 501:     } else {
 502:       patchSession(change);
 503:     }
 504:   }
 505:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 506:     if (!studyMode) {
 507:       if (!session) {
 508:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 509:         return;
 510:       }
 511:       setStudyBoard({
 512:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 513:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 514:         moves: [...session.moves],
 515:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 516:         flipped: session.flipped,
 517:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 518:       });
 519:       setStudyMode(true);
 520:     } else {
 521:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 522:       if (studyBoard) {
 523:         patchSession({
 524:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 525:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 526:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 527:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 528:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 529:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 530:         });
 531:       }
 532:       setStudyMode(false);
 533:     }
 534:     setLastMove(null);
 535:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 536:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 537:   
 538:     try {
 539:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 540:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 541:       } else {
 542:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 543:       }
 544:     } catch {
 545:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 546:     }
 547: }

 549:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 550:     try {
 551:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 552:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 553:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 554:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 555:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 556:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 557:       setBook(opened);
 558:       setSession(nextSession);
 559:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 560:       setError("");
 561:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 562:     } catch (cause) {
 563:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 564:     }
 565:   }
 566: 
 567:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 568:     if (!file) return;
 569:     try {
 570:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 571:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 572:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 573:       const now = Date.now();
 574:       const created: BookRecord = {
 575:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 576:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 577:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 578:         byteLength: file.size,
 579:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 580:         addedAt: now,
 581:       };
 582:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 583:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 584:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 585:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 586:       setBook(created);
 587:       setSession(blank);
 588:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 589:       setError("");
 590:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 591:     } catch (cause) {
 592:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 593:     }
 594:   }
 595: 
 596:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 597:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 598: 
 599:     try {
 600:       await removeBook(item.id);
 601:       await removeSession(item.id);
 602: 
 603:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 604:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 605:         const next = { ...current };
 606:         delete next[item.id];
 607:         return next;
 608:       });
 609: 
 610:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 611:         setBook(null);
 612:         setSession(null);
 613:         setPdf(null);
 614:       }
 615: 
 616:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 617:       setError("");
 618:     } catch (cause) {
 619:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 620:     }
 621:   }
 622:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 623:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 624:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 625:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 626:     try {
 627:       await putBook(renamed);
 628:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 629:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 630:     } catch (cause) {
 631:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 632:     }
 633:   }

 635:   function changePage(delta: number) {
 636:     if (!session) return;
 637:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 638:   }

 640:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 641:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 642:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 643:   }

 645:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 646:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 647:     try {
 648:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 649:       setSession({
 650:         ...activeSession,
 651:         originalFen: fen,
 652:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 653:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 654:         moves: [],
 655:         moveIndex: 0,
 656:       });
 657:       setLastMove(null);
 658:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 659:       setUserArrows([]);
 660:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 661:       return true;
 662:     } catch (cause) {
 663:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 664:       return false;
 665:     }
 666:   }

 668:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 669:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 670:     if (!loaded) return false;
 671:     setEngineScore(null);
 672:     setEngineMessage("");
 673:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 674:       toggleEngine();
 675:     } else {
 676:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 677:     }
 678:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 679:     return true;
 680:   }

 731:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 732:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 733:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 734:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 735:       return;
 736:     }
 737:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 738:     try {
 739:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 740:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 741:       preview.width = crop.width;
 742:       preview.height = crop.height;
 743:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 744:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 745:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 746:     } catch (cause) {
 747:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 748:       return;
 749:     }
 750:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 751:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 752:     setTransferFen("");
 753:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 754:         setRecognitionError("");
 755:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 756:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 757:     try {
 758:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 759:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 760:       });
 761:       const form = new FormData();
 762:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 763:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 764:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 765:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 766:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 767:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 768:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 769:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 770:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 771:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 772:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 773:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 774:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 775:       }
 776:     } catch (cause) {
 777:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 778:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 779:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 780:     }
 781:   }

 783:   function closeTransfer() {
 784:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 785:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 786:     setTransferPreview("");
 787:     setTransferFen("");
 788:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 789:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 790:     setRecognitionError("");
 791:       }

 794:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 795:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 796:       setGameEndOverlay({
 797:         title: "Checkmate",
 798:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 799:       });
 800:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 801:       setGameEndOverlay({
 802:         title: "Stalemate",
 803:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 804:       });
 805:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 806:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 807:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 808:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 809:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 810:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 811:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 812:     } else {
 813:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 814:     }
 815:   }

 817:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 818:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 819:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 820:     try {
 821:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 822:       const result = currentGame.move({
 823:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 824:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 825:         promotion: piece,
 826:       });
 827:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 828:       patchBoardSession({
 829:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 830:         moves: nextMoves,
 831:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 832:       });
 833:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 834:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 835:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 836:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 837:       setError("");
 838:     } catch {
 839:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 840:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 841:     }
 842:   }
 843: 
 844:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 845:     if (!boardSession) return;
 846:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 847:     try {
 848:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 849:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 850:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 851:       if (promote) {
 852:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 853:         return;
 854:       }
 855:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 856:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 857:       if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 858:         const line = nextMoves
 859:           .map((move, index) => index % 2 === 0 ? `${Math.floor(index / 2) + 1}. ${move}` : move)
 860:           .join(" ");
 861:         setOpeningExplorerInput(line);
 862:         setOpeningExplorerPly(nextMoves.length);
 863:       } else {
 864:         patchBoardSession({
 865:           currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 866:           moves: nextMoves,
 867:           moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 868:         });
 869:       }
 870:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 871:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 872:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 873:       setError("");
 874:     } catch {
 875:       const piece = game.get(to);
 876:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 877:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 878:     }
 879:   }
 880: 
 881:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 882:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 883:     setRedSquares([]);
 884: 
 885:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 886:       setUserArrows([]);
 887:       setArrowStart(null);
 888:       setArrowHover(null);
 889:       return;
 890:     }
 891: if (!boardSession) return;
 892:     if (annotationMode) {
 893:       if (!arrowStart) {
 894:         setArrowStart(square);
 895:         return;
 896:       }
 897:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 898:       setArrowStart(null);
 899:       setArrowHover(null);
 900:       return;
 901:     }
 902:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 903:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 904:       return;
 905:     }
 906:     const piece = game.get(square);
 907:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 908:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 909:   }

 911:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 912:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 913: 
 914:   event.preventDefault();
 915: 
 916:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 917:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 918:     event.clientX,
 919:     event.clientY,
 920:     bounds,
 921:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 922:   );
 923: 
 924:   if (!square) return;
 925: 
 926:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 927:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 928:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 929:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 930:   setArrowStart(square);
 931:   setArrowHover(square);
 932: 
 933:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 934: }
 935: 
 936:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 937:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 938:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 939:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 940:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 941:     setArrowHover(square);
 942:   }
 943: 
 944:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 945:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 946: 
 947:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 948: 
 949:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 950:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 951:     event.clientX,
 952:     event.clientY,
 953:     bounds,
 954:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 955:   );
 956: 
 957:   if (to && to !== from) {
 958:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 959:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 960:   } else {
 961:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 962:   }
 963: 
 964:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 965:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 966:   setArrowStart(null);
 967:   setArrowHover(null);
 968: }
 969: 
 970:   function cancelBoardArrowGesture() {
 971:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;

1046:   async function detectBoards() {
1047:     if (detecting) {
1048:       stopBoardScan();
1049:       return;
1050:     }
1051: 
1052:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
1053:     if (!API_BASE) {
1054:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1055:       return;
1056:     }
1057: 
1058:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1059:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1060:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1061:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1062: 
1063:     setDetecting(true);
1064:     setError("");
1065:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1066:     patchSession((current) => ({
1067:       ...current,
1068:       candidatesByPage: {
1069:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1070:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1071:       },
1072:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1073:     }));
1074: 
1075:     try {
1076:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1077:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1078:           (blob) => blob
1079:             ? resolve(blob)
1080:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1081:           "image/png",
1082:         );
1083:       });
1084: 
1085:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1086: 
1087:       const form = new FormData();
1088:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1089: 
1090:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1091:         method: "POST",
1092:         body: form,
1093:         signal: abortController.signal,
1094:       });
1095: 
1096:       if (!response.ok) {
1097:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1098:       }
1099: 
1100:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1101:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1102:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1103:       );
1104: 
1105:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1106: 
1107:       patchSession((current) => ({
1108:         ...current,
1109:         candidatesByPage: {
1110:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1111:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1112:         },
1113:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1114:       }));
1115: 
1116:       setNotice(
1117:         candidates.length
1118:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1119:           : "No board candidates found.",
1120:       );
1121:     } catch (cause) {
1122:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1123: 
1124:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1125:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1126:       } else {
1127:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1128:       }
1129:     } finally {
1130:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1131:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1132:         setDetecting(false);
1133:       }
1134:     }
1135:   }

1154:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1155:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1156:     if (!manualMode) return;
1157: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1158: if (!canvas) return;
1159: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1160: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1161: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1162: if (
1163:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1164:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1165:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1166:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1167: ) return;
1168:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1169:     if (!point) return;
1170:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1171:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };

1177:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1178:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1179:     if (edit) {
1180:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1181:       if (!point || !session) return;

1183:       patchSession((current) => {

1190:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1191:           },
1192:         };
1193:       });
1194:       return;
1195:     }
1196:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1197:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1198:     if (point) {
1199:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };

1205:   function finishRegion() {
1206:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1207:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1208:       return;
1209:     }
1210:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1211:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1212:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1213:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1214:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1215:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1216:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1217:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1218:     setDragSelection(null);
1219:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1220:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1221:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1222:       x, y, width, height,
1223:       relativeScore: 1,
1224:       source: "manual",
1225:     };
1226:     patchSession((current) => ({
1227:       ...current,
1228:       candidatesByPage: {
1229:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1230:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1231:       },
1232:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1233:     }));
1234:     setManualMode(false);
1235:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1236:   }

1245:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1246:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1247:     try {
1248:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1249:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1250:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1251:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1252:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1253:       const scale = mode === "width"
1254:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1255:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1256:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1257:     } catch (cause) {
1258:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1259:     }
1260:   }

 380:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 381:         return;
 382:       }
 383:       setStudyBoard({
 384:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 385:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 386:         moves: [...session.moves],
 387:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 388:         flipped: session.flipped,
 389:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 390:       });
 391:       setStudyMode(true);
 392:     } else {
 393:       setStudyMode(false);
 394:     }
 395:     setLastMove(null);
 396:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 397:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 398:   }

 400:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 401:     try {
 402:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 403:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 404:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 405:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 406:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 407:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 408:       setBook(opened);
 409:       setSession(nextSession);
 410:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 411:       setError("");
 412:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 413:     } catch (cause) {
 414:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 415:     }
 416:   }
 417: 
 418:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 419:     if (!file) return;
 420:     try {
 421:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 422:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 423:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 424:       const now = Date.now();
 425:       const created: BookRecord = {
 426:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 427:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 428:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 429:         byteLength: file.size,
 430:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 431:         addedAt: now,
 432:       };
 433:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 434:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 435:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 436:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 437:       setBook(created);
 438:       setSession(blank);
 439:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 440:       setError("");
 441:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 442:     } catch (cause) {
 443:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 444:     }
 445:   }
 446: 
 447:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 448:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 449: 
 450:     try {
 451:       await removeBook(item.id);
 452:       await removeSession(item.id);
 453: 
 454:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 455:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 456:         const next = { ...current };
 457:         delete next[item.id];
 458:         return next;
 459:       });
 460: 
 461:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 462:         setBook(null);
 463:         setSession(null);
 464:         setPdf(null);
 465:       }
 466: 
 467:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 468:       setError("");
 469:     } catch (cause) {
 470:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 471:     }
 472:   }
 473:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 474:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 475:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 476:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 477:     try {
 478:       await putBook(renamed);
 479:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 480:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 481:     } catch (cause) {
 482:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 483:     }
 484:   }

 496:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 497:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 498:     try {
 499:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 500:       setSession({
 501:         ...activeSession,
 502:         originalFen: fen,
 503:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 504:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 505:         moves: [],
 506:         moveIndex: 0,
 507:       });
 508:       setLastMove(null);
 509:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 510:       setUserArrows([]);
 511:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 512:       return true;
 513:     } catch (cause) {
 514:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 515:       return false;
 516:     }
 517:   }

 582:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 583:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 584:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 585:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 586:       return;
 587:     }
 588:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 589:     try {
 590:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 591:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 592:       preview.width = crop.width;
 593:       preview.height = crop.height;
 594:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 595:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 596:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 597:     } catch (cause) {
 598:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 599:       return;
 600:     }
 601:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 602:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 603:     setTransferFen("");
 604:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 605:         setRecognitionError("");
 606:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 607:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 608:     try {
 609:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 610:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 611:       });
 612:       const form = new FormData();
 613:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 614:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 615:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 616:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 617:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 618:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 619:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 620:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 621:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 622:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 623:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 624:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 625:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 626:       }
 627:     } catch (cause) {
 628:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 629:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 630:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 631:     }
 632:   }
 633: 
 634:   function closeTransfer() {
 635:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 636:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 637:     setTransferPreview("");
 638:     setTransferFen("");
 639:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 640:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 641:     setRecognitionError("");
 642:       }

 645:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 646:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 647:       setGameEndOverlay({
 648:         title: "Checkmate",
 649:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 650:       });
 651:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 652:       setGameEndOverlay({
 653:         title: "Stalemate",
 654:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 655:       });
 656:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 657:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 658:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 659:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 660:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 661:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 662:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 663:     } else {
 664:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 665:     }
 666:   }

 668:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 669:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 670:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 671:     try {
 672:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 673:       const result = currentGame.move({
 674:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 675:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 676:         promotion: piece,
 677:       });
 678:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 679:       patchBoardSession({
 680:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 681:         moves: nextMoves,
 682:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 683:       });
 684:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 685:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 686:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 687:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 688:       setError("");
 689:     } catch {
 690:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 691:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 692:     }
 693:   }
 694: 
 695:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 696:     if (!boardSession) return;
 697:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 698:     try {
 699:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 700:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 701:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 702:       if (promote) {
 703:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 704:         return;
 705:       }
 706:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 707:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 708:       patchBoardSession({
 709:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 710:         moves: nextMoves,
 711:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 712:       });
 713:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 714:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 715:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 716:       setError("");
 717:     } catch {
 718:       const piece = game.get(to);
 719:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 720:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 721:     }
 722:   }

 724:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 725:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 726:     setRedSquares([]);
 727: 
 728:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 729:       setUserArrows([]);
 730:       setArrowStart(null);
 731:       setArrowHover(null);
 732:       return;
 733:     }
 734: if (!boardSession) return;
 735:     if (annotationMode) {
 736:       if (!arrowStart) {
 737:         setArrowStart(square);
 738:         return;
 739:       }
 740:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 741:       setArrowStart(null);
 742:       setArrowHover(null);
 743:       return;
 744:     }
 745:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 746:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 747:       return;
 748:     }
 749:     const piece = game.get(square);
 750:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 751:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 752:   }

 754:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 755:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 756: 
 757:   event.preventDefault();
 758: 
 759:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 760:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 761:     event.clientX,
 762:     event.clientY,
 763:     bounds,
 764:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 765:   );
 766: 
 767:   if (!square) return;
 768: 
 769:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 770:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 771:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 772:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 773:   setArrowStart(square);
 774:   setArrowHover(square);
 775: 
 776:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 777: }

 779:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 780:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 781:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 782:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 783:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 784:     setArrowHover(square);
 785:   }

 787:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 788:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 789: 
 790:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 791: 
 792:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 793:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 794:     event.clientX,
 795:     event.clientY,
 796:     bounds,
 797:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 798:   );
 799: 
 800:   if (to && to !== from) {
 801:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 802:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 803:   } else {
 804:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 805:   }
 806: 
 807:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 808:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 809:   setArrowStart(null);
 810:   setArrowHover(null);
 811: }

 863:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 864:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 865: 
 866:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 867:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 868:     controller?.abort();

 873:     setCropEditingId(null);
 874:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 875:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 876: 
 877:     patchSession((current) => ({
 878:       ...current,
 879:       candidatesByPage: {
 880:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 881:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 882:       },
 883:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 884:     }));

 889:   async function detectBoards() {
 890:     if (detecting) {
 891:       stopBoardScan();
 892:       return;
 893:     }
 894: 
 895:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 896:     if (!API_BASE) {
 897:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 898:       return;
 899:     }
 900: 
 901:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 902:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 903:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 904:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 905: 
 906:     setDetecting(true);
 907:     setError("");
 908:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 909:     patchSession((current) => ({
 910:       ...current,
 911:       candidatesByPage: {
 912:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 913:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 914:       },
 915:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 916:     }));
 917: 
 918:     try {
 919:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 920:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 921:           (blob) => blob
 922:             ? resolve(blob)
 923:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 924:           "image/png",
 925:         );
 926:       });
 927: 
 928:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 929: 
 930:       const form = new FormData();
 931:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 932: 
 933:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 934:         method: "POST",
 935:         body: form,
 936:         signal: abortController.signal,
 937:       });
 938: 
 939:       if (!response.ok) {
 940:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 941:       }
 942: 
 943:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 944:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 945:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 946:       );
 947: 
 948:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 949: 
 950:       patchSession((current) => ({
 951:         ...current,
 952:         candidatesByPage: {
 953:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 954:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 955:         },
 956:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 957:       }));
 958: 
 959:       setNotice(
 960:         candidates.length
 961:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 962:           : "No board candidates found.",
 963:       );
 964:     } catch (cause) {
 965:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 966: 
 967:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 968:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 969:       } else {
 970:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 971:       }
 972:     } finally {
 973:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 974:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 975:         setDetecting(false);
 976:       }
 977:     }
 978:   }
 979:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
 980:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
 981:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 982:   }

 995:   }

 997:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 998:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 999:     if (!manualMode) return;
1000: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1001: if (!canvas) return;
1002: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1003: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1004: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1005: if (
1006:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1007:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1008:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1009:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1010: ) return;
1011:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1012:     if (!point) return;
1013:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1014:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1015:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1016:     setDragSelection(selection);
1017:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1018:   }
