 639:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 640:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 641:     try {
 642:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 643:       const result = currentGame.move({
 644:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 645:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 646:         promotion: piece,
 647:       });
 648:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 649:       patchSession({
 650:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 651:         moves: nextMoves,
 652:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 653:       });
 654:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 655:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 656:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 657:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 658:       setError("");
 659:     } catch {
 660:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 661:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 662:     }
 663:   }
 664: 
 665:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 666:     if (!session) return;
 667:     try {
 668:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 669:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 670:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 671:       if (promote) {
 672:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 673:         return;
 674:       }
 675:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 676:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 677:       patchSession({
 678:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 679:         moves: nextMoves,
 680:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 681:       });
 682:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 683:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 684:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 685:       setError("");
 686:     } catch {
 687:       const piece = game.get(to);
 688:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 689:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 690:     }
 691:   }

 693:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 694:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 695:     setRedSquares([]);
 696:     
 697:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 698:       setUserArrows([]);
 699:       setArrowStart(null);
 700:       setArrowHover(null);
 701:       return;
 702:     }
 703: if (!session) return;
 704:     if (annotationMode) {
 705:       if (!arrowStart) {
 706:         setArrowStart(square);
 707:         return;
 708:       }
 709:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 710:       setArrowStart(null);
 711:       setArrowHover(null);
 712:       return;
 713:     }
 714:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 715:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 716:       return;
 717:     }
 718:     const piece = game.get(square);
 719:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 720:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 721:   }

 723:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 724:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 725: 
 726:   event.preventDefault();
 727: 
 728:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 729:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 730:     event.clientX,
 731:     event.clientY,
 732:     bounds,
 733:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 734:   );
 735: 
 736:   if (!square) return;
 737: 
 738:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 739:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 740:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 741:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 742:   setArrowStart(square);
 743:   setArrowHover(square);
 744: 
 745:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 746: }
 747: 
 748:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 749:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 750:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 751:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 752:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 753:     setArrowHover(square);
 754:   }
 755: 
 756:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 757:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 758: 
 759:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 760: 
 761:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 762:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 763:     event.clientX,
 764:     event.clientY,
 765:     bounds,
 766:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 767:   );
 768: 
 769:   if (to && to !== from) {
 770:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 771:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 772:   } else {
 773:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 774:   }
 775: 
 776:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 777:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 778:   setArrowStart(null);
 779:   setArrowHover(null);
 780: }

 784:     setArrowStart(null);
 785:     setArrowHover(null);

 810:   function stopBoardScan() {
 811:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 812:     if (!controller) return;
 813: 
 814:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 815:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 816:     controller.abort();
 817:     setDetecting(false);
 818:     setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 819:

 821:       ...current,
 822:       candidatesByPage: {
 823:         ...current.candidatesByPage,

 825:       },
 826:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 827:     }));
 828:   }

 832:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 833:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 834: 
 835:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 836:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;

 841:     setDragSelection(null);

 844:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 845: 
 846:     patchSession((current) => ({
 847:       ...current,
 848:       candidatesByPage: {
 849:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 850:         [String(current.page)]: [],

 858:   async function detectBoards() {
 859:     if (detecting) {
 860:       stopBoardScan();
 861:       return;
 862:     }
 863: 
 864:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 865:     if (!API_BASE) {
 866:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 867:       return;
 868:     }
 869: 
 870:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 871:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 872:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 873:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 874: 
 875:     setDetecting(true);
 876:     setError("");
 877:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 878:     patchSession((current) => ({
 879:       ...current,
 880:       candidatesByPage: {
 881:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 882:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 883:       },
 884:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 885:     }));
 886: 
 887:     try {
 888:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 889:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 890:           (blob) => blob
 891:             ? resolve(blob)
 892:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 893:           "image/png",
 894:         );
 895:       });
 896: 
 897:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 898: 
 899:       const form = new FormData();
 900:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 901: 
 902:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 903:         method: "POST",
 904:         body: form,
 905:         signal: abortController.signal,
 906:       });
 907: 
 908:       if (!response.ok) {
 909:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 910:       }
 911: 
 912:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 913:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 914:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 915:       );
 916: 
 917:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 918: 
 919:       patchSession((current) => ({
 920:         ...current,
 921:         candidatesByPage: {
 922:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 923:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 924:         },
 925:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 926:       }));
 927: 
 928:       setNotice(
 929:         candidates.length
 930:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 931:           : "No board candidates found.",
 932:       );
 933:     } catch (cause) {
 934:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 935: 
 936:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 937:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 938:       } else {
 939:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 940:       }
 941:     } finally {
 942:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 943:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 944:         setDetecting(false);
 945:       }
 946:     }
 947:   }
 948:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
 949:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
 950:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 951:   }

 953:   function startCropEdit(
 954:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 955:     candidate: Candidate,
 956:     handle: CropHandle,
 957:   ) {
 958:     event.stopPropagation();
 959:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 960:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
 961:     if (!point || !stage) return;
 962:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
 963:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 964:   }

 966:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 967:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 968:     if (!manualMode) return;
 969: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 970: if (!canvas) return;
 971: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 972: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 973: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 974: if (
 975:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 976:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 977:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 978:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 979: ) return;
 980:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 981:     if (!point) return;
 982:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 983:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 984:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 985:     setDragSelection(selection);
 986:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 987:   }
 988: 
 989:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 990:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 991:     if (edit) {
 992:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 993:       if (!point || !session) return;
 994:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 995:       patchSession((current) => {
 996:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 997:         return {
 998:           ...current,
 999:           candidatesByPage: {
1000:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1001:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1002:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1003:           },
1004:         };
1005:       });
1006:       return;
1007:     }
1008:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1009:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1010:     if (point) {
1011:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1012:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1013:       setDragSelection(selection);
1014:     }
1015:   }
1016: 
1017:   function finishRegion() {
1018:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1019:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1020:       return;
1021:     }
1022:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1023:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1024:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1025:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1026:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1027:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1028:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1029:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1030:     setDragSelection(null);
1031:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1032:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1033:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1034:       x, y, width, height,
1035:       relativeScore: 1,
1036:       source: "manual",
1037:     };
1038:     patchSession((current) => ({
1039:       ...current,
1040:       candidatesByPage: {
1041:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1042:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1043:       },
1044:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1045:     }));
1046:     setManualMode(false);
1047:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1048:   }

1051:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1052:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1053:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1054:     setDragSelection(null);
1055:   }

1057:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1058:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1059:     try {
1060:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1061:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1062:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1063:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1064:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1065:       const scale = mode === "width"
1066:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1067:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1068:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1069:     } catch (cause) {
1070:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1071:     }
1072:   }

 329:   function toggleEngine() {
 330:     if (engineEnabled) {

 343:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 344:         (status, message) => {
 345:           setEngineStatus(status);
 346:           if (status === "error") {
 347:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 348:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 349:             setEngineScore(null);
 350:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 351:             engineRef.current = null;
 352:           }
 353:         },
 354:         setEngineScore,
 355:       );
 356:       engineRef.current = client;
 357:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 358:     } catch (cause) {

 406:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 407:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 408:       setBook(opened);

 418:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 419:     if (!file) return;
 420:     try {
 421:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 422:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 423:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 424:       const now = Date.now();
 425:       const created: BookRecord = {
 426:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 427:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 428:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 429:         byteLength: file.size,
 430:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 431:         addedAt: now,
 432:       };
 433:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 434:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 435:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 436:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 437:       setBook(created);
 438:       setSession(blank);
 439:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 440:       setError("");
 441:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 442:     } catch (cause) {
 443:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 444:     }
 445:   }

 447:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 448:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 449: 
 450:     try {
 451:       await removeBook(item.id);
 452:       await removeSession(item.id);
 453: 
 454:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 455:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 456:         const next = { ...current };
 457:         delete next[item.id];
 458:         return next;
 459:       });
 460: 
 461:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 462:         setBook(null);
 463:         setSession(null);
 464:         setPdf(null);
 465:       }
 466: 
 467:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 468:       setError("");
 469:     } catch (cause) {
 470:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 471:     }
 472:   }
 473:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 474:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 475:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 476:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 477:     try {
 478:       await putBook(renamed);
 479:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 480:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 481:     } catch (cause) {
 482:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 483:     }
 484:   }

 582:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 583:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 584:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 585:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 586:       return;
 587:     }
 588:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 589:     try {
 590:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 591:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 592:       preview.width = crop.width;
 593:       preview.height = crop.height;
 594:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 595:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 596:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 597:     } catch (cause) {
 598:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 599:       return;
 600:     }
 601:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 602:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 603:     setTransferFen("");
 604:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 605:         setRecognitionError("");
 606:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 607:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 608:     try {
 609:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 610:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 611:       });
 612:       const form = new FormData();
 613:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 614:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 615:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 616:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 617:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 618:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 619:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 620:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 621:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 622:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 623:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 624:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 625:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 626:       }
 627:     } catch (cause) {
 628:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 629:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 630:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 631:     }
 632:   }
 633: 
 634:   function closeTransfer() {
 635:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 636:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 637:     setTransferPreview("");
 638:     setTransferFen("");
 639:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 640:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 641:     setRecognitionError("");
 642:       }

 645:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 646:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 647:       setGameEndOverlay({
 648:         title: "Checkmate",
 649:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 650:       });
 651:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 652:       setGameEndOverlay({
 653:         title: "Stalemate",
 654:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 655:       });
 656:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 657:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 658:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 659:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 660:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 661:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 662:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 663:     } else {
 664:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 665:     }
 666:   }
 667: 
 668:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 669:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 670:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 671:     try {
 672:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 673:       const result = currentGame.move({
 674:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 675:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 676:         promotion: piece,
 677:       });
 678:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 679:       patchBoardSession({
 680:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 681:         moves: nextMoves,
 682:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 683:       });
 684:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 685:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 686:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 687:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 688:       setError("");
 689:     } catch {
 690:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 691:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 692:     }
 693:   }
 694: 
 695:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 696:     if (!boardSession) return;
 697:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 698:     try {
 699:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 700:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 701:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 702:       if (promote) {
 703:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 704:         return;
 705:       }
 706:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 707:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 708:       patchBoardSession({
 709:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 710:         moves: nextMoves,
 711:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 712:       });
 713:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 714:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 715:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 716:       setError("");
 717:     } catch {
 718:       const piece = game.get(to);
 719:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 720:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 721:     }
 722:   }

 724:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 725:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 726:     setRedSquares([]);
 727: 
 728:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 729:       setUserArrows([]);
 730:       setArrowStart(null);
 731:       setArrowHover(null);
 732:       return;
 733:     }
 734: if (!boardSession) return;
 735:     if (annotationMode) {
 736:       if (!arrowStart) {
 737:         setArrowStart(square);
 738:         return;
 739:       }
 740:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 741:       setArrowStart(null);
 742:       setArrowHover(null);
 743:       return;
 744:     }
 745:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 746:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 747:       return;
 748:     }
 749:     const piece = game.get(square);
 750:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 751:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 752:   }

 791: 
 792:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

 794:     event.clientX,
 795:     event.clientY,
 796:     bounds,
 797:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 798:   );

 801:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));

 803:   } else {
 804:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 805:   }
 806:

 889:   async function detectBoards() {
 890:     if (detecting) {
 891:       stopBoardScan();
 892:       return;
 893:     }
 894: 
 895:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 896:     if (!API_BASE) {
 897:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 898:       return;
 899:     }
 900: 
 901:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 902:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 903:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 904:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 905: 
 906:     setDetecting(true);
 907:     setError("");
 908:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 909:     patchSession((current) => ({
 910:       ...current,
 911:       candidatesByPage: {
 912:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 913:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 914:       },
 915:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 916:     }));
 917: 
 918:     try {
 919:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 920:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 921:           (blob) => blob
 922:             ? resolve(blob)
 923:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 924:           "image/png",
 925:         );
 926:       });
 927: 
 928:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 929: 
 930:       const form = new FormData();
 931:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 932: 
 933:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 934:         method: "POST",
 935:         body: form,
 936:         signal: abortController.signal,
 937:       });
 938: 
 939:       if (!response.ok) {
 940:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 941:       }
 942: 
 943:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 944:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 945:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 946:       );
 947: 
 948:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 949: 
 950:       patchSession((current) => ({
 951:         ...current,
 952:         candidatesByPage: {
 953:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 954:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 955:         },
 956:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 957:       }));
 958: 
 959:       setNotice(
 960:         candidates.length
 961:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 962:           : "No board candidates found.",
 963:       );
 964:     } catch (cause) {
 965:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 966: 
 967:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 968:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 969:       } else {
 970:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 971:       }
 972:     } finally {
 973:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 974:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 975:         setDetecting(false);
 976:       }
 977:     }
 978:   }

 997:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 998:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 999:     if (!manualMode) return;
1000: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1001: if (!canvas) return;
1002: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1003: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1004: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1005: if (
1006:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1007:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1008:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1009:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1010: ) return;
1011:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1012:     if (!point) return;
1013:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1014:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1015:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1016:     setDragSelection(selection);
1017:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1018:   }

1020:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1021:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1022:     if (edit) {
1023:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1024:       if (!point || !session) return;
1025:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1026:       patchSession((current) => {
1027:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1028:         return {
1029:           ...current,
1030:           candidatesByPage: {
1031:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1032:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1033:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1034:           },
1035:         };
1036:       });
1037:       return;
1038:     }
1039:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1040:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1041:     if (point) {
1042:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1043:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1044:       setDragSelection(selection);
1045:     }
1046:   }

1048:   function finishRegion() {
1049:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1050:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1051:       return;
1052:     }
1053:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1054:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1055:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1056:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1057:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1058:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1059:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1060:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1061:     setDragSelection(null);
1062:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1063:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1064:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1065:       x, y, width, height,
1066:       relativeScore: 1,
1067:       source: "manual",
1068:     };
1069:     patchSession((current) => ({
1070:       ...current,
1071:       candidatesByPage: {
1072:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1073:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1074:       },
1075:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1076:     }));
1077:     setManualMode(false);
1078:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1079:   }

1088:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1089:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1090:     try {
1091:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1092:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1093:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1094:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1095:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1096:       const scale = mode === "width"
1097:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1098:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1099:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1100:     } catch (cause) {
1101:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1102:     }
1103:   }

  28: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  29:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);

  44: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {

  46:   const san: string[] = [];
  47:   for (const uci of pv) {

  57:     } catch {

  59:     }
  60:   }

 324:         event.preventDefault();
 325:         return;
 326:       }
 327:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 328:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 329:     }
 330:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 331:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 332:   });
 333: 
 334:   useEffect(() => () => {
 335:     engineRef.current?.dispose();
 336:     engineRef.current = null;
 337:   }, []);
 338: 
 339:   const sortedBooks = useMemo(() => [...books].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt), [books]);
 340:   const visibleBooks = useMemo(() => {
 341:     const needle = bookSearch.trim().toLowerCase();

 343:       const matchesTab = libraryTab === "all" || libraryTab === "recent";
 344:       return matchesTab && item.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle);
 345:     });

 357:   useEffect(() => {

 388:   const boardSession: StudyBoardState | null =
 389:     workspaceMode === "analysis"
 390:       ? analysisBoard
 391:       : workspaceMode === "opening-prep"
 392:         ? openingPrepBoard
 393:         : workspaceMode === "opening-explorer"
 394:           ? {
 395:               lineBaseFen: START_FEN,
 396:               currentFen: openingPosition.fen,
 397:               moves: openingPosition.sanMoves,
 398:               moveIndex: openingPosition.sanMoves.length,
 399:               flipped: false,
 400:               coordinates: true,
 401:             }

 403:             ? studyBoard

 406:     if (!boardSession) return new Chess();
 407:     try {
 408:       return makePosition(boardSession.lineBaseFen, boardSession.moves, boardSession.moveIndex);
 409:     } catch {
 410:       try { return new Chess(boardSession.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 411:     }

 416:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);

 419:     try { return makePosition(boardSession?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, boardSession?.moves ?? [], boardSession?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 420:     catch { return []; }
 421:   }, [boardSession]);
 422:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 423:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 424:     : null);

 441:   }, [engineEnabled, boardSession?.currentFen, boardSession?.moveIndex, game, engineDepth]);

 443:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 444:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 445:   }

 447:   function toggleEngine() {
 448:     if (engineEnabled) {
 449:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 450:       engineRef.current = null;
 451:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 452:       setEngineStatus("off");
 453:       setEngineScore(null);
 454:       setEngineMessage("");
 455:       return;
 456:     }
 457:     try {
 458:       setEngineScore(null);
 459:       setEngineMessage("");
 460:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 461:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 462:         (status, message) => {
 463:           setEngineStatus(status);
 464:           if (status === "error") {
 465:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 466:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 467:             setEngineScore(null);
 468:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 469:             engineRef.current = null;
 470:           }
 471:         },
 472:         setEngineScore,
 473:       );
 474:       engineRef.current = client;
 475:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 476:     } catch (cause) {
 477:       setEngineStatus("error");
 478:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 479:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 480:     }
 481:   }

 483:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 484:     setSession((current) => {
 485:       if (!current) return current;
 486:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 487:     });
 488:   }
 489: 
 490:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 491:     if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 492:       return;
 493:     }
 494: 
 495:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 496:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 497:     } else if (workspaceMode === "opening-prep") {
 498:       setOpeningPrepBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 499:     } else if (studyMode) {
 500:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 501:     } else {
 502:       patchSession(change);
 503:     }
 504:   }
 505:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 506:     if (!studyMode) {
 507:       if (!session) {
 508:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 509:         return;
 510:       }
 511:       setStudyBoard({
 512:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 513:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 514:         moves: [...session.moves],
 515:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 516:         flipped: session.flipped,
 517:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 518:       });
 519:       setStudyMode(true);
 520:     } else {
 521:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 522:       if (studyBoard) {
 523:         patchSession({
 524:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 525:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 526:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 527:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 528:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 529:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 530:         });
 531:       }
 532:       setStudyMode(false);
 533:     }
 534:     setLastMove(null);
 535:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 536:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 537:   
 538:     try {
 539:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 540:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 541:       } else {
 542:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 543:       }
 544:     } catch {
 545:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 546:     }
 547: }

 549:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 550:     try {
 551:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 552:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 553:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 554:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 555:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 556:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 557:       setBook(opened);
 558:       setSession(nextSession);
 559:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 560:       setError("");
 561:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 562:     } catch (cause) {
 563:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 564:     }
 565:   }

 567:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 568:     if (!file) return;
 569:     try {
 570:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 571:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 572:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 573:       const now = Date.now();
 574:       const created: BookRecord = {
 575:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 576:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 577:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 578:         byteLength: file.size,
 579:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 580:         addedAt: now,
 581:       };
 582:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 583:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 584:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 585:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 586:       setBook(created);
 587:       setSession(blank);
 588:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 589:       setError("");
 590:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 591:     } catch (cause) {
 592:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 593:     }
 594:   }

 596:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 597:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 598: 
 599:     try {
 600:       await removeBook(item.id);
 601:       await removeSession(item.id);
 602: 
 603:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 604:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 605:         const next = { ...current };
 606:         delete next[item.id];
 607:         return next;
 608:       });
 609: 
 610:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 611:         setBook(null);
 612:         setSession(null);
 613:         setPdf(null);
 614:       }
 615: 
 616:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 617:       setError("");
 618:     } catch (cause) {
 619:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 620:     }
 621:   }
 622:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 623:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 624:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 625:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 626:     try {
 627:       await putBook(renamed);
 628:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 629:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 630:     } catch (cause) {
 631:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 632:     }
 633:   }

 645:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 646:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");

 650:         ...activeSession,
 651:         originalFen: fen,
 652:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 653:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 654:         moves: [],
 655:         moveIndex: 0,
 656:       });
 657:       setLastMove(null);
 658:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 659:       setUserArrows([]);
 660:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 661:       return true;
 662:     } catch (cause) {
 663:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 664:       return false;
 665:     }
 666:   }

 731:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 732:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 733:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 734:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 735:       return;
 736:     }
 737:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 738:     try {
 739:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 740:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 741:       preview.width = crop.width;
 742:       preview.height = crop.height;
 743:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 744:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 745:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 746:     } catch (cause) {
 747:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 748:       return;
 749:     }
 750:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 751:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 752:     setTransferFen("");
 753:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 754:         setRecognitionError("");
 755:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 756:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 757:     try {
 758:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 759:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 760:       });
 761:       const form = new FormData();
 762:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 763:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 764:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 765:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 766:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 767:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 768:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 769:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 770:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 771:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 772:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 773:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 774:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 775:       }
 776:     } catch (cause) {
 777:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 778:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 779:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 780:     }
 781:   }

 783:   function closeTransfer() {
 784:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 785:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 786:     setTransferPreview("");
 787:     setTransferFen("");
 788:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 789:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 790:     setRecognitionError("");
 791:       }

 794:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 795:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 796:       setGameEndOverlay({
 797:         title: "Checkmate",
 798:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 799:       });
 800:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 801:       setGameEndOverlay({
 802:         title: "Stalemate",
 803:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 804:       });
 805:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 806:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 807:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 808:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 809:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 810:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 811:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 812:     } else {
 813:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 814:     }
 815:   }

 817:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 818:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 819:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 820:     try {
 821:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 822:       const result = currentGame.move({
 823:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 824:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 825:         promotion: piece,
 826:       });
 827:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 828:       patchBoardSession({
 829:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 830:         moves: nextMoves,
 831:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 832:       });
 833:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 834:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 835:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 836:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 837:       setError("");
 838:     } catch {
 839:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 840:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 841:     }
 842:   }
 843: 
 844:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 845:     if (!boardSession) return;
 846:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 847:     try {
 848:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 849:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 850:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 851:       if (promote) {
 852:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 853:         return;
 854:       }
 855:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 856:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 857:       patchBoardSession({
 858:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 859:         moves: nextMoves,
 860:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 861:       });
 862:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 863:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 864:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 865:       setError("");
 866:     } catch {
 867:       const piece = game.get(to);
 868:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 869:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 870:     }
 871:   }
 872: 
 873:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 874:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 875:     setRedSquares([]);
 876: 
 877:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 878:       setUserArrows([]);
 879:       setArrowStart(null);
 880:       setArrowHover(null);
 881:       return;
 882:     }
 883: if (!boardSession) return;
 884:     if (annotationMode) {
 885:       if (!arrowStart) {
 886:         setArrowStart(square);
 887:         return;
 888:       }
 889:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 890:       setArrowStart(null);
 891:       setArrowHover(null);
 892:       return;
 893:     }
 894:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 895:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 896:       return;
 897:     }
 898:     const piece = game.get(square);
 899:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 900:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 901:   }

 903:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 904:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 905: 
 906:   event.preventDefault();
 907: 
 908:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 909:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 910:     event.clientX,
 911:     event.clientY,
 912:     bounds,
 913:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 914:   );
 915: 
 916:   if (!square) return;
 917: 
 918:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 919:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 920:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 921:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 922:   setArrowStart(square);
 923:   setArrowHover(square);
 924: 
 925:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 926: }
 927: 
 928:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 929:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 930:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

1038:   async function detectBoards() {
1039:     if (detecting) {
1040:       stopBoardScan();
1041:       return;
1042:     }
1043: 
1044:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
1045:     if (!API_BASE) {
1046:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1047:       return;
1048:     }
1049: 
1050:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1051:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1052:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1053:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1054: 
1055:     setDetecting(true);
1056:     setError("");
1057:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1058:     patchSession((current) => ({
1059:       ...current,
1060:       candidatesByPage: {
1061:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1062:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1063:       },
1064:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1065:     }));
1066: 
1067:     try {
1068:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1069:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1070:           (blob) => blob
1071:             ? resolve(blob)
1072:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1073:           "image/png",
1074:         );
1075:       });
1076: 
1077:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1078: 
1079:       const form = new FormData();
1080:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1081: 
1082:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1083:         method: "POST",
1084:         body: form,
1085:         signal: abortController.signal,
1086:       });
1087: 
1088:       if (!response.ok) {
1089:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1090:       }
1091: 
1092:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1093:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1094:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1095:       );
1096: 
1097:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1098: 
1099:       patchSession((current) => ({
1100:         ...current,
1101:         candidatesByPage: {
1102:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1103:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1104:         },
1105:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1106:       }));
1107: 
1108:       setNotice(
1109:         candidates.length
1110:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1111:           : "No board candidates found.",
1112:       );
1113:     } catch (cause) {
1114:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1115: 
1116:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1117:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1118:       } else {
1119:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1120:       }
1121:     } finally {
1122:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1123:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1124:         setDetecting(false);
1125:       }
1126:     }
1127:   }

1146:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1147:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1148:     if (!manualMode) return;
1149: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1150: if (!canvas) return;
1151: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1152: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1153: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1154: if (
1155:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1156:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1157:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1158:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1159: ) return;
1160:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1161:     if (!point) return;
1162:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1163:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1164:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1165:     setDragSelection(selection);

1169:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1170:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1171:     if (edit) {
1172:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1173:       if (!point || !session) return;
1174:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1175:       patchSession((current) => {
1176:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1177:         return {
1178:           ...current,
1179:           candidatesByPage: {
1180:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1181:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1182:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1183:           },
1184:         };
1185:       });
1186:       return;
1187:     }
1188:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1189:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1190:     if (point) {
1191:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1192:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1193:       setDragSelection(selection);
1194:     }

1197:   function finishRegion() {
1198:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1199:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1200:       return;
1201:     }
1202:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1203:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1204:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1205:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1206:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1207:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1208:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1209:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1210:     setDragSelection(null);
1211:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1212:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1213:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1214:       x, y, width, height,
1215:       relativeScore: 1,
1216:       source: "manual",
1217:     };
1218:     patchSession((current) => ({
1219:       ...current,
1220:       candidatesByPage: {
1221:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1222:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1223:       },
1224:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1225:     }));
1226:     setManualMode(false);
1227:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1228:   }

1234:     setDragSelection(null);

1237:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1238:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1239:     try {
1240:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1241:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1242:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1243:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1244:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1245:       const scale = mode === "width"
1246:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1247:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1248:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1249:     } catch (cause) {
1250:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1251:     }
1252:   }

  26: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  27:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  28:   if (!match) return uci;
  29:   try {
  30:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  31:     const move = position.move({
  32:       from: match[1] as Square,
  33:       to: match[2] as Square,
  34:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  35:     });
  36:     return move.san;
  37:   } catch {
  38:     return uci;
  39:   }
  40: }

  42: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  43:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  44:   const san: string[] = [];
  45:   for (const uci of pv) {
  46:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  47:     if (!match) break;
  48:     try {
  49:       const move = position.move({
  50:         from: match[1] as Square,
  51:         to: match[2] as Square,
  52:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  53:       });
  54:       san.push(move.san);
  55:     } catch {
  56:       break;
  57:     }
  58:   }
  59:   return san.join(" ");
  60: }

 344:     if (!selectedSquare) return new Set<string>();
 345:     return new Set(game.moves({ square: selectedSquare, verbose: true }).map((move) => move.to));
 346:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 347:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 348:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 349:     try { return makePosition(boardSession?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, boardSession?.moves ?? [], boardSession?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 350:     catch { return []; }
 351:   }, [boardSession]);
 352:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 353:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 354:     : null);
 355:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 356:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 357:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 358:   );
 359: 
 360:   useEffect(() => {
 361:     setUserArrows([]);
 362:     setArrowStart(null);
 363:     setArrowHover(null);
 364:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 365:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 366: 
 367:   useEffect(() => {
 368:     if (engineEnabled && boardSession) {
 369:       engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 370:     }
 371:   }, [engineEnabled, boardSession?.currentFen, boardSession?.moveIndex, game, engineDepth]);
 372: 
 373:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 374:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 375:   }
 376: 
 377:   function toggleEngine() {
 378:     if (engineEnabled) {
 379:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 380:       engineRef.current = null;
 381:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 382:       setEngineStatus("off");
 383:       setEngineScore(null);
 384:       setEngineMessage("");
 385:       return;
 386:     }
 387:     try {
 388:       setEngineScore(null);
 389:       setEngineMessage("");
 390:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 391:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 392:         (status, message) => {
 393:           setEngineStatus(status);
 394:           if (status === "error") {
 395:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 396:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 397:             setEngineScore(null);
 398:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 399:             engineRef.current = null;
 400:           }
 401:         },
 402:         setEngineScore,
 403:       );
 404:       engineRef.current = client;
 405:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 406:     } catch (cause) {
 407:       setEngineStatus("error");
 408:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 409:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 410:     }
 411:   }
 412: 
 413:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 414:     setSession((current) => {
 415:       if (!current) return current;
 416:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 417:     });
 418:   }
 419: 
 420:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 421:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 422:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 423:     } else if (studyMode) {
 424:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 425:     } else {
 426:       patchSession(change);
 427:     }
 428:   }

 430:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 431:     if (!studyMode) {
 432:       if (!session) {
 433:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 434:         return;
 435:       }
 436:       setStudyBoard({
 437:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 438:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 439:         moves: [...session.moves],
 440:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 441:         flipped: session.flipped,
 442:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 443:       });
 444:       setStudyMode(true);
 445:     } else {
 446:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 447:       if (studyBoard) {
 448:         patchSession({
 449:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 450:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 451:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 452:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 453:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 454:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 455:         });
 456:       }
 457:       setStudyMode(false);
 458:     }
 459:     setLastMove(null);
 460:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 461:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 462:   
 463:     try {
 464:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 465:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 466:       } else {
 467:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 468:       }
 469:     } catch {
 470:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 471:     }
 472: }

 474:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 475:     try {
 476:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 477:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 478:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 479:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 480:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 481:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 482:       setBook(opened);
 483:       setSession(nextSession);
 484:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 485:       setError("");
 486:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 487:     } catch (cause) {
 488:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 489:     }
 490:   }
 491: 
 492:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 493:     if (!file) return;
 494:     try {
 495:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 496:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 497:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 498:       const now = Date.now();
 499:       const created: BookRecord = {
 500:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 501:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 502:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 503:         byteLength: file.size,
 504:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 505:         addedAt: now,
 506:       };
 507:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 508:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 509:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 510:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 511:       setBook(created);
 512:       setSession(blank);
 513:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 514:       setError("");
 515:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 516:     } catch (cause) {
 517:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 518:     }
 519:   }
 520: 
 521:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 522:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 523: 
 524:     try {
 525:       await removeBook(item.id);
 526:       await removeSession(item.id);
 527: 
 528:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 529:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 530:         const next = { ...current };
 531:         delete next[item.id];
 532:         return next;
 533:       });
 534: 
 535:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 536:         setBook(null);
 537:         setSession(null);
 538:         setPdf(null);
 539:       }
 540: 
 541:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 542:       setError("");
 543:     } catch (cause) {
 544:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 545:     }
 546:   }
 547:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 548:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 549:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 550:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 551:     try {
 552:       await putBook(renamed);
 553:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 554:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 555:     } catch (cause) {
 556:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 557:     }
 558:   }

 561:     if (!session) return;
 562:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 563:   }

 565:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 566:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 567:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 568:   }

 570:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 571:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 572:     try {
 573:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 574:       setSession({
 575:         ...activeSession,
 576:         originalFen: fen,
 577:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 578:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 579:         moves: [],
 580:         moveIndex: 0,
 581:       });
 582:       setLastMove(null);
 583:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 584:       setUserArrows([]);
 585:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 586:       return true;
 587:     } catch (cause) {
 588:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 589:       return false;
 590:     }
 591:   }

 593:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 594:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 595:     if (!loaded) return false;
 596:     setEngineScore(null);
 597:     setEngineMessage("");
 598:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 599:       toggleEngine();
 600:     } else {
 601:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 602:     }
 603:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 604:     return true;
 605:   }

 656:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 657:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 658:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 659:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 660:       return;
 661:     }
 662:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 663:     try {
 664:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 665:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 666:       preview.width = crop.width;
 667:       preview.height = crop.height;
 668:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 669:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 670:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 671:     } catch (cause) {
 672:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 673:       return;
 674:     }
 675:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 676:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 677:     setTransferFen("");
 678:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 679:         setRecognitionError("");
 680:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 681:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 682:     try {
 683:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 684:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 685:       });
 686:       const form = new FormData();
 687:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 688:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 689:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 690:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 691:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 692:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 693:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 694:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 695:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 696:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 697:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 698:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 699:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 700:       }
 701:     } catch (cause) {
 702:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 703:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 704:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 705:     }
 706:   }

 708:   function closeTransfer() {
 709:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 710:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 711:     setTransferPreview("");
 712:     setTransferFen("");
 713:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 714:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 715:     setRecognitionError("");
 716:       }

 719:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 720:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 721:       setGameEndOverlay({
 722:         title: "Checkmate",
 723:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 724:       });
 725:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 726:       setGameEndOverlay({
 727:         title: "Stalemate",
 728:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 729:       });
 730:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 731:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 732:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 733:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 734:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 735:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 736:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 737:     } else {
 738:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 739:     }
 740:   }
