 583:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 584:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 585:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 586:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 587:       return;
 588:     }
 589:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 590:     try {
 591:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 592:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 593:       preview.width = crop.width;
 594:       preview.height = crop.height;
 595:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 596:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 597:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 598:     } catch (cause) {
 599:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 600:       return;
 601:     }
 602:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 603:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 604:     setTransferFen("");
 605:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 606:         setRecognitionError("");
 607:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 608:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 609:     try {
 610:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 611:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 612:       });
 613:       const form = new FormData();
 614:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 615:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 616:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 617:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 618:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 619:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 620:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 621:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 622:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 623:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 624:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 625:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 626:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 627:       }
 628:     } catch (cause) {
 629:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 630:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 631:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 632:     }
 633:   }
 634: 
 635:   function closeTransfer() {
 636:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 637:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 638:     setTransferPreview("");
 639:     setTransferFen("");
 640:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 641:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 642:     setRecognitionError("");
 643:       }

 646:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 647:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 648:       setGameEndOverlay({
 649:         title: "Checkmate",
 650:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 651:       });
 652:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 653:       setGameEndOverlay({
 654:         title: "Stalemate",
 655:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 656:       });
 657:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 658:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 659:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 660:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 661:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 662:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 663:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 664:     } else {
 665:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 666:     }
 667:   }

 669:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 670:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 671:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 672:     try {
 673:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 674:       const result = currentGame.move({
 675:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 676:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 677:         promotion: piece,
 678:       });
 679:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 680:       patchBoardSession({
 681:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 682:         moves: nextMoves,
 683:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 684:       });
 685:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 686:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 687:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 688:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 689:       setError("");
 690:     } catch {
 691:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 692:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 693:     }
 694:   }
 695: 
 696:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 697:     if (!boardSession) return;
 698:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 699:     try {
 700:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 701:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 702:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 703:       if (promote) {
 704:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 705:         return;
 706:       }
 707:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 708:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 709:       patchBoardSession({
 710:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 711:         moves: nextMoves,
 712:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 713:       });
 714:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 715:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 716:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 717:       setError("");
 718:     } catch {
 719:       const piece = game.get(to);
 720:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 721:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 722:     }
 723:   }

 725:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 726:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 727:     setRedSquares([]);
 728: 
 729:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 730:       setUserArrows([]);
 731:       setArrowStart(null);
 732:       setArrowHover(null);
 733:       return;
 734:     }
 735: if (!boardSession) return;
 736:     if (annotationMode) {
 737:       if (!arrowStart) {
 738:         setArrowStart(square);
 739:         return;
 740:       }
 741:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 742:       setArrowStart(null);
 743:       setArrowHover(null);
 744:       return;
 745:     }
 746:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 747:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 748:       return;
 749:     }
 750:     const piece = game.get(square);
 751:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 752:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 753:   }

 755:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 756:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 757: 
 758:   event.preventDefault();
 759: 
 760:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 761:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 762:     event.clientX,
 763:     event.clientY,
 764:     bounds,
 765:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 766:   );
 767: 
 768:   if (!square) return;
 769: 
 770:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 771:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 772:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 773:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 774:   setArrowStart(square);
 775:   setArrowHover(square);
 776: 
 777:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 778: }

 780:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 781:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 782:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 783:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 784:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 785:     setArrowHover(square);
 786:   }
 787: 
 788:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 789:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 790: 
 791:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 792: 
 793:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 794:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 795:     event.clientX,
 796:     event.clientY,
 797:     bounds,
 798:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 799:   );
 800: 
 801:   if (to && to !== from) {
 802:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 803:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 804:   } else {
 805:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 806:   }
 807: 
 808:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 809:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 810:   setArrowStart(null);
 811:   setArrowHover(null);
 812: }

 864:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 865:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 866: 
 867:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 868:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;

 873:     setDragSelection(null);
 874:     setCropEditingId(null);
 875:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 876:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 877: 
 878:     patchSession((current) => ({
 879:       ...current,
 880:       candidatesByPage: {
 881:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 882:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 883:       },
 884:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 885:     }));
 886:

 890:   async function detectBoards() {
 891:     if (detecting) {
 892:       stopBoardScan();
 893:       return;
 894:     }
 895: 
 896:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 897:     if (!API_BASE) {
 898:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 899:       return;
 900:     }
 901: 
 902:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 903:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 904:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 905:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 906: 
 907:     setDetecting(true);
 908:     setError("");
 909:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 910:     patchSession((current) => ({
 911:       ...current,
 912:       candidatesByPage: {
 913:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 914:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 915:       },
 916:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 917:     }));
 918: 
 919:     try {
 920:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 921:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 922:           (blob) => blob
 923:             ? resolve(blob)
 924:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 925:           "image/png",
 926:         );
 927:       });
 928: 
 929:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 930: 
 931:       const form = new FormData();
 932:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 933: 
 934:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 935:         method: "POST",
 936:         body: form,
 937:         signal: abortController.signal,
 938:       });
 939: 
 940:       if (!response.ok) {
 941:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 942:       }
 943: 
 944:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 945:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 946:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 947:       );
 948: 
 949:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 950: 
 951:       patchSession((current) => ({
 952:         ...current,
 953:         candidatesByPage: {
 954:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 955:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 956:         },
 957:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 958:       }));
 959: 
 960:       setNotice(
 961:         candidates.length
 962:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 963:           : "No board candidates found.",
 964:       );
 965:     } catch (cause) {
 966:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 967: 
 968:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 969:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 970:       } else {
 971:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 972:       }
 973:     } finally {
 974:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 975:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 976:         setDetecting(false);
 977:       }
 978:     }
 979:   }
 980:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
 981:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
 982:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 983:   }

 985:   function startCropEdit(
 986:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 987:     candidate: Candidate,
 988:     handle: CropHandle,
 989:   ) {
 990:     event.stopPropagation();
 991:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 992:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
 993:     if (!point || !stage) return;
 994:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
 995:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 996:   }
 997: 
 998:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 999:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1000:     if (!manualMode) return;
1001: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1002: if (!canvas) return;
1003: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1004: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1005: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1006: if (
1007:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1008:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1009:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1010:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1011: ) return;
1012:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1013:     if (!point) return;
1014:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1015:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1016:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1017:     setDragSelection(selection);
1018:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1019:   }
1020: 
1021:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1022:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1023:     if (edit) {
1024:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1025:       if (!point || !session) return;
1026:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1027:       patchSession((current) => {
1028:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1029:         return {
1030:           ...current,
1031:           candidatesByPage: {
1032:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1033:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1034:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1035:           },
1036:         };
1037:       });
1038:       return;
1039:     }
1040:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1041:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1042:     if (point) {
1043:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1044:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1045:       setDragSelection(selection);
1046:     }
1047:   }
1048: 
1049:   function finishRegion() {
1050:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1051:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1052:       return;
1053:     }
1054:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1055:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1056:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1057:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1058:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1059:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1060:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1061:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1062:     setDragSelection(null);
1063:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1064:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1065:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1066:       x, y, width, height,
1067:       relativeScore: 1,
1068:       source: "manual",
1069:     };
1070:     patchSession((current) => ({
1071:       ...current,
1072:       candidatesByPage: {
1073:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1074:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1075:       },
1076:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1077:     }));
1078:     setManualMode(false);
1079:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1080:   }

1082:   function cancelRegion() {
1083:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1084:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1085:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1086:     setDragSelection(null);
1087:   }

1089:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1090:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1091:     try {
1092:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1093:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1094:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1095:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1096:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1097:       const scale = mode === "width"
1098:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1099:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1100:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1101:     } catch (cause) {
1102:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1103:     }
1104:   }

  28: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  29:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  30:   if (!match) return uci;
  31:   try {
  32:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  33:     const move = position.move({
  34:       from: match[1] as Square,
  35:       to: match[2] as Square,
  36:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  37:     });
  38:     return move.san;
  39:   } catch {
  40:     return uci;
  41:   }

  44: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  45:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  46:   const san: string[] = [];
  47:   for (const uci of pv) {

  55:       });
  56:       san.push(move.san);
  57:     } catch {
  58:       break;
  59:     }
  60:   }

 443:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {

 447:   function toggleEngine() {
 448:     if (engineEnabled) {
 449:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 450:       engineRef.current = null;
 451:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 452:       setEngineStatus("off");
 453:       setEngineScore(null);
 454:       setEngineMessage("");
 455:       return;
 456:     }
 457:     try {
 458:       setEngineScore(null);
 459:       setEngineMessage("");
 460:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 461:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 462:         (status, message) => {
 463:           setEngineStatus(status);
 464:           if (status === "error") {
 465:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 466:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 467:             setEngineScore(null);
 468:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 469:             engineRef.current = null;
 470:           }
 471:         },
 472:         setEngineScore,
 473:       );
 474:       engineRef.current = client;
 475:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 476:     } catch (cause) {
 477:       setEngineStatus("error");
 478:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 479:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 480:     }
 481:   }

 483:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 484:     setSession((current) => {
 485:       if (!current) return current;
 486:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 487:     });
 488:   }
 489: 
 490:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 491:     if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 492:       return;
 493:     }
 494: 
 495:     if (workspaceMode === "analysis") {
 496:       setAnalysisBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 497:     } else if (workspaceMode === "opening-prep") {
 498:       setOpeningPrepBoard((current) => ({ ...current, ...change }));
 499:     } else if (studyMode) {
 500:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 501:     } else {
 502:       patchSession(change);
 503:     }
 504:   }
 505:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 506:     if (!studyMode) {
 507:       if (!session) {
 508:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 509:         return;
 510:       }
 511:       setStudyBoard({
 512:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 513:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 514:         moves: [...session.moves],
 515:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 516:         flipped: session.flipped,
 517:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 518:       });
 519:       setStudyMode(true);
 520:     } else {
 521:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 522:       if (studyBoard) {
 523:         patchSession({
 524:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 525:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 526:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 527:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 528:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 529:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 530:         });
 531:       }
 532:       setStudyMode(false);
 533:     }
 534:     setLastMove(null);
 535:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 536:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 537:   
 538:     try {
 539:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 540:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 541:       } else {
 542:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 543:       }
 544:     } catch {
 545:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 546:     }
 547: }

 549:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 550:     try {
 551:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 552:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 553:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 554:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 555:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 556:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 557:       setBook(opened);
 558:       setSession(nextSession);
 559:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 560:       setError("");
 561:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 562:     } catch (cause) {
 563:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 564:     }
 565:   }

 567:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 568:     if (!file) return;
 569:     try {
 570:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 571:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 572:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 573:       const now = Date.now();
 574:       const created: BookRecord = {
 575:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 576:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 577:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 578:         byteLength: file.size,
 579:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 580:         addedAt: now,
 581:       };
 582:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 583:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 584:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 585:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 586:       setBook(created);
 587:       setSession(blank);
 588:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 589:       setError("");
 590:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 591:     } catch (cause) {
 592:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 593:     }
 594:   }
 595: 
 596:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 597:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 598: 
 599:     try {
 600:       await removeBook(item.id);
 601:       await removeSession(item.id);
 602: 
 603:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 604:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 605:         const next = { ...current };
 606:         delete next[item.id];
 607:         return next;
 608:       });
 609: 
 610:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 611:         setBook(null);
 612:         setSession(null);
 613:         setPdf(null);
 614:       }
 615: 
 616:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 617:       setError("");
 618:     } catch (cause) {
 619:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 620:     }
 621:   }
 622:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 623:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 624:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 625:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 626:     try {
 627:       await putBook(renamed);
 628:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 629:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 630:     } catch (cause) {
 631:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 632:     }
 633:   }

 635:   function changePage(delta: number) {
 636:     if (!session) return;
 637:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 638:   }

 640:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 641:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 642:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 643:   }

 645:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 646:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 647:     try {
 648:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 649:       setSession({
 650:         ...activeSession,
 651:         originalFen: fen,
 652:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 653:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 654:         moves: [],
 655:         moveIndex: 0,
 656:       });
 657:       setLastMove(null);
 658:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 659:       setUserArrows([]);
 660:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 661:       return true;
 662:     } catch (cause) {
 663:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 664:       return false;
 665:     }
 666:   }

 668:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 669:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 670:     if (!loaded) return false;
 671:     setEngineScore(null);
 672:     setEngineMessage("");
 673:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 674:       toggleEngine();
 675:     } else {
 676:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 677:     }
 678:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 679:     return true;
 680:   }

 682:   function selectCandidate(candidate: Candidate) {
 683:     if (!session) return;
 684:     setCropEditingId(null);
 685:     cropBaselineRef.current = null;
 686:     patchSession({ selectedDiagramId: candidate.id });
 687:     setNotice("Region selected. The current chess position is unchanged; use Adjust Crop or Use on Board to continue.");
 688:   }

 731:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 732:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 733:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 734:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 735:       return;
 736:     }
 737:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 738:     try {
 739:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 740:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 741:       preview.width = crop.width;
 742:       preview.height = crop.height;
 743:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 744:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 745:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 746:     } catch (cause) {
 747:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 748:       return;
 749:     }
 750:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 751:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 752:     setTransferFen("");
 753:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 754:         setRecognitionError("");
 755:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 756:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 757:     try {
 758:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 759:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 760:       });
 761:       const form = new FormData();
 762:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 763:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 764:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 765:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 766:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 767:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 768:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 769:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 770:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 771:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 772:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 773:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 774:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 775:       }
 776:     } catch (cause) {
 777:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 778:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 779:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 780:     }
 781:   }
 782: 
 783:   function closeTransfer() {
 784:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 785:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 786:     setTransferPreview("");
 787:     setTransferFen("");
 788:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 789:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 790:     setRecognitionError("");
 791:       }

 794:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 795:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 796:       setGameEndOverlay({
 797:         title: "Checkmate",
 798:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 799:       });
 800:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 801:       setGameEndOverlay({
 802:         title: "Stalemate",
 803:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 804:       });
 805:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 806:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 807:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 808:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 809:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 810:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 811:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 812:     } else {
 813:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 814:     }
 815:   }

 817:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 818:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 819:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 820:     try {
 821:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 822:       const result = currentGame.move({
 823:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 824:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 825:         promotion: piece,
 826:       });
 827:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 828:       patchBoardSession({
 829:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 830:         moves: nextMoves,
 831:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 832:       });
 833:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 834:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 835:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 836:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 837:       setError("");
 838:     } catch {
 839:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 840:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 841:     }
 842:   }
 843: 
 844:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 845:     if (!boardSession) return;
 846:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 847:     try {
 848:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 849:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 850:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 851:       if (promote) {
 852:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 853:         return;
 854:       }
 855:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 856:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 857:       if (workspaceMode === "opening-explorer") {
 858:         const line = nextMoves
 859:           .map((move, index) => index % 2 === 0 ? `${Math.floor(index / 2) + 1}. ${move}` : move)
 860:           .join(" ");
 861:         setOpeningExplorerInput(line);
 862:         setOpeningExplorerPly(nextMoves.length);
 863:       } else {
 864:         patchBoardSession({
 865:           currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 866:           moves: nextMoves,
 867:           moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 868:         });
 869:       }
 870:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 871:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 872:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 873:       setError("");
 874:     } catch {
 875:       const piece = game.get(to);
 876:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 877:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 878:     }
 879:   }
 880: 
 881:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 882:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 883:     setRedSquares([]);
 884: 
 885:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 886:       setUserArrows([]);
 887:       setArrowStart(null);
 888:       setArrowHover(null);
 889:       return;
 890:     }
 891: if (!boardSession) return;
 892:     if (annotationMode) {
 893:       if (!arrowStart) {
 894:         setArrowStart(square);
 895:         return;
 896:       }
 897:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 898:       setArrowStart(null);
 899:       setArrowHover(null);
 900:       return;
 901:     }
 902:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 903:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 904:       return;
 905:     }
 906:     const piece = game.get(square);
 907:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 908:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 909:   }

 911:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 912:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 913: 
 914:   event.preventDefault();
 915: 
 916:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 917:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 918:     event.clientX,
 919:     event.clientY,
 920:     bounds,
 921:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 922:   );
 923: 
 924:   if (!square) return;
 925: 
 926:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 927:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 928:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 929:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 930:   setArrowStart(square);
 931:   setArrowHover(square);
 932: 
 933:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 934: }

 936:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 937:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 938:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 939:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 940:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 941:     setArrowHover(square);

 944:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 945:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 946: 
 947:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 948: 
 949:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 950:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 951:     event.clientX,
 952:     event.clientY,
 953:     bounds,
 954:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 955:   );
 956: 
 957:   if (to && to !== from) {
 958:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 959:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 960:   } else {
 961:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 962:   }
 963: 
 964:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 965:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 966:   setArrowStart(null);
 967:   setArrowHover(null);
 968: }

 983:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 984:     } catch (cause) {
 985:       setError(`Could not navigate to move: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 986:     }
 987:   }

1020:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
1021:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1022:

1024:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;

1029:     setDragSelection(null);
1030:     setCropEditingId(null);
1031:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1032:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1033: 
1034:     patchSession((current) => ({
1035:       ...current,
1036:       candidatesByPage: {
1037:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1038:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1039:       },

1042:

1046:   async function detectBoards() {
1047:     if (detecting) {
1048:       stopBoardScan();
1049:       return;
1050:     }
1051: 
1052:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
1053:     if (!API_BASE) {
1054:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
1055:       return;
1056:     }
1057: 
1058:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1059:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1060:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1061:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1062: 
1063:     setDetecting(true);
1064:     setError("");
1065:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1066:     patchSession((current) => ({
1067:       ...current,
1068:       candidatesByPage: {
1069:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1070:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1071:       },
1072:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1073:     }));
1074: 
1075:     try {
1076:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1077:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1078:           (blob) => blob
1079:             ? resolve(blob)
1080:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1081:           "image/png",
1082:         );
1083:       });
1084: 
1085:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1086: 
1087:       const form = new FormData();
1088:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1089: 
1090:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1091:         method: "POST",
1092:         body: form,
1093:         signal: abortController.signal,
1094:       });
1095: 
1096:       if (!response.ok) {
1097:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1098:       }
1099: 
1100:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1101:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1102:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1103:       );
1104: 
1105:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1106: 
1107:       patchSession((current) => ({
1108:         ...current,
1109:         candidatesByPage: {
1110:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1111:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1112:         },
1113:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1114:       }));
1115: 
1116:       setNotice(
1117:         candidates.length
1118:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1119:           : "No board candidates found.",
1120:       );
1121:     } catch (cause) {
1122:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1123: 
1124:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1125:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1126:       } else {
1127:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1128:       }
1129:     } finally {
1130:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1131:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1132:         setDetecting(false);
1133:       }
1134:     }
1135:   }

1154:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1155:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1156:     if (!manualMode) return;
1157: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1158: if (!canvas) return;
1159: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1160: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1161: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1162: if (
1163:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1164:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1165:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1166:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1167: ) return;
1168:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1169:     if (!point) return;
1170:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1171:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1172:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1173:     setDragSelection(selection);
1174:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1175:   }

1177:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1178:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1179:     if (edit) {
1180:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1181:       if (!point || !session) return;
1182:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1183:       patchSession((current) => {
1184:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1185:         return {
1186:           ...current,
1187:           candidatesByPage: {
1188:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1189:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1190:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1191:           },
1192:         };
1193:       });
1194:       return;
1195:     }
1196:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1197:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1198:     if (point) {
1199:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1200:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1201:       setDragSelection(selection);
1202:     }
1203:   }
1204: 
1205:   function finishRegion() {
1206:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1207:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1208:       return;
1209:     }
1210:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1211:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1212:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1213:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1214:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1215:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1216:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1217:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1218:     setDragSelection(null);
1219:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1220:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1221:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1222:       x, y, width, height,
1223:       relativeScore: 1,
1224:       source: "manual",
1225:     };
1226:     patchSession((current) => ({
1227:       ...current,
1228:       candidatesByPage: {
1229:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1230:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1231:       },
1232:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1233:     }));
1234:     setManualMode(false);
1235:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1236:   }
1237: 
1238:   function cancelRegion() {
1239:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1240:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1241:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1242:     setDragSelection(null);
1243:   }

1245:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1246:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1247:     try {
1248:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1249:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1250:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1251:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1252:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1253:       const scale = mode === "width"
1254:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1255:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1256:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1257:     } catch (cause) {
1258:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1259:     }
1260:   }

1264:   function saveBookmark() {
1265:     if (!session) return;
1266:     patchSession((current) => ({
1267:       ...current,
1268:       bookmarks: current.bookmarks.includes(current.page)
1269:         ? current.bookmarks.filter((page) => page !== current.page)
1270:         : [...current.bookmarks, current.page].sort((a, b) => a - b),
1271:     }));
1272:   }

1274:   function savePosition() {
1275:     if (!session) return;
1276:     const position = {
1277:       id: crypto.randomUUID(),
1278:       title: `Page ${session.page} position`,
1279:       fen: session.currentFen,
1280:       page: session.page,

 328:   function toggleEngine() {
 329:     if (engineEnabled) {
 330:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 331:       engineRef.current = null;
 332:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 333:       setEngineStatus("off");
 334:       setEngineScore(null);
 335:       setEngineMessage("");
 336:       return;
 337:     }
 338:     try {
 339:       setEngineScore(null);
 340:       setEngineMessage("");
 341:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 342:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 343:         (status, message) => {
 344:           setEngineStatus(status);
 345:           if (status === "error") {
 346:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 347:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 348:             setEngineScore(null);
 349:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 350:             engineRef.current = null;
 351:           }
 352:         },
 353:         setEngineScore,
 354:       );
 355:       engineRef.current = client;
 356:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 357:     } catch (cause) {
 358:       setEngineStatus("error");
 359:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 360:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 361:     }
 362:   }

 365:     setSession((current) => {

 367:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 368:     });

 409:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 410:     try {
 411:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 412:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 413:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 414:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 415:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 416:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 417:       setBook(opened);
 418:       setSession(nextSession);
 419:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 420:       setError("");
 421:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 422:     } catch (cause) {
 423:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);

 427:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 428:     if (!file) return;
 429:     try {
 430:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 431:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 432:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 433:       const now = Date.now();
 434:       const created: BookRecord = {
 435:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 436:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 437:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 438:         byteLength: file.size,
 439:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 440:         addedAt: now,
 441:       };
 442:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 443:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 444:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 445:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 446:       setBook(created);
 447:       setSession(blank);
 448:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 449:       setError("");
 450:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 451:     } catch (cause) {
 452:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 453:     }
 454:   }

 456:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 457:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 458: 
 459:     try {
 460:       await removeBook(item.id);
 461:       await removeSession(item.id);
 462: 
 463:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 464:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 465:         const next = { ...current };
 466:         delete next[item.id];
 467:         return next;
 468:       });
 469: 
 470:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 471:         setBook(null);
 472:         setSession(null);
 473:         setPdf(null);
 474:       }
 475: 
 476:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 477:       setError("");
 478:     } catch (cause) {
 479:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 480:     }
 481:   }
 482:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 483:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 484:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 485:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 486:     try {
 487:       await putBook(renamed);
 488:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 489:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 490:     } catch (cause) {
 491:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 492:     }
 493:   }

 505:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 506:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 507:     try {
 508:       const next = new Chess(fen);

 510:         ...activeSession,
 511:         originalFen: fen,
 512:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 513:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 514:         moves: [],
 515:         moveIndex: 0,
 516:       });
 517:       setLastMove(null);
 518:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 519:       setUserArrows([]);
 520:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 521:       return true;
 522:     } catch (cause) {
 523:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 524:       return false;
 525:     }
 526:   }

 591:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 592:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 593:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 594:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 595:       return;
 596:     }
 597:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 598:     try {
 599:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 600:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 601:       preview.width = crop.width;
 602:       preview.height = crop.height;
 603:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 604:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 605:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 606:     } catch (cause) {
 607:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 608:       return;
 609:     }
 610:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 611:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 612:     setTransferFen("");
 613:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 614:         setRecognitionError("");
 615:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 616:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 617:     try {
 618:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 619:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 620:       });
 621:       const form = new FormData();
 622:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 623:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 624:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 625:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 626:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 627:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 628:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 629:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 630:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 631:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 632:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 633:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 634:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 635:       }
 636:     } catch (cause) {
 637:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 638:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 639:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 640:     }
 641:   }
 642: 
 643:   function closeTransfer() {
 644:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 645:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 646:     setTransferPreview("");
 647:     setTransferFen("");
 648:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 649:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 650:     setRecognitionError("");
 651:       }

 654:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 655:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 656:       setGameEndOverlay({
 657:         title: "Checkmate",
 658:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 659:       });
 660:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 661:       setGameEndOverlay({
 662:         title: "Stalemate",
 663:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 664:       });
 665:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 666:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 667:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 668:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 669:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 670:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 671:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 672:     } else {
 673:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 674:     }
 675:   }

 677:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 678:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 679:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 680:     try {
 681:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 682:       const result = currentGame.move({
 683:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 684:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 685:         promotion: piece,
 686:       });
 687:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 688:       patchBoardSession({
 689:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 690:         moves: nextMoves,
 691:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 692:       });
 693:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 694:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 695:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 696:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 697:       setError("");
 698:     } catch {
 699:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 700:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 701:     }
 702:   }
 703: 
 704:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 705:     if (!boardSession) return;
 706:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 707:     try {
 708:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 709:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 710:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 711:       if (promote) {
 712:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 713:         return;
 714:       }
 715:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 716:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 717:       patchBoardSession({
 718:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 719:         moves: nextMoves,
 720:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 721:       });
 722:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 723:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 724:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 725:       setError("");
 726:     } catch {
 727:       const piece = game.get(to);
 728:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 729:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 730:     }
 731:   }

 733:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 734:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 735:     setRedSquares([]);
 736: 
 737:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 738:       setUserArrows([]);
 739:       setArrowStart(null);
 740:       setArrowHover(null);
 741:       return;
 742:     }
 743: if (!boardSession) return;
 744:     if (annotationMode) {
 745:       if (!arrowStart) {
 746:         setArrowStart(square);
 747:         return;
 748:       }
 749:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 750:       setArrowStart(null);
 751:       setArrowHover(null);
 752:       return;
 753:     }
 754:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 755:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 756:       return;
 757:     }
 758:     const piece = game.get(square);
 759:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 760:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 761:   }

 898:   async function detectBoards() {
 899:     if (detecting) {
 900:       stopBoardScan();
 901:       return;
 902:     }
 903: 
 904:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 905:     if (!API_BASE) {
 906:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 907:       return;
 908:     }
 909: 
 910:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 911:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 912:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 913:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 914: 
 915:     setDetecting(true);
 916:     setError("");
 917:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 918:     patchSession((current) => ({
 919:       ...current,
 920:       candidatesByPage: {
 921:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 922:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 923:       },
 924:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 925:     }));
 926: 
 927:     try {
 928:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 929:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 930:           (blob) => blob
 931:             ? resolve(blob)
 932:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 933:           "image/png",
 934:         );
 935:       });
 936: 
 937:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 938: 
 939:       const form = new FormData();
 940:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 941: 
 942:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 943:         method: "POST",
 944:         body: form,
 945:         signal: abortController.signal,
 946:       });
 947: 
 948:       if (!response.ok) {
 949:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 950:       }
 951: 
 952:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 953:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 954:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 955:       );
 956: 
 957:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 958: 
 959:       patchSession((current) => ({
 960:         ...current,
 961:         candidatesByPage: {
 962:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 963:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 964:         },
 965:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 966:       }));
 967: 
 968:       setNotice(
 969:         candidates.length
 970:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 971:           : "No board candidates found.",
 972:       );
 973:     } catch (cause) {
 974:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 975: 
 976:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 977:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 978:       } else {
 979:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 980:       }
 981:     } finally {
 982:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 983:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 984:         setDetecting(false);
 985:       }
 986:     }
 987:   }

1006:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1007:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1008:     if (!manualMode) return;
1009: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1010: if (!canvas) return;
1011: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1012: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1013: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1014: if (
1015:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1016:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1017:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1018:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1019: ) return;
1020:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1021:     if (!point) return;
1022:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1023:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1024:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;

1029:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1030:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1031:     if (edit) {
1032:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1033:       if (!point || !session) return;
1034:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1035:       patchSession((current) => {
1036:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1037:         return {
1038:           ...current,
1039:           candidatesByPage: {
1040:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1041:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1042:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1043:           },
1044:         };
1045:       });
1046:       return;
1047:     }
1048:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1049:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1050:     if (point) {
1051:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1052:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1053:       setDragSelection(selection);
1054:     }

1057:   function finishRegion() {
1058:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1059:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1060:       return;
1061:     }
1062:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1063:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1064:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1065:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1066:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1067:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1068:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1069:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1070:     setDragSelection(null);
1071:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1072:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1073:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1074:       x, y, width, height,
1075:       relativeScore: 1,
1076:       source: "manual",
1077:     };
1078:     patchSession((current) => ({
1079:       ...current,
1080:       candidatesByPage: {
1081:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1082:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1083:       },
1084:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1085:     }));
1086:     setManualMode(false);
1087:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1088:   }

1095:   }

1097:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1098:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1099:     try {
1100:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1101:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1102:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1103:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1104:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1105:       const scale = mode === "width"
1106:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1107:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1108:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1109:     } catch (cause) {
1110:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1111:     }
1112:   }

 423:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 424:         const next = { ...current };
 425:         delete next[item.id];
 426:         return next;
 427:       });
 428: 
 429:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 430:         setBook(null);
 431:         setSession(null);
 432:         setPdf(null);
 433:       }
 434: 
 435:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 436:       setError("");
 437:     } catch (cause) {
 438:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 439:     }
 440:   }
 441:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 442:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 443:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 444:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 445:     try {
 446:       await putBook(renamed);
 447:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 448:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 449:     } catch (cause) {
 450:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 451:     }
 452:   }

 454:   function changePage(delta: number) {
 455:     if (!session) return;
 456:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 457:   }

 459:   function goToPage(value: number) {

 461:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 462:   }

 464:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 465:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 466:     try {
 467:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 468:       setSession({
 469:         ...activeSession,
 470:         originalFen: fen,
 471:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 472:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 473:         moves: [],
 474:         moveIndex: 0,
 475:       });
 476:       setLastMove(null);
 477:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 478:       setUserArrows([]);
 479:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 480:       return true;
 481:     } catch (cause) {
 482:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 483:       return false;
 484:     }
 485:   }

 493:       toggleEngine();
 494:     } else {
 495:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 496:     }
 497:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 498:     return true;

 550:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 551:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 552:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 553:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 554:       return;
 555:     }
 556:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 557:     try {
 558:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 559:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 560:       preview.width = crop.width;
 561:       preview.height = crop.height;
 562:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 563:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 564:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 565:     } catch (cause) {
 566:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 567:       return;
 568:     }
 569:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 570:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 571:     setTransferFen("");
 572:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 573:         setRecognitionError("");
 574:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 575:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 576:     try {
 577:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 578:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 579:       });
 580:       const form = new FormData();
 581:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 582:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 583:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 584:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 585:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 586:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 587:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 588:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 589:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 590:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 591:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 592:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 593:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 594:       }
 595:     } catch (cause) {
 596:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 597:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 598:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 599:     }
 600:   }
 601: 
 602:   function closeTransfer() {
 603:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 604:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 605:     setTransferPreview("");
 606:     setTransferFen("");
 607:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 608:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 609:     setRecognitionError("");
 610:       }

 613:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 614:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 615:       setGameEndOverlay({
 616:         title: "Checkmate",
 617:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 618:       });
 619:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 620:       setGameEndOverlay({
 621:         title: "Stalemate",
 622:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 623:       });
 624:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 625:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 626:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 627:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 629:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 630:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 631:     } else {
 632:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 633:     }
 634:   }
 635: 
 636:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 637:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 638:     try {
 639:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 640:       const result = currentGame.move({
 641:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 642:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 643:         promotion: piece,
 644:       });
 645:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 646:       patchSession({
 647:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 648:         moves: nextMoves,
 649:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 650:       });
 651:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 652:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 653:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 654:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 655:       setError("");
 656:     } catch {
 657:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 658:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 659:     }
 660:   }
 661: 
 662:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 663:     if (!session) return;
 664:     try {
 665:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 666:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 667:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 668:       if (promote) {
 669:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 670:         return;
 671:       }
 672:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 673:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 674:       patchSession({
 675:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 676:         moves: nextMoves,
 677:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 678:       });
 679:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 680:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 681:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 682:       setError("");
 683:     } catch {
 684:       const piece = game.get(to);
 685:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 686:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 687:     }
 688:   }

 690:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 691:     
 692:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 693:       setUserArrows([]);
 694:       setArrowStart(null);
 695:       setArrowHover(null);
 696:       return;
 697:     }
 698: if (!session) return;
 699:     if (annotationMode) {
 700:       if (!arrowStart) {
 701:         setArrowStart(square);
 702:         return;
 703:       }
 704:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 705:       setArrowStart(null);
 706:       setArrowHover(null);
 707:       return;
 708:     }
 709:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 710:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 711:       return;
 712:     }
 713:     const piece = game.get(square);
 714:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 715:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 716:   }

 718:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 719:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 720:

 722: 
 723:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 724:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 725:     event.clientX,
 726:     event.clientY,
 727:     bounds,
 728:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 729:   );
 730: 
 731:   if (!square) return;
 732: 
 733:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 734:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;

 736:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 737:   setArrowStart(square);
 738:   setArrowHover(square);
 739: 
 740:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 741: }
