 743:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 744:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 745:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

 751:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 752:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 753: 
 754:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 755: 
 756:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 757:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 758:     event.clientX,
 759:     event.clientY,
 760:     bounds,
 761:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 762:   );
 763: 
 764:   if (to && to !== from) {
 765:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 766:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 767:   } else {
 768:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 769:   }
 770: 
 771:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 772:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 773:   setArrowStart(null);
 774:   setArrowHover(null);
 775: }

 826:   function clearBoardScan() {
 827:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 828:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 829: 
 830:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 831:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 832:     controller?.abort();

 835:     setManualMode(false);
 836:     setDragSelection(null);
 837:     setCropEditingId(null);
 838:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 839:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 840: 
 841:     patchSession((current) => ({
 842:       ...current,
 843:       candidatesByPage: {
 844:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 845:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 846:       },
 847:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 848:     }));
 849: 
 850:     setError("");
 851:     setNotice("Board detection cleared.");

 853:   async function detectBoards() {
 854:     if (detecting) {
 855:       stopBoardScan();
 856:       return;
 857:     }
 858: 
 859:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 860:     if (!API_BASE) {
 861:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 862:       return;
 863:     }
 864: 
 865:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 866:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 867:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 868:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 869: 
 870:     setDetecting(true);
 871:     setError("");
 872:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 873:     patchSession((current) => ({
 874:       ...current,
 875:       candidatesByPage: {
 876:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 877:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 878:       },
 879:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 880:     }));
 881: 
 882:     try {
 883:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 884:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 885:           (blob) => blob
 886:             ? resolve(blob)
 887:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 888:           "image/png",
 889:         );
 890:       });
 891: 
 892:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 893: 
 894:       const form = new FormData();
 895:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 896: 
 897:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 898:         method: "POST",
 899:         body: form,
 900:         signal: abortController.signal,
 901:       });
 902: 
 903:       if (!response.ok) {
 904:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 905:       }
 906: 
 907:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 908:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 909:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 910:       );
 911: 
 912:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 913: 
 914:       patchSession((current) => ({
 915:         ...current,
 916:         candidatesByPage: {
 917:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 918:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 919:         },
 920:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 921:       }));
 922: 
 923:       setNotice(
 924:         candidates.length
 925:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 926:           : "No board candidates found.",
 927:       );
 928:     } catch (cause) {
 929:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 930: 
 931:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 932:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 933:       } else {
 934:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 935:       }
 936:     } finally {
 937:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 938:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 939:         setDetecting(false);
 940:       }
 941:     }
 942:   }

 948:   function startCropEdit(
 949:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 950:     candidate: Candidate,

 953:     event.stopPropagation();

 961:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 962:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 963:     if (!manualMode) return;
 964: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 965: if (!canvas) return;
 966: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 967: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 968: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 969: if (
 970:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 971:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 972:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 973:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 974: ) return;
 975:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 976:     if (!point) return;
 977:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 978:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 979:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 980:     setDragSelection(selection);
 981:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 982:   }
 983: 
 984:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 985:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 986:     if (edit) {
 987:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 988:       if (!point || !session) return;
 989:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 990:       patchSession((current) => {
 991:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 992:         return {
 993:           ...current,
 994:           candidatesByPage: {
 995:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 996:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 997:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 998:           },
 999:         };
1000:       });
1001:       return;
1002:     }
1003:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1004:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1005:     if (point) {
1006:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1007:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1008:       setDragSelection(selection);
1009:     }
1010:   }
1011: 
1012:   function finishRegion() {
1013:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1014:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1015:       return;
1016:     }
1017:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1018:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1019:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1020:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1021:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1022:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1023:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1024:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1025:     setDragSelection(null);
1026:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1027:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1028:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1029:       x, y, width, height,
1030:       relativeScore: 1,
1031:       source: "manual",
1032:     };
1033:     patchSession((current) => ({
1034:       ...current,
1035:       candidatesByPage: {
1036:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1037:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1038:       },
1039:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,

 265:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 266:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 267:     }
 268:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 269:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 270:   });
 271: 
 272:   useEffect(() => () => {
 273:     engineRef.current?.dispose();
 274:     engineRef.current = null;
 275:   }, []);
 276: 
 277:   const sortedBooks = useMemo(() => [...books].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt), [books]);
 278:   const visibleBooks = useMemo(() => {
 279:     const needle = bookSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
 280:     return sortedBooks.filter((item) => {
 281:       const saved = sessionIndex[item.id];
 282:       const matchesTab =
 283:         libraryTab === "all" || libraryTab === "recent" || libraryTab === "local" ||
 284:         (libraryTab === "bookmarks" && (saved?.bookmarks.length ?? 0) > 0) ||
 285:         (libraryTab === "positions" && (saved?.positions.length ?? 0) > 0) ||
 286:         (libraryTab === "progress" && (saved?.page ?? 1) > 1);
 287:       return matchesTab && item.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle);
 288:     });
 289:   }, [bookSearch, libraryTab, sessionIndex, sortedBooks]);
 290: 
 291:   const game = useMemo(() => {
 292:     if (!session) return new Chess();
 293:     try {
 294:       return makePosition(session.lineBaseFen, session.moves, session.moveIndex);
 295:     } catch {
 296:       try { return new Chess(session.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 297:     }
 298:   }, [session]);
 299:   const legalTargets = useMemo(() => {
 300:     if (!selectedSquare) return new Set<string>();
 301:     return new Set(game.moves({ square: selectedSquare, verbose: true }).map((move) => move.to));
 302:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 303:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 304:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 305:     try { return makePosition(session?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, session?.moves ?? [], session?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 306:     catch { return []; }
 307:   }, [session]);
 308:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 309:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 310:     : null);
 311:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 312:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 313:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 314:   );
 315: 
 316:   useEffect(() => {
 317:     setUserArrows([]);
 318:     setArrowStart(null);
 319:     setArrowHover(null);
 320:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 321:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 322: 
 323:   useEffect(() => {
 324:     if (engineEnabled) engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 325:   }, [engineEnabled, session?.currentFen, session?.moveIndex, engineDepth]);
 326: 
 327:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 328:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 329:   }
 330: 
 331:   function toggleEngine() {
 332:     if (engineEnabled) {
 333:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 334:       engineRef.current = null;
 335:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 336:       setEngineStatus("off");
 337:       setEngineScore(null);
 338:       setEngineMessage("");
 339:       return;
 340:     }
 341:     try {
 342:       setEngineScore(null);
 343:       setEngineMessage("");
 344:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 345:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 346:         (status, message) => {
 347:           setEngineStatus(status);
 348:           if (status === "error") {
 349:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 350:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 351:             setEngineScore(null);
 352:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 353:             engineRef.current = null;
 354:           }
 355:         },
 356:         setEngineScore,
 357:       );
 358:       engineRef.current = client;
 359:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 360:     } catch (cause) {
 361:       setEngineStatus("error");
 362:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 363:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 364:     }
 365:   }

 367:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 368:     setSession((current) => {
 369:       if (!current) return current;
 370:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 371:     });
 372:   }

 374:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 375:     try {
 376:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 377:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 378:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 379:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 380:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 381:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 382:       setBook(opened);
 383:       setSession(nextSession);
 384:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 385:       setError("");
 386:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 387:     } catch (cause) {
 388:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 389:     }
 390:   }
 391: 
 392:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 393:     if (!file) return;
 394:     try {
 395:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 396:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 397:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 398:       const now = Date.now();
 399:       const created: BookRecord = {
 400:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 401:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 402:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 403:         byteLength: file.size,
 404:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 405:         addedAt: now,
 406:       };
 407:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 408:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 409:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 410:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 411:       setBook(created);
 412:       setSession(blank);
 413:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 414:       setError("");
 415:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 416:     } catch (cause) {
 417:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 418:     }
 419:   }

 421:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 422:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove "${item.title}" from your library?`)) return;
 423: 
 424:     try {
 425:       await removeBook(item.id);
 426:       await removeSession(item.id);
 427: 
 428:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 429:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 430:         const next = { ...current };
 431:         delete next[item.id];
 432:         return next;
 433:       });
 434: 
 435:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 436:         setBook(null);
 437:         setSession(null);
 438:         setPdf(null);
 439:       }
 440: 
 441:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 442:       setError("");
 443:     } catch (cause) {
 444:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 445:     }
 446:   }
 447:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 448:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 449:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 450:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 451:     try {
 452:       await putBook(renamed);
 453:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 454:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 455:     } catch (cause) {
 456:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 457:     }
 458:   }

 470:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 471:     if (!session) return false;

 479:         moveIndex: 0,
 480:       });
 481:       setLastMove(null);
 482:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 483:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 484:       return true;
 485:     } catch (cause) {
 486:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 487:       return false;
 488:     }

 540:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 541:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 542:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 543:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 544:       return;
 545:     }
 546:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 547:     try {
 548:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 549:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 550:       preview.width = crop.width;
 551:       preview.height = crop.height;
 552:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 553:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 554:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 555:     } catch (cause) {
 556:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 557:       return;
 558:     }
 559:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 560:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 561:     setTransferFen("");
 562:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 563:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 564:     setRecognitionError("");
 565:     setTransferPiece("P");
 566:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 567:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 568:     try {
 569:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 570:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 571:       });
 572:       const form = new FormData();
 573:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 574:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 575:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 576:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 577:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 578:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 579:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 580:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 581:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 582:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 583:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 584:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 585:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 586:       }
 587:     } catch (cause) {
 588:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 589:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 590:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 591:     }
 592:   }
 593: 
 594:   function closeTransfer() {
 595:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 596:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 597:     setTransferPreview("");
 598:     setTransferFen("");
 599:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 600:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 601:     setRecognitionError("");
 602:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 603:   }

 605:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 606:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 607:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 608:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 609:       return;
 610:     }
 611:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 612:     if (!board) {
 613:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 614:       return;
 615:     }
 616:     const row = displayRow;
 617:     const col = displayCol;
 618:     try {
 619:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 620:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 621:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 622:       setRecognitionError("");
 623:     } catch (cause) {
 624:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 625:     }
 626:   }
 627: 
 628:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 629:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 630:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 631:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 632:       return;
 633:     }
 634:     try {
 635:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 636:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 637:       setRecognitionError("");
 638:     } catch (cause) {
 639:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 640:     }
 641:   }
 642: 
 643:   function confirmTransfer() {
 644:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 645:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 646:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 647:       return;
 648:     }
 649:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 650:       closeTransfer();
 651:     }
 652:   }
 653: 
 654:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 655:     if (!session) return;
 656:     try {
 657:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 658:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 659:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 660:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 661:       if (promote) {
 662:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 663:         if (!choice) return;
 664:         switch (choice) {
 665:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 666:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 667:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 668:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 669:           default:
 670:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 671:             return;
 672:         }
 673:       }
 674:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 675:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 676:       patchSession({
 677:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 678:         moves: nextMoves,
 679:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 680:       });
 681:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 682:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 683:       setError("");
 684:     } catch {
 685:       const piece = game.get(to);
 686:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 687:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 688:     }
 689:   }
 690: 
 691:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 692:     if (!session) return;
 693:     if (annotationMode) {
 694:       if (!arrowStart) {
 695:         setArrowStart(square);
 696:         return;
 697:       }
 698:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 699:       setArrowStart(null);
 700:       setArrowHover(null);
 701:       return;
 702:     }
 703:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 704:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 705:       return;
 706:     }
 707:     const piece = game.get(square);
 708:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 709:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 710:   }

 770:   async function detectBoards() {
 771:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 772:     if (!API_BASE) {
 773:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Start the optional CV service and set VITE_API_BASE_URL, or draw a board region manually.");
 774:       return;
 775:     }
 776:     setDetecting(true);
 777:     setError("");
 778:     try {
 779:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 780:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")), "image/png");
 781:       });
 782:       const form = new FormData();
 783:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 784:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 785:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 786:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 787:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map((item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index));
 788:       patchSession((current) => ({
 789:         ...current,
 790:         candidatesByPage: { ...current.candidatesByPage, [String(current.page)]: candidates },
 791:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 792:       }));
 793:       setNotice(candidates.length ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.` : "No board candidates found. You can draw a region manually.");
 794:     } catch (cause) {
 795:       setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 796:     } finally {
 797:       setDetecting(false);
 798:     }
 799:   }

 819:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 820:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 821:     if (!manualMode) return;
 822: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 823: if (!canvas) return;
 824: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 825: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 826: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 827: if (
 828:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 829:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 830:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 831:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 832: ) return;
 833:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 834:     if (!point) return;
 835:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 836:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 837:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 838:     setDragSelection(selection);
 839:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 840:   }
 841: 
 842:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 843:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 844:     if (edit) {
 845:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 846:       if (!point || !session) return;
 847:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 848:       patchSession((current) => {
 849:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 850:         return {
 851:           ...current,
 852:           candidatesByPage: {
 853:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 854:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 855:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 856:           },
 857:         };
 858:       });
 859:       return;
 860:     }
 861:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 862:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 863:     if (point) {
 864:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 865:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 866:       setDragSelection(selection);
 867:     }
 868:   }
 869: 
 870:   function finishRegion() {
 871:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 872:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 873:       return;
 874:     }
 875:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 876:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 877:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 878:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 879:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 880:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 881:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 882:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 883:     setDragSelection(null);
 884:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 885:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 886:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 887:       x, y, width, height,
 888:       relativeScore: 1,
 889:       source: "manual",
 890:     };
 891:     patchSession((current) => ({
 892:       ...current,
 893:       candidatesByPage: {
 894:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 895:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 896:       },
 897:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 898:     }));
 899:     setManualMode(false);
 900:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 901:   }
 902: 
 903:   function cancelRegion() {
 904:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 905:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 906:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 907:     setDragSelection(null);
 908:   }
 909: 
 910:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 911:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 912:     try {
 913:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 914:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 915:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 916:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 917:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 918:       const scale = mode === "width"
 919:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 920:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 921:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 922:     } catch (cause) {
 923:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 924:     }
 925:   }

 933:     } catch (cause) {
 934:       setError(`Could not expand chessboard: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 935:     }
 936:   }

 154:         }
 155:       } catch (cause) {
 156:         if (!cancelled) setError(`Could not restore the local library: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 157:       } finally {
 158:         if (!cancelled) setReady(true);
 159:       }
 160:     }
 161:     void initialize();
 162:     return () => { cancelled = true; };
 163:   }, []);
 164: 
 165:   useEffect(() => {
 166:     if (!ready || !book || !session) return;
 167:     const snapshot = session;
 168:     void Promise.all([putSession(snapshot), setActiveBookId(book.id)])
 169:       .then(() => setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [snapshot.bookId]: snapshot })))
 170:       .catch((cause: unknown) => setError(`Could not save reading session: ${messageOf(cause)}`));
 171:   }, [ready, book, session]);
 172: 
 173:   useEffect(() => {
 174:     pdfRef.current?.cleanup();
 175:     void loadingTaskRef.current?.destroy();
 176:     setPdf(null);
 177:     if (!book) {
 178:       pdfRef.current = null;
 179:       loadingTaskRef.current = null;
 180:       return;
 181:     }
 182:     let cancelled = false;
 183:     let loadingTask: PDFDocumentLoadingTask | null = null;
 184:     setPdfLoading(true);
 185:     setError("");
 186:     book.file.slice(0).arrayBuffer().then((data) => {
 187:       if (cancelled) return;
 188:       loadingTask = getDocument({ data });
 189:       loadingTaskRef.current = loadingTask;
 190:       return loadingTask.promise;
 191:     }).then((document) => {
 192:       if (!document) return;
 193:       if (cancelled) {
 194:         void document.cleanup();
 195:         return;
 196:       }
 197:       pdfRef.current = document;
 198:       setPdf(document);
 199:       setPdfLoading(false);
 200:       setSession((current) => current ? { ...current, pageCount: document.numPages } : current);
 201:     }).catch((cause: unknown) => {
 202:       if (!cancelled) {
 203:         setPdfLoading(false);
 204:         setError(`Could not open this PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 205:       }
 206:     });
 207:     return () => {
 208:       cancelled = true;
 209:       if (loadingTask) void loadingTask.destroy();
 210:     };
 211:   }, [book]);
 212: 
 213:   useEffect(() => {
 214:     if (!pdf || !session || !canvasRef.current) return;
 215:     let cancelled = false;
 216:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 217:     setRendering(true);
 218:     pdf.getPage(session.page).then((page) => {
 219:       if (cancelled) return;
 220:       const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale: session.zoom * Math.min(1.4, 1100 / page.getViewport({ scale: 1 }).width) });
 221:       const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
 222:       if (!context) throw new Error("Canvas rendering is unavailable in this browser.");
 223:       canvas.width = Math.floor(viewport.width);
 224:       canvas.height = Math.floor(viewport.height);
 225:       const task = page.render({ canvas, canvasContext: context, viewport });
 226:       renderTaskRef.current = task;
 227:       return task.promise;
 228:     }).then(() => {
 229:       if (!cancelled) setRendering(false);
 230:     }).catch((cause: unknown) => {
 231:       if (!cancelled && !(cause instanceof Error && cause.name === "RenderingCancelledException")) {
 232:         setRendering(false);
 233:         setError(`Could not render page ${session.page}: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 234:       }
 235:     });
 236:     return () => {
 237:       cancelled = true;
 238:       renderTaskRef.current?.cancel();
 239:     };
 240:   }, [pdf, session?.page, session?.zoom]);
 241: 
 242:   useEffect(() => {
 243:     function onKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 244:       if (!session || !book || isTypingTarget(event.target)) return;
 245:       if (cropEditingId && ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key)) {
 246:         const candidate = (session.candidatesByPage[String(session.page)] ?? []).find((item) => item.id === cropEditingId);
 247:         if (!candidate) return;
 248:         const step = event.shiftKey ? 0.01 : 0.002;
 249:         const x = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
 250:         const y = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
 251:         const next = editCrop(candidate, "move", x, y);
 252:         patchSession((current) => {
 253:           const pageKey = String(current.page);
 254:           return {
 255:             ...current,
 256:             candidatesByPage: {
 257:               ...current.candidatesByPage,
 258:               [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((item) =>
 259:                 item.id === candidate.id ? { ...item, ...next } : item),
 260:             },
 261:           };
 262:         });
 263:         event.preventDefault();
 264:         return;
 265:       }
 266:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 267:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 268:     }
 269:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 270:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 271:   });
 272: 
 273:   useEffect(() => () => {
 274:     engineRef.current?.dispose();
 275:     engineRef.current = null;
 276:   }, []);
 277: 
 278:   const sortedBooks = useMemo(() => [...books].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt), [books]);
 279:   const visibleBooks = useMemo(() => {
 280:     const needle = bookSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
 281:     return sortedBooks.filter((item) => {
 282:       const matchesTab = libraryTab === "all" || libraryTab === "recent";
 283:       return matchesTab && item.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle);
 284:     });
 285:   }, [bookSearch, libraryTab, sessionIndex, sortedBooks]);

 287:   const boardSession: StudyBoardState | null = studyMode ? studyBoard : session;
 288:   const game = useMemo(() => {
 289:     if (!boardSession) return new Chess();
 290:     try {
 291:       return makePosition(boardSession.lineBaseFen, boardSession.moves, boardSession.moveIndex);
 292:     } catch {
 293:       try { return new Chess(boardSession.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 294:     }
 295:   }, [boardSession]);
 296:   const legalTargets = useMemo(() => {
 297:     if (!selectedSquare) return new Set<string>();

 299:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 300:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 301:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 302:     try { return makePosition(boardSession?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, boardSession?.moves ?? [], boardSession?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 303:     catch { return []; }
 304:   }, [boardSession]);
 305:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 306:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 307:     : null);
 308:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 309:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 310:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 311:   );

 313:   useEffect(() => {
 314:     setUserArrows([]);
 315:     setArrowStart(null);
 316:     setArrowHover(null);
 317:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 318:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 319: 
 320:   useEffect(() => {
 321:     if (engineEnabled && boardSession) {
 322:       engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 323:     }
 324:   }, [engineEnabled, boardSession?.currentFen, boardSession?.moveIndex, game, engineDepth]);

 326:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 327:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 328:   }

 330:   function toggleEngine() {
 331:     if (engineEnabled) {
 332:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 333:       engineRef.current = null;
 334:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 335:       setEngineStatus("off");
 336:       setEngineScore(null);
 337:       setEngineMessage("");
 338:       return;
 339:     }
 340:     try {
 341:       setEngineScore(null);
 342:       setEngineMessage("");
 343:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 344:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 345:         (status, message) => {
 346:           setEngineStatus(status);
 347:           if (status === "error") {
 348:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 349:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 350:             setEngineScore(null);
 351:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 352:             engineRef.current = null;
 353:           }
 354:         },
 355:         setEngineScore,
 356:       );
 357:       engineRef.current = client;
 358:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 359:     } catch (cause) {
 360:       setEngineStatus("error");
 361:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 362:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 363:     }
 364:   }

 366:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 367:     setSession((current) => {
 368:       if (!current) return current;
 369:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 370:     });
 371:   }

 373:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 374:     if (studyMode) setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 375:     else patchSession(change);
 376:   }

 378:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 379:     if (!studyMode) {
 380:       if (!session) {
 381:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 382:         return;
 383:       }
 384:       setStudyBoard({
 385:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 386:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 387:         moves: [...session.moves],
 388:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 389:         flipped: session.flipped,
 390:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 391:       });
 392:       setStudyMode(true);
 393:     } else {
 394:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 395:       if (studyBoard) {
 396:         patchSession({
 397:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 398:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 399:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 400:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 401:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 402:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 403:         });
 404:       }
 405:       setStudyMode(false);
 406:     }
 407:     setLastMove(null);
 408:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 409:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 410:   
 411:     try {
 412:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 413:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 414:       } else {
 415:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 416:       }
 417:     } catch {
 418:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 419:     }
 420: }

 422:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 423:     try {
 424:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 425:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 426:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 427:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 428:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 429:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 430:       setBook(opened);
 431:       setSession(nextSession);
 432:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 433:       setError("");
 434:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 435:     } catch (cause) {
 436:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 437:     }
 438:   }

 440:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 441:     if (!file) return;
 442:     try {
 443:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 444:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 445:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 446:       const now = Date.now();
 447:       const created: BookRecord = {
 448:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 449:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 450:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 451:         byteLength: file.size,
 452:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 453:         addedAt: now,
 454:       };
 455:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 456:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 457:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 458:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 459:       setBook(created);
 460:       setSession(blank);
 461:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 462:       setError("");
 463:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 464:     } catch (cause) {
 465:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 466:     }
 467:   }

 469:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 470:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 471: 
 472:     try {
 473:       await removeBook(item.id);
 474:       await removeSession(item.id);
 475: 
 476:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 477:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 478:         const next = { ...current };
 479:         delete next[item.id];
 480:         return next;
 481:       });
 482: 
 483:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 484:         setBook(null);
 485:         setSession(null);
 486:         setPdf(null);
 487:       }
 488: 
 489:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 490:       setError("");
 491:     } catch (cause) {
 492:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 493:     }
 494:   }
 495:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 496:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 497:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 498:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 499:     try {
 500:       await putBook(renamed);
 501:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 502:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 503:     } catch (cause) {
 504:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 505:     }
 506:   }

 509:     if (!session) return;
 510:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 511:   }

 513:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 514:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 515:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 516:   }

 518:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 519:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 520:     try {
 521:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 522:       setSession({
 523:         ...activeSession,
 524:         originalFen: fen,
 525:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 526:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 527:         moves: [],
 528:         moveIndex: 0,
 529:       });
 530:       setLastMove(null);
 531:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 532:       setUserArrows([]);
 533:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 534:       return true;
 535:     } catch (cause) {
 536:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 537:       return false;
 538:     }
 539:   }

 552:     return true;

 604:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 605:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 606:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 607:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 608:       return;
 609:     }
 610:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 611:     try {
 612:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 613:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 614:       preview.width = crop.width;
 615:       preview.height = crop.height;
 616:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 617:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 618:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 619:     } catch (cause) {
 620:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 621:       return;
 622:     }
 623:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 624:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 625:     setTransferFen("");
 626:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 627:         setRecognitionError("");
 628:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 629:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 630:     try {
 631:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 632:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 633:       });
 634:       const form = new FormData();
 635:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 636:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 637:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 638:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 639:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 640:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 641:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 642:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 643:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 644:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 645:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 646:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 647:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 648:       }
 649:     } catch (cause) {
 650:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 651:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 652:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 653:     }
 654:   }
 655: 
 656:   function closeTransfer() {
 657:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 658:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 659:     setTransferPreview("");
 660:     setTransferFen("");
 661:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 662:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 663:     setRecognitionError("");
 664:       }

 667:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 668:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 669:       setGameEndOverlay({
 670:         title: "Checkmate",
 671:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 672:       });
 673:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 674:       setGameEndOverlay({
 675:         title: "Stalemate",
 676:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 677:       });
 678:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 679:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 680:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 681:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 682:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 683:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 684:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 685:     } else {
 686:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 687:     }
 688:   }
 689: 
 690:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 691:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 692:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 693:     try {
 694:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 695:       const result = currentGame.move({
 696:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 697:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 698:         promotion: piece,
 699:       });
 700:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 701:       patchBoardSession({
 702:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 703:         moves: nextMoves,
 704:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 705:       });
 706:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 707:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 708:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 709:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 710:       setError("");
 711:     } catch {
 712:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 713:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 714:     }
 715:   }
 716: 
 717:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 718:     if (!boardSession) return;
 719:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 720:     try {
 721:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 722:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 723:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 724:       if (promote) {
 725:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 726:         return;
 727:       }
 728:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 729:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 730:       patchBoardSession({
 731:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 732:         moves: nextMoves,
 733:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 734:       });
 735:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 736:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 737:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 738:       setError("");
 739:     } catch {
 740:       const piece = game.get(to);
 741:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 742:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 743:     }
 744:   }
 745: 
 746:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 747:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 748:     setRedSquares([]);
 749: 
 750:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 751:       setUserArrows([]);
 752:       setArrowStart(null);
 753:       setArrowHover(null);
 754:       return;
 755:     }
 756: if (!boardSession) return;
 757:     if (annotationMode) {
 758:       if (!arrowStart) {
 759:         setArrowStart(square);
 760:         return;
 761:       }
 762:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 763:       setArrowStart(null);
 764:       setArrowHover(null);
 765:       return;
 766:     }
 767:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 768:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 769:       return;
 770:     }
 771:     const piece = game.get(square);
 772:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 773:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 774:   }

 776:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 777:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 778: 
 779:   event.preventDefault();
 780: 
 781:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 782:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 783:     event.clientX,
 784:     event.clientY,
 785:     bounds,
 786:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 787:   );
 788:

 792:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;

 794:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 795:   setArrowStart(square);
 796:   setArrowHover(square);
 797:

 799: }

 801:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 802:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 803:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 804:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 805:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 806:     setArrowHover(square);

 809:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 810:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 811: 
 812:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 813: 
 814:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 815:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 816:     event.clientX,
 817:     event.clientY,
 818:     bounds,
 819:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 820:   );
 821: 
 822:   if (to && to !== from) {
 823:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 824:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 825:   } else {
 826:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 827:   }
 828: 
 829:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 830:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 831:   setArrowStart(null);
 832:   setArrowHover(null);
 833: }

 885:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 886:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;

 900:       ...current,
 901:       candidatesByPage: {
 902:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 903:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 904:       },

 906:     }));

 911:   async function detectBoards() {
 912:     if (detecting) {
 913:       stopBoardScan();
 914:       return;
 915:     }
 916: 
 917:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 918:     if (!API_BASE) {
 919:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 920:       return;
 921:     }
 922: 
 923:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 924:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 925:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 926:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 927: 
 928:     setDetecting(true);
 929:     setError("");
 930:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 931:     patchSession((current) => ({
 932:       ...current,
 933:       candidatesByPage: {
 934:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 935:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 936:       },
 937:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 938:     }));
 939: 
 940:     try {
 941:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 942:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 943:           (blob) => blob
 944:             ? resolve(blob)
 945:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 946:           "image/png",
 947:         );
 948:       });
 949: 
 950:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 951: 
 952:       const form = new FormData();
 953:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 954: 
 955:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 956:         method: "POST",
 957:         body: form,
 958:         signal: abortController.signal,
 959:       });
 960: 
 961:       if (!response.ok) {
 962:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 963:       }
 964: 
 965:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 966:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 967:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 968:       );
 969: 
 970:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 971: 
 972:       patchSession((current) => ({
 973:         ...current,
 974:         candidatesByPage: {
 975:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 976:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 977:         },
 978:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 979:       }));
 980: 
 981:       setNotice(
 982:         candidates.length
 983:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 984:           : "No board candidates found.",
 985:       );
 986:     } catch (cause) {
 987:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 988: 
 989:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 990:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 991:       } else {
 992:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 993:       }
 994:     } finally {
 995:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 996:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 997:         setDetecting(false);
 998:       }
 999:     }
1000:   }
1001:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {

1003:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;

1019:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1020:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1021:     if (!manualMode) return;
1022: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1023: if (!canvas) return;
1024: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1025: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1026: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1027: if (
1028:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1029:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1030:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1031:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1032: ) return;
1033:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1034:     if (!point) return;
1035:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1036:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1037:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1038:     setDragSelection(selection);
1039:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1040:   }

1042:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1043:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1044:     if (edit) {
1045:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1046:       if (!point || !session) return;
1047:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1048:       patchSession((current) => {
1049:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1050:         return {
1051:           ...current,
1052:           candidatesByPage: {
1053:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1054:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1055:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1056:           },
1057:         };
1058:       });
1059:       return;
1060:     }
1061:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1062:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1063:     if (point) {
1064:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1065:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1066:       setDragSelection(selection);
1067:     }
1068:   }

1070:   function finishRegion() {
1071:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1072:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1073:       return;
1074:     }
1075:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1076:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1077:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1078:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1079:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1080:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1081:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1082:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1083:     setDragSelection(null);
1084:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1085:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1086:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1087:       x, y, width, height,
1088:       relativeScore: 1,
1089:       source: "manual",
1090:     };
1091:     patchSession((current) => ({
1092:       ...current,
1093:       candidatesByPage: {
1094:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1095:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1096:       },
1097:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1098:     }));
1099:     setManualMode(false);
1100:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1101:   }

1104:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1105:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1106:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1107:     setDragSelection(null);

1110:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1111:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1112:     try {
1113:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1114:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1115:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1116:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1117:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1118:       const scale = mode === "width"
1119:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1120:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1121:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1122:     } catch (cause) {
1123:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1124:     }
1125:   }

 491:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 492:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 493:   }

 495:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 496:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 497:     try {
 498:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 499:       setSession({
 500:         ...activeSession,
 501:         originalFen: fen,
 502:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 503:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 504:         moves: [],
 505:         moveIndex: 0,
 506:       });
 507:       setLastMove(null);
 508:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 509:       setUserArrows([]);
 510:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 511:       return true;
 512:     } catch (cause) {
 513:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 514:       return false;
 515:     }
 516:   }
 517: 
 518:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 519:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 520:     if (!loaded) return false;
 521:     setEngineScore(null);
 522:     setEngineMessage("");
 523:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 524:       toggleEngine();
 525:     } else {
 526:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 527:     }
 528:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 529:     return true;
 530:   }

 537:     setNotice("Region selected. The current chess position is unchanged; use Adjust Crop or Use on Board to continue.");

 546:     const baseline = cropBaselineRef.current;

 551:         ...current,

 564:       patchSession((current) => {

 566:         return {
 567:           ...current,
 568:           candidatesByPage: {
 569:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 570:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 571:               candidate.id === baseline.id ? baseline : candidate),
 572:           },

 581:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 582:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 583:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 584:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 585:       return;
 586:     }
 587:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 588:     try {
 589:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 590:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 591:       preview.width = crop.width;
 592:       preview.height = crop.height;
 593:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 594:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 595:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 596:     } catch (cause) {
 597:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 598:       return;
 599:     }
 600:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 601:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 602:     setTransferFen("");
 603:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 604:         setRecognitionError("");
 605:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 606:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 607:     try {
 608:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 609:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 610:       });
 611:       const form = new FormData();
 612:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 613:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 614:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 615:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 616:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 617:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 618:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 619:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 620:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 621:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 622:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 623:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 624:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 625:       }
 626:     } catch (cause) {
 627:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 628:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 629:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 630:     }
 631:   }
 632: 
 633:   function closeTransfer() {
 634:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 635:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 636:     setTransferPreview("");
 637:     setTransferFen("");
 638:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 639:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 640:     setRecognitionError("");
 641:       }

 644:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 645:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 646:       setGameEndOverlay({
 647:         title: "Checkmate",
 648:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 649:       });
 650:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 651:       setGameEndOverlay({
 652:         title: "Stalemate",
 653:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 654:       });
 655:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 656:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 657:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 658:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 659:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 660:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 661:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 662:     } else {
 663:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 664:     }
 665:   }

 667:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 668:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 669:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 670:     try {
 671:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 672:       const result = currentGame.move({
 673:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 674:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 675:         promotion: piece,
 676:       });
 677:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 678:       patchBoardSession({
 679:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 680:         moves: nextMoves,
 681:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 682:       });
 683:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 684:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 685:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 686:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 687:       setError("");
 688:     } catch {
 689:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 690:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 691:     }
 692:   }
 693: 
 694:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 695:     if (!boardSession) return;
 696:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 697:     try {
 698:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 699:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 700:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 701:       if (promote) {
 702:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 703:         return;
 704:       }
 705:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 706:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 707:       patchBoardSession({
 708:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 709:         moves: nextMoves,
 710:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 711:       });
 712:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 713:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 714:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 715:       setError("");
 716:     } catch {
 717:       const piece = game.get(to);
 718:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 719:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 720:     }
 721:   }
 722: 
 723:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 724:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 725:     setRedSquares([]);
 726: 
 727:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 728:       setUserArrows([]);
 729:       setArrowStart(null);
 730:       setArrowHover(null);
 731:       return;
 732:     }
 733: if (!boardSession) return;
 734:     if (annotationMode) {
 735:       if (!arrowStart) {
 736:         setArrowStart(square);
 737:         return;
 738:       }
 739:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 740:       setArrowStart(null);
 741:       setArrowHover(null);
 742:       return;
 743:     }
 744:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 745:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 746:       return;
 747:     }
 748:     const piece = game.get(square);
 749:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 750:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 751:   }

 753:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 754:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 755: 
 756:   event.preventDefault();
 757: 
 758:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 759:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 760:     event.clientX,
 761:     event.clientY,
 762:     bounds,
 763:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 764:   );
 765: 
 766:   if (!square) return;
 767: 
 768:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 769:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 770:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 771:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 772:   setArrowStart(square);
 773:   setArrowHover(square);
 774: 
 775:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 776: }

 778:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 779:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 780:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 781:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 782:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 783:     setArrowHover(square);
 784:   }

 786:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 787:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 788: 
 789:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 790: 
 791:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 792:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 793:     event.clientX,
 794:     event.clientY,
 795:     bounds,
 796:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 797:   );
 798: 
 799:   if (to && to !== from) {
 800:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 801:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 802:   } else {
 803:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 804:   }
 805: 
 806:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 807:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 808:   setArrowStart(null);
 809:   setArrowHover(null);
 810: }

 862:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 863:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 864: 
 865:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 866:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 867:     controller?.abort();

 870:     setManualMode(false);
 871:     setDragSelection(null);
 872:     setCropEditingId(null);
 873:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 874:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 875: 
 876:     patchSession((current) => ({
 877:       ...current,
 878:       candidatesByPage: {
 879:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 880:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 881:       },
 882:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 883:     }));
 884: 
 885:     setError("");
