 888:   async function detectBoards() {
 889:     if (detecting) {
 890:       stopBoardScan();
 891:       return;
 892:     }
 893: 
 894:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 895:     if (!API_BASE) {
 896:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 897:       return;
 898:     }
 899: 
 900:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 901:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 902:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 903:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 904: 
 905:     setDetecting(true);
 906:     setError("");
 907:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 908:     patchSession((current) => ({
 909:       ...current,
 910:       candidatesByPage: {
 911:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 912:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 913:       },
 914:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 915:     }));
 916: 
 917:     try {
 918:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 919:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 920:           (blob) => blob
 921:             ? resolve(blob)
 922:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 923:           "image/png",
 924:         );
 925:       });
 926: 
 927:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 928: 
 929:       const form = new FormData();
 930:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 931: 
 932:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 933:         method: "POST",
 934:         body: form,
 935:         signal: abortController.signal,
 936:       });
 937: 
 938:       if (!response.ok) {
 939:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 940:       }
 941: 
 942:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 943:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 944:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 945:       );
 946: 
 947:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 948: 
 949:       patchSession((current) => ({
 950:         ...current,
 951:         candidatesByPage: {
 952:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 953:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 954:         },
 955:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 956:       }));
 957: 
 958:       setNotice(
 959:         candidates.length
 960:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 961:           : "No board candidates found.",
 962:       );
 963:     } catch (cause) {
 964:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 965: 
 966:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 967:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 968:       } else {
 969:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 970:       }
 971:     } finally {
 972:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 973:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 974:         setDetecting(false);
 975:       }
 976:     }
 977:   }
 978:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {

 980:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 981:   }

 983:   function startCropEdit(
 984:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 985:     candidate: Candidate,
 986:     handle: CropHandle,
 987:   ) {
 988:     event.stopPropagation();
 989:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 990:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
 991:     if (!point || !stage) return;
 992:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
 993:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 994:   }

 996:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 997:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 998:     if (!manualMode) return;
 999: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1000: if (!canvas) return;
1001: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1002: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1003: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1004: if (
1005:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1006:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1007:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1008:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1009: ) return;
1010:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1011:     if (!point) return;
1012:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1013:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1014:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1015:     setDragSelection(selection);
1016:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1017:   }
1018: 
1019:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1020:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1021:     if (edit) {
1022:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1023:       if (!point || !session) return;
1024:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1025:       patchSession((current) => {
1026:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1027:         return {
1028:           ...current,
1029:           candidatesByPage: {
1030:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1031:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1032:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1033:           },
1034:         };
1035:       });
1036:       return;
1037:     }
1038:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1039:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1040:     if (point) {
1041:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1042:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1043:       setDragSelection(selection);
1044:     }
1045:   }
1046: 
1047:   function finishRegion() {
1048:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1049:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1050:       return;
1051:     }
1052:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1053:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1054:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1055:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1056:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1057:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1058:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1059:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1060:     setDragSelection(null);
1061:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1062:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1063:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1064:       x, y, width, height,
1065:       relativeScore: 1,
1066:       source: "manual",
1067:     };
1068:     patchSession((current) => ({
1069:       ...current,
1070:       candidatesByPage: {
1071:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1072:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1073:       },
1074:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1075:     }));
1076:     setManualMode(false);
1077:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1078:   }
1079: 
1080:   function cancelRegion() {
1081:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1082:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1083:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1084:     setDragSelection(null);
1085:   }

1087:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1088:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1089:     try {
1090:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1091:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1092:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1093:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1094:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1095:       const scale = mode === "width"
1096:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1097:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;

 256:             ...current,
 257:             candidatesByPage: {
 258:               ...current.candidatesByPage,
 259:               [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((item) =>
 260:                 item.id === candidate.id ? { ...item, ...next } : item),
 261:             },
 262:           };
 263:         });
 264:         event.preventDefault();
 265:         return;
 266:       }
 267:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 268:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 269:     }
 270:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 271:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 272:   });
 273: 
 274:   useEffect(() => () => {
 275:     engineRef.current?.dispose();
 276:     engineRef.current = null;
 277:   }, []);
 278: 
 279:   const sortedBooks = useMemo(() => [...books].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt), [books]);
 280:   const visibleBooks = useMemo(() => {
 281:     const needle = bookSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
 282:     return sortedBooks.filter((item) => {
 283:       const matchesTab = libraryTab === "all" || libraryTab === "recent";
 284:       return matchesTab && item.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle);
 285:     });
 286:   }, [bookSearch, libraryTab, sessionIndex, sortedBooks]);

 288:   const boardSession: StudyBoardState | null = studyMode ? studyBoard : session;
 289:   const game = useMemo(() => {
 290:     if (!boardSession) return new Chess();
 291:     try {
 292:       return makePosition(boardSession.lineBaseFen, boardSession.moves, boardSession.moveIndex);
 293:     } catch {
 294:       try { return new Chess(boardSession.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 295:     }
 296:   }, [boardSession]);
 297:   const legalTargets = useMemo(() => {
 298:     if (!selectedSquare) return new Set<string>();
 299:     return new Set(game.moves({ square: selectedSquare, verbose: true }).map((move) => move.to));
 300:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 301:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 302:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 303:     try { return makePosition(boardSession?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, boardSession?.moves ?? [], boardSession?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 304:     catch { return []; }
 305:   }, [boardSession]);
 306:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 307:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 308:     : null);
 309:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 310:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 311:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 312:   );

 314:   useEffect(() => {
 315:     setUserArrows([]);
 316:     setArrowStart(null);
 317:     setArrowHover(null);
 318:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 319:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);

 322:     if (engineEnabled) engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 323:   }, [engineEnabled, session?.currentFen, session?.moveIndex, engineDepth]);

 325:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 326:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 327:   }

 329:   function toggleEngine() {
 330:     if (engineEnabled) {
 331:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 332:       engineRef.current = null;
 333:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 334:       setEngineStatus("off");
 335:       setEngineScore(null);
 336:       setEngineMessage("");
 337:       return;
 338:     }
 339:     try {
 340:       setEngineScore(null);
 341:       setEngineMessage("");
 342:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 343:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 344:         (status, message) => {
 345:           setEngineStatus(status);
 346:           if (status === "error") {
 347:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 348:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 349:             setEngineScore(null);
 350:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 351:             engineRef.current = null;
 352:           }
 353:         },
 354:         setEngineScore,
 355:       );
 356:       engineRef.current = client;
 357:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 358:     } catch (cause) {
 359:       setEngineStatus("error");
 360:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 361:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 362:     }
 363:   }

 366:     setSession((current) => {
 367:       if (!current) return current;
 368:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 369:     });
 370:   }

 374:     else patchSession(change);

 400:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 401:     try {
 402:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 403:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 404:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 405:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 406:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 407:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 408:       setBook(opened);
 409:       setSession(nextSession);
 410:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 411:       setError("");
 412:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 413:     } catch (cause) {
 414:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 415:     }
 416:   }

 418:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 419:     if (!file) return;
 420:     try {
 421:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 422:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 423:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 424:       const now = Date.now();
 425:       const created: BookRecord = {
 426:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 427:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 428:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 429:         byteLength: file.size,
 430:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 431:         addedAt: now,
 432:       };
 433:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 434:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 435:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 436:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 437:       setBook(created);
 438:       setSession(blank);
 439:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 440:       setError("");
 441:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 442:     } catch (cause) {
 443:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 444:     }
 445:   }

 447:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 448:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 449: 
 450:     try {
 451:       await removeBook(item.id);
 452:       await removeSession(item.id);
 453: 
 454:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 455:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 456:         const next = { ...current };
 457:         delete next[item.id];
 458:         return next;
 459:       });
 460: 
 461:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 462:         setBook(null);
 463:         setSession(null);
 464:         setPdf(null);
 465:       }
 466: 
 467:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 468:       setError("");
 469:     } catch (cause) {
 470:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 471:     }
 472:   }
 473:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 474:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 475:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 476:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 477:     try {
 478:       await putBook(renamed);
 479:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 480:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 481:     } catch (cause) {
 482:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 483:     }
 484:   }

 487:     if (!session) return;
 488:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 489:   }

 493:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });

 496:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 497:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 498:     try {
 499:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 500:       setSession({
 501:         ...activeSession,
 502:         originalFen: fen,
 503:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 504:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 505:         moves: [],
 506:         moveIndex: 0,
 507:       });
 508:       setLastMove(null);
 509:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 510:       setUserArrows([]);
 511:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 512:       return true;
 513:     } catch (cause) {
 514:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 515:       return false;
 516:     }
 517:   }

 529:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 530:     return true;

 582:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 583:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 584:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 585:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 586:       return;
 587:     }
 588:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 589:     try {
 590:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 591:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 592:       preview.width = crop.width;
 593:       preview.height = crop.height;
 594:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 595:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 596:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 597:     } catch (cause) {
 598:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 599:       return;
 600:     }
 601:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 602:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 603:     setTransferFen("");
 604:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 605:         setRecognitionError("");
 606:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 607:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 608:     try {
 609:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 610:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 611:       });
 612:       const form = new FormData();
 613:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 614:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 615:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 616:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 617:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 618:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 619:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 620:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 621:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 622:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 623:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 624:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 625:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 626:       }
 627:     } catch (cause) {
 628:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 629:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 630:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 631:     }
 632:   }

 634:   function closeTransfer() {
 635:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 636:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 637:     setTransferPreview("");
 638:     setTransferFen("");
 639:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 640:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 641:     setRecognitionError("");
 642:       }

 645:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 646:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 647:       setGameEndOverlay({
 648:         title: "Checkmate",
 649:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 650:       });
 651:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 652:       setGameEndOverlay({
 653:         title: "Stalemate",
 654:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 655:       });
 656:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 657:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 658:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 659:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 660:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 661:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 662:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 663:     } else {
 664:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 665:     }
 666:   }

 668:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 669:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 670:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 671:     try {
 672:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 673:       const result = currentGame.move({
 674:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 675:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 676:         promotion: piece,
 677:       });
 678:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 679:       patchBoardSession({
 680:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 681:         moves: nextMoves,
 682:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 683:       });
 684:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 685:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 686:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 687:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 688:       setError("");
 689:     } catch {
 690:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 691:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 692:     }
 693:   }
 694: 
 695:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 696:     if (!boardSession) return;
 697:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 698:     try {
 699:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 700:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 701:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 702:       if (promote) {
 703:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 704:         return;
 705:       }
 706:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 707:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 708:       patchBoardSession({
 709:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 710:         moves: nextMoves,
 711:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 712:       });
 713:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 714:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 715:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 716:       setError("");
 717:     } catch {
 718:       const piece = game.get(to);
 719:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 720:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 721:     }
 722:   }

 724:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 725:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 726:     setRedSquares([]);
 727: 
 728:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 729:       setUserArrows([]);
 730:       setArrowStart(null);
 731:       setArrowHover(null);
 732:       return;
 733:     }
 734: if (!boardSession) return;
 735:     if (annotationMode) {
 736:       if (!arrowStart) {
 737:         setArrowStart(square);
 738:         return;
 739:       }
 740:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 741:       setArrowStart(null);
 742:       setArrowHover(null);
 743:       return;
 744:     }
 745:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 746:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 747:       return;
 748:     }
 749:     const piece = game.get(square);
 750:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 751:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 752:   }

 754:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 755:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 756: 
 757:   event.preventDefault();
 758: 
 759:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 760:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 761:     event.clientX,
 762:     event.clientY,
 763:     bounds,
 764:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 765:   );
 766: 
 767:   if (!square) return;
 768: 
 769:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 770:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 771:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 772:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 773:   setArrowStart(square);
 774:   setArrowHover(square);
 775: 
 776:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 777: }
 778: 
 779:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 780:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 781:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 782:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 783:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 784:     setArrowHover(square);
 785:   }
 786: 
 787:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 788:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 789: 
 790:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 791: 
 792:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 793:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 794:     event.clientX,
 795:     event.clientY,
 796:     bounds,
 797:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 798:   );
 799: 
 800:   if (to && to !== from) {
 801:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 802:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 803:   } else {
 804:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 805:   }
 806: 
 807:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 808:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 809:   setArrowStart(null);
 810:   setArrowHover(null);
 811: }

 813:   function cancelBoardArrowGesture() {
 814:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 815:     setArrowStart(null);
 816:     setArrowHover(null);
 817:   }

 825:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
 826:       setSelectedSquare(null);

 862:   function clearBoardScan() {
 863:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 864:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 865: 
 866:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 867:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 868:     controller?.abort();
 869: 
 870:     setDetecting(false);
 871:     setManualMode(false);
 872:     setDragSelection(null);
 873:     setCropEditingId(null);
 874:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 875:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 876: 
 877:     patchSession((current) => ({
 878:       ...current,
 879:       candidatesByPage: {
 880:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 881:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 882:       },
 883:       selectedDiagramId: null,

 888:   }
 889:   async function detectBoards() {
 890:     if (detecting) {
 891:       stopBoardScan();
 892:       return;
 893:     }
 894: 
 895:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 896:     if (!API_BASE) {
 897:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 898:       return;
 899:     }
 900: 
 901:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 902:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 903:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 904:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 905: 
 906:     setDetecting(true);
 907:     setError("");
 908:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 909:     patchSession((current) => ({
 910:       ...current,
 911:       candidatesByPage: {
 912:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 913:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 914:       },
 915:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 916:     }));
 917: 
 918:     try {
 919:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 920:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 921:           (blob) => blob
 922:             ? resolve(blob)
 923:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 924:           "image/png",
 925:         );
 926:       });
 927: 
 928:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 929: 
 930:       const form = new FormData();
 931:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 932: 
 933:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 934:         method: "POST",
 935:         body: form,
 936:         signal: abortController.signal,
 937:       });
 938: 
 939:       if (!response.ok) {
 940:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 941:       }
 942: 
 943:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 944:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 945:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 946:       );
 947: 
 948:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 949: 
 950:       patchSession((current) => ({
 951:         ...current,
 952:         candidatesByPage: {
 953:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 954:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 955:         },
 956:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 957:       }));
 958: 
 959:       setNotice(
 960:         candidates.length
 961:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 962:           : "No board candidates found.",
 963:       );
 964:     } catch (cause) {
 965:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 966: 
 967:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 968:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 969:       } else {
 970:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 971:       }
 972:     } finally {
 973:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 974:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 975:         setDetecting(false);
 976:       }
 977:     }
 978:   }
 979:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {

 981:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;

 984:   function startCropEdit(
 985:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 986:     candidate: Candidate,
 987:     handle: CropHandle,
 988:   ) {
 989:     event.stopPropagation();

 991:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
 992:     if (!point || !stage) return;

 997:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 998:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 999:     if (!manualMode) return;
1000: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1001: if (!canvas) return;
1002: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1003: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1004: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1005: if (
1006:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1007:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1008:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1009:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1010: ) return;
1011:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1012:     if (!point) return;
1013:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1014:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1015:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1016:     setDragSelection(selection);
1017:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1018:   }

1020:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1021:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1022:     if (edit) {
1023:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1024:       if (!point || !session) return;
1025:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1026:       patchSession((current) => {
1027:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1028:         return {
1029:           ...current,
1030:           candidatesByPage: {
1031:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1032:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1033:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1034:           },
1035:         };
1036:       });
1037:       return;
1038:     }
1039:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1040:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1041:     if (point) {
1042:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1043:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1044:       setDragSelection(selection);
1045:     }
1046:   }

1048:   function finishRegion() {
1049:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1050:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1051:       return;
1052:     }
1053:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1054:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1055:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1056:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1057:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1058:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1059:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1060:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1061:     setDragSelection(null);
1062:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1063:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1064:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1065:       x, y, width, height,
1066:       relativeScore: 1,
1067:       source: "manual",
1068:     };
1069:     patchSession((current) => ({
1070:       ...current,
1071:       candidatesByPage: {
1072:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1073:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1074:       },
1075:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1076:     }));
1077:     setManualMode(false);
1078:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1079:   }

1083:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1084:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1085:     setDragSelection(null);

1088:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1089:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1090:     try {
1091:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1092:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1093:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1094:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1095:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1096:       const scale = mode === "width"
1097:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1098:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1099:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1100:     } catch (cause) {
1101:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1102:     }
1103:   }

 321:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {

 325:   function toggleEngine() {
 326:     if (engineEnabled) {
 327:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 328:       engineRef.current = null;
 329:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 330:       setEngineStatus("off");
 331:       setEngineScore(null);
 332:       setEngineMessage("");
 333:       return;
 334:     }
 335:     try {
 336:       setEngineScore(null);
 337:       setEngineMessage("");
 338:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 339:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 340:         (status, message) => {
 341:           setEngineStatus(status);
 342:           if (status === "error") {
 343:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 344:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 345:             setEngineScore(null);
 346:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 347:             engineRef.current = null;
 348:           }
 349:         },
 350:         setEngineScore,
 351:       );
 352:       engineRef.current = client;
 353:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 354:     } catch (cause) {
 355:       setEngineStatus("error");
 356:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 357:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 358:     }
 359:   }

 361:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 362:     setSession((current) => {
 363:       if (!current) return current;
 364:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 365:     });
 366:   }

 368:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 369:     try {
 370:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 371:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 372:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 373:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 374:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 375:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 376:       setBook(opened);
 377:       setSession(nextSession);
 378:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 379:       setError("");
 380:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 381:     } catch (cause) {
 382:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 383:     }
 384:   }

 386:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 387:     if (!file) return;
 388:     try {
 389:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 390:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 391:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 392:       const now = Date.now();
 393:       const created: BookRecord = {
 394:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 395:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 396:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 397:         byteLength: file.size,
 398:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 399:         addedAt: now,
 400:       };
 401:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 402:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 403:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 404:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 405:       setBook(created);
 406:       setSession(blank);
 407:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 408:       setError("");
 409:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 410:     } catch (cause) {
 411:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 412:     }
 413:   }

 415:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 416:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 417: 
 418:     try {
 419:       await removeBook(item.id);
 420:       await removeSession(item.id);
 421: 
 422:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 423:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 424:         const next = { ...current };
 425:         delete next[item.id];
 426:         return next;
 427:       });
 428: 
 429:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 430:         setBook(null);
 431:         setSession(null);
 432:         setPdf(null);
 433:       }
 434: 
 435:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 436:       setError("");
 437:     } catch (cause) {
 438:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 439:     }
 440:   }
 441:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 442:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 443:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 444:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 445:     try {
 446:       await putBook(renamed);
 447:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 448:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 449:     } catch (cause) {
 450:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 451:     }
 452:   }

 464:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 465:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 466:     try {
 467:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 468:       setSession({
 469:         ...activeSession,
 470:         originalFen: fen,
 471:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 472:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 473:         moves: [],
 474:         moveIndex: 0,
 475:       });
 476:       setLastMove(null);
 477:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 478:       setUserArrows([]);
 479:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 480:       return true;
 481:     } catch (cause) {
 482:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 483:       return false;
 484:     }
 485:   }

 497:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");

 550:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 551:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 552:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 553:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 554:       return;
 555:     }
 556:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 557:     try {
 558:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 559:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 560:       preview.width = crop.width;
 561:       preview.height = crop.height;
 562:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 563:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 564:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 565:     } catch (cause) {
 566:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 567:       return;
 568:     }
 569:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 570:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 571:     setTransferFen("");
 572:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 573:         setRecognitionError("");
 574:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 575:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 576:     try {
 577:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 578:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 579:       });
 580:       const form = new FormData();
 581:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 582:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 583:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 584:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 585:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 586:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 587:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 588:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 589:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 590:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 591:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 592:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 593:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 594:       }
 595:     } catch (cause) {
 596:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 597:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 598:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 599:     }
 600:   }
 601: 
 602:   function closeTransfer() {
 603:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 604:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 605:     setTransferPreview("");
 606:     setTransferFen("");
 607:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 608:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 609:     setRecognitionError("");
 610:       }

 613:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 614:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 615:       setGameEndOverlay({
 616:         title: "Checkmate",
 617:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 618:       });
 619:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 620:       setGameEndOverlay({
 621:         title: "Stalemate",
 622:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 623:       });
 624:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 625:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 626:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 627:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 629:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 630:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 631:     } else {
 632:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 633:     }
 634:   }
 635: 
 636:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 637:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 638:     try {
 639:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 640:       const result = currentGame.move({
 641:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 642:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 643:         promotion: piece,
 644:       });
 645:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 646:       patchSession({
 647:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 648:         moves: nextMoves,
 649:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 650:       });
 651:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 652:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 653:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 654:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 655:       setError("");
 656:     } catch {
 657:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 658:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 659:     }
 660:   }
 661: 
 662:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 663:     if (!session) return;
 664:     try {
 665:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 666:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 667:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 668:       if (promote) {
 669:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 670:         return;
 671:       }
 672:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 673:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 674:       patchSession({
 675:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 676:         moves: nextMoves,
 677:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 678:       });
 679:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 680:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 681:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 682:       setError("");
 683:     } catch {
 684:       const piece = game.get(to);
 685:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 686:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 687:     }
 688:   }

 690:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 691:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 692:     setRedSquares([]);
 693: 
 694:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 695:       setUserArrows([]);
 696:       setArrowStart(null);
 697:       setArrowHover(null);
 698:       return;
 699:     }
 700: if (!session) return;
 701:     if (annotationMode) {
 702:       if (!arrowStart) {
 703:         setArrowStart(square);
 704:         return;
 705:       }
 706:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 707:       setArrowStart(null);
 708:       setArrowHover(null);
 709:       return;
 710:     }
 711:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 712:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 713:       return;
 714:     }
 715:     const piece = game.get(square);
 716:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 717:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 718:   }

 855:   async function detectBoards() {
 856:     if (detecting) {
 857:       stopBoardScan();
 858:       return;
 859:     }
 860: 
 861:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 862:     if (!API_BASE) {
 863:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 864:       return;
 865:     }
 866: 
 867:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 868:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 869:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 870:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 871: 
 872:     setDetecting(true);
 873:     setError("");
 874:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 875:     patchSession((current) => ({
 876:       ...current,
 877:       candidatesByPage: {
 878:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 879:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 880:       },
 881:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 882:     }));
 883: 
 884:     try {
 885:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 886:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 887:           (blob) => blob
 888:             ? resolve(blob)
 889:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 890:           "image/png",
 891:         );
 892:       });
 893: 
 894:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 895: 
 896:       const form = new FormData();
 897:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 898: 
 899:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 900:         method: "POST",
 901:         body: form,
 902:         signal: abortController.signal,
 903:       });
 904: 
 905:       if (!response.ok) {
 906:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 907:       }
 908: 
 909:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 910:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 911:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 912:       );
 913: 
 914:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 915: 
 916:       patchSession((current) => ({
 917:         ...current,
 918:         candidatesByPage: {
 919:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 920:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 921:         },
 922:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 923:       }));
 924: 
 925:       setNotice(
 926:         candidates.length
 927:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 928:           : "No board candidates found.",
 929:       );
 930:     } catch (cause) {
 931:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 932: 
 933:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 934:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 935:       } else {
 936:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 937:       }
 938:     } finally {
 939:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 940:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 941:         setDetecting(false);
 942:       }
 943:     }
 944:   }

 963:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 964:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;

 970: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 971: if (
 972:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 973:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 974:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 975:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom

 986:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 987:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 988:     if (edit) {
 989:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 990:       if (!point || !session) return;
 991:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 992:       patchSession((current) => {

 995:           ...current,
 996:           candidatesByPage: {
 997:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 998:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 999:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1000:           },
1001:         };
1002:       });
1003:       return;
1004:     }
1005:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1006:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1007:     if (point) {
1008:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };

1010:       setDragSelection(selection);

1014:   function finishRegion() {
1015:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1016:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1017:       return;
1018:     }
1019:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1020:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1021:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1022:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1023:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1024:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1025:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1026:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1027:     setDragSelection(null);
1028:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1029:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1030:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1031:       x, y, width, height,
1032:       relativeScore: 1,
1033:       source: "manual",
1034:     };
1035:     patchSession((current) => ({
1036:       ...current,
1037:       candidatesByPage: {
1038:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1039:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1040:       },
1041:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1042:     }));
1043:     setManualMode(false);
1044:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1045:   }

1054:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1055:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1056:     try {
1057:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1058:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1059:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1060:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1061:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1062:       const scale = mode === "width"
1063:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1064:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1065:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1066:     } catch (cause) {
1067:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1068:     }
1069:   }

 425:         const next = { ...current };
 426:         delete next[item.id];
 427:         return next;
 428:       });
 429: 
 430:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 431:         setBook(null);
 432:         setSession(null);
 433:         setPdf(null);
 434:       }
 435: 
 436:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 437:       setError("");
 438:     } catch (cause) {
 439:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 440:     }
 441:   }
 442:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 443:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 444:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 445:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 446:     try {
 447:       await putBook(renamed);
 448:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 449:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 450:     } catch (cause) {
 451:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 452:     }
 453:   }

 455:   function changePage(delta: number) {
 456:     if (!session) return;
 457:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 458:   }

 460:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 461:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 462:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 463:   }

 465:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 466:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 467:     try {
 468:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 469:       setSession({
 470:         ...activeSession,
 471:         originalFen: fen,
 472:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 473:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 474:         moves: [],
 475:         moveIndex: 0,
 476:       });
 477:       setLastMove(null);
 478:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 479:       setUserArrows([]);
 480:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 481:       return true;
 482:     } catch (cause) {
 483:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 484:       return false;
 485:     }
 486:   }

 494:       toggleEngine();
 495:     } else {
 496:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 497:     }
 498:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 499:     return true;
 500:   }

 551:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 552:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 553:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 554:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 555:       return;
 556:     }
 557:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 558:     try {
 559:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 560:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 561:       preview.width = crop.width;
 562:       preview.height = crop.height;
 563:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 564:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 565:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 566:     } catch (cause) {
 567:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 568:       return;
 569:     }
 570:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 571:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 572:     setTransferFen("");
 573:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 574:         setRecognitionError("");
 575:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 576:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 577:     try {
 578:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 579:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 580:       });
 581:       const form = new FormData();
 582:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 583:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 584:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 585:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 586:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 587:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 588:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 589:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 590:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 591:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 592:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 593:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 594:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 595:       }
 596:     } catch (cause) {
 597:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 598:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 599:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 600:     }
 601:   }
 602: 
 603:   function closeTransfer() {
 604:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 605:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 606:     setTransferPreview("");
 607:     setTransferFen("");
 608:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 609:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 610:     setRecognitionError("");
 611:       }

 614:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 615:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 616:       setGameEndOverlay({
 617:         title: "Checkmate",
 618:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 619:       });
 620:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 621:       setGameEndOverlay({
 622:         title: "Stalemate",
 623:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 624:       });
 625:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 626:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 627:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 629:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 630:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 631:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 632:     } else {
 633:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 634:     }
 635:   }
 636: 
 637:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 638:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 639:     try {
 640:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 641:       const result = currentGame.move({
 642:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 643:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 644:         promotion: piece,
 645:       });
 646:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 647:       patchSession({
 648:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 649:         moves: nextMoves,
 650:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 651:       });
 652:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 653:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 654:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 655:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 656:       setError("");
 657:     } catch {
 658:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 659:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 660:     }
 661:   }
 662: 
 663:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 664:     if (!session) return;
 665:     try {
 666:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 667:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 668:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 669:       if (promote) {
 670:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 671:         return;
 672:       }
 673:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 674:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 675:       patchSession({
 676:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 677:         moves: nextMoves,
 678:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 679:       });
 680:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 681:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 682:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 683:       setError("");
 684:     } catch {
 685:       const piece = game.get(to);
 686:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 687:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 688:     }
 689:   }
 690: 
 691:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 692:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 693:     setRedSquares([]);
 694:     
 695:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 696:       setUserArrows([]);
 697:       setArrowStart(null);
 698:       setArrowHover(null);
 699:       return;
 700:     }
 701: if (!session) return;
 702:     if (annotationMode) {
 703:       if (!arrowStart) {
 704:         setArrowStart(square);
 705:         return;
 706:       }
 707:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 708:       setArrowStart(null);
 709:       setArrowHover(null);
 710:       return;
 711:     }
 712:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 713:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 714:       return;
 715:     }
 716:     const piece = game.get(square);
 717:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 718:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 719:   }

 721:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 722:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 723: 
 724:   event.preventDefault();
 725: 
 726:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 727:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 728:     event.clientX,
 729:     event.clientY,
 730:     bounds,
 731:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 732:   );
 733: 
 734:   if (!square) return;
 735: 
 736:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 737:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 738:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 739:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 740:   setArrowStart(square);
 741:   setArrowHover(square);
 742: 
 743:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 744: }

 746:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 747:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 748:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 749:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 750:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 751:     setArrowHover(square);
 752:   }

 754:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 755:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 756: 
 757:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 758: 
 759:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 760:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 761:     event.clientX,
 762:     event.clientY,
 763:     bounds,
 764:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 765:   );
 766: 
 767:   if (to && to !== from) {
 768:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 769:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 770:   } else {
 771:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 772:   }
 773: 
 774:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 775:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 776:   setArrowStart(null);
 777:   setArrowHover(null);
 778: }

 829:   function clearBoardScan() {
 830:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 831:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 832: 
 833:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 834:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 835:     controller?.abort();

 838:     setManualMode(false);
 839:     setDragSelection(null);
 840:     setCropEditingId(null);
 841:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 842:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 843: 
 844:     patchSession((current) => ({
 845:       ...current,
 846:       candidatesByPage: {
 847:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 848:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 849:       },
 850:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 851:     }));
 852: 
 853:     setError("");
 854:     setNotice("Board detection cleared.");

 856:   async function detectBoards() {
 857:     if (detecting) {
 858:       stopBoardScan();
 859:       return;
 860:     }
 861: 
 862:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 863:     if (!API_BASE) {
 864:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 865:       return;
 866:     }
 867: 
 868:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 869:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 870:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 871:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 872: 
 873:     setDetecting(true);
 874:     setError("");
 875:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 876:     patchSession((current) => ({
 877:       ...current,
 878:       candidatesByPage: {
 879:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 880:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 881:       },
 882:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 883:     }));
 884: 
 885:     try {
 886:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 887:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 888:           (blob) => blob
 889:             ? resolve(blob)
 890:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 891:           "image/png",
 892:         );
 893:       });
 894: 
 895:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 896: 
 897:       const form = new FormData();
 898:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 899: 
 900:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 901:         method: "POST",
 902:         body: form,
 903:         signal: abortController.signal,
 904:       });
 905: 
 906:       if (!response.ok) {
 907:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 908:       }
 909: 
 910:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 911:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 912:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 913:       );
 914: 
 915:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 916: 
 917:       patchSession((current) => ({
 918:         ...current,
 919:         candidatesByPage: {
 920:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 921:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 922:         },
 923:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 924:       }));
 925: 
 926:       setNotice(
 927:         candidates.length
 928:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 929:           : "No board candidates found.",
 930:       );
 931:     } catch (cause) {
 932:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 933: 
 934:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 935:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 936:       } else {
 937:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 938:       }
 939:     } finally {
 940:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 941:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 942:         setDetecting(false);
 943:       }
 944:     }
 945:   }
 946:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {

 948:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 949:   }

 951:   function startCropEdit(
 952:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 953:     candidate: Candidate,
 954:     handle: CropHandle,
 955:   ) {
 956:     event.stopPropagation();
 957:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 958:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
 959:     if (!point || !stage) return;
 960:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
 961:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);

 964:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 965:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 966:     if (!manualMode) return;
 967: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 968: if (!canvas) return;
 969: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 970: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 971: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 972: if (
 973:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 974:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 975:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 976:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 977: ) return;
 978:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 979:     if (!point) return;
 980:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 981:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 982:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 983:     setDragSelection(selection);
 984:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 985:   }
 986: 
 987:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 988:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 989:     if (edit) {
 990:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 991:       if (!point || !session) return;
 992:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 993:       patchSession((current) => {
 994:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 995:         return {
 996:           ...current,
 997:           candidatesByPage: {
 998:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 999:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1000:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1001:           },
1002:         };
1003:       });
1004:       return;
1005:     }
1006:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1007:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1008:     if (point) {
1009:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1010:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1011:       setDragSelection(selection);
1012:     }
1013:   }
1014: 
1015:   function finishRegion() {
1016:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1017:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1018:       return;
1019:     }
1020:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1021:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1022:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1023:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1024:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1025:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1026:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1027:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1028:     setDragSelection(null);
1029:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1030:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1031:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1032:       x, y, width, height,
1033:       relativeScore: 1,
1034:       source: "manual",
1035:     };
1036:     patchSession((current) => ({
1037:       ...current,
1038:       candidatesByPage: {
1039:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1040:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1041:       },
1042:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
