 249:         const x = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
 250:         const y = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
 251:         const next = editCrop(candidate, "move", x, y);
 252:         patchSession((current) => {
 253:           const pageKey = String(current.page);
 254:           return {
 255:             ...current,
 256:             candidatesByPage: {
 257:               ...current.candidatesByPage,
 258:               [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((item) =>
 259:                 item.id === candidate.id ? { ...item, ...next } : item),
 260:             },
 261:           };
 262:         });
 263:         event.preventDefault();
 264:         return;
 265:       }
 266:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 267:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 268:     }
 269:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 270:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 271:   });
 272: 
 273:   useEffect(() => () => {
 274:     engineRef.current?.dispose();
 275:     engineRef.current = null;
 276:   }, []);
 277: 
 278:   const sortedBooks = useMemo(() => [...books].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt), [books]);
 279:   const visibleBooks = useMemo(() => {
 280:     const needle = bookSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
 281:     return sortedBooks.filter((item) => {
 282:       const matchesTab = libraryTab === "all" || libraryTab === "recent";
 283:       return matchesTab && item.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle);
 284:     });
 285:   }, [bookSearch, libraryTab, sessionIndex, sortedBooks]);
 286: 
 287:   const boardSession: StudyBoardState | null = studyMode ? studyBoard : session;
 288:   const game = useMemo(() => {
 289:     if (!boardSession) return new Chess();
 290:     try {
 291:       return makePosition(boardSession.lineBaseFen, boardSession.moves, boardSession.moveIndex);
 292:     } catch {
 293:       try { return new Chess(boardSession.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 294:     }
 295:   }, [boardSession]);
 296:   const legalTargets = useMemo(() => {
 297:     if (!selectedSquare) return new Set<string>();
 298:     return new Set(game.moves({ square: selectedSquare, verbose: true }).map((move) => move.to));
 299:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 300:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 301:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 302:     try { return makePosition(boardSession?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, boardSession?.moves ?? [], boardSession?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 303:     catch { return []; }
 304:   }, [boardSession]);
 305:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 306:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 307:     : null);
 308:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 309:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 310:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 311:   );
 312: 
 313:   useEffect(() => {
 314:     setUserArrows([]);
 315:     setArrowStart(null);
 316:     setArrowHover(null);
 317:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 318:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 319: 
 320:   useEffect(() => {
 321:     if (engineEnabled) engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 322:   }, [engineEnabled, session?.currentFen, session?.moveIndex, engineDepth]);
 323: 
 324:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 325:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 326:   }

 328:   function toggleEngine() {
 329:     if (engineEnabled) {
 330:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 331:       engineRef.current = null;
 332:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 333:       setEngineStatus("off");
 334:       setEngineScore(null);
 335:       setEngineMessage("");
 336:       return;
 337:     }
 338:     try {
 339:       setEngineScore(null);
 340:       setEngineMessage("");
 341:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 342:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 343:         (status, message) => {
 344:           setEngineStatus(status);
 345:           if (status === "error") {
 346:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 347:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 348:             setEngineScore(null);
 349:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 350:             engineRef.current = null;
 351:           }
 352:         },
 353:         setEngineScore,
 354:       );
 355:       engineRef.current = client;
 356:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 357:     } catch (cause) {
 358:       setEngineStatus("error");
 359:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 360:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 361:     }
 362:   }

 364:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 365:     setSession((current) => {
 366:       if (!current) return current;
 367:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 368:     });
 369:   }

 371:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 372:     if (studyMode) setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 373:     else patchSession(change);
 374:   }

 376:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 377:     if (!studyMode) {
 378:       if (!session) {
 379:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 380:         return;
 381:       }
 382:       setStudyBoard({
 383:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 384:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 385:         moves: [...session.moves],
 386:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 387:         flipped: session.flipped,
 388:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 389:       });
 390:       setStudyMode(true);
 391:     } else {
 392:       setStudyMode(false);
 393:     }
 394:     setLastMove(null);
 395:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 396:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 397:   
 398:     try {
 399:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 400:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 401:       } else {
 402:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 403:       }
 404:     } catch {
 405:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 406:     }

 409:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 410:     try {
 411:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 412:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 413:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 414:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 415:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 416:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 417:       setBook(opened);
 418:       setSession(nextSession);
 419:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 420:       setError("");
 421:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 422:     } catch (cause) {
 423:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 424:     }
 425:   }

 427:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 428:     if (!file) return;
 429:     try {
 430:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 431:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 432:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 433:       const now = Date.now();
 434:       const created: BookRecord = {
 435:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 436:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 437:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 438:         byteLength: file.size,
 439:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 440:         addedAt: now,
 441:       };
 442:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 443:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 444:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 445:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 446:       setBook(created);
 447:       setSession(blank);
 448:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 449:       setError("");
 450:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 451:     } catch (cause) {
 452:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 453:     }
 454:   }

 456:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 457:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 458: 
 459:     try {
 460:       await removeBook(item.id);
 461:       await removeSession(item.id);
 462: 
 463:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 464:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 465:         const next = { ...current };
 466:         delete next[item.id];
 467:         return next;
 468:       });
 469: 
 470:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 471:         setBook(null);
 472:         setSession(null);
 473:         setPdf(null);
 474:       }
 475: 
 476:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 477:       setError("");
 478:     } catch (cause) {
 479:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 480:     }
 481:   }
 482:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 483:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 484:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 485:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 486:     try {
 487:       await putBook(renamed);
 488:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 489:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 490:     } catch (cause) {
 491:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 492:     }
 493:   }

 496:     if (!session) return;
 497:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 498:   }

 500:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 501:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 502:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 503:   }

 505:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 506:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 507:     try {
 508:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 509:       setSession({
 510:         ...activeSession,
 511:         originalFen: fen,
 512:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 513:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 514:         moves: [],
 515:         moveIndex: 0,
 516:       });
 517:       setLastMove(null);
 518:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 519:       setUserArrows([]);
 520:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 521:       return true;
 522:     } catch (cause) {
 523:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 524:       return false;
 525:     }
 526:   }

 535:     } else {
 536:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 537:     }
 538:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 539:     return true;

 591:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 592:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 593:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 594:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 595:       return;
 596:     }
 597:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 598:     try {
 599:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 600:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 601:       preview.width = crop.width;
 602:       preview.height = crop.height;
 603:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 604:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 605:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 606:     } catch (cause) {
 607:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 608:       return;
 609:     }
 610:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 611:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 612:     setTransferFen("");
 613:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 614:         setRecognitionError("");
 615:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 616:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 617:     try {
 618:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 619:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 620:       });
 621:       const form = new FormData();
 622:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 623:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 624:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 625:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 626:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 627:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 628:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 629:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 630:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 631:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 632:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 633:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 634:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 635:       }
 636:     } catch (cause) {
 637:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 638:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 639:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 640:     }
 641:   }

 643:   function closeTransfer() {
 644:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 645:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 646:     setTransferPreview("");
 647:     setTransferFen("");
 648:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 649:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 650:     setRecognitionError("");
 651:       }

 654:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 655:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 656:       setGameEndOverlay({
 657:         title: "Checkmate",
 658:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 659:       });
 660:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 661:       setGameEndOverlay({
 662:         title: "Stalemate",
 663:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 664:       });
 665:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 666:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 667:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 668:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 669:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 670:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 671:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 672:     } else {
 673:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 674:     }
 675:   }

 677:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 678:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 679:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 680:     try {
 681:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 682:       const result = currentGame.move({
 683:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 684:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 685:         promotion: piece,
 686:       });
 687:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 688:       patchBoardSession({
 689:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 690:         moves: nextMoves,
 691:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 692:       });
 693:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 694:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 695:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 696:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 697:       setError("");
 698:     } catch {
 699:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 700:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 701:     }
 702:   }
 703: 
 704:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 705:     if (!boardSession) return;
 706:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 707:     try {
 708:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 709:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 710:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 711:       if (promote) {
 712:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 713:         return;
 714:       }
 715:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 716:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 717:       patchBoardSession({
 718:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 719:         moves: nextMoves,
 720:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 721:       });
 722:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 723:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 724:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 725:       setError("");
 726:     } catch {
 727:       const piece = game.get(to);
 728:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 729:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 730:     }
 731:   }
 732: 
 733:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 734:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 735:     setRedSquares([]);
 736: 
 737:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 738:       setUserArrows([]);
 739:       setArrowStart(null);
 740:       setArrowHover(null);
 741:       return;
 742:     }
 743: if (!boardSession) return;
 744:     if (annotationMode) {
 745:       if (!arrowStart) {
 746:         setArrowStart(square);
 747:         return;
 748:       }
 749:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 750:       setArrowStart(null);
 751:       setArrowHover(null);
 752:       return;
 753:     }
 754:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 755:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 756:       return;
 757:     }
 758:     const piece = game.get(square);
 759:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 760:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 761:   }

 763:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 764:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 765: 
 766:   event.preventDefault();
 767: 
 768:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 769:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 770:     event.clientX,
 771:     event.clientY,
 772:     bounds,
 773:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 774:   );
 775: 
 776:   if (!square) return;
 777: 
 778:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 779:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 780:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 781:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 782:   setArrowStart(square);
 783:   setArrowHover(square);
 784: 
 785:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 786: }
 787: 
 788:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 789:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 790:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 791:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 792:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 793:     setArrowHover(square);
 794:   }
 795: 
 796:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 797:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 798: 
 799:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 800: 
 801:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 802:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 803:     event.clientX,
 804:     event.clientY,
 805:     bounds,
 806:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 807:   );
 808: 
 809:   if (to && to !== from) {
 810:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 811:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 812:   } else {
 813:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 814:   }
 815: 
 816:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 817:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 818:   setArrowStart(null);
 819:   setArrowHover(null);
 820: }
 821: 
 822:   function cancelBoardArrowGesture() {
 823:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 824:     setArrowStart(null);
 825:     setArrowHover(null);
 826:   }

 828:   function jumpToMove(index: number) {
 829:     if (!boardSession) return;
 830:     try {
 831:       const next = makePosition(boardSession.lineBaseFen, boardSession.moves, index);
 832:       const last = next.history({ verbose: true }).at(-1);
 833:       patchBoardSession({ moveIndex: index, currentFen: next.fen() });
 834:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);
 835:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 836:     } catch (cause) {
 837:       setError(`Could not navigate to move: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 838:     }
 839:   }

 848:   }

 850:   function stopBoardScan() {
 851:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 852:     if (!controller) return;
 853: 
 854:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 855:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 856:     controller.abort();
 857:     setDetecting(false);
 858:     setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 859: 
 860:     patchSession((current) => ({
 861:       ...current,
 862:       candidatesByPage: {
 863:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 864:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 865:       },
 866:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 867:     }));
 868:   }

 871:   function clearBoardScan() {
 872:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 873:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 874: 
 875:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 876:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 877:     controller?.abort();
 878: 
 879:     setDetecting(false);
 880:     setManualMode(false);
 881:     setDragSelection(null);
 882:     setCropEditingId(null);
 883:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 884:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 885: 
 886:     patchSession((current) => ({
 887:       ...current,
 888:       candidatesByPage: {
 889:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 890:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 891:       },
 892:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 893:     }));
 894: 
 895:     setError("");
 896:     setNotice("Board detection cleared.");
 897:   }
 898:   async function detectBoards() {
 899:     if (detecting) {
 900:       stopBoardScan();
 901:       return;
 902:     }
 903: 
 904:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 905:     if (!API_BASE) {
 906:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 907:       return;
 908:     }
 909: 
 910:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 911:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 912:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 913:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 914: 
 915:     setDetecting(true);
 916:     setError("");
 917:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 918:     patchSession((current) => ({
 919:       ...current,
 920:       candidatesByPage: {
 921:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 922:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 923:       },
 924:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 925:     }));
 926: 
 927:     try {
 928:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 929:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 930:           (blob) => blob
 931:             ? resolve(blob)
 932:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 933:           "image/png",
 934:         );
 935:       });
 936: 
 937:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 938: 
 939:       const form = new FormData();
 940:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 941: 
 942:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 943:         method: "POST",
 944:         body: form,
 945:         signal: abortController.signal,
 946:       });
 947: 
 948:       if (!response.ok) {
 949:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 950:       }
 951: 
 952:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 953:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 954:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 955:       );
 956: 
 957:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 958: 
 959:       patchSession((current) => ({
 960:         ...current,
 961:         candidatesByPage: {
 962:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 963:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 964:         },
 965:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 966:       }));
 967: 
 968:       setNotice(
 969:         candidates.length
 970:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 971:           : "No board candidates found.",
 972:       );
 973:     } catch (cause) {
 974:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 975: 
 976:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 977:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 978:       } else {
 979:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 980:       }
 981:     } finally {
 982:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 983:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 984:         setDetecting(false);
 985:       }
 986:     }
 987:   }
 988:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
 989:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
 990:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 991:   }

 993:   function startCropEdit(
 994:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 995:     candidate: Candidate,
 996:     handle: CropHandle,
 997:   ) {
 998:     event.stopPropagation();
 999:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1000:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
1001:     if (!point || !stage) return;
1002:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
1003:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1004:   }

1006:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1007:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1008:     if (!manualMode) return;
1009: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1010: if (!canvas) return;
1011: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1012: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1013: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1014: if (
1015:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1016:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1017:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1018:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1019: ) return;
1020:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1021:     if (!point) return;
1022:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1023:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1024:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1025:     setDragSelection(selection);
1026:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1027:   }
1028: 
1029:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1030:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1031:     if (edit) {
1032:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1033:       if (!point || !session) return;
1034:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1035:       patchSession((current) => {
1036:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1037:         return {
1038:           ...current,
1039:           candidatesByPage: {
1040:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1041:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1042:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1043:           },
1044:         };
1045:       });
1046:       return;
1047:     }
1048:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1049:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1050:     if (point) {
1051:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1052:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1053:       setDragSelection(selection);
1054:     }
1055:   }
1056: 
1057:   function finishRegion() {
1058:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1059:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1060:       return;
1061:     }
1062:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1063:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1064:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1065:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1066:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1067:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1068:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1069:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1070:     setDragSelection(null);
1071:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1072:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1073:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1074:       x, y, width, height,
1075:       relativeScore: 1,
1076:       source: "manual",
1077:     };
1078:     patchSession((current) => ({
1079:       ...current,
1080:       candidatesByPage: {
1081:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1082:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1083:       },
1084:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1085:     }));
1086:     setManualMode(false);
1087:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1088:   }
1089: 
1090:   function cancelRegion() {
1091:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1092:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1093:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1094:     setDragSelection(null);
1095:   }

1097:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1098:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1099:     try {
1100:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1101:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1102:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1103:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1104:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1105:       const scale = mode === "width"
1106:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1107:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1108:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1109:     } catch (cause) {
1110:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1111:     }
1112:   }

  54:   return `${"abcdefgh"[fileIndex]}${rankIndex + 1}` as Square;
  55: }
  56: 
  57: function normalizedCandidate(value: CandidateInput, index: number): Candidate {
  58:   const { relative_score, confidence, ...candidate } = value;
  59:   return {
  60:     ...candidate,
  61:     id: candidate.id || `candidate-${index + 1}`,
  62:     source: candidate.source ?? "automatic",
  63:     relativeScore: candidate.relativeScore ?? relative_score ?? confidence ?? 0,
  64:   };
  65: }

 328:   function toggleEngine() {
 329:     if (engineEnabled) {
 330:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 331:       engineRef.current = null;
 332:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 333:       setEngineStatus("off");
 334:       setEngineScore(null);
 335:       setEngineMessage("");
 336:       return;
 337:     }
 338:     try {
 339:       setEngineScore(null);
 340:       setEngineMessage("");
 341:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 342:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 343:         (status, message) => {
 344:           setEngineStatus(status);
 345:           if (status === "error") {
 346:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 347:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 348:             setEngineScore(null);
 349:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 350:             engineRef.current = null;
 351:           }
 352:         },
 353:         setEngineScore,
 354:       );
 355:       engineRef.current = client;
 356:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 357:     } catch (cause) {
 358:       setEngineStatus("error");
 359:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 360:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 361:     }
 362:   }

 409:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 410:     try {
 411:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 412:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);

 415:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 416:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 417:       setBook(opened);
 418:       setSession(nextSession);
 419:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 420:       setError("");

 427:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 428:     if (!file) return;
 429:     try {
 430:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 431:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 432:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 433:       const now = Date.now();
 434:       const created: BookRecord = {
 435:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 436:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 437:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 438:         byteLength: file.size,
 439:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 440:         addedAt: now,
 441:       };
 442:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 443:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 444:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 445:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 446:       setBook(created);
 447:       setSession(blank);
 448:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 449:       setError("");
 450:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 451:     } catch (cause) {
 452:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 453:     }
 454:   }

 456:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 457:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 458: 
 459:     try {
 460:       await removeBook(item.id);
 461:       await removeSession(item.id);
 462: 
 463:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 464:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 465:         const next = { ...current };
 466:         delete next[item.id];
 467:         return next;
 468:       });
 469: 
 470:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 471:         setBook(null);
 472:         setSession(null);
 473:         setPdf(null);
 474:       }
 475: 
 476:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 477:       setError("");
 478:     } catch (cause) {
 479:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 480:     }
 481:   }
 482:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 483:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 484:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 485:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 486:     try {
 487:       await putBook(renamed);
 488:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 489:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 490:     } catch (cause) {
 491:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 492:     }
 493:   }

 505:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 506:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 507:     try {
 508:       const next = new Chess(fen);

 510:         ...activeSession,
 511:         originalFen: fen,
 512:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 513:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 514:         moves: [],
 515:         moveIndex: 0,
 516:       });
 517:       setLastMove(null);
 518:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 519:       setUserArrows([]);
 520:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 521:       return true;
 522:     } catch (cause) {
 523:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 524:       return false;
 525:     }
 526:   }

 591:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 592:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 593:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 594:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 595:       return;
 596:     }
 597:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 598:     try {
 599:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 600:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 601:       preview.width = crop.width;
 602:       preview.height = crop.height;
 603:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 604:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 605:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 606:     } catch (cause) {
 607:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 608:       return;
 609:     }
 610:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 611:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 612:     setTransferFen("");
 613:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 614:         setRecognitionError("");
 615:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 616:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 617:     try {
 618:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 619:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 620:       });
 621:       const form = new FormData();
 622:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 623:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 624:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 625:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 626:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 627:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 628:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 629:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 630:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 631:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 632:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 633:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 634:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 635:       }
 636:     } catch (cause) {
 637:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 638:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 639:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 640:     }
 641:   }

 647:     setTransferFen("");

 654:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 655:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 656:       setGameEndOverlay({
 657:         title: "Checkmate",
 658:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 659:       });
 660:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 661:       setGameEndOverlay({
 662:         title: "Stalemate",
 663:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 664:       });
 665:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 666:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 667:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 668:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 669:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 670:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 671:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 672:     } else {
 673:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 674:     }
 675:   }

 677:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 678:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 679:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 680:     try {
 681:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 682:       const result = currentGame.move({
 683:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 684:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 685:         promotion: piece,
 686:       });
 687:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 688:       patchBoardSession({
 689:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 690:         moves: nextMoves,
 691:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 692:       });
 693:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 694:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 695:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 696:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 697:       setError("");
 698:     } catch {
 699:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 700:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 701:     }
 702:   }
 703: 
 704:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 705:     if (!boardSession) return;
 706:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 707:     try {
 708:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 709:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 710:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 711:       if (promote) {
 712:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 713:         return;
 714:       }
 715:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 716:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 717:       patchBoardSession({
 718:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 719:         moves: nextMoves,
 720:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 721:       });
 722:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 723:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 724:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 725:       setError("");
 726:     } catch {
 727:       const piece = game.get(to);
 728:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 729:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 730:     }
 731:   }

 733:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 734:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 735:     setRedSquares([]);
 736: 
 737:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 738:       setUserArrows([]);
 739:       setArrowStart(null);
 740:       setArrowHover(null);
 741:       return;
 742:     }
 743: if (!boardSession) return;
 744:     if (annotationMode) {
 745:       if (!arrowStart) {
 746:         setArrowStart(square);
 747:         return;
 748:       }
 749:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 750:       setArrowStart(null);
 751:       setArrowHover(null);
 752:       return;
 753:     }
 754:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 755:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 756:       return;
 757:     }
 758:     const piece = game.get(square);
 759:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 760:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 761:   }

 898:   async function detectBoards() {
 899:     if (detecting) {
 900:       stopBoardScan();
 901:       return;
 902:     }
 903: 
 904:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 905:     if (!API_BASE) {
 906:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 907:       return;
 908:     }
 909: 
 910:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 911:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 912:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 913:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 914: 
 915:     setDetecting(true);
 916:     setError("");
 917:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 918:     patchSession((current) => ({
 919:       ...current,
 920:       candidatesByPage: {
 921:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 922:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 923:       },
 924:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 925:     }));
 926: 
 927:     try {
 928:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 929:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 930:           (blob) => blob
 931:             ? resolve(blob)
 932:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 933:           "image/png",
 934:         );
 935:       });
 936: 
 937:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 938: 
 939:       const form = new FormData();
 940:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 941: 
 942:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 943:         method: "POST",
 944:         body: form,
 945:         signal: abortController.signal,
 946:       });
 947: 
 948:       if (!response.ok) {
 949:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 950:       }
 951: 
 952:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 953:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 954:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 955:       );
 956: 
 957:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 958: 
 959:       patchSession((current) => ({
 960:         ...current,
 961:         candidatesByPage: {
 962:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 963:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 964:         },
 965:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 966:       }));
 967: 
 968:       setNotice(
 969:         candidates.length
 970:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 971:           : "No board candidates found.",
 972:       );
 973:     } catch (cause) {
 974:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 975: 
 976:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 977:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 978:       } else {
 979:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 980:       }
 981:     } finally {
 982:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 983:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 984:         setDetecting(false);
 985:       }
 986:     }
 987:   }

1006:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1007:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1008:     if (!manualMode) return;
1009: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1010: if (!canvas) return;
1011: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1012: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1013: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1014: if (
1015:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1016:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1017:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1018:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1019: ) return;
1020:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1021:     if (!point) return;

1029:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1030:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1031:     if (edit) {
1032:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1033:       if (!point || !session) return;
1034:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1035:       patchSession((current) => {

1038:           ...current,

1042:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1043:           },

1045:       });
1046:       return;
1047:     }
1048:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1049:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1050:     if (point) {
1051:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };

1053:       setDragSelection(selection);
1054:     }

1057:   function finishRegion() {
1058:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1059:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1060:       return;
1061:     }
1062:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1063:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1064:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1065:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1066:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1067:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1068:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1069:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1070:     setDragSelection(null);
1071:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1072:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1073:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1074:       x, y, width, height,
1075:       relativeScore: 1,
1076:       source: "manual",
1077:     };
1078:     patchSession((current) => ({
1079:       ...current,
1080:       candidatesByPage: {
1081:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1082:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1083:       },
1084:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1085:     }));
1086:     setManualMode(false);
1087:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1088:   }

1097:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1098:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1099:     try {
1100:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1101:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1102:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1103:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1104:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1105:       const scale = mode === "width"
1106:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1107:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1108:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1109:     } catch (cause) {
1110:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1111:     }
1112:   }

 343:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 344:             setEngineScore(null);
 345:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 346:             engineRef.current = null;
 347:           }
 348:         },
 349:         setEngineScore,
 350:       );
 351:       engineRef.current = client;
 352:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 353:     } catch (cause) {
 354:       setEngineStatus("error");
 355:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 356:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 357:     }
 358:   }
 359: 
 360:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 361:     setSession((current) => {
 362:       if (!current) return current;
 363:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 364:     });
 365:   }

 367:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 368:     try {
 369:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 370:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 371:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 372:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 373:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 374:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 375:       setBook(opened);
 376:       setSession(nextSession);
 377:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 378:       setError("");
 379:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 380:     } catch (cause) {
 381:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 382:     }
 383:   }
 384: 
 385:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 386:     if (!file) return;
 387:     try {
 388:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 389:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 390:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 391:       const now = Date.now();
 392:       const created: BookRecord = {
 393:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 394:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 395:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 396:         byteLength: file.size,
 397:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 398:         addedAt: now,
 399:       };
 400:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 401:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 402:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 403:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 404:       setBook(created);
 405:       setSession(blank);
 406:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 407:       setError("");
 408:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 409:     } catch (cause) {
 410:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 411:     }
 412:   }
 413: 
 414:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 415:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 416: 
 417:     try {
 418:       await removeBook(item.id);
 419:       await removeSession(item.id);
 420: 
 421:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 422:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 423:         const next = { ...current };
 424:         delete next[item.id];
 425:         return next;
 426:       });
 427: 
 428:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 429:         setBook(null);
 430:         setSession(null);
 431:         setPdf(null);
 432:       }
 433: 
 434:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 435:       setError("");
 436:     } catch (cause) {
 437:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 438:     }
 439:   }
 440:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 441:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 442:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 443:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 444:     try {
 445:       await putBook(renamed);
 446:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 447:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 448:     } catch (cause) {
 449:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 450:     }
 451:   }

 463:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 464:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 465:     try {
 466:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 467:       setSession({
 468:         ...activeSession,
 469:         originalFen: fen,
 470:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 471:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 472:         moves: [],
 473:         moveIndex: 0,
 474:       });
 475:       setLastMove(null);
 476:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 477:       setUserArrows([]);
 478:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 479:       return true;
 480:     } catch (cause) {
 481:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 482:       return false;
 483:     }
 484:   }

 493:     } else {

 495:     }
 496:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 497:     return true;

 549:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 550:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 551:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 552:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 553:       return;
 554:     }
 555:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 556:     try {
 557:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 558:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 559:       preview.width = crop.width;
 560:       preview.height = crop.height;
 561:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 562:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 563:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 564:     } catch (cause) {
 565:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 566:       return;
 567:     }
 568:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 569:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 570:     setTransferFen("");
 571:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 572:         setRecognitionError("");
 573:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 574:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 575:     try {
 576:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 577:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 578:       });
 579:       const form = new FormData();
 580:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 581:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 582:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 583:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 584:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 585:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 586:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 587:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 588:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 589:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 590:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 591:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 592:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 593:       }
 594:     } catch (cause) {
 595:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 596:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 597:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 598:     }
 599:   }
 600: 
 601:   function closeTransfer() {
 602:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 603:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 604:     setTransferPreview("");
 605:     setTransferFen("");
 606:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 607:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 608:     setRecognitionError("");
 609:       }

 612:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 613:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 614:       setGameEndOverlay({
 615:         title: "Checkmate",
 616:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 617:       });
 618:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 619:       setGameEndOverlay({
 620:         title: "Stalemate",
 621:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 622:       });
 623:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 624:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 625:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 626:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 627:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 629:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 630:     } else {
 631:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 632:     }
 633:   }

 635:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 636:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 637:     try {
 638:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 639:       const result = currentGame.move({
 640:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 641:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 642:         promotion: piece,
 643:       });
 644:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 645:       patchSession({
 646:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 647:         moves: nextMoves,
 648:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 649:       });
 650:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 651:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 652:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 653:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 654:       setError("");
 655:     } catch {
 656:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 657:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 658:     }
 659:   }
 660: 
 661:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 662:     if (!session) return;
 663:     try {
 664:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 665:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 666:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 667:       if (promote) {
 668:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 669:         return;
 670:       }
 671:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 672:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 673:       patchSession({
 674:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 675:         moves: nextMoves,
 676:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 677:       });
 678:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 679:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 680:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 681:       setError("");
 682:     } catch {
 683:       const piece = game.get(to);
 684:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 685:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 686:     }
 687:   }

 689:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 690:     
 691:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 692:       setUserArrows([]);
 693:       setArrowStart(null);
 694:       setArrowHover(null);
 695:       return;
 696:     }
 697: if (!session) return;
 698:     if (annotationMode) {
 699:       if (!arrowStart) {
 700:         setArrowStart(square);
 701:         return;
 702:       }
 703:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 704:       setArrowStart(null);
 705:       setArrowHover(null);
 706:       return;
 707:     }
 708:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 709:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 710:       return;
 711:     }
 712:     const piece = game.get(square);
 713:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 714:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 715:   }

 750:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 751: 
 752:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

 764:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;

 766: 
 767:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 768:   setArrowStart(null);
 769:   setArrowHover(null);

 822:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 823:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 824: 
 825:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 826:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 827:     controller?.abort();
 828:

 831:     setDragSelection(null);
 832:     setCropEditingId(null);
 833:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 834:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 835: 
 836:     patchSession((current) => ({
 837:       ...current,
 838:       candidatesByPage: {
 839:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 840:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 841:       },

 848:   async function detectBoards() {
 849:     if (detecting) {
 850:       stopBoardScan();
 851:       return;
 852:     }
 853: 
 854:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 855:     if (!API_BASE) {
 856:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 857:       return;
 858:     }
 859: 
 860:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 861:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 862:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 863:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 864: 
 865:     setDetecting(true);
 866:     setError("");
 867:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 868:     patchSession((current) => ({
 869:       ...current,
 870:       candidatesByPage: {
 871:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 872:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 873:       },
 874:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 875:     }));
 876: 
 877:     try {
 878:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 879:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 880:           (blob) => blob
 881:             ? resolve(blob)
 882:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 883:           "image/png",
 884:         );
 885:       });
 886: 
 887:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 888: 
 889:       const form = new FormData();
 890:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 891: 
 892:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 893:         method: "POST",
 894:         body: form,
 895:         signal: abortController.signal,
 896:       });
 897: 
 898:       if (!response.ok) {
 899:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 900:       }
 901: 
 902:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 903:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 904:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 905:       );
 906: 
 907:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 908: 
 909:       patchSession((current) => ({
 910:         ...current,
 911:         candidatesByPage: {
 912:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 913:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 914:         },
 915:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 916:       }));
 917: 
 918:       setNotice(
 919:         candidates.length
 920:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 921:           : "No board candidates found.",
 922:       );
 923:     } catch (cause) {
 924:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 925: 
 926:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 927:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 928:       } else {
 929:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 930:       }
 931:     } finally {
 932:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 933:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 934:         setDetecting(false);
 935:       }
 936:     }
 937:   }

 939:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
 940:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 941:   }

 956:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 957:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 958:     if (!manualMode) return;
 959: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 960: if (!canvas) return;
 961: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 962: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 963: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 964: if (
 965:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 966:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 967:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 968:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 969: ) return;
 970:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 971:     if (!point) return;
 972:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 973:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 974:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 975:     setDragSelection(selection);
 976:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 977:   }

 979:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 980:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 981:     if (edit) {
 982:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 983:       if (!point || !session) return;
 984:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 985:       patchSession((current) => {
 986:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 987:         return {
 988:           ...current,
 989:           candidatesByPage: {
 990:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 991:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 992:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 993:           },
 994:         };
 995:       });
 996:       return;
 997:     }
 998:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 999:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1000:     if (point) {
1001:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1002:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1003:       setDragSelection(selection);
1004:     }
1005:   }
1006: 
1007:   function finishRegion() {
1008:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1009:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1010:       return;
1011:     }
1012:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1013:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1014:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1015:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1016:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1017:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1018:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1019:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1020:     setDragSelection(null);
1021:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1022:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1023:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1024:       x, y, width, height,
1025:       relativeScore: 1,
1026:       source: "manual",
1027:     };
1028:     patchSession((current) => ({
1029:       ...current,
1030:       candidatesByPage: {
1031:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1032:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1033:       },
1034:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1035:     }));
1036:     setManualMode(false);
1037:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1038:   }

1043:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1044:     setDragSelection(null);
1045:   }

1047:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1048:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1049:     try {
1050:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1051:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1052:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1053:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1054:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1055:       const scale = mode === "width"
1056:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1057:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1058:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1059:     } catch (cause) {
1060:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1061:     }
1062:   }

 241:   useEffect(() => {
 242:     function onKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 243:       if (!session || !book || isTypingTarget(event.target)) return;
 244:       if (cropEditingId && ["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key)) {
 245:         const candidate = (session.candidatesByPage[String(session.page)] ?? []).find((item) => item.id === cropEditingId);
 246:         if (!candidate) return;
 247:         const step = event.shiftKey ? 0.01 : 0.002;
 248:         const x = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0;
 249:         const y = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : event.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0;
 250:         const next = editCrop(candidate, "move", x, y);

 252:           const pageKey = String(current.page);

 260:           };
 261:         });
 262:         event.preventDefault();
 263:         return;
 264:       }
 265:       if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") changePage(-1);
 266:       if (event.key === "ArrowRight") changePage(1);
 267:     }
 268:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
 269:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);

 327:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 328:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);

 331:   function toggleEngine() {
 332:     if (engineEnabled) {
 333:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 334:       engineRef.current = null;
 335:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 336:       setEngineStatus("off");
 337:       setEngineScore(null);
 338:       setEngineMessage("");
 339:       return;
 340:     }
 341:     try {
 342:       setEngineScore(null);
 343:       setEngineMessage("");
 344:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 345:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 346:         (status, message) => {
 347:           setEngineStatus(status);
 348:           if (status === "error") {
 349:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 350:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 351:             setEngineScore(null);
 352:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 353:             engineRef.current = null;
 354:           }
 355:         },
 356:         setEngineScore,
 357:       );
 358:       engineRef.current = client;
 359:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 360:     } catch (cause) {
 361:       setEngineStatus("error");
 362:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 363:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 364:     }
 365:   }

 367:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 368:     setSession((current) => {
 369:       if (!current) return current;
 370:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 371:     });
 372:   }

 374:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 375:     try {
 376:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 377:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 378:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 379:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 380:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 381:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 382:       setBook(opened);
 383:       setSession(nextSession);
 384:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 385:       setError("");
 386:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 387:     } catch (cause) {
 388:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 389:     }
 390:   }

 392:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 393:     if (!file) return;
 394:     try {
 395:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 396:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 397:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 398:       const now = Date.now();
 399:       const created: BookRecord = {
 400:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 401:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 402:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 403:         byteLength: file.size,
 404:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 405:         addedAt: now,
 406:       };
 407:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 408:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 409:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 410:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 411:       setBook(created);
 412:       setSession(blank);
 413:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 414:       setError("");
 415:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 416:     } catch (cause) {
 417:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 418:     }
 419:   }
