 421:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 422:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove "${item.title}" from your library?`)) return;
 423: 
 424:     try {
 425:       await removeBook(item.id);
 426:       await removeSession(item.id);
 427: 
 428:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 429:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 430:         const next = { ...current };
 431:         delete next[item.id];
 432:         return next;
 433:       });
 434: 
 435:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 436:         setBook(null);
 437:         setSession(null);
 438:         setPdf(null);
 439:       }
 440: 
 441:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 442:       setError("");
 443:     } catch (cause) {
 444:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 445:     }
 446:   }
 447:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 448:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 449:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 450:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 451:     try {
 452:       await putBook(renamed);
 453:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 454:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 455:     } catch (cause) {
 456:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 457:     }
 458:   }

 540:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 541:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 542:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 543:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 544:       return;
 545:     }
 546:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 547:     try {
 548:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 549:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 550:       preview.width = crop.width;
 551:       preview.height = crop.height;
 552:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 553:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 554:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 555:     } catch (cause) {
 556:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 557:       return;
 558:     }
 559:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 560:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 561:     setTransferFen("");
 562:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 563:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 564:     setRecognitionError("");
 565:     setTransferPiece("P");
 566:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 567:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 568:     try {
 569:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 570:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 571:       });
 572:       const form = new FormData();
 573:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 574:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 575:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 576:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 577:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 578:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 579:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 580:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 581:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 582:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 583:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 584:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 585:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 586:       }
 587:     } catch (cause) {
 588:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 589:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 590:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 591:     }
 592:   }
 593: 
 594:   function closeTransfer() {
 595:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 596:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 597:     setTransferPreview("");
 598:     setTransferFen("");
 599:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 600:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 601:     setRecognitionError("");
 602:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 603:   }

 605:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 606:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 607:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 608:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 609:       return;
 610:     }
 611:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 612:     if (!board) {
 613:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 614:       return;
 615:     }
 616:     const row = displayRow;
 617:     const col = displayCol;
 618:     try {
 619:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 620:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 621:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 622:       setRecognitionError("");
 623:     } catch (cause) {
 624:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 625:     }
 626:   }
 627: 
 628:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 629:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 630:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 631:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 632:       return;
 633:     }
 634:     try {
 635:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 636:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 637:       setRecognitionError("");
 638:     } catch (cause) {
 639:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 640:     }
 641:   }

 643:   function confirmTransfer() {
 644:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 645:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 646:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 647:       return;
 648:     }
 649:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 650:       closeTransfer();
 651:     }
 652:   }
 653: 
 654:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 655:     if (!session) return;
 656:     try {
 657:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 658:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 659:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 660:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 661:       if (promote) {
 662:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 663:         if (!choice) return;
 664:         switch (choice) {
 665:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 666:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 667:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 668:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 669:           default:
 670:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 671:             return;
 672:         }
 673:       }
 674:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 675:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 676:       patchSession({
 677:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 678:         moves: nextMoves,
 679:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 680:       });
 681:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 682:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 683:       setError("");
 684:     } catch {
 685:       const piece = game.get(to);
 686:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 687:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 688:     }
 689:   }
 690: 
 691:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 692:     if (!session) return;
 693:     if (annotationMode) {
 694:       if (!arrowStart) {
 695:         setArrowStart(square);
 696:         return;
 697:       }
 698:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 699:       setArrowStart(null);
 700:       setArrowHover(null);
 701:       return;
 702:     }
 703:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 704:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 705:       return;
 706:     }
 707:     const piece = game.get(square);
 708:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 709:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 710:   }

 712:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 713:     if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 714:     event.preventDefault();
 715:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 716:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 717:     if (!square) return;
 718:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 719:     arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 720:     setArrowStart(square);
 721:     setArrowHover(square);
 722:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 723:   }

 725:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 726:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 727:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 728:     setArrowHover(boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped)));
 729:   }
 730: 
 731:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 732:     const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 733:     if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 734:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 735:     const to = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 736:     if (to && to !== from) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 737:     arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 738:     setArrowStart(null);
 739:     setArrowHover(null);
 740:   }

 770:   async function detectBoards() {
 771:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 772:     if (!API_BASE) {
 773:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Start the optional CV service and set VITE_API_BASE_URL, or draw a board region manually.");
 774:       return;
 775:     }
 776:     setDetecting(true);
 777:     setError("");
 778:     try {
 779:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 780:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")), "image/png");
 781:       });
 782:       const form = new FormData();
 783:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 784:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 785:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 786:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 787:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map((item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index));
 788:       patchSession((current) => ({
 789:         ...current,
 790:         candidatesByPage: { ...current.candidatesByPage, [String(current.page)]: candidates },
 791:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 792:       }));
 793:       setNotice(candidates.length ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.` : "No board candidates found. You can draw a region manually.");
 794:     } catch (cause) {
 795:       setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 796:     } finally {
 797:       setDetecting(false);
 798:     }
 799:   }

 801:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
 802:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
 803:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 804:   }

 806:   function startCropEdit(
 807:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 808:     candidate: Candidate,
 809:     handle: CropHandle,
 810:   ) {
 811:     event.stopPropagation();
 812:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 813:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
 814:     if (!point || !stage) return;
 815:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
 816:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 817:   }
 818: 
 819:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 820:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 821:     if (!manualMode) return;
 822: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 823: if (!canvas) return;
 824: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 825: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 826: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 827: if (
 828:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 829:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 830:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 831:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 832: ) return;
 833:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 834:     if (!point) return;
 835:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 836:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 837:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 838:     setDragSelection(selection);
 839:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 840:   }
 841: 
 842:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 843:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 844:     if (edit) {
 845:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 846:       if (!point || !session) return;
 847:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 848:       patchSession((current) => {
 849:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 850:         return {
 851:           ...current,
 852:           candidatesByPage: {
 853:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 854:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 855:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 856:           },
 857:         };
 858:       });
 859:       return;
 860:     }
 861:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 862:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 863:     if (point) {
 864:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 865:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 866:       setDragSelection(selection);
 867:     }
 868:   }
 869: 
 870:   function finishRegion() {
 871:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 872:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 873:       return;
 874:     }
 875:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 876:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 877:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 878:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 879:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 880:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 881:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 882:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 883:     setDragSelection(null);
 884:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 885:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 886:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 887:       x, y, width, height,
 888:       relativeScore: 1,
 889:       source: "manual",
 890:     };
 891:     patchSession((current) => ({
 892:       ...current,
 893:       candidatesByPage: {
 894:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 895:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 896:       },
 897:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 898:     }));
 899:     setManualMode(false);
 900:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 901:   }
 902: 
 903:   function cancelRegion() {
 904:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 905:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 906:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 907:     setDragSelection(null);
 908:   }

 910:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 911:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 912:     try {
 913:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 914:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 915:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 916:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 917:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 918:       const scale = mode === "width"
 919:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 920:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 921:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 922:     } catch (cause) {
 923:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 924:     }
 925:   }

  26: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  27:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  28:   if (!match) return uci;
  29:   try {
  30:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  31:     const move = position.move({
  32:       from: match[1] as Square,
  33:       to: match[2] as Square,
  34:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  35:     });
  36:     return move.san;
  37:   } catch {
  38:     return uci;
  39:   }

  42: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  43:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  44:   const san: string[] = [];
  45:   for (const uci of pv) {

 367:   function toggleEngine() {
 368:     if (engineEnabled) {
 369:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 370:       engineRef.current = null;
 371:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 372:       setEngineStatus("off");
 373:       setEngineScore(null);
 374:       setEngineMessage("");
 375:       return;
 376:     }
 377:     try {
 378:       setEngineScore(null);
 379:       setEngineMessage("");
 380:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 381:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 382:         (status, message) => {
 383:           setEngineStatus(status);
 384:           if (status === "error") {
 385:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 386:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 387:             setEngineScore(null);
 388:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 389:             engineRef.current = null;
 390:           }
 391:         },
 392:         setEngineScore,
 393:       );
 394:       engineRef.current = client;
 395:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 396:     } catch (cause) {
 397:       setEngineStatus("error");
 398:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 399:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 400:     }
 401:   }

 404:     setSession((current) => {

 406:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 407:     });

 415:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 416:     if (!studyMode) {
 417:       if (!session) {
 418:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 419:         return;
 420:       }
 421:       setStudyBoard({
 422:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 423:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 424:         moves: [...session.moves],
 425:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 426:         flipped: session.flipped,
 427:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 428:       });
 429:       setStudyMode(true);
 430:     } else {
 431:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 432:       if (studyBoard) {
 433:         patchSession({
 434:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 435:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 436:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 437:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 438:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 439:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 440:         });
 441:       }
 442:       setStudyMode(false);
 443:     }
 444:     setLastMove(null);
 445:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 446:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 447:   
 448:     try {
 449:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 450:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 451:       } else {
 452:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 453:       }
 454:     } catch {
 455:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 456:     }
 457: }

 459:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 460:     try {
 461:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 462:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 463:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 464:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 465:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 466:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 467:       setBook(opened);
 468:       setSession(nextSession);
 469:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 470:       setError("");
 471:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 472:     } catch (cause) {
 473:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 474:     }
 475:   }

 477:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 478:     if (!file) return;
 479:     try {
 480:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 481:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 482:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 483:       const now = Date.now();
 484:       const created: BookRecord = {
 485:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 486:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 487:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 488:         byteLength: file.size,
 489:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 490:         addedAt: now,
 491:       };
 492:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 493:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 494:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 495:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 496:       setBook(created);
 497:       setSession(blank);
 498:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 499:       setError("");
 500:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 501:     } catch (cause) {
 502:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 503:     }
 504:   }

 506:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 507:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 508: 
 509:     try {
 510:       await removeBook(item.id);
 511:       await removeSession(item.id);
 512: 
 513:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 514:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 515:         const next = { ...current };
 516:         delete next[item.id];
 517:         return next;
 518:       });
 519: 
 520:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 521:         setBook(null);
 522:         setSession(null);
 523:         setPdf(null);
 524:       }
 525: 
 526:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 527:       setError("");
 528:     } catch (cause) {
 529:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 530:     }
 531:   }
 532:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 533:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 534:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 535:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 536:     try {
 537:       await putBook(renamed);
 538:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 539:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 540:     } catch (cause) {
 541:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 542:     }
 543:   }

 555:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 556:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 557:     try {
 558:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 559:       setSession({
 560:         ...activeSession,
 561:         originalFen: fen,
 562:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 563:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 564:         moves: [],
 565:         moveIndex: 0,
 566:       });
 567:       setLastMove(null);
 568:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 569:       setUserArrows([]);
 570:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 571:       return true;
 572:     } catch (cause) {
 573:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 574:       return false;
 575:     }
 576:   }

 588:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");

 641:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 642:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 643:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 644:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 645:       return;
 646:     }
 647:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 648:     try {
 649:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 650:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 651:       preview.width = crop.width;
 652:       preview.height = crop.height;
 653:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 654:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 655:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 656:     } catch (cause) {
 657:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 658:       return;
 659:     }
 660:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 661:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 662:     setTransferFen("");
 663:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 664:         setRecognitionError("");
 665:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 666:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 667:     try {
 668:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 669:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 670:       });
 671:       const form = new FormData();
 672:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 673:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 674:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 675:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 676:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 677:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 678:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 679:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 680:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 681:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 682:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 683:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 684:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 685:       }
 686:     } catch (cause) {
 687:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 688:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 689:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 690:     }
 691:   }

 693:   function closeTransfer() {
 694:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 695:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 696:     setTransferPreview("");
 697:     setTransferFen("");
 698:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 699:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 700:     setRecognitionError("");
 701:       }

 704:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 705:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 706:       setGameEndOverlay({
 707:         title: "Checkmate",
 708:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 709:       });
 710:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 711:       setGameEndOverlay({
 712:         title: "Stalemate",
 713:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 714:       });
 715:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 716:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 717:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 718:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 719:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 720:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 721:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 722:     } else {
 723:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 724:     }
 725:   }

 727:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 728:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 729:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 730:     try {
 731:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 732:       const result = currentGame.move({
 733:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 734:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 735:         promotion: piece,
 736:       });
 737:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 738:       patchBoardSession({
 739:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 740:         moves: nextMoves,
 741:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 742:       });
 743:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 744:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 745:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 746:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 747:       setError("");
 748:     } catch {
 749:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 750:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 751:     }
 752:   }
 753: 
 754:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 755:     if (!boardSession) return;
 756:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 757:     try {
 758:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 759:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 760:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 761:       if (promote) {
 762:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 763:         return;
 764:       }
 765:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 766:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 767:       patchBoardSession({
 768:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 769:         moves: nextMoves,
 770:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 771:       });
 772:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 773:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 774:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 775:       setError("");
 776:     } catch {
 777:       const piece = game.get(to);
 778:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 779:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 780:     }
 781:   }

 783:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 784:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 785:     setRedSquares([]);
 786: 
 787:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 788:       setUserArrows([]);
 789:       setArrowStart(null);
 790:       setArrowHover(null);
 791:       return;
 792:     }
 793: if (!boardSession) return;
 794:     if (annotationMode) {
 795:       if (!arrowStart) {
 796:         setArrowStart(square);
 797:         return;
 798:       }
 799:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 800:       setArrowStart(null);
 801:       setArrowHover(null);
 802:       return;
 803:     }
 804:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 805:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 806:       return;
 807:     }
 808:     const piece = game.get(square);
 809:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 810:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 811:   }

 846:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 847:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 848: 
 849:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 850: 
 851:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 852:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 853:     event.clientX,
 854:     event.clientY,
 855:     bounds,
 856:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 857:   );
 858:

 860:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 861:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 862:   } else {
 863:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 864:   }
 865: 
 866:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 867:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;

 869:   setArrowHover(null);

 948:   async function detectBoards() {
 949:     if (detecting) {
 950:       stopBoardScan();
 951:       return;
 952:     }
 953: 
 954:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 955:     if (!API_BASE) {
 956:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 957:       return;
 958:     }
 959: 
 960:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 961:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 962:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 963:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 964: 
 965:     setDetecting(true);
 966:     setError("");
 967:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 968:     patchSession((current) => ({
 969:       ...current,
 970:       candidatesByPage: {
 971:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 972:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 973:       },
 974:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 975:     }));
 976: 
 977:     try {
 978:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 979:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 980:           (blob) => blob
 981:             ? resolve(blob)
 982:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 983:           "image/png",
 984:         );
 985:       });
 986: 
 987:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 988: 
 989:       const form = new FormData();
 990:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 991: 
 992:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 993:         method: "POST",
 994:         body: form,
 995:         signal: abortController.signal,
 996:       });
 997: 
 998:       if (!response.ok) {
 999:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1000:       }
1001: 
1002:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1003:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1004:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1005:       );
1006: 
1007:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1008: 
1009:       patchSession((current) => ({
1010:         ...current,
1011:         candidatesByPage: {
1012:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1013:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1014:         },
1015:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1016:       }));
1017: 
1018:       setNotice(
1019:         candidates.length
1020:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1021:           : "No board candidates found.",
1022:       );
1023:     } catch (cause) {
1024:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1025: 
1026:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1027:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1028:       } else {
1029:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1030:       }
1031:     } finally {
1032:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1033:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1034:         setDetecting(false);
1035:       }
1036:     }
1037:   }

1056:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1057:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1058:     if (!manualMode) return;
1059: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1060: if (!canvas) return;
1061: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1062: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1063: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1064: if (
1065:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1066:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1067:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1068:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1069: ) return;
1070:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1071:     if (!point) return;
1072:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1073:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1074:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1075:     setDragSelection(selection);
1076:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1077:   }

1079:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1080:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1081:     if (edit) {
1082:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1083:       if (!point || !session) return;
1084:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1085:       patchSession((current) => {
1086:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1087:         return {
1088:           ...current,
1089:           candidatesByPage: {
1090:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1091:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1092:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1093:           },
1094:         };
1095:       });
1096:       return;
1097:     }
1098:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1099:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1100:     if (point) {
1101:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1102:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1103:       setDragSelection(selection);
1104:     }
1105:   }

1107:   function finishRegion() {
1108:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1109:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1110:       return;
1111:     }
1112:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1113:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1114:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1115:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1116:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1117:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1118:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1119:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1120:     setDragSelection(null);
1121:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1122:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1123:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1124:       x, y, width, height,
1125:       relativeScore: 1,
1126:       source: "manual",
1127:     };
1128:     patchSession((current) => ({
1129:       ...current,
1130:       candidatesByPage: {
1131:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1132:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1133:       },
1134:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1135:     }));
1136:     setManualMode(false);
1137:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1138:   }

1147:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1148:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1149:     try {
1150:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1151:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1152:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1153:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1154:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1155:       const scale = mode === "width"
1156:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1157:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1158:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1159:     } catch (cause) {
1160:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1161:     }
1162:   }

  26: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  27:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  28:   if (!match) return uci;
  29:   try {
  30:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  31:     const move = position.move({
  32:       from: match[1] as Square,
  33:       to: match[2] as Square,
  34:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  35:     });
  36:     return move.san;
  37:   } catch {
  38:     return uci;
  39:   }
  40: }
  41: 
  42: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  43:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  44:   const san: string[] = [];
  45:   for (const uci of pv) {
  46:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  47:     if (!match) break;
  48:     try {
  49:       const move = position.move({
  50:         from: match[1] as Square,
  51:         to: match[2] as Square,
  52:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  53:       });
  54:       san.push(move.san);
  55:     } catch {
  56:       break;
  57:     }
  58:   }
  59:   return san.join(" ");
  60: }

 368:     if (engineEnabled) {
 369:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 370:       engineRef.current = null;
 371:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 372:       setEngineStatus("off");
 373:       setEngineScore(null);
 374:       setEngineMessage("");
 375:       return;
 376:     }
 377:     try {
 378:       setEngineScore(null);
 379:       setEngineMessage("");
 380:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 381:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 382:         (status, message) => {
 383:           setEngineStatus(status);
 384:           if (status === "error") {
 385:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 386:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 387:             setEngineScore(null);
 388:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 389:             engineRef.current = null;
 390:           }
 391:         },
 392:         setEngineScore,
 393:       );
 394:       engineRef.current = client;
 395:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 396:     } catch (cause) {
 397:       setEngineStatus("error");
 398:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 399:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 400:     }
 401:   }
 402: 
 403:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 404:     setSession((current) => {
 405:       if (!current) return current;
 406:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 407:     });
 408:   }
 409: 
 410:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 411:     if (studyMode) setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 412:     else patchSession(change);
 413:   }

 415:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 416:     if (!studyMode) {
 417:       if (!session) {
 418:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 419:         return;
 420:       }
 421:       setStudyBoard({
 422:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 423:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 424:         moves: [...session.moves],
 425:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 426:         flipped: session.flipped,
 427:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 428:       });
 429:       setStudyMode(true);
 430:     } else {
 431:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 432:       if (studyBoard) {
 433:         patchSession({
 434:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 435:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 436:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 437:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 438:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 439:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 440:         });
 441:       }
 442:       setStudyMode(false);
 443:     }
 444:     setLastMove(null);
 445:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 446:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 447:   
 448:     try {
 449:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 450:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 451:       } else {
 452:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 453:       }
 454:     } catch {
 455:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 456:     }
 457: }

 459:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 460:     try {
 461:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 462:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 463:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 464:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 465:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 466:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 467:       setBook(opened);
 468:       setSession(nextSession);
 469:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 470:       setError("");
 471:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 472:     } catch (cause) {
 473:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 474:     }
 475:   }
 476: 
 477:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 478:     if (!file) return;
 479:     try {
 480:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 481:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 482:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 483:       const now = Date.now();
 484:       const created: BookRecord = {
 485:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 486:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 487:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 488:         byteLength: file.size,
 489:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 490:         addedAt: now,
 491:       };
 492:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 493:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 494:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 495:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 496:       setBook(created);
 497:       setSession(blank);
 498:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 499:       setError("");
 500:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 501:     } catch (cause) {
 502:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 503:     }
 504:   }

 506:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 507:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 508: 
 509:     try {
 510:       await removeBook(item.id);
 511:       await removeSession(item.id);
 512: 
 513:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 514:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 515:         const next = { ...current };
 516:         delete next[item.id];
 517:         return next;
 518:       });
 519: 
 520:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 521:         setBook(null);
 522:         setSession(null);
 523:         setPdf(null);
 524:       }
 525: 
 526:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 527:       setError("");
 528:     } catch (cause) {
 529:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 530:     }
 531:   }
 532:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 533:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 534:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 535:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 536:     try {
 537:       await putBook(renamed);
 538:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 539:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 540:     } catch (cause) {
 541:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 542:     }
 543:   }

 546:     if (!session) return;
 547:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });

 551:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 552:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 553:   }

 555:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 556:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 557:     try {
 558:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 559:       setSession({
 560:         ...activeSession,
 561:         originalFen: fen,
 562:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 563:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 564:         moves: [],
 565:         moveIndex: 0,
 566:       });
 567:       setLastMove(null);
 568:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 569:       setUserArrows([]);
 570:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 571:       return true;
 572:     } catch (cause) {
 573:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 574:       return false;
 575:     }
 576:   }

 578:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 579:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 580:     if (!loaded) return false;
 581:     setEngineScore(null);
 582:     setEngineMessage("");
 583:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 584:       toggleEngine();
 585:     } else {
 586:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 587:     }
 588:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 589:     return true;

 641:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 642:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 643:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 644:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 645:       return;
 646:     }
 647:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 648:     try {
 649:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 650:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 651:       preview.width = crop.width;
 652:       preview.height = crop.height;
 653:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 654:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 655:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 656:     } catch (cause) {
 657:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 658:       return;
 659:     }
 660:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 661:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 662:     setTransferFen("");
 663:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 664:         setRecognitionError("");
 665:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 666:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 667:     try {
 668:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 669:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 670:       });
 671:       const form = new FormData();
 672:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 673:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 674:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 675:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 676:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 677:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 678:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 679:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 680:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 681:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 682:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 683:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 684:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 685:       }
 686:     } catch (cause) {
 687:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 688:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 689:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 690:     }
 691:   }
 692: 
 693:   function closeTransfer() {
 694:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 695:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 696:     setTransferPreview("");
 697:     setTransferFen("");
 698:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 699:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 700:     setRecognitionError("");
 701:       }

 704:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 705:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 706:       setGameEndOverlay({
 707:         title: "Checkmate",
 708:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 709:       });
 710:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 711:       setGameEndOverlay({
 712:         title: "Stalemate",
 713:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 714:       });
 715:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 716:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 717:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 718:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 719:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 720:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 721:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 722:     } else {
 723:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 724:     }
 725:   }

 727:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 728:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 729:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 730:     try {
 731:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 732:       const result = currentGame.move({
 733:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 734:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 735:         promotion: piece,
 736:       });
 737:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 738:       patchBoardSession({
 739:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 740:         moves: nextMoves,
 741:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 742:       });
 743:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 744:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 745:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 746:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 747:       setError("");
 748:     } catch {
 749:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 750:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 751:     }
 752:   }
 753: 
 754:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 755:     if (!boardSession) return;
 756:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 757:     try {
 758:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 759:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 760:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 761:       if (promote) {
 762:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 763:         return;
 764:       }
 765:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 766:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 767:       patchBoardSession({
 768:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 769:         moves: nextMoves,
 770:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 771:       });
 772:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 773:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 774:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 775:       setError("");
 776:     } catch {
 777:       const piece = game.get(to);
 778:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 779:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 780:     }
 781:   }
 782: 
 783:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 784:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 785:     setRedSquares([]);
 786: 
 787:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 788:       setUserArrows([]);
 789:       setArrowStart(null);
 790:       setArrowHover(null);
 791:       return;
 792:     }
 793: if (!boardSession) return;
 794:     if (annotationMode) {
 795:       if (!arrowStart) {
 796:         setArrowStart(square);
 797:         return;
 798:       }
 799:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 800:       setArrowStart(null);
 801:       setArrowHover(null);
 802:       return;
 803:     }
 804:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 805:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 806:       return;
 807:     }
 808:     const piece = game.get(square);
 809:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 810:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 811:   }

 813:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 814:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 815: 
 816:   event.preventDefault();
 817: 
 818:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 819:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 820:     event.clientX,
 821:     event.clientY,
 822:     bounds,
 823:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 824:   );
 825: 
 826:   if (!square) return;
 827: 
 828:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 829:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 830:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 831:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 832:   setArrowStart(square);
 833:   setArrowHover(square);
 834: 
 835:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 836: }

 838:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 839:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 840:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 841:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 842:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 843:     setArrowHover(square);
 844:   }
 845: 
 846:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 847:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 848: 
 849:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 850: 
 851:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 852:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 853:     event.clientX,
 854:     event.clientY,
 855:     bounds,
 856:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 857:   );
 858: 
 859:   if (to && to !== from) {
 860:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 861:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 862:   } else {
 863:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 864:   }
 865: 
 866:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 867:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 868:   setArrowStart(null);
 869:   setArrowHover(null);
 870: }

 922:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.

 940:         [String(current.page)]: [],

 948:   async function detectBoards() {
 949:     if (detecting) {
 950:       stopBoardScan();
 951:       return;
 952:     }
 953: 
 954:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 955:     if (!API_BASE) {
 956:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 957:       return;
 958:     }
 959: 
 960:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 961:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 962:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 963:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 964: 
 965:     setDetecting(true);
 966:     setError("");
 967:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 968:     patchSession((current) => ({
 969:       ...current,
 970:       candidatesByPage: {
 971:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 972:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 973:       },
 974:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 975:     }));
 976: 
 977:     try {
 978:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 979:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 980:           (blob) => blob
 981:             ? resolve(blob)
 982:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 983:           "image/png",
 984:         );
 985:       });
 986: 
 987:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 988: 
 989:       const form = new FormData();
 990:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 991: 
 992:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 993:         method: "POST",
 994:         body: form,
 995:         signal: abortController.signal,
 996:       });
 997: 
 998:       if (!response.ok) {
 999:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1000:       }
1001: 
1002:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1003:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1004:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1005:       );
1006: 
1007:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1008: 
1009:       patchSession((current) => ({
1010:         ...current,
1011:         candidatesByPage: {
1012:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1013:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1014:         },
1015:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1016:       }));
1017: 
1018:       setNotice(
1019:         candidates.length
1020:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1021:           : "No board candidates found.",
1022:       );
1023:     } catch (cause) {
1024:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1025: 
1026:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1027:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1028:       } else {
1029:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1030:       }
1031:     } finally {
1032:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1033:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1034:         setDetecting(false);
1035:       }
1036:     }
1037:   }
1038:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
1039:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
1040:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;

1043:   function startCropEdit(
1044:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
1045:     candidate: Candidate,
1046:     handle: CropHandle,
1047:   ) {
1048:     event.stopPropagation();

1050:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
1051:     if (!point || !stage) return;
1052:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };

1056:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1057:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1058:     if (!manualMode) return;
1059: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1060: if (!canvas) return;
1061: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1062: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1063: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1064: if (
1065:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1066:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1067:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1068:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1069: ) return;
1070:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1071:     if (!point) return;
1072:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1073:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1074:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1075:     setDragSelection(selection);
1076:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1077:   }

1079:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1080:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1081:     if (edit) {
1082:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1083:       if (!point || !session) return;
1084:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1085:       patchSession((current) => {
1086:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1087:         return {
1088:           ...current,
1089:           candidatesByPage: {
1090:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1091:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1092:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1093:           },
1094:         };
1095:       });
1096:       return;
1097:     }
1098:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1099:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1100:     if (point) {
1101:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1102:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1103:       setDragSelection(selection);
1104:     }
1105:   }

1107:   function finishRegion() {
1108:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1109:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1110:       return;
1111:     }
1112:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1113:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1114:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1115:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1116:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1117:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1118:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1119:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1120:     setDragSelection(null);
1121:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1122:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1123:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1124:       x, y, width, height,
1125:       relativeScore: 1,
1126:       source: "manual",
1127:     };
1128:     patchSession((current) => ({
1129:       ...current,
1130:       candidatesByPage: {
1131:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1132:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1133:       },
1134:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1135:     }));
1136:     setManualMode(false);
1137:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1138:   }

1141:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1142:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1143:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1144:     setDragSelection(null);
1145:   }

1147:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1148:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1149:     try {
1150:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1151:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1152:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1153:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1154:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1155:       const scale = mode === "width"
1156:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1157:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1158:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1159:     } catch (cause) {
1160:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1161:     }
1162:   }

1422:                       [baseX - px * shaftHalfWidth, baseY - py * shaftHalfWidth],

  26: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  27:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  28:   if (!match) return uci;
  29:   try {
  30:     const position = new Chess(fen);
  31:     const move = position.move({
  32:       from: match[1] as Square,
  33:       to: match[2] as Square,
  34:       ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  35:     });
  36:     return move.san;
  37:   } catch {
  38:     return uci;
  39:   }
  40: }
  41: 
  42: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {
  43:   const position = new Chess(fen);
  44:   const san: string[] = [];
  45:   for (const uci of pv) {
  46:     const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  47:     if (!match) break;
  48:     try {
  49:       const move = position.move({
  50:         from: match[1] as Square,
  51:         to: match[2] as Square,
  52:         ...(match[3] ? { promotion: match[3] as "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" } : {}),
  53:       });
  54:       san.push(move.san);
  55:     } catch {
  56:       break;
  57:     }
  58:   }
  59:   return san.join(" ");
  60: }

 367:   function toggleEngine() {
 368:     if (engineEnabled) {
 369:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 370:       engineRef.current = null;
 371:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 372:       setEngineStatus("off");
 373:       setEngineScore(null);
 374:       setEngineMessage("");
 375:       return;
 376:     }
 377:     try {
 378:       setEngineScore(null);
 379:       setEngineMessage("");
 380:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 381:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 382:         (status, message) => {
 383:           setEngineStatus(status);
 384:           if (status === "error") {
 385:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 386:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 387:             setEngineScore(null);
 388:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 389:             engineRef.current = null;
 390:           }
 391:         },
 392:         setEngineScore,
 393:       );
 394:       engineRef.current = client;
 395:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 396:     } catch (cause) {
 397:       setEngineStatus("error");
 398:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 399:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 400:     }
 401:   }

 404:     setSession((current) => {

 406:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 407:     });

 415:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 416:     if (!studyMode) {
 417:       if (!session) {
 418:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 419:         return;
 420:       }
 421:       setStudyBoard({
 422:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 423:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 424:         moves: [...session.moves],
 425:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 426:         flipped: session.flipped,
 427:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 428:       });
 429:       setStudyMode(true);
 430:     } else {
 431:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 432:       if (studyBoard) {
 433:         patchSession({
 434:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 435:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 436:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 437:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 438:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 439:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 440:         });
 441:       }
 442:       setStudyMode(false);
 443:     }
 444:     setLastMove(null);
 445:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 446:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 447:   
 448:     try {
 449:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 450:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 451:       } else {
 452:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 453:       }
 454:     } catch {
 455:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 456:     }
 457: }

 459:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 460:     try {
 461:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 462:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 463:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 464:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 465:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 466:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 467:       setBook(opened);
 468:       setSession(nextSession);
 469:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 470:       setError("");
 471:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 472:     } catch (cause) {
 473:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 474:     }
 475:   }

 477:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 478:     if (!file) return;
 479:     try {
 480:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 481:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 482:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 483:       const now = Date.now();
 484:       const created: BookRecord = {
 485:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 486:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 487:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 488:         byteLength: file.size,
 489:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 490:         addedAt: now,
 491:       };
 492:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 493:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 494:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 495:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 496:       setBook(created);
 497:       setSession(blank);
 498:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 499:       setError("");
 500:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 501:     } catch (cause) {
 502:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 503:     }
 504:   }

 506:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 507:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 508: 
 509:     try {
 510:       await removeBook(item.id);
 511:       await removeSession(item.id);
 512: 
 513:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 514:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 515:         const next = { ...current };
 516:         delete next[item.id];
 517:         return next;
 518:       });
 519: 
 520:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 521:         setBook(null);
 522:         setSession(null);
 523:         setPdf(null);
 524:       }
 525: 
 526:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 527:       setError("");
 528:     } catch (cause) {
 529:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 530:     }
 531:   }
 532:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 533:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 534:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 535:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 536:     try {
 537:       await putBook(renamed);
 538:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 539:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 540:     } catch (cause) {
 541:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 542:     }
 543:   }

 555:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 556:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 557:     try {
 558:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 559:       setSession({
 560:         ...activeSession,
 561:         originalFen: fen,
 562:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 563:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 564:         moves: [],
 565:         moveIndex: 0,
 566:       });
 567:       setLastMove(null);
 568:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 569:       setUserArrows([]);
 570:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 571:       return true;
 572:     } catch (cause) {
 573:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 574:       return false;
 575:     }
 576:   }

 588:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
