 641:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 642:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 643:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 644:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 645:       return;
 646:     }
 647:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 648:     try {
 649:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 650:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 651:       preview.width = crop.width;
 652:       preview.height = crop.height;
 653:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 654:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 655:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 656:     } catch (cause) {
 657:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 658:       return;
 659:     }
 660:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 661:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 662:     setTransferFen("");
 663:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 664:         setRecognitionError("");
 665:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 666:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 667:     try {
 668:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 669:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 670:       });
 671:       const form = new FormData();
 672:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 673:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 674:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 675:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 676:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 677:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 678:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 679:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 680:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 681:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 682:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 683:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 684:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 685:       }
 686:     } catch (cause) {
 687:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 688:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 689:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 690:     }
 691:   }

 693:   function closeTransfer() {
 694:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 695:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 696:     setTransferPreview("");
 697:     setTransferFen("");
 698:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 699:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 700:     setRecognitionError("");
 701:       }

 704:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 705:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 706:       setGameEndOverlay({
 707:         title: "Checkmate",
 708:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 709:       });
 710:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 711:       setGameEndOverlay({
 712:         title: "Stalemate",
 713:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 714:       });
 715:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 716:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 717:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 718:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 719:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 720:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 721:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 722:     } else {
 723:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 724:     }
 725:   }

 727:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 728:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 729:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 730:     try {
 731:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 732:       const result = currentGame.move({
 733:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 734:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 735:         promotion: piece,
 736:       });
 737:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 738:       patchBoardSession({
 739:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 740:         moves: nextMoves,
 741:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 742:       });
 743:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 744:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 745:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 746:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 747:       setError("");
 748:     } catch {
 749:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 750:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 751:     }
 752:   }
 753: 
 754:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 755:     if (!boardSession) return;
 756:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 757:     try {
 758:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 759:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 760:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 761:       if (promote) {
 762:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 763:         return;
 764:       }
 765:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 766:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 767:       patchBoardSession({
 768:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 769:         moves: nextMoves,
 770:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 771:       });
 772:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 773:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 774:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 775:       setError("");
 776:     } catch {
 777:       const piece = game.get(to);
 778:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 779:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 780:     }
 781:   }

 783:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 784:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 785:     setRedSquares([]);
 786: 
 787:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 788:       setUserArrows([]);
 789:       setArrowStart(null);
 790:       setArrowHover(null);
 791:       return;
 792:     }
 793: if (!boardSession) return;
 794:     if (annotationMode) {
 795:       if (!arrowStart) {
 796:         setArrowStart(square);
 797:         return;
 798:       }
 799:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 800:       setArrowStart(null);
 801:       setArrowHover(null);
 802:       return;
 803:     }
 804:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 805:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 806:       return;
 807:     }
 808:     const piece = game.get(square);
 809:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 810:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 811:   }

 846:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 847:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 848: 
 849:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 850: 
 851:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 852:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 853:     event.clientX,
 854:     event.clientY,
 855:     bounds,
 856:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 857:   );
 858:

 860:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 861:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 862:   } else {
 863:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 864:   }
 865: 
 866:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 867:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;

 869:   setArrowHover(null);

 948:   async function detectBoards() {
 949:     if (detecting) {
 950:       stopBoardScan();
 951:       return;
 952:     }
 953: 
 954:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 955:     if (!API_BASE) {
 956:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 957:       return;
 958:     }
 959: 
 960:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 961:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 962:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 963:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 964: 
 965:     setDetecting(true);
 966:     setError("");
 967:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 968:     patchSession((current) => ({
 969:       ...current,
 970:       candidatesByPage: {
 971:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 972:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 973:       },
 974:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 975:     }));
 976: 
 977:     try {
 978:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 979:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 980:           (blob) => blob
 981:             ? resolve(blob)
 982:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 983:           "image/png",
 984:         );
 985:       });
 986: 
 987:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 988: 
 989:       const form = new FormData();
 990:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 991: 
 992:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 993:         method: "POST",
 994:         body: form,
 995:         signal: abortController.signal,
 996:       });
 997: 
 998:       if (!response.ok) {
 999:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1000:       }
1001: 
1002:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1003:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1004:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1005:       );
1006: 
1007:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1008: 
1009:       patchSession((current) => ({
1010:         ...current,
1011:         candidatesByPage: {
1012:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1013:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1014:         },
1015:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1016:       }));
1017: 
1018:       setNotice(
1019:         candidates.length
1020:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1021:           : "No board candidates found.",
1022:       );
1023:     } catch (cause) {
1024:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1025: 
1026:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1027:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1028:       } else {
1029:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1030:       }
1031:     } finally {
1032:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1033:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1034:         setDetecting(false);
1035:       }
1036:     }
1037:   }

1056:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1057:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1058:     if (!manualMode) return;
1059: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1060: if (!canvas) return;
1061: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1062: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1063: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1064: if (
1065:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1066:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1067:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1068:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1069: ) return;
1070:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1071:     if (!point) return;
1072:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1073:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1074:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1075:     setDragSelection(selection);
1076:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1077:   }

1079:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1080:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1081:     if (edit) {
1082:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1083:       if (!point || !session) return;
1084:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1085:       patchSession((current) => {
1086:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1087:         return {
1088:           ...current,
1089:           candidatesByPage: {
1090:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1091:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1092:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1093:           },
1094:         };
1095:       });
1096:       return;
1097:     }
1098:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1099:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1100:     if (point) {
1101:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1102:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1103:       setDragSelection(selection);
1104:     }
1105:   }

1107:   function finishRegion() {
1108:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1109:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1110:       return;
1111:     }
1112:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1113:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1114:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1115:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1116:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1117:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1118:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1119:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1120:     setDragSelection(null);
1121:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1122:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1123:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1124:       x, y, width, height,
1125:       relativeScore: 1,
1126:       source: "manual",
1127:     };
1128:     patchSession((current) => ({
1129:       ...current,
1130:       candidatesByPage: {
1131:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1132:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1133:       },
1134:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1135:     }));
1136:     setManualMode(false);
1137:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1138:   }

1147:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1148:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1149:     try {
1150:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1151:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1152:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1153:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1154:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1155:       const scale = mode === "width"
1156:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1157:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1158:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1159:     } catch (cause) {
1160:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1161:     }
1162:   }

 370:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 371:     });
 372:   }
 373: 
 374:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 375:     try {
 376:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 377:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 378:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 379:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 380:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 381:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 382:       setBook(opened);
 383:       setSession(nextSession);
 384:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 385:       setError("");
 386:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 387:     } catch (cause) {
 388:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 389:     }
 390:   }
 391: 
 392:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 393:     if (!file) return;
 394:     try {
 395:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 396:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 397:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 398:       const now = Date.now();
 399:       const created: BookRecord = {
 400:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 401:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 402:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 403:         byteLength: file.size,
 404:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 405:         addedAt: now,
 406:       };
 407:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 408:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 409:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 410:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 411:       setBook(created);
 412:       setSession(blank);
 413:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 414:       setError("");
 415:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 416:     } catch (cause) {
 417:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 418:     }
 419:   }
 420: 
 421:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 422:     if (!window.confirm(`Remove â€œ${item.title}â€ and its local PDF from this browser? Cloud copies are not affected.`)) return;
 423:     try {
 424:       await Promise.all([removeBook(item.id), removeSession(item.id)]);
 425:       const remaining = books.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== item.id).sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt);
 426:       setBooks(remaining);
 427:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 428:         const next = { ...current };
 429:         delete next[item.id];
 430:         return next;
 431:       });
 432:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 433:         const nextBook = remaining[0] ?? null;
 434:         setBook(nextBook);
 435:         setSession(nextBook ? sessionIndex[nextBook.id] ?? newSession(nextBook.id) : null);
 436:         await setActiveBookId(nextBook?.id ?? null);
 437:       }
 438:     } catch (cause) {
 439:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 440:     }
 441:   }
 442: 
 443:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 444:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 445:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 446:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 447:     try {
 448:       await putBook(renamed);
 449:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 450:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 451:     } catch (cause) {
 452:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 453:     }
 454:   }

 536:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 537:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 538:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 539:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 540:       return;
 541:     }
 542:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 543:     try {
 544:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 545:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 546:       preview.width = crop.width;
 547:       preview.height = crop.height;
 548:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 549:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 550:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 551:     } catch (cause) {
 552:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 553:       return;
 554:     }
 555:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 556:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 557:     setTransferFen("");
 558:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 559:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 560:     setRecognitionError("");
 561:     setTransferPiece("P");
 562:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 563:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 564:     try {
 565:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 566:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 567:       });
 568:       const form = new FormData();
 569:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 570:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 571:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 572:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 573:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 574:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 575:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 576:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 577:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 578:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 579:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 580:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 581:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 582:       }
 583:     } catch (cause) {
 584:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 585:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 586:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 587:     }
 588:   }
 589: 
 590:   function closeTransfer() {
 591:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 592:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 593:     setTransferPreview("");
 594:     setTransferFen("");
 595:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 596:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 597:     setRecognitionError("");
 598:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 599:   }

 601:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 602:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 603:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 604:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 605:       return;
 606:     }
 607:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 608:     if (!board) {
 609:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 610:       return;
 611:     }
 612:     const row = displayRow;
 613:     const col = displayCol;
 614:     try {
 615:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 616:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 617:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 618:       setRecognitionError("");
 619:     } catch (cause) {
 620:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 621:     }
 622:   }
 623: 
 624:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 625:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 626:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 627:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 628:       return;
 629:     }
 630:     try {
 631:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 632:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 633:       setRecognitionError("");
 634:     } catch (cause) {
 635:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 636:     }
 637:   }
 638: 
 639:   function confirmTransfer() {
 640:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 641:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 642:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 643:       return;
 644:     }
 645:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 646:       closeTransfer();
 647:     }
 648:   }
 649: 
 650:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 651:     if (!session) return;
 652:     try {
 653:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 654:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 655:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 656:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 657:       if (promote) {
 658:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 659:         if (!choice) return;
 660:         switch (choice) {
 661:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 662:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 663:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 664:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 665:           default:
 666:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 667:             return;
 668:         }
 669:       }
 670:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 671:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 672:       patchSession({
 673:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 674:         moves: nextMoves,
 675:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 676:       });
 677:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 678:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 679:       setError("");
 680:     } catch {
 681:       const piece = game.get(to);
 682:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 683:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 684:     }
 685:   }
 686: 
 687:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 688:     if (!session) return;
 689:     if (annotationMode) {
 690:       if (!arrowStart) {
 691:         setArrowStart(square);
 692:         return;
 693:       }
 694:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 695:       setArrowStart(null);
 696:       setArrowHover(null);
 697:       return;
 698:     }
 699:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 700:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 701:       return;
 702:     }
 703:     const piece = game.get(square);
 704:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 705:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 706:   }

 713:     if (!square) return;

 766:   async function detectBoards() {
 767:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 768:     if (!API_BASE) {
 769:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Start the optional CV service and set VITE_API_BASE_URL, or draw a board region manually.");
 770:       return;
 771:     }
 772:     setDetecting(true);
 773:     setError("");
 774:     try {
 775:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 776:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")), "image/png");
 777:       });
 778:       const form = new FormData();
 779:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 780:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 781:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 782:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 783:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map((item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index));
 784:       patchSession((current) => ({
 785:         ...current,
 786:         candidatesByPage: { ...current.candidatesByPage, [String(current.page)]: candidates },
 787:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 788:       }));
 789:       setNotice(candidates.length ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Review each candidate; recognition is manual.` : "No board candidates found. You can draw a region manually.");
 790:     } catch (cause) {
 791:       setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 792:     } finally {
 793:       setDetecting(false);
 794:     }
 795:   }

 802:   function startCropEdit(
 803:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 804:     candidate: Candidate,
 805:     handle: CropHandle,
 806:   ) {
 807:     event.stopPropagation();

 815:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 816:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 817:     if (!manualMode || event.target !== canvasRef.current) return;
 818:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 819:     if (!point) return;
 820:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 821:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 822:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 823:     setDragSelection(selection);
 824:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 825:   }
 826: 
 827:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 828:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 829:     if (edit) {
 830:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 831:       if (!point || !session) return;
 832:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 833:       patchSession((current) => {
 834:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 835:         return {
 836:           ...current,
 837:           candidatesByPage: {
 838:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 839:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 840:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 841:           },
 842:         };
 843:       });
 844:       return;
 845:     }
 846:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 847:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 848:     if (point) {
 849:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 850:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 851:       setDragSelection(selection);
 852:     }
 853:   }
 854: 
 855:   function finishRegion() {
 856:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 857:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 858:       return;
 859:     }
 860:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 861:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 862:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 863:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 864:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 865:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 866:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 867:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 868:     setDragSelection(null);
 869:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 870:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 871:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 872:       x, y, width, height,
 873:       relativeScore: 1,
 874:       source: "manual",
 875:     };
 876:     patchSession((current) => ({
 877:       ...current,
 878:       candidatesByPage: {
 879:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 880:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
 881:       },
 882:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
 883:     }));
 884:     setManualMode(false);
 885:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
 886:   }
 887: 
 888:   function cancelRegion() {
 889:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 890:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 891:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 892:     setDragSelection(null);
 893:   }

 895:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
 896:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
 897:     try {
 898:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
 899:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
 900:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
 901:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
 902:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
 903:       const scale = mode === "width"
 904:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
 905:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
 906:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
 907:     } catch (cause) {
 908:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 909:     }
 910:   }

 917:       else await target.requestFullscreen();
 918:     } catch (cause) {
 919:       setError(`Could not expand chessboard: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 920:     }
 921:   }

 923:   function saveBookmark() {
 924:     if (!session) return;
 925:     patchSession((current) => ({
 926:       ...current,
 927:       bookmarks: current.bookmarks.includes(current.page)

 315:     setUserArrows([]);
 316:     setArrowStart(null);
 317:     setArrowHover(null);
 318:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 319:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);

 323:   }, [engineEnabled, session?.currentFen, session?.moveIndex, engineDepth]);

 325:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 326:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 327:   }
 328: 
 329:   function toggleEngine() {
 330:     if (engineEnabled) {
 331:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 332:       engineRef.current = null;
 333:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 334:       setEngineStatus("off");
 335:       setEngineScore(null);
 336:       setEngineMessage("");
 337:       return;
 338:     }
 339:     try {
 340:       setEngineScore(null);
 341:       setEngineMessage("");
 342:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 343:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 344:         (status, message) => {
 345:           setEngineStatus(status);
 346:           if (status === "error") {
 347:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 348:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 349:             setEngineScore(null);
 350:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 351:             engineRef.current = null;
 352:           }
 353:         },
 354:         setEngineScore,
 355:       );
 356:       engineRef.current = client;
 357:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 358:     } catch (cause) {
 359:       setEngineStatus("error");
 360:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 361:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 362:     }
 363:   }

 365:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 366:     setSession((current) => {
 367:       if (!current) return current;
 368:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 369:     });
 370:   }

 372:   function patchBoardSession(change: Partial<StudyBoardState>) {
 373:     if (studyMode) setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 374:     else patchSession(change);
 375:   }

 378:     if (!studyMode) {
 379:       if (!session) {

 386:         moves: [...session.moves],
 387:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 388:         flipped: session.flipped,
 389:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 390:       });
 391:       setStudyMode(true);
 392:     } else {

 397:     setPromotionRequest(null);

 400:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 401:     try {
 402:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 403:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 404:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 405:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 406:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 407:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 408:       setBook(opened);
 409:       setSession(nextSession);
 410:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 411:       setError("");
 412:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 413:     } catch (cause) {
 414:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 415:     }
 416:   }
 417: 
 418:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 419:     if (!file) return;
 420:     try {
 421:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 422:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 423:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 424:       const now = Date.now();
 425:       const created: BookRecord = {
 426:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 427:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 428:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 429:         byteLength: file.size,
 430:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 431:         addedAt: now,
 432:       };
 433:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 434:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 435:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 436:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 437:       setBook(created);
 438:       setSession(blank);
 439:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 440:       setError("");
 441:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 442:     } catch (cause) {
 443:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 444:     }
 445:   }

 447:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 448:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 449: 
 450:     try {
 451:       await removeBook(item.id);
 452:       await removeSession(item.id);
 453: 
 454:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 455:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 456:         const next = { ...current };
 457:         delete next[item.id];
 458:         return next;
 459:       });
 460: 
 461:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 462:         setBook(null);
 463:         setSession(null);
 464:         setPdf(null);
 465:       }
 466: 
 467:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 468:       setError("");
 469:     } catch (cause) {
 470:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 471:     }
 472:   }
 473:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 474:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 475:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 476:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 477:     try {
 478:       await putBook(renamed);
 479:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 480:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 481:     } catch (cause) {
 482:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 483:     }
 484:   }

 493:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });

 496:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 497:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 498:     try {
 499:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 500:       setSession({
 501:         ...activeSession,
 502:         originalFen: fen,
 503:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 504:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 505:         moves: [],
 506:         moveIndex: 0,
 507:       });
 508:       setLastMove(null);
 509:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 510:       setUserArrows([]);
 511:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 512:       return true;
 513:     } catch (cause) {
 514:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 515:       return false;
 516:     }
 517:   }

 526:     } else {

 528:     }
 529:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 530:     return true;

 582:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 583:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 584:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 585:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 586:       return;
 587:     }
 588:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 589:     try {
 590:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 591:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 592:       preview.width = crop.width;
 593:       preview.height = crop.height;
 594:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 595:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 596:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 597:     } catch (cause) {
 598:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 599:       return;
 600:     }
 601:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 602:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 603:     setTransferFen("");
 604:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 605:         setRecognitionError("");
 606:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 607:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 608:     try {
 609:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 610:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 611:       });
 612:       const form = new FormData();
 613:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 614:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 615:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 616:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 617:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 618:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 619:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 620:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 621:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 622:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 623:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 624:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 625:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 626:       }
 627:     } catch (cause) {
 628:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 629:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 630:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 631:     }
 632:   }

 634:   function closeTransfer() {
 635:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 636:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 637:     setTransferPreview("");
 638:     setTransferFen("");
 639:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 640:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 641:     setRecognitionError("");
 642:       }

 645:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 646:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 647:       setGameEndOverlay({
 648:         title: "Checkmate",
 649:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 650:       });
 651:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 652:       setGameEndOverlay({
 653:         title: "Stalemate",
 654:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 655:       });
 656:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 657:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 658:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 659:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 660:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 661:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 662:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 663:     } else {
 664:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 665:     }
 666:   }

 668:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 669:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 670:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 671:     try {
 672:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 673:       const result = currentGame.move({
 674:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 675:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 676:         promotion: piece,
 677:       });
 678:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 679:       patchBoardSession({
 680:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 681:         moves: nextMoves,
 682:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 683:       });
 684:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 685:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 686:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 687:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 688:       setError("");
 689:     } catch {
 690:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 691:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 692:     }
 693:   }
 694: 
 695:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 696:     if (!boardSession) return;
 697:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 698:     try {
 699:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 700:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 701:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 702:       if (promote) {
 703:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 704:         return;
 705:       }
 706:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 707:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 708:       patchBoardSession({
 709:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 710:         moves: nextMoves,
 711:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 712:       });
 713:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 714:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 715:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 716:       setError("");
 717:     } catch {
 718:       const piece = game.get(to);
 719:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 720:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 721:     }
 722:   }

 724:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 725:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 726:     setRedSquares([]);
 727: 
 728:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 729:       setUserArrows([]);
 730:       setArrowStart(null);
 731:       setArrowHover(null);
 732:       return;
 733:     }
 734: if (!session) return;
 735:     if (annotationMode) {
 736:       if (!arrowStart) {
 737:         setArrowStart(square);
 738:         return;
 739:       }
 740:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 741:       setArrowStart(null);
 742:       setArrowHover(null);
 743:       return;
 744:     }
 745:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 746:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 747:       return;
 748:     }
 749:     const piece = game.get(square);
 750:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 751:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 752:   }

 754:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 755:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 756: 
 757:   event.preventDefault();
 758: 
 759:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 760:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 761:     event.clientX,
 762:     event.clientY,
 763:     bounds,
 764:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 765:   );
 766: 
 767:   if (!square) return;
 768: 
 769:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 770:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 771:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 772:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 773:   setArrowStart(square);
 774:   setArrowHover(square);
 775: 
 776:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 777: }
 778: 
 779:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 780:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 781:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 782:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 783:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 784:     setArrowHover(square);
 785:   }
 786: 
 787:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 788:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 789: 
 790:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 791: 
 792:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 793:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 794:     event.clientX,
 795:     event.clientY,
 796:     bounds,
 797:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 798:   );
 799: 
 800:   if (to && to !== from) {
 801:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 802:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 803:   } else {
 804:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 805:   }
 806: 
 807:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 808:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 809:   setArrowStart(null);
 810:   setArrowHover(null);
 811: }

 863:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 864:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;

 867:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;

 873:     setCropEditingId(null);

 876:

 878:       ...current,

 880:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 881:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 882:       },

 889:   async function detectBoards() {
 890:     if (detecting) {
 891:       stopBoardScan();
 892:       return;
 893:     }
 894: 
 895:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 896:     if (!API_BASE) {
 897:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 898:       return;
 899:     }
 900: 
 901:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 902:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 903:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 904:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 905: 
 906:     setDetecting(true);
 907:     setError("");
 908:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 909:     patchSession((current) => ({
 910:       ...current,
 911:       candidatesByPage: {
 912:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 913:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 914:       },
 915:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 916:     }));
 917: 
 918:     try {
 919:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 920:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 921:           (blob) => blob
 922:             ? resolve(blob)
 923:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 924:           "image/png",
 925:         );
 926:       });
 927: 
 928:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 929: 
 930:       const form = new FormData();
 931:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 932: 
 933:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 934:         method: "POST",
 935:         body: form,
 936:         signal: abortController.signal,
 937:       });
 938: 
 939:       if (!response.ok) {
 940:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 941:       }
 942: 
 943:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 944:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 945:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 946:       );
 947: 
 948:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 949: 
 950:       patchSession((current) => ({
 951:         ...current,
 952:         candidatesByPage: {
 953:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 954:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 955:         },
 956:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 957:       }));
 958: 
 959:       setNotice(
 960:         candidates.length
 961:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 962:           : "No board candidates found.",
 963:       );
 964:     } catch (cause) {
 965:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 966: 
 967:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 968:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 969:       } else {
 970:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 971:       }
 972:     } finally {
 973:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 974:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 975:         setDetecting(false);
 976:       }
 977:     }
 978:   }
 979:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
 980:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
 981:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
 982:   }

 984:   function startCropEdit(
 985:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 986:     candidate: Candidate,
 987:     handle: CropHandle,
 988:   ) {
 989:     event.stopPropagation();
 990:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 991:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
 992:     if (!point || !stage) return;
 993:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
 994:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 995:   }

 997:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 998:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 999:     if (!manualMode) return;
1000: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1001: if (!canvas) return;
1002: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1003: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1004: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1005: if (
1006:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1007:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1008:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1009:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1010: ) return;
1011:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1012:     if (!point) return;
1013:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1014:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1015:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1016:     setDragSelection(selection);
1017:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1018:   }

1020:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1021:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1022:     if (edit) {
1023:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1024:       if (!point || !session) return;
1025:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1026:       patchSession((current) => {
1027:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1028:         return {
1029:           ...current,
1030:           candidatesByPage: {
1031:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1032:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1033:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1034:           },
1035:         };
1036:       });
1037:       return;
1038:     }
1039:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1040:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1041:     if (point) {
1042:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1043:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1044:       setDragSelection(selection);
1045:     }
1046:   }

1048:   function finishRegion() {
1049:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1050:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1051:       return;
1052:     }
1053:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1054:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1055:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1056:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1057:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1058:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1059:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1060:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1061:     setDragSelection(null);
1062:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1063:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1064:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1065:       x, y, width, height,
1066:       relativeScore: 1,
1067:       source: "manual",
1068:     };
1069:     patchSession((current) => ({
1070:       ...current,
1071:       candidatesByPage: {
1072:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1073:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1074:       },
1075:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1076:     }));
1077:     setManualMode(false);
1078:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1079:   }
1080: 
1081:   function cancelRegion() {
1082:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1083:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1084:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1085:     setDragSelection(null);
1086:   }

1088:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1089:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1090:     try {
1091:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1092:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1093:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1094:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1095:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1096:       const scale = mode === "width"
1097:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1098:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1099:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1100:     } catch (cause) {
1101:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1102:     }
1103:   }

 329:   function toggleEngine() {
 330:     if (engineEnabled) {
 331:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 332:       engineRef.current = null;
 333:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 334:       setEngineStatus("off");
 335:       setEngineScore(null);
 336:       setEngineMessage("");
 337:       return;
 338:     }
 339:     try {
 340:       setEngineScore(null);
 341:       setEngineMessage("");
 342:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 343:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 344:         (status, message) => {
 345:           setEngineStatus(status);
 346:           if (status === "error") {
 347:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 348:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 349:             setEngineScore(null);
 350:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 351:             engineRef.current = null;
 352:           }
 353:         },
 354:         setEngineScore,
 355:       );
 356:       engineRef.current = client;
 357:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 358:     } catch (cause) {
 359:       setEngineStatus("error");
 360:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 361:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 362:     }
 363:   }

 400:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 401:     try {
 402:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 403:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 404:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 405:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 406:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 407:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 408:       setBook(opened);
 409:       setSession(nextSession);
 410:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 411:       setError("");
 412:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 413:     } catch (cause) {
 414:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 415:     }

 418:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 419:     if (!file) return;
 420:     try {
 421:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 422:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 423:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 424:       const now = Date.now();
 425:       const created: BookRecord = {
 426:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 427:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 428:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 429:         byteLength: file.size,
 430:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 431:         addedAt: now,
 432:       };
 433:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 434:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 435:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 436:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 437:       setBook(created);
 438:       setSession(blank);
 439:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 440:       setError("");
 441:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 442:     } catch (cause) {
 443:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 444:     }
 445:   }

 447:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 448:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 449: 
 450:     try {
 451:       await removeBook(item.id);
 452:       await removeSession(item.id);
 453: 
 454:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 455:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 456:         const next = { ...current };
 457:         delete next[item.id];
 458:         return next;
 459:       });
 460: 
 461:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 462:         setBook(null);
 463:         setSession(null);
 464:         setPdf(null);
 465:       }
 466: 
 467:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 468:       setError("");
 469:     } catch (cause) {
 470:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 471:     }
 472:   }
 473:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 474:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 475:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 476:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 477:     try {
 478:       await putBook(renamed);
 479:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 480:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 481:     } catch (cause) {
 482:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 483:     }
 484:   }

 496:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 497:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 498:     try {
 499:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 500:       setSession({
 501:         ...activeSession,
 502:         originalFen: fen,
 503:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 504:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 505:         moves: [],
 506:         moveIndex: 0,
 507:       });
 508:       setLastMove(null);
 509:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 510:       setUserArrows([]);
 511:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 512:       return true;
 513:     } catch (cause) {
 514:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 515:       return false;
 516:     }
 517:   }

 582:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 583:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 584:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 585:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 586:       return;
 587:     }
 588:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 589:     try {
 590:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 591:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 592:       preview.width = crop.width;
 593:       preview.height = crop.height;
 594:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 595:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 596:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 597:     } catch (cause) {
 598:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 599:       return;
 600:     }
 601:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 602:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 603:     setTransferFen("");
 604:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 605:         setRecognitionError("");
 606:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 607:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 608:     try {
 609:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 610:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 611:       });
 612:       const form = new FormData();
 613:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 614:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 615:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 616:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 617:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 618:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 619:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 620:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 621:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 622:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 623:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 624:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 625:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 626:       }
 627:     } catch (cause) {
 628:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 629:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 630:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 631:     }
 632:   }
 633: 
 634:   function closeTransfer() {
 635:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 636:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 637:     setTransferPreview("");
 638:     setTransferFen("");
 639:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 640:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 641:     setRecognitionError("");
 642:       }

 645:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 646:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 647:       setGameEndOverlay({
 648:         title: "Checkmate",
 649:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 650:       });
 651:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 652:       setGameEndOverlay({
 653:         title: "Stalemate",
 654:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 655:       });
 656:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 657:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 658:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 659:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 660:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 661:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 662:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 663:     } else {
 664:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 665:     }
 666:   }
 667: 
 668:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 669:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 670:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 671:     try {
 672:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 673:       const result = currentGame.move({
 674:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 675:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 676:         promotion: piece,
 677:       });
 678:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 679:       patchBoardSession({
 680:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 681:         moves: nextMoves,
 682:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 683:       });
 684:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 685:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 686:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 687:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 688:       setError("");
 689:     } catch {
 690:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 691:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 692:     }
 693:   }
 694: 
 695:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 696:     if (!boardSession) return;
 697:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 698:     try {
 699:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 700:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 701:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 702:       if (promote) {
 703:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 704:         return;
 705:       }
 706:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 707:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 708:       patchBoardSession({
 709:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 710:         moves: nextMoves,
 711:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 712:       });
 713:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 714:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 715:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 716:       setError("");
 717:     } catch {
 718:       const piece = game.get(to);
 719:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 720:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 721:     }
 722:   }
 723: 
 724:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 725:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 726:     setRedSquares([]);
 727: 
 728:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 729:       setUserArrows([]);
 730:       setArrowStart(null);
 731:       setArrowHover(null);
 732:       return;
 733:     }
 734: if (!boardSession) return;
 735:     if (annotationMode) {
 736:       if (!arrowStart) {
 737:         setArrowStart(square);
 738:         return;
 739:       }
 740:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 741:       setArrowStart(null);
 742:       setArrowHover(null);
 743:       return;
 744:     }
 745:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 746:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 747:       return;
 748:     }
 749:     const piece = game.get(square);
 750:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 751:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 752:   }

 764:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 765:   );

 787:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {

 791: 
 792:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();

 794:     event.clientX,
 795:     event.clientY,
 796:     bounds,
 797:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 798:   );
 799:

 801:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));

 803:   } else {
 804:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 805:   }
 806:

 808:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;

 889:   async function detectBoards() {
 890:     if (detecting) {
 891:       stopBoardScan();
 892:       return;
 893:     }
 894: 
 895:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 896:     if (!API_BASE) {
 897:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 898:       return;
 899:     }
 900: 
 901:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 902:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 903:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 904:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 905: 
 906:     setDetecting(true);
 907:     setError("");
 908:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 909:     patchSession((current) => ({
 910:       ...current,
 911:       candidatesByPage: {
 912:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 913:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 914:       },
 915:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 916:     }));
 917: 
 918:     try {
 919:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 920:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 921:           (blob) => blob
 922:             ? resolve(blob)
 923:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 924:           "image/png",
 925:         );
 926:       });
 927: 
 928:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 929: 
 930:       const form = new FormData();
 931:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 932: 
 933:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 934:         method: "POST",
 935:         body: form,
 936:         signal: abortController.signal,
 937:       });
 938: 
 939:       if (!response.ok) {
 940:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 941:       }
 942: 
 943:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 944:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 945:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 946:       );
 947: 
 948:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 949: 
 950:       patchSession((current) => ({
 951:         ...current,
 952:         candidatesByPage: {
 953:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 954:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 955:         },
 956:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 957:       }));
 958: 
 959:       setNotice(
 960:         candidates.length
 961:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 962:           : "No board candidates found.",
 963:       );
 964:     } catch (cause) {
 965:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 966: 
 967:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 968:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 969:       } else {
 970:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 971:       }
 972:     } finally {
 973:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 974:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 975:         setDetecting(false);
 976:       }
 977:     }
 978:   }

 997:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 998:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 999:     if (!manualMode) return;
1000: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1001: if (!canvas) return;
1002: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1003: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1004: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1005: if (
1006:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1007:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1008:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1009:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1010: ) return;

1020:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1021:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1022:     if (edit) {
1023:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1024:       if (!point || !session) return;
1025:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1026:       patchSession((current) => {
1027:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1028:         return {
1029:           ...current,

1031:             ...current.candidatesByPage,

1033:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1034:           },
1035:         };
1036:       });
1037:       return;
1038:     }
1039:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1040:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1041:     if (point) {
1042:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };

1048:   function finishRegion() {
1049:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1050:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1051:       return;
1052:     }
1053:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1054:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1055:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1056:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1057:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1058:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1059:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1060:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1061:     setDragSelection(null);
1062:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1063:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1064:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1065:       x, y, width, height,
1066:       relativeScore: 1,
1067:       source: "manual",
1068:     };
1069:     patchSession((current) => ({
1070:       ...current,
1071:       candidatesByPage: {
1072:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1073:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1074:       },
1075:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1076:     }));
1077:     setManualMode(false);
1078:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1079:   }
