1088:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1089:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1090:     try {
1091:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1092:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1093:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1094:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1095:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1096:       const scale = mode === "width"
1097:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1098:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1099:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1100:     } catch (cause) {
1101:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1102:     }
1103:   }

  27: function formatUciMove(fen: string, uci: string): string {
  28:   const match = /^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/.exec(uci);
  29:   if (!match) return uci;

  36:     });

  38:   } catch {

  40:   }

  43: function formatUciPv(fen: string, pv: string[]): string {

  55:       san.push(move.san);
  56:     } catch {

  58:     }
  59:   }

  83: function readableDate(timestamp: number): string {
  84:   if (!timestamp) return "Not opened";
  85:   const elapsed = Date.now() - timestamp;

 450:       setStudyBoard((current) => current ? { ...current, ...change } : current);
 451:     } else {
 452:       patchSession(change);
 453:     }
 454:   }
 455: 
 456:   async function toggleStudyMode() {
 457:     if (!studyMode) {
 458:       if (!session) {
 459:         setError("Open a book before entering study mode.");
 460:         return;
 461:       }
 462:       setStudyBoard({
 463:         lineBaseFen: session.lineBaseFen,
 464:         currentFen: session.currentFen,
 465:         moves: [...session.moves],
 466:         moveIndex: session.moveIndex,
 467:         flipped: session.flipped,
 468:         coordinates: session.coordinates,
 469:       });
 470:       setStudyMode(true);
 471:     } else {
 472:       // Preserve the latest Focus Mode board when returning to normal mode.
 473:       if (studyBoard) {
 474:         patchSession({
 475:           lineBaseFen: studyBoard.lineBaseFen,
 476:           currentFen: studyBoard.currentFen,
 477:           moves: [...studyBoard.moves],
 478:           moveIndex: studyBoard.moveIndex,
 479:           flipped: studyBoard.flipped,
 480:           coordinates: studyBoard.coordinates,
 481:         });
 482:       }
 483:       setStudyMode(false);
 484:     }
 485:     setLastMove(null);
 486:     setSelectedSquare(null);
 487:     setPromotionRequest(null);
 488:   
 489:     try {
 490:       if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
 491:         await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
 492:       } else {
 493:         await document.exitFullscreen();
 494:       }
 495:     } catch {
 496:       // Focus layout still works when browser fullscreen is blocked.
 497:     }
 498: }

 500:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 501:     try {
 502:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 503:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 504:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 505:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 506:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 507:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 508:       setBook(opened);
 509:       setSession(nextSession);
 510:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 511:       setError("");
 512:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 513:     } catch (cause) {
 514:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 515:     }
 516:   }
 517: 
 518:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 519:     if (!file) return;
 520:     try {
 521:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 522:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 523:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 524:       const now = Date.now();
 525:       const created: BookRecord = {
 526:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 527:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 528:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 529:         byteLength: file.size,
 530:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 531:         addedAt: now,
 532:       };
 533:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 534:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 535:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 536:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 537:       setBook(created);
 538:       setSession(blank);
 539:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 540:       setError("");
 541:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 542:     } catch (cause) {
 543:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 544:     }
 545:   }
 546: 
 547:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 548:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 549: 
 550:     try {
 551:       await removeBook(item.id);
 552:       await removeSession(item.id);
 553: 
 554:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 555:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 556:         const next = { ...current };
 557:         delete next[item.id];
 558:         return next;
 559:       });
 560: 
 561:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 562:         setBook(null);
 563:         setSession(null);
 564:         setPdf(null);
 565:       }
 566: 
 567:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 568:       setError("");
 569:     } catch (cause) {
 570:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 571:     }
 572:   }
 573:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 574:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 575:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 576:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 577:     try {
 578:       await putBook(renamed);
 579:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 580:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 581:     } catch (cause) {
 582:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 583:     }
 584:   }

 596:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 597:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 598:     try {
 599:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 600:       setSession({
 601:         ...activeSession,
 602:         originalFen: fen,
 603:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 604:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 605:         moves: [],
 606:         moveIndex: 0,
 607:       });
 608:       setLastMove(null);
 609:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 610:       setUserArrows([]);
 611:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 612:       return true;
 613:     } catch (cause) {
 614:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 615:       return false;
 616:     }
 617:   }

 682:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 683:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 684:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 685:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 686:       return;
 687:     }
 688:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 689:     try {
 690:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 691:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 692:       preview.width = crop.width;
 693:       preview.height = crop.height;
 694:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 695:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 696:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 697:     } catch (cause) {
 698:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 699:       return;
 700:     }
 701:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 702:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 703:     setTransferFen("");
 704:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 705:         setRecognitionError("");
 706:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 707:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 708:     try {
 709:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 710:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 711:       });
 712:       const form = new FormData();
 713:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 714:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 715:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 716:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 717:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 718:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 719:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 720:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 721:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 722:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 723:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 724:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 725:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 726:       }
 727:     } catch (cause) {
 728:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 729:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 730:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 731:     }
 732:   }
 733: 
 734:   function closeTransfer() {
 735:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 736:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 737:     setTransferPreview("");
 738:     setTransferFen("");
 739:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 740:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 741:     setRecognitionError("");
 742:       }

 745:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 746:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 747:       setGameEndOverlay({
 748:         title: "Checkmate",
 749:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 750:       });
 751:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 752:       setGameEndOverlay({
 753:         title: "Stalemate",
 754:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 755:       });
 756:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 757:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 758:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 759:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 760:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 761:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 762:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 763:     } else {
 764:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 765:     }
 766:   }

 768:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 769:     if (!promotionRequest || !boardSession) return;
 770:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 771:     try {
 772:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 773:       const result = currentGame.move({
 774:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 775:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 776:         promotion: piece,
 777:       });
 778:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 779:       patchBoardSession({
 780:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 781:         moves: nextMoves,
 782:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 783:       });
 784:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 785:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 786:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 787:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 788:       setError("");
 789:     } catch {
 790:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 791:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 792:     }
 793:   }
 794: 
 795:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 796:     if (!boardSession) return;
 797:     const activeBoard = boardSession;
 798:     try {
 799:       const currentGame = new Chess(activeBoard.currentFen);
 800:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 801:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 802:       if (promote) {
 803:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 804:         return;
 805:       }
 806:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 807:       const nextMoves = [...activeBoard.moves.slice(0, activeBoard.moveIndex), result.san];
 808:       patchBoardSession({
 809:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 810:         moves: nextMoves,
 811:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 812:       });
 813:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 814:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 815:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 816:       setError("");
 817:     } catch {
 818:       const piece = game.get(to);
 819:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 820:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 821:     }
 822:   }
 823: 
 824:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 825:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 826:     setRedSquares([]);
 827: 
 828:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 829:       setUserArrows([]);
 830:       setArrowStart(null);
 831:       setArrowHover(null);
 832:       return;
 833:     }
 834: if (!boardSession) return;
 835:     if (annotationMode) {
 836:       if (!arrowStart) {
 837:         setArrowStart(square);
 838:         return;
 839:       }
 840:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 841:       setArrowStart(null);
 842:       setArrowHover(null);
 843:       return;
 844:     }
 845:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 846:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 847:       return;
 848:     }
 849:     const piece = game.get(square);
 850:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 851:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 852:   }

 854:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 855:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 856: 
 857:   event.preventDefault();
 858: 
 859:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 860:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 861:     event.clientX,
 862:     event.clientY,
 863:     bounds,
 864:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 865:   );
 866: 
 867:   if (!square) return;
 868: 
 869:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 870:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 871:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 872:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 873:   setArrowStart(square);
 874:   setArrowHover(square);
 875: 
 876:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 877: }
 878: 
 879:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 880:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 881:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 882:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(boardSession?.flipped));
 883:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 884:     setArrowHover(square);
 885:   }
 886: 
 887:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 888:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 889: 
 890:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 891: 
 892:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 893:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 894:     event.clientX,
 895:     event.clientY,
 896:     bounds,
 897:     Boolean(boardSession?.flipped),
 898:   );
 899: 
 900:   if (to && to !== from) {
 901:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 902:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 903:   } else {
 904:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 905:   }
 906: 
 907:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 908:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 909:   setArrowStart(null);
 910:   setArrowHover(null);
 911: }

 963:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 964:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 965:

 967:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;

 973:     setCropEditingId(null);
 974:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 975:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 976: 
 977:     patchSession((current) => ({
 978:       ...current,
 979:       candidatesByPage: {
 980:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 981:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 982:       },
 983:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 984:     }));

 989:   async function detectBoards() {
 990:     if (detecting) {
 991:       stopBoardScan();
 992:       return;
 993:     }
 994: 
 995:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 996:     if (!API_BASE) {
 997:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 998:       return;
 999:     }
1000: 
1001:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
1002:     const abortController = new AbortController();
1003:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
1004:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
1005: 
1006:     setDetecting(true);
1007:     setError("");
1008:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
1009:     patchSession((current) => ({
1010:       ...current,
1011:       candidatesByPage: {
1012:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1013:         [String(current.page)]: [],
1014:       },
1015:       selectedDiagramId: null,
1016:     }));
1017: 
1018:     try {
1019:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
1020:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
1021:           (blob) => blob
1022:             ? resolve(blob)
1023:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
1024:           "image/png",
1025:         );
1026:       });
1027: 
1028:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1029: 
1030:       const form = new FormData();
1031:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
1032: 
1033:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
1034:         method: "POST",
1035:         body: form,
1036:         signal: abortController.signal,
1037:       });
1038: 
1039:       if (!response.ok) {
1040:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
1041:       }
1042: 
1043:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
1044:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
1045:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
1046:       );
1047: 
1048:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1049: 
1050:       patchSession((current) => ({
1051:         ...current,
1052:         candidatesByPage: {
1053:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
1054:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
1055:         },
1056:         selectedDiagramId: null,
1057:       }));
1058: 
1059:       setNotice(
1060:         candidates.length
1061:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
1062:           : "No board candidates found.",
1063:       );
1064:     } catch (cause) {
1065:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
1066: 
1067:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
1068:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
1069:       } else {
1070:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1071:       }
1072:     } finally {
1073:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
1074:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
1075:         setDetecting(false);
1076:       }
1077:     }
1078:   }
1079:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
1080:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
1081:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;
1082:   }

1084:   function startCropEdit(
1085:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
1086:     candidate: Candidate,
1087:     handle: CropHandle,
1088:   ) {
1089:     event.stopPropagation();
1090:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1091:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
1092:     if (!point || !stage) return;
1093:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
1094:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1095:   }

1097:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1098:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
1099:     if (!manualMode) return;
1100: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
1101: if (!canvas) return;
1102: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
1103: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
1104: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1105: if (
1106:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
1107:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
1108:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
1109:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
1110: ) return;
1111:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1112:     if (!point) return;
1113:     dragStartRef.current = point;
1114:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1115:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1116:     setDragSelection(selection);
1117:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
1118:   }

1120:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1121:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1122:     if (edit) {
1123:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1124:       if (!point || !session) return;
1125:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1126:       patchSession((current) => {
1127:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1128:         return {
1129:           ...current,
1130:           candidatesByPage: {
1131:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1132:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1133:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1134:           },
1135:         };
1136:       });
1137:       return;
1138:     }
1139:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1140:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1141:     if (point) {
1142:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1143:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1144:       setDragSelection(selection);
1145:     }
1146:   }
1147: 
1148:   function finishRegion() {
1149:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1150:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1151:       return;
1152:     }
1153:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1154:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1155:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1156:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1157:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1158:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1159:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1160:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1161:     setDragSelection(null);
1162:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1163:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1164:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1165:       x, y, width, height,
1166:       relativeScore: 1,
1167:       source: "manual",
1168:     };
1169:     patchSession((current) => ({
1170:       ...current,
1171:       candidatesByPage: {
1172:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1173:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1174:       },
1175:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1176:     }));
1177:     setManualMode(false);
1178:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1179:   }
1180: 
1181:   function cancelRegion() {
1182:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1183:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1184:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1185:     setDragSelection(null);
1186:   }

1188:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1189:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1190:     try {
1191:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1192:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1193:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1194:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1195:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1196:       const scale = mode === "width"
1197:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1198:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1199:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1200:     } catch (cause) {
1201:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1202:     }
1203:   }

  63: }
  64: 
  65: function normalizedCandidate(value: CandidateInput, index: number): Candidate {
  66:   const { relative_score, confidence, ...candidate } = value;
  67:   return {
  68:     ...candidate,
  69:     id: candidate.id || `candidate-${index + 1}`,
  70:     source: candidate.source ?? "automatic",
  71:     relativeScore: candidate.relativeScore ?? relative_score ?? confidence ?? 0,
  72:   };
  73: }

 333:   function toggleEngine() {
 334:     if (engineEnabled) {
 335:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 336:       engineRef.current = null;
 337:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 338:       setEngineStatus("off");
 339:       setEngineScore(null);
 340:       setEngineMessage("");
 341:       return;
 342:     }
 343:     try {
 344:       setEngineScore(null);
 345:       setEngineMessage("");
 346:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 347:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 348:         (status, message) => {
 349:           setEngineStatus(status);
 350:           if (status === "error") {
 351:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 352:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 353:             setEngineScore(null);
 354:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 355:             engineRef.current = null;
 356:           }
 357:         },
 358:         setEngineScore,
 359:       );
 360:       engineRef.current = client;
 361:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 362:     } catch (cause) {
 363:       setEngineStatus("error");
 364:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 365:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 366:     }
 367:   }

 369:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 370:     setSession((current) => {
 371:       if (!current) return current;
 372:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 373:     });
 374:   }

 376:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 377:     try {
 378:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 379:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 380:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 381:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 382:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 383:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 384:       setBook(opened);
 385:       setSession(nextSession);
 386:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 387:       setError("");
 388:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 389:     } catch (cause) {
 390:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 391:     }

 394:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 395:     if (!file) return;
 396:     try {
 397:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 398:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 399:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 400:       const now = Date.now();
 401:       const created: BookRecord = {
 402:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 403:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 404:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 405:         byteLength: file.size,
 406:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 407:         addedAt: now,
 408:       };
 409:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 410:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 411:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 412:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 413:       setBook(created);
 414:       setSession(blank);
 415:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 416:       setError("");
 417:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 418:     } catch (cause) {
 419:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 420:     }
 421:   }

 423:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 424:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 425: 
 426:     try {
 427:       await removeBook(item.id);
 428:       await removeSession(item.id);
 429: 
 430:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 431:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 432:         const next = { ...current };
 433:         delete next[item.id];
 434:         return next;
 435:       });
 436: 
 437:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 438:         setBook(null);
 439:         setSession(null);
 440:         setPdf(null);
 441:       }
 442: 
 443:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 444:       setError("");
 445:     } catch (cause) {
 446:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 447:     }
 448:   }
 449:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 450:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 451:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 452:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 453:     try {
 454:       await putBook(renamed);
 455:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 456:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 457:     } catch (cause) {
 458:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 459:     }
 460:   }

 479:         currentFen: next.fen(),

 481:         moveIndex: 0,

 483:       setLastMove(null);
 484:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 485:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 486:       return true;

 488:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 489:       return false;

 542:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 543:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 544:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 545:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 546:       return;
 547:     }
 548:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 549:     try {
 550:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 551:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 552:       preview.width = crop.width;
 553:       preview.height = crop.height;
 554:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 555:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 556:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 557:     } catch (cause) {
 558:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 559:       return;
 560:     }
 561:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 562:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 563:     setTransferFen("");
 564:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 565:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 566:     setRecognitionError("");
 567:     setTransferPiece("P");
 568:     const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 569:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 570:     try {
 571:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 572:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 573:       });
 574:       const form = new FormData();
 575:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 576:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 577:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 578:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 579:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 580:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 581:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 582:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 583:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 584:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 585:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 586:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 587:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 588:       }
 589:     } catch (cause) {
 590:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 591:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 592:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 593:     }
 594:   }
 595: 
 596:   function closeTransfer() {
 597:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 598:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 599:     setTransferPreview("");
 600:     setTransferFen("");
 601:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 602:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 603:     setRecognitionError("");
 604:     setRecognitionEdited(false);
 605:   }
 606: 
 607:   function editTransferSquare(displayRow: number, displayCol: number) {
 608:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 609:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 610:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a six-field FEN before editing individual squares.");
 611:       return;
 612:     }
 613:     const board = parseFenPlacement(fields[0]);
 614:     if (!board) {
 615:       setRecognitionError("The FEN piece placement is invalid. Correct it before editing squares.");
 616:       return;
 617:     }
 618:     const row = displayRow;
 619:     const col = displayCol;
 620:     try {
 621:       const placement = setFenPiece(fields[0], row, col, transferPiece);
 622:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, placement));
 623:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 624:       setRecognitionError("");
 625:     } catch (cause) {
 626:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 627:     }
 628:   }
 629: 
 630:   function flipTransferPosition() {
 631:     const fields = transferFen.trim().split(/\s+/);
 632:     if (fields.length !== 6) {
 633:       setRecognitionError("Recognize a position or enter a complete FEN before flipping it.");
 634:       return;
 635:     }
 636:     try {
 637:       setTransferFen(withFenPlacement(transferFen, flipFenPlacement(fields[0])));
 638:       setRecognitionEdited(true);
 639:       setRecognitionError("");
 640:     } catch (cause) {
 641:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 642:     }
 643:   }
 644: 
 645:   function confirmTransfer() {
 646:     if (!transferCandidate) return;
 647:     if (!transferFen.trim()) {
 648:       setRecognitionError("Enter or recognize a FEN position first.");
 649:       return;
 650:     }
 651:     if (moveToPosition(transferFen.trim())) {
 652:       closeTransfer();
 653:     }
 654:   }
 655: 
 656:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 657:     if (!session) return;
 658:     try {
 659:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 660:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 661:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 662:       let promotion: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n" = "q";
 663:       if (promote) {
 664:         const choice = window.prompt("Promote to queen, rook, bishop, or knight? (q/r/b/n)", "q")?.toLowerCase();
 665:         if (!choice) return;
 666:         switch (choice) {
 667:           case "q": promotion = "q"; break;
 668:           case "r": promotion = "r"; break;
 669:           case "b": promotion = "b"; break;
 670:           case "n": promotion = "n"; break;
 671:           default:
 672:             setError("Promotion must be q, r, b, or n.");
 673:             return;
 674:         }
 675:       }
 676:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to, promotion });
 677:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 678:       patchSession({
 679:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 680:         moves: nextMoves,
 681:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 682:       });
 683:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 684:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 685:       setError("");
 686:     } catch {
 687:       const piece = game.get(to);
 688:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 689:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 690:     }
 691:   }
 692: 
 693:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 694:     if (!session) return;
 695:     if (annotationMode) {
 696:       if (!arrowStart) {
 697:         setArrowStart(square);
 698:         return;
 699:       }
 700:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 701:       setArrowStart(null);
 702:       setArrowHover(null);
 703:       return;
 704:     }
 705:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 706:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 707:       return;
 708:     }
 709:     const piece = game.get(square);
 710:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 711:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 712:   }

 820:   async function detectBoards() {
 821:     if (detecting) {
 822:       stopBoardScan();
 823:       return;
 824:     }
 825: 
 826:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 827:     if (!API_BASE) {
 828:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 829:       return;
 830:     }
 831: 
 832:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 833:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 834:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 835:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 836: 
 837:     setDetecting(true);
 838:     setError("");
 839:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 840:     patchSession((current) => ({
 841:       ...current,
 842:       candidatesByPage: {
 843:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 844:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 845:       },
 846:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 847:     }));
 848: 
 849:     try {
 850:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 851:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 852:           (blob) => blob
 853:             ? resolve(blob)
 854:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 855:           "image/png",
 856:         );
 857:       });
 858: 
 859:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 860: 
 861:       const form = new FormData();
 862:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 863: 
 864:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 865:         method: "POST",
 866:         body: form,
 867:         signal: abortController.signal,
 868:       });
 869: 
 870:       if (!response.ok) {
 871:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 872:       }
 873: 
 874:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 875:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 876:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 877:       );
 878: 
 879:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 880: 
 881:       patchSession((current) => ({
 882:         ...current,
 883:         candidatesByPage: {
 884:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 885:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 886:         },
 887:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 888:       }));
 889: 
 890:       setNotice(
 891:         candidates.length
 892:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 893:           : "No board candidates found.",
 894:       );
 895:     } catch (cause) {
 896:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 897: 
 898:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 899:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 900:       } else {
 901:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 902:       }
 903:     } finally {
 904:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 905:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 906:         setDetecting(false);
 907:       }
 908:     }
 909:   }

 928:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 929:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 930:     if (!manualMode) return;
 931: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 932: if (!canvas) return;
 933: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 934: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 935: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 936: if (
 937:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 938:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 939:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 940:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 941: ) return;
 942:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 943:     if (!point) return;
 944:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 945:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 946:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 947:     setDragSelection(selection);
 948:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);

 951:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 952:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 953:     if (edit) {
 954:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 955:       if (!point || !session) return;
 956:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 957:       patchSession((current) => {
 958:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 959:         return {
 960:           ...current,
 961:           candidatesByPage: {
 962:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 963:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 964:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
 965:           },
 966:         };
 967:       });
 968:       return;
 969:     }
 970:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
 971:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 972:     if (point) {
 973:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 974:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 975:       setDragSelection(selection);
 976:     }
 977:   }
 978: 
 979:   function finishRegion() {
 980:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
 981:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 982:       return;
 983:     }
 984:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
 985:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
 986:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
 987:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
 988:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
 989:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
 990:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 991:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
 992:     setDragSelection(null);
 993:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
 994:     const candidate: Candidate = {
 995:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
 996:       x, y, width, height,
 997:       relativeScore: 1,
 998:       source: "manual",
 999:     };
1000:     patchSession((current) => ({
1001:       ...current,
1002:       candidatesByPage: {
1003:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1004:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1005:       },
1006:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1007:     }));
1008:     setManualMode(false);
1009:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1010:   }

1016:     setDragSelection(null);

1019:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1020:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1021:     try {
1022:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1023:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1024:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1025:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1026:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1027:       const scale = mode === "width"
1028:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1029:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1030:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1031:     } catch (cause) {
1032:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1033:     }
1034:   }

1469:           {recognitionError && recognitionStatus !== "failed" && <p className="recognition-error" role="alert">{recognitionError}</p>}

1473:           </label>
1474:           {transferFen && <p className={transferFenValid ? "fen-validation valid-fen" : "fen-validation"}>{transferFenValid ? "Syntactically valid chess position Â· visually verify it against the diagram." : "FEN is not a valid chess position yet."}</p>}

1476:         </section>
1477:       </div>}
1478:       {(error || notice) && <div className={`toast ${error ? "toast-error" : ""}`} role={error ? "alert" : "status"}><span>{error || notice}</span><button aria-label="Dismiss message" onClick={() => { setError(""); setNotice(""); }}>Ã—</button></div>}
1479:     </main>
1480:   );
1481: }

 465:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 466:     try {
 467:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 468:       setSession({
 469:         ...activeSession,
 470:         originalFen: fen,
 471:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 472:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 473:         moves: [],
 474:         moveIndex: 0,
 475:       });
 476:       setLastMove(null);
 477:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 478:       setUserArrows([]);
 479:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 480:       return true;
 481:     } catch (cause) {
 482:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 483:       return false;
 484:     }
 485:   }
 486: 
 487:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 488:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 489:     if (!loaded) return false;
 490:     setEngineScore(null);
 491:     setEngineMessage("");
 492:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 493:       toggleEngine();
 494:     } else {
 495:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 496:     }
 497:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 498:     return true;
 499:   }

 550:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 551:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 552:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 553:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 554:       return;
 555:     }
 556:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 557:     try {
 558:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 559:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 560:       preview.width = crop.width;
 561:       preview.height = crop.height;
 562:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 563:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 564:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 565:     } catch (cause) {
 566:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 567:       return;
 568:     }
 569:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 570:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 571:     setTransferFen("");
 572:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 573:         setRecognitionError("");
 574:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 575:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 576:     try {
 577:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 578:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 579:       });
 580:       const form = new FormData();
 581:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 582:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 583:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 584:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 585:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 586:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 587:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 588:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 589:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 590:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 591:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 592:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 593:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 594:       }
 595:     } catch (cause) {
 596:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 597:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 598:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 599:     }
 600:   }
 601: 
 602:   function closeTransfer() {
 603:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 604:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 605:     setTransferPreview("");
 606:     setTransferFen("");
 607:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 608:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 609:     setRecognitionError("");
 610:       }

 613:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 614:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 615:       setGameEndOverlay({
 616:         title: "Checkmate",
 617:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 618:       });
 619:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 620:       setGameEndOverlay({
 621:         title: "Stalemate",
 622:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 623:       });
 624:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 625:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 626:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 627:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 629:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 630:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 631:     } else {
 632:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 633:     }
 634:   }

 636:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 637:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 638:     try {
 639:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 640:       const result = currentGame.move({
 641:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 642:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 643:         promotion: piece,
 644:       });
 645:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 646:       patchSession({
 647:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 648:         moves: nextMoves,
 649:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 650:       });
 651:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 652:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 653:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 654:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 655:       setError("");
 656:     } catch {
 657:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 658:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 659:     }
 660:   }
 661: 
 662:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 663:     if (!session) return;
 664:     try {
 665:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 666:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 667:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 668:       if (promote) {
 669:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 670:         return;
 671:       }
 672:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 673:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 674:       patchSession({
 675:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 676:         moves: nextMoves,
 677:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 678:       });
 679:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 680:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 681:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 682:       setError("");
 683:     } catch {
 684:       const piece = game.get(to);
 685:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 686:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 687:     }
 688:   }

 690:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 691:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 692:     setRedSquares([]);
 693: 
 694:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 695:       setUserArrows([]);
 696:       setArrowStart(null);
 697:       setArrowHover(null);
 698:       return;
 699:     }
 700: if (!session) return;
 701:     if (annotationMode) {
 702:       if (!arrowStart) {
 703:         setArrowStart(square);
 704:         return;
 705:       }
 706:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 707:       setArrowStart(null);
 708:       setArrowHover(null);
 709:       return;
 710:     }
 711:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 712:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 713:       return;
 714:     }
 715:     const piece = game.get(square);
 716:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 717:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 718:   }

 720:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 721:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 722: 
 723:   event.preventDefault();
 724: 
 725:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 726:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 727:     event.clientX,
 728:     event.clientY,
 729:     bounds,
 730:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 731:   );
 732: 
 733:   if (!square) return;
 734: 
 735:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 736:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 737:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 738:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 739:   setArrowStart(square);
 740:   setArrowHover(square);
 741: 
 742:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 743: }

 745:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 746:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 747:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 748:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 749:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 750:     setArrowHover(square);

 753:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 754:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 755: 
 756:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 757: 
 758:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 759:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 760:     event.clientX,
 761:     event.clientY,
 762:     bounds,
 763:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 764:   );
 765: 
 766:   if (to && to !== from) {
 767:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 768:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 769:   } else {
 770:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 771:   }
 772: 
 773:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 774:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 775:   setArrowStart(null);
 776:   setArrowHover(null);
 777: }

 792:       setSelectedSquare(null);

 794:       setError(`Could not navigate to move: ${messageOf(cause)}`);

 830:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 831:

 833:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;

 839:     setCropEditingId(null);

 841:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 842:

 844:       ...current,

 846:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 847:         [String(current.page)]: [],

 855:   async function detectBoards() {
 856:     if (detecting) {
 857:       stopBoardScan();
 858:       return;
 859:     }
 860: 
 861:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 862:     if (!API_BASE) {
 863:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 864:       return;
 865:     }
 866: 
 867:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 868:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 869:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 870:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 871: 
 872:     setDetecting(true);
 873:     setError("");
 874:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 875:     patchSession((current) => ({
 876:       ...current,
 877:       candidatesByPage: {
 878:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 879:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 880:       },
 881:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 882:     }));
 883: 
 884:     try {
 885:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 886:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 887:           (blob) => blob
 888:             ? resolve(blob)
 889:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 890:           "image/png",
 891:         );
 892:       });
 893: 
 894:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 895: 
 896:       const form = new FormData();
 897:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 898: 
 899:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 900:         method: "POST",
 901:         body: form,
 902:         signal: abortController.signal,
 903:       });
 904: 
 905:       if (!response.ok) {
 906:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 907:       }
 908: 
 909:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 910:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 911:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 912:       );
 913: 
 914:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 915: 
 916:       patchSession((current) => ({
 917:         ...current,
 918:         candidatesByPage: {
 919:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 920:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 921:         },
 922:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 923:       }));
 924: 
 925:       setNotice(
 926:         candidates.length
 927:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 928:           : "No board candidates found.",
 929:       );
 930:     } catch (cause) {
 931:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 932: 
 933:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 934:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 935:       } else {
 936:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 937:       }
 938:     } finally {
 939:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 940:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 941:         setDetecting(false);
 942:       }
 943:     }
 944:   }

 951:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,

 963:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 964:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 965:     if (!manualMode) return;
 966: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 967: if (!canvas) return;
 968: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 969: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 970: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 971: if (
 972:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 973:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 974:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 975:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 976: ) return;
 977:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 978:     if (!point) return;
 979:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 980:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 981:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 982:     setDragSelection(selection);
 983:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 984:   }

 986:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 987:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 988:     if (edit) {
 989:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 990:       if (!point || !session) return;
 991:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 992:       patchSession((current) => {
 993:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 994:         return {
 995:           ...current,
 996:           candidatesByPage: {
 997:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 998:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 999:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1000:           },
1001:         };
1002:       });
1003:       return;
1004:     }
1005:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1006:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1007:     if (point) {
1008:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1009:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1010:       setDragSelection(selection);
1011:     }
1012:   }
1013: 
1014:   function finishRegion() {
1015:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1016:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1017:       return;
1018:     }
1019:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1020:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1021:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1022:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1023:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1024:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1025:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1026:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1027:     setDragSelection(null);
1028:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1029:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1030:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1031:       x, y, width, height,
1032:       relativeScore: 1,
1033:       source: "manual",
1034:     };
1035:     patchSession((current) => ({
1036:       ...current,
1037:       candidatesByPage: {
1038:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1039:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1040:       },
1041:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1042:     }));
1043:     setManualMode(false);
1044:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1045:   }
1046: 
1047:   function cancelRegion() {
1048:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1049:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1050:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1051:     setDragSelection(null);
1052:   }

1054:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1055:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1056:     try {
1057:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1058:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1059:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1060:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1061:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1062:       const scale = mode === "width"
1063:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1064:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1065:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1066:     } catch (cause) {
1067:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1068:     }
1069:   }

1073:   function saveBookmark() {
1074:     if (!session) return;
1075:     patchSession((current) => ({

 281:       return matchesTab && item.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle);
 282:     });
 283:   }, [bookSearch, libraryTab, sessionIndex, sortedBooks]);
 284: 
 285:   const game = useMemo(() => {
 286:     if (!session) return new Chess();
 287:     try {
 288:       return makePosition(session.lineBaseFen, session.moves, session.moveIndex);
 289:     } catch {
 290:       try { return new Chess(session.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 291:     }
 292:   }, [session]);
 293:   const legalTargets = useMemo(() => {
 294:     if (!selectedSquare) return new Set<string>();
 295:     return new Set(game.moves({ square: selectedSquare, verbose: true }).map((move) => move.to));
 296:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 297:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 298:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 299:     try { return makePosition(session?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, session?.moves ?? [], session?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 300:     catch { return []; }
 301:   }, [session]);
 302:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 303:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 304:     : null);
 305:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 306:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 307:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 308:   );
 309: 
 310:   useEffect(() => {
 311:     setUserArrows([]);
 312:     setArrowStart(null);
 313:     setArrowHover(null);
 314:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 315:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 316: 
 317:   useEffect(() => {
 318:     if (engineEnabled) engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 319:   }, [engineEnabled, session?.currentFen, session?.moveIndex, engineDepth]);
 320: 
 321:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 322:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 323:   }
 324: 
 325:   function toggleEngine() {
 326:     if (engineEnabled) {
 327:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 328:       engineRef.current = null;
 329:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 330:       setEngineStatus("off");
 331:       setEngineScore(null);
 332:       setEngineMessage("");
 333:       return;
 334:     }
 335:     try {
 336:       setEngineScore(null);
 337:       setEngineMessage("");
 338:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 339:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 340:         (status, message) => {
 341:           setEngineStatus(status);
 342:           if (status === "error") {
 343:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 344:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 345:             setEngineScore(null);
 346:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 347:             engineRef.current = null;
 348:           }
 349:         },
 350:         setEngineScore,
 351:       );
 352:       engineRef.current = client;
 353:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 354:     } catch (cause) {
 355:       setEngineStatus("error");
 356:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 357:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 358:     }
 359:   }
 360: 
 361:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 362:     setSession((current) => {
 363:       if (!current) return current;
 364:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 365:     });
 366:   }

 368:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 369:     try {
 370:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 371:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 372:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 373:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 374:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 375:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 376:       setBook(opened);
 377:       setSession(nextSession);
 378:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 379:       setError("");
 380:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 381:     } catch (cause) {
 382:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 383:     }
 384:   }
 385: 
 386:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 387:     if (!file) return;
 388:     try {
 389:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 390:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 391:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 392:       const now = Date.now();
 393:       const created: BookRecord = {
 394:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 395:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 396:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 397:         byteLength: file.size,
 398:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 399:         addedAt: now,
 400:       };
 401:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 402:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 403:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 404:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 405:       setBook(created);
 406:       setSession(blank);
 407:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 408:       setError("");
 409:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 410:     } catch (cause) {
 411:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 412:     }
 413:   }
 414: 
 415:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 416:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 417: 
 418:     try {
 419:       await removeBook(item.id);
 420:       await removeSession(item.id);
 421: 
 422:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 423:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 424:         const next = { ...current };
 425:         delete next[item.id];
 426:         return next;
 427:       });
 428: 
 429:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 430:         setBook(null);
 431:         setSession(null);
 432:         setPdf(null);
 433:       }
 434: 
 435:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 436:       setError("");
 437:     } catch (cause) {
 438:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 439:     }
 440:   }
 441:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 442:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 443:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 444:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 445:     try {
 446:       await putBook(renamed);
 447:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 448:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 449:     } catch (cause) {
 450:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 451:     }
 452:   }

 454:   function changePage(delta: number) {
 455:     if (!session) return;
 456:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 457:   }

 459:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 460:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 461:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 462:   }

 464:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 465:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 466:     try {
 467:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 468:       setSession({
 469:         ...activeSession,
 470:         originalFen: fen,
 471:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 472:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 473:         moves: [],
 474:         moveIndex: 0,
 475:       });
 476:       setLastMove(null);
 477:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 478:       setUserArrows([]);
 479:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 480:       return true;
 481:     } catch (cause) {
 482:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 483:       return false;
 484:     }
 485:   }

 487:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 488:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 489:     if (!loaded) return false;
 490:     setEngineScore(null);
 491:     setEngineMessage("");
 492:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 493:       toggleEngine();
 494:     } else {
 495:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 496:     }
 497:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 498:     return true;
 499:   }

 515:     const baseline = cropBaselineRef.current;

 550:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 551:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 552:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 553:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 554:       return;
 555:     }
 556:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 557:     try {
 558:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 559:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 560:       preview.width = crop.width;
 561:       preview.height = crop.height;
 562:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 563:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 564:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 565:     } catch (cause) {
 566:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 567:       return;
 568:     }
 569:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 570:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 571:     setTransferFen("");
 572:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 573:         setRecognitionError("");
 574:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 575:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 576:     try {
 577:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 578:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 579:       });
 580:       const form = new FormData();
 581:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 582:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 583:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 584:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 585:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 586:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 587:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 588:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 589:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 590:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 591:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 592:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 593:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 594:       }
 595:     } catch (cause) {
 596:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 597:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 598:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 599:     }
 600:   }

 602:   function closeTransfer() {
 603:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 604:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 605:     setTransferPreview("");
 606:     setTransferFen("");
 607:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 608:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 609:     setRecognitionError("");
 610:       }
