 613:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 614:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 615:       setGameEndOverlay({
 616:         title: "Checkmate",
 617:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 618:       });
 619:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 620:       setGameEndOverlay({
 621:         title: "Stalemate",
 622:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 623:       });
 624:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 625:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 626:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 627:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 629:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 630:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 631:     } else {
 632:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 633:     }
 634:   }

 636:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 637:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 638:     try {
 639:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 640:       const result = currentGame.move({
 641:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 642:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 643:         promotion: piece,
 644:       });
 645:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 646:       patchSession({
 647:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 648:         moves: nextMoves,
 649:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 650:       });
 651:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 652:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 653:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 654:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 655:       setError("");
 656:     } catch {
 657:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 658:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 659:     }
 660:   }
 661: 
 662:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 663:     if (!session) return;
 664:     try {
 665:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 666:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 667:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 668:       if (promote) {
 669:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 670:         return;
 671:       }
 672:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 673:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 674:       patchSession({
 675:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 676:         moves: nextMoves,
 677:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 678:       });
 679:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 680:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 681:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 682:       setError("");
 683:     } catch {
 684:       const piece = game.get(to);
 685:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 686:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 687:     }
 688:   }

 690:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 691:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 692:     setRedSquares([]);
 693: 
 694:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 695:       setUserArrows([]);
 696:       setArrowStart(null);
 697:       setArrowHover(null);
 698:       return;
 699:     }
 700: if (!session) return;
 701:     if (annotationMode) {
 702:       if (!arrowStart) {
 703:         setArrowStart(square);
 704:         return;
 705:       }
 706:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 707:       setArrowStart(null);
 708:       setArrowHover(null);
 709:       return;
 710:     }
 711:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 712:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 713:       return;
 714:     }
 715:     const piece = game.get(square);
 716:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 717:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 718:   }

 720:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 721:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 722: 
 723:   event.preventDefault();
 724: 
 725:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 726:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 727:     event.clientX,
 728:     event.clientY,
 729:     bounds,
 730:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 731:   );
 732: 
 733:   if (!square) return;
 734: 
 735:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 736:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 737:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 738:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 739:   setArrowStart(square);
 740:   setArrowHover(square);
 741: 
 742:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 743: }
 744: 
 745:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 746:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 747:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 748:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 749:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 750:     setArrowHover(square);
 751:   }
 752: 
 753:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 754:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 755: 
 756:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 757: 
 758:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 759:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 760:     event.clientX,
 761:     event.clientY,
 762:     bounds,
 763:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 764:   );
 765: 
 766:   if (to && to !== from) {
 767:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 768:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 769:   } else {
 770:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 771:   }
 772: 
 773:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 774:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 775:   setArrowStart(null);
 776:   setArrowHover(null);
 777: }

 855:   async function detectBoards() {
 856:     if (detecting) {
 857:       stopBoardScan();
 858:       return;
 859:     }
 860: 
 861:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 862:     if (!API_BASE) {
 863:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 864:       return;
 865:     }
 866: 
 867:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 868:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 869:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 870:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 871: 
 872:     setDetecting(true);
 873:     setError("");
 874:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 875:     patchSession((current) => ({
 876:       ...current,
 877:       candidatesByPage: {
 878:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 879:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 880:       },
 881:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 882:     }));
 883: 
 884:     try {
 885:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 886:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 887:           (blob) => blob
 888:             ? resolve(blob)
 889:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 890:           "image/png",
 891:         );
 892:       });
 893: 
 894:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 895: 
 896:       const form = new FormData();
 897:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 898: 
 899:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 900:         method: "POST",
 901:         body: form,
 902:         signal: abortController.signal,
 903:       });
 904: 
 905:       if (!response.ok) {
 906:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 907:       }
 908: 
 909:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 910:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 911:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 912:       );
 913: 
 914:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 915: 
 916:       patchSession((current) => ({
 917:         ...current,
 918:         candidatesByPage: {
 919:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 920:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 921:         },
 922:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 923:       }));
 924: 
 925:       setNotice(
 926:         candidates.length
 927:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 928:           : "No board candidates found.",
 929:       );
 930:     } catch (cause) {
 931:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 932: 
 933:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 934:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 935:       } else {
 936:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 937:       }
 938:     } finally {
 939:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 940:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 941:         setDetecting(false);
 942:       }
 943:     }
 944:   }
 945:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
 946:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
 947:     return box ? pointOnCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY, box) : null;

 950:   function startCropEdit(
 951:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 952:     candidate: Candidate,
 953:     handle: CropHandle,
 954:   ) {
 955:     event.stopPropagation();
 956:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 957:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
 958:     if (!point || !stage) return;
 959:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };

 963:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 964:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 965:     if (!manualMode) return;
 966: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 967: if (!canvas) return;
 968: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 969: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 970: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 971: if (
 972:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 973:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 974:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 975:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 976: ) return;
 977:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 978:     if (!point) return;
 979:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 980:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 981:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 982:     setDragSelection(selection);
 983:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 984:   }

 986:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 987:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 988:     if (edit) {
 989:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 990:       if (!point || !session) return;
 991:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 992:       patchSession((current) => {
 993:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 994:         return {
 995:           ...current,
 996:           candidatesByPage: {
 997:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 998:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 999:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1000:           },
1001:         };
1002:       });
1003:       return;
1004:     }
1005:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1006:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1007:     if (point) {
1008:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1009:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1010:       setDragSelection(selection);
1011:     }
1012:   }

1014:   function finishRegion() {
1015:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1016:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1017:       return;
1018:     }
1019:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1020:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1021:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1022:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1023:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1024:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1025:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1026:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1027:     setDragSelection(null);
1028:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1029:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1030:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1031:       x, y, width, height,
1032:       relativeScore: 1,
1033:       source: "manual",
1034:     };
1035:     patchSession((current) => ({
1036:       ...current,
1037:       candidatesByPage: {
1038:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1039:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1040:       },
1041:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1042:     }));
1043:     setManualMode(false);
1044:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1045:   }

1048:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1049:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1050:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1051:     setDragSelection(null);
1052:   }

1054:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1055:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1056:     try {
1057:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1058:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1059:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1060:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1061:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1062:       const scale = mode === "width"
1063:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1064:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1065:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1066:     } catch (cause) {
1067:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1068:     }
1069:   }

 334:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {

 338:   function toggleEngine() {
 339:     if (engineEnabled) {
 340:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 341:       engineRef.current = null;
 342:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 343:       setEngineStatus("off");
 344:       setEngineScore(null);
 345:       setEngineMessage("");
 346:       return;
 347:     }
 348:     try {
 349:       setEngineScore(null);
 350:       setEngineMessage("");
 351:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 352:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 353:         (status, message) => {
 354:           setEngineStatus(status);
 355:           if (status === "error") {
 356:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 357:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 358:             setEngineScore(null);
 359:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 360:             engineRef.current = null;
 361:           }
 362:         },
 363:         setEngineScore,
 364:       );
 365:       engineRef.current = client;
 366:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 367:     } catch (cause) {
 368:       setEngineStatus("error");
 369:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 370:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 371:     }
 372:   }

 374:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 375:     setSession((current) => {
 376:       if (!current) return current;
 377:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 378:     });

 381:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 382:     try {
 383:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 384:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 385:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 386:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 387:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 388:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 389:       setBook(opened);
 390:       setSession(nextSession);
 391:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 392:       setError("");
 393:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 394:     } catch (cause) {
 395:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 396:     }
 397:   }

 399:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 400:     if (!file) return;
 401:     try {
 402:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 403:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 404:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 405:       const now = Date.now();
 406:       const created: BookRecord = {
 407:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 408:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 409:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 410:         byteLength: file.size,
 411:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 412:         addedAt: now,
 413:       };
 414:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 415:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 416:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 417:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 418:       setBook(created);
 419:       setSession(blank);
 420:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 421:       setError("");
 422:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 423:     } catch (cause) {
 424:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 425:     }
 426:   }

 428:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 429:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 430: 
 431:     try {
 432:       await removeBook(item.id);
 433:       await removeSession(item.id);
 434: 
 435:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 436:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 437:         const next = { ...current };
 438:         delete next[item.id];
 439:         return next;
 440:       });
 441: 
 442:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 443:         setBook(null);
 444:         setSession(null);
 445:         setPdf(null);
 446:       }
 447: 
 448:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 449:       setError("");
 450:     } catch (cause) {
 451:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 452:     }
 453:   }
 454:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 455:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 456:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 457:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 458:     try {
 459:       await putBook(renamed);
 460:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 461:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 462:     } catch (cause) {
 463:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 464:     }
 465:   }

 477:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 478:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 479:     try {
 480:       const next = new Chess(fen);

 482:         ...activeSession,
 483:         originalFen: fen,
 484:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 485:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 486:         moves: [],
 487:         moveIndex: 0,
 488:       });
 489:       setLastMove(null);
 490:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 491:       setUserArrows([]);
 492:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 493:       return true;
 494:     } catch (cause) {
 495:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 496:       return false;
 497:     }
 498:   }

 563:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 564:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 565:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 566:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 567:       return;
 568:     }
 569:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 570:     try {
 571:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 572:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 573:       preview.width = crop.width;
 574:       preview.height = crop.height;
 575:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 576:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 577:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 578:     } catch (cause) {
 579:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 580:       return;
 581:     }
 582:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 583:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 584:     setTransferFen("");
 585:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 586:         setRecognitionError("");
 587:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 588:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 589:     try {
 590:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 591:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 592:       });
 593:       const form = new FormData();
 594:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 595:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 596:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 597:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 598:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 599:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 600:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 601:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 602:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 603:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 604:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 605:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 606:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 607:       }
 608:     } catch (cause) {
 609:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 610:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 611:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 612:     }
 613:   }
 614: 
 615:   function closeTransfer() {
 616:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 617:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 618:     setTransferPreview("");
 619:     setTransferFen("");
 620:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 621:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 622:     setRecognitionError("");
 623:       }

 626:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 627:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 628:       setGameEndOverlay({
 629:         title: "Checkmate",
 630:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 631:       });
 632:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 633:       setGameEndOverlay({
 634:         title: "Stalemate",
 635:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 636:       });
 637:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 638:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 639:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 640:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 641:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 642:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 643:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 644:     } else {
 645:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 646:     }
 647:   }

 649:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 650:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 651:     try {
 652:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 653:       const result = currentGame.move({
 654:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 655:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 656:         promotion: piece,
 657:       });
 658:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 659:       patchSession({
 660:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 661:         moves: nextMoves,
 662:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 663:       });
 664:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 665:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 666:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 667:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 668:       setError("");
 669:     } catch {
 670:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 671:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 672:     }
 673:   }
 674: 
 675:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 676:     if (!session) return;
 677:     try {
 678:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 679:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 680:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 681:       if (promote) {
 682:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 683:         return;
 684:       }
 685:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 686:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 687:       patchSession({
 688:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 689:         moves: nextMoves,
 690:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 691:       });
 692:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 693:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 694:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 695:       setError("");
 696:     } catch {
 697:       const piece = game.get(to);
 698:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 699:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 700:     }
 701:   }

 703:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 704:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 705:     setRedSquares([]);
 706: 
 707:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 708:       setUserArrows([]);
 709:       setArrowStart(null);
 710:       setArrowHover(null);
 711:       return;
 712:     }
 713: if (!session) return;
 714:     if (annotationMode) {
 715:       if (!arrowStart) {
 716:         setArrowStart(square);
 717:         return;
 718:       }
 719:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 720:       setArrowStart(null);
 721:       setArrowHover(null);
 722:       return;
 723:     }
 724:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 725:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 726:       return;
 727:     }
 728:     const piece = game.get(square);
 729:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 730:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 731:   }

 733:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {

 737:

 742:     bounds,
 743:     Boolean(session?.flipped),

 758:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 759:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;

 766:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 767:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 768: 
 769:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 770: 
 771:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 772:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 773:     event.clientX,
 774:     event.clientY,
 775:     bounds,
 776:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 777:   );
 778: 
 779:   if (to && to !== from) {
 780:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 781:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 782:   } else {
 783:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 784:   }
 785: 
 786:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 787:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;

 789:   setArrowHover(null);

 868:   async function detectBoards() {
 869:     if (detecting) {
 870:       stopBoardScan();
 871:       return;
 872:     }
 873: 
 874:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 875:     if (!API_BASE) {
 876:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 877:       return;
 878:     }
 879: 
 880:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 881:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 882:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 883:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 884: 
 885:     setDetecting(true);
 886:     setError("");
 887:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 888:     patchSession((current) => ({
 889:       ...current,
 890:       candidatesByPage: {
 891:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 892:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 893:       },
 894:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 895:     }));
 896: 
 897:     try {
 898:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 899:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 900:           (blob) => blob
 901:             ? resolve(blob)
 902:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 903:           "image/png",
 904:         );
 905:       });
 906: 
 907:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 908: 
 909:       const form = new FormData();
 910:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 911: 
 912:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 913:         method: "POST",
 914:         body: form,
 915:         signal: abortController.signal,
 916:       });
 917: 
 918:       if (!response.ok) {
 919:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 920:       }
 921: 
 922:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 923:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 924:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 925:       );
 926: 
 927:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 928: 
 929:       patchSession((current) => ({
 930:         ...current,
 931:         candidatesByPage: {
 932:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 933:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 934:         },
 935:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 936:       }));
 937: 
 938:       setNotice(
 939:         candidates.length
 940:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 941:           : "No board candidates found.",
 942:       );
 943:     } catch (cause) {
 944:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 945: 
 946:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 947:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 948:       } else {
 949:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 950:       }
 951:     } finally {
 952:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 953:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 954:         setDetecting(false);
 955:       }
 956:     }
 957:   }

 976:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 977:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 978:     if (!manualMode) return;
 979: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 980: if (!canvas) return;
 981: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 982: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 983: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 984: if (
 985:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 986:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 987:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 988:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 989: ) return;

 991:     if (!point) return;

 999:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
1000:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
1001:     if (edit) {
1002:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
1003:       if (!point || !session) return;
1004:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
1005:       patchSession((current) => {
1006:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
1007:         return {
1008:           ...current,
1009:           candidatesByPage: {
1010:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
1011:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1012:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1013:           },
1014:         };
1015:       });
1016:       return;
1017:     }
1018:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1019:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1020:     if (point) {
1021:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1022:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1023:       setDragSelection(selection);
1024:     }

1027:   function finishRegion() {
1028:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1029:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1030:       return;
1031:     }
1032:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1033:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1034:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1035:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1036:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1037:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1038:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1039:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1040:     setDragSelection(null);
1041:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1042:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1043:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1044:       x, y, width, height,
1045:       relativeScore: 1,
1046:       source: "manual",
1047:     };
1048:     patchSession((current) => ({
1049:       ...current,
1050:       candidatesByPage: {
1051:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1052:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1053:       },
1054:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1055:     }));
1056:     setManualMode(false);
1057:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1058:   }

1061:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1062:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1063:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1064:     setDragSelection(null);
1065:   }

1067:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1068:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1069:     try {
1070:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1071:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1072:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1073:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1074:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1075:       const scale = mode === "width"
1076:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1077:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1078:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1079:     } catch (cause) {
1080:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1081:     }
1082:   }

 473:         moves: [],
 474:         moveIndex: 0,
 475:       });
 476:       setLastMove(null);
 477:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 478:       setUserArrows([]);
 479:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 480:       return true;
 481:     } catch (cause) {
 482:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 483:       return false;
 484:     }
 485:   }

 487:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 488:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 489:     if (!loaded) return false;
 490:     setEngineScore(null);
 491:     setEngineMessage("");
 492:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 493:       toggleEngine();
 494:     } else {
 495:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 496:     }
 497:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 498:     return true;
 499:   }

 550:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 551:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 552:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 553:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 554:       return;
 555:     }
 556:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 557:     try {
 558:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 559:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 560:       preview.width = crop.width;
 561:       preview.height = crop.height;
 562:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 563:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 564:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 565:     } catch (cause) {
 566:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 567:       return;
 568:     }
 569:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 570:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 571:     setTransferFen("");
 572:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 573:         setRecognitionError("");
 574:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 575:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 576:     try {
 577:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 578:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 579:       });
 580:       const form = new FormData();
 581:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 582:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 583:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 584:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 585:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 586:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 587:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 588:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 589:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 590:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 591:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 592:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 593:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 594:       }
 595:     } catch (cause) {
 596:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 597:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 598:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 599:     }
 600:   }
 601: 
 602:   function closeTransfer() {
 603:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 604:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 605:     setTransferPreview("");
 606:     setTransferFen("");
 607:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 608:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 609:     setRecognitionError("");
 610:       }

 613:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 614:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 615:       setGameEndOverlay({
 616:         title: "Checkmate",
 617:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 618:       });
 619:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 620:       setGameEndOverlay({
 621:         title: "Stalemate",
 622:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 623:       });
 624:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 625:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 626:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 627:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 629:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 630:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 631:     } else {
 632:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 633:     }
 634:   }
 635: 
 636:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 637:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 638:     try {
 639:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 640:       const result = currentGame.move({
 641:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 642:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 643:         promotion: piece,
 644:       });
 645:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 646:       patchSession({
 647:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 648:         moves: nextMoves,
 649:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 650:       });
 651:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 652:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 653:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 654:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 655:       setError("");
 656:     } catch {
 657:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 658:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 659:     }
 660:   }
 661: 
 662:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 663:     if (!session) return;
 664:     try {
 665:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 666:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 667:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 668:       if (promote) {
 669:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 670:         return;
 671:       }
 672:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 673:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 674:       patchSession({
 675:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 676:         moves: nextMoves,
 677:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 678:       });
 679:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 680:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 681:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 682:       setError("");
 683:     } catch {
 684:       const piece = game.get(to);
 685:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 686:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 687:     }
 688:   }

 690:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 691:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 692:     setRedSquares([]);
 693: 
 694:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 695:       setUserArrows([]);
 696:       setArrowStart(null);
 697:       setArrowHover(null);
 698:       return;
 699:     }
 700: if (!session) return;
 701:     if (annotationMode) {
 702:       if (!arrowStart) {
 703:         setArrowStart(square);
 704:         return;
 705:       }
 706:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 707:       setArrowStart(null);
 708:       setArrowHover(null);
 709:       return;
 710:     }
 711:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 712:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 713:       return;
 714:     }
 715:     const piece = game.get(square);
 716:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 717:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 718:   }

 720:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 721:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 722: 
 723:   event.preventDefault();
 724: 
 725:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 726:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 727:     event.clientX,
 728:     event.clientY,
 729:     bounds,
 730:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 731:   );
 732: 
 733:   if (!square) return;
 734: 
 735:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 736:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 737:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 738:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 739:   setArrowStart(square);
 740:   setArrowHover(square);
 741: 
 742:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 743: }

 745:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 746:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 747:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 748:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 749:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 750:     setArrowHover(square);

 753:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 754:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 755: 
 756:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 757: 
 758:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 759:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 760:     event.clientX,
 761:     event.clientY,
 762:     bounds,
 763:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 764:   );
 765: 
 766:   if (to && to !== from) {
 767:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 768:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 769:   } else {
 770:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 771:   }
 772: 
 773:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 774:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 775:   setArrowStart(null);
 776:   setArrowHover(null);
 777: }

 791:       setLastMove(last ? { from: last.from, to: last.to } : null);

 829:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 830:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 831:

 833:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;

 839:     setCropEditingId(null);

 841:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 842: 
 843:     patchSession((current) => ({
 844:       ...current,
 845:       candidatesByPage: {
 846:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 847:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 848:       },

 850:     }));
 851:

 855:   async function detectBoards() {
 856:     if (detecting) {
 857:       stopBoardScan();
 858:       return;
 859:     }
 860: 
 861:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 862:     if (!API_BASE) {
 863:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 864:       return;
 865:     }
 866: 
 867:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 868:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 869:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 870:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 871: 
 872:     setDetecting(true);
 873:     setError("");
 874:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 875:     patchSession((current) => ({
 876:       ...current,
 877:       candidatesByPage: {
 878:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 879:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 880:       },
 881:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 882:     }));
 883: 
 884:     try {
 885:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 886:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 887:           (blob) => blob
 888:             ? resolve(blob)
 889:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 890:           "image/png",
 891:         );
 892:       });
 893: 
 894:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 895: 
 896:       const form = new FormData();
 897:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 898: 
 899:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 900:         method: "POST",
 901:         body: form,
 902:         signal: abortController.signal,
 903:       });
 904: 
 905:       if (!response.ok) {
 906:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 907:       }
 908: 
 909:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 910:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 911:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 912:       );
 913: 
 914:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 915: 
 916:       patchSession((current) => ({
 917:         ...current,
 918:         candidatesByPage: {
 919:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 920:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 921:         },
 922:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 923:       }));
 924: 
 925:       setNotice(
 926:         candidates.length
 927:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 928:           : "No board candidates found.",
 929:       );
 930:     } catch (cause) {
 931:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 932: 
 933:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 934:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 935:       } else {
 936:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 937:       }
 938:     } finally {
 939:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 940:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 941:         setDetecting(false);
 942:       }
 943:     }
 944:   }

 951:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 952:     candidate: Candidate,

 963:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 964:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 965:     if (!manualMode) return;
 966: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 967: if (!canvas) return;
 968: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 969: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 970: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 971: if (
 972:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 973:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 974:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 975:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 976: ) return;
 977:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 978:     if (!point) return;
 979:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 980:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 981:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 982:     setDragSelection(selection);
 983:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 984:   }

 986:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 987:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 988:     if (edit) {
 989:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 990:       if (!point || !session) return;
 991:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 992:       patchSession((current) => {
 993:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 994:         return {
 995:           ...current,
 996:           candidatesByPage: {
 997:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 998:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
 999:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1000:           },
1001:         };
1002:       });
1003:       return;
1004:     }
1005:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1006:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1007:     if (point) {
1008:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1009:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1010:       setDragSelection(selection);
1011:     }
1012:   }
1013: 
1014:   function finishRegion() {
1015:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1016:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1017:       return;
1018:     }
1019:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1020:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1021:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1022:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1023:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1024:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1025:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1026:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1027:     setDragSelection(null);
1028:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1029:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1030:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1031:       x, y, width, height,
1032:       relativeScore: 1,
1033:       source: "manual",
1034:     };
1035:     patchSession((current) => ({
1036:       ...current,
1037:       candidatesByPage: {
1038:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1039:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1040:       },
1041:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1042:     }));
1043:     setManualMode(false);
1044:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1045:   }
1046: 
1047:   function cancelRegion() {
1048:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1049:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1050:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1051:     setDragSelection(null);
1052:   }

1054:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1055:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;
1056:     try {
1057:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1058:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1059:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1060:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1061:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1062:       const scale = mode === "width"
1063:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1064:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1065:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1066:     } catch (cause) {
1067:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1068:     }
1069:   }

1073:   function saveBookmark() {
1074:     if (!session) return;
1075:     patchSession((current) => ({
1076:       ...current,
1077:       bookmarks: current.bookmarks.includes(current.page)
1078:         ? current.bookmarks.filter((page) => page !== current.page)
1079:         : [...current.bookmarks, current.page].sort((a, b) => a - b),
1080:     }));
1081:   }

 287:     if (!session) return new Chess();
 288:     try {
 289:       return makePosition(session.lineBaseFen, session.moves, session.moveIndex);
 290:     } catch {
 291:       try { return new Chess(session.currentFen); } catch { return new Chess(); }
 292:     }
 293:   }, [session]);
 294:   const legalTargets = useMemo(() => {
 295:     if (!selectedSquare) return new Set<string>();
 296:     return new Set(game.moves({ square: selectedSquare, verbose: true }).map((move) => move.to));
 297:   }, [game, selectedSquare]);
 298:   const pieceSquares = game.board();
 299:   const moveHistory = useMemo(() => {
 300:     try { return makePosition(session?.lineBaseFen ?? START_FEN, session?.moves ?? [], session?.moveIndex ?? 0).history({ verbose: true }); }
 301:     catch { return []; }
 302:   }, [session]);
 303:   const highlightedMove = lastMove ?? (moveHistory.length
 304:     ? { from: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].from, to: moveHistory[moveHistory.length - 1].to }
 305:     : null);
 306:   const engineArrow = useMemo(
 307:     () => engineEnabled ? parseBestMove(engineScore?.bestMove) : null,
 308:     [engineEnabled, engineScore?.bestMove],
 309:   );
 310: 
 311:   useEffect(() => {
 312:     setUserArrows([]);
 313:     setArrowStart(null);
 314:     setArrowHover(null);
 315:     setAnnotationMode(false);
 316:   }, [book?.id, session?.currentFen]);
 317: 
 318:   useEffect(() => {
 319:     if (engineEnabled) engineRef.current?.analyze(game.fen(), engineDepth);
 320:   }, [engineEnabled, session?.currentFen, session?.moveIndex, engineDepth]);
 321: 
 322:   function messageOf(cause: unknown): string {
 323:     return cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause);
 324:   }
 325: 
 326:   function toggleEngine() {
 327:     if (engineEnabled) {
 328:       engineRef.current?.dispose();
 329:       engineRef.current = null;
 330:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 331:       setEngineStatus("off");
 332:       setEngineScore(null);
 333:       setEngineMessage("");
 334:       return;
 335:     }
 336:     try {
 337:       setEngineScore(null);
 338:       setEngineMessage("");
 339:       const client = new StockfishEngine(
 340:         `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js`,
 341:         (status, message) => {
 342:           setEngineStatus(status);
 343:           if (status === "error") {
 344:             setEngineMessage(message || "Stockfish could not start. Check the engine assets and browser worker support.");
 345:             setEngineEnabled(false);
 346:             setEngineScore(null);
 347:             engineRef.current?.dispose();
 348:             engineRef.current = null;
 349:           }
 350:         },
 351:         setEngineScore,
 352:       );
 353:       engineRef.current = client;
 354:       setEngineEnabled(true);
 355:     } catch (cause) {
 356:       setEngineStatus("error");
 357:       setEngineMessage(`Stockfish could not start: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 358:       setEngineEnabled(false);
 359:     }
 360:   }
 361: 
 362:   function patchSession(change: Partial<BookSession> | ((current: BookSession) => BookSession)) {
 363:     setSession((current) => {
 364:       if (!current) return current;
 365:       return typeof change === "function" ? change(current) : { ...current, ...change };
 366:     });
 367:   }

 369:   async function openBook(item: BookRecord) {
 370:     try {
 371:       const existing = sessionIndex[item.id] ?? await getSession(item.id);
 372:       const nextSession = existing ?? newSession(item.id);
 373:       const opened = { ...item, lastOpenedAt: Date.now() };
 374:       await Promise.all([putBook(opened), putSession(nextSession), setActiveBookId(opened.id)]);
 375:       setBooks((current) => [...current.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== opened.id), opened].sort((a, b) => b.lastOpenedAt - a.lastOpenedAt));
 376:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [opened.id]: nextSession }));
 377:       setBook(opened);
 378:       setSession(nextSession);
 379:       setNotice(`Opened ${opened.title}`);
 380:       setError("");
 381:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 382:     } catch (cause) {
 383:       setError(`Could not open book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 384:     }
 385:   }
 386: 
 387:   async function addBook(file?: File) {
 388:     if (!file) return;
 389:     try {
 390:       if (file.size > FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error("PDFs must be 100 MB or smaller.");
 391:       const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 5).arrayBuffer());
 392:       if (new TextDecoder().decode(header) !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("The selected file does not contain a valid PDF header.");
 393:       const now = Date.now();
 394:       const created: BookRecord = {
 395:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 396:         title: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
 397:         file: file.slice(0, file.size, "application/pdf"),
 398:         byteLength: file.size,
 399:         lastOpenedAt: now,
 400:         addedAt: now,
 401:       };
 402:       const blank = newSession(created.id);
 403:       await Promise.all([putBook(created), putSession(blank), setActiveBookId(created.id)]);
 404:       setBooks((current) => [created, ...current]);
 405:       setSessionIndex((current) => ({ ...current, [created.id]: blank }));
 406:       setBook(created);
 407:       setSession(blank);
 408:       setNotice("PDF added to this browser's local library.");
 409:       setError("");
 410:       if (fileInput.current) fileInput.current.value = "";
 411:     } catch (cause) {
 412:       setError(`Could not add PDF: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 413:     }
 414:   }
 415: 
 416:   async function deleteBook(item: BookRecord) {
 417:     if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${item.title}" and its saved reading progress from this browser? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
 418: 
 419:     try {
 420:       await removeBook(item.id);
 421:       await removeSession(item.id);
 422: 
 423:       setBooks((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.id !== item.id));
 424:       setSessionIndex((current) => {
 425:         const next = { ...current };
 426:         delete next[item.id];
 427:         return next;
 428:       });
 429: 
 430:       if (book?.id === item.id) {
 431:         setBook(null);
 432:         setSession(null);
 433:         setPdf(null);
 434:       }
 435: 
 436:       setNotice(`Removed "${item.title}" from your library.`);
 437:       setError("");
 438:     } catch (cause) {
 439:       setError(`Could not remove book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 440:     }
 441:   }
 442:   async function renameBook(item: BookRecord) {
 443:     const title = window.prompt("Book title", item.title)?.trim();
 444:     if (!title || title === item.title) return;
 445:     const renamed = { ...item, title };
 446:     try {
 447:       await putBook(renamed);
 448:       setBooks((current) => current.map((entry) => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 449:       if (book?.id === item.id) setBook(renamed);
 450:     } catch (cause) {
 451:       setError(`Could not rename book: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 452:     }
 453:   }

 455:   function changePage(delta: number) {
 456:     if (!session) return;
 457:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 999_999, session.page + delta)) });
 458:   }

 460:   function goToPage(value: number) {
 461:     if (!session || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
 462:     patchSession({ page: Math.max(1, Math.min(session.pageCount || 1, Math.floor(value))) });
 463:   }

 465:   function moveToPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 466:     const activeSession = session ?? newSession("analysis");
 467:     try {
 468:       const next = new Chess(fen);
 469:       setSession({
 470:         ...activeSession,
 471:         originalFen: fen,
 472:         lineBaseFen: fen,
 473:         currentFen: next.fen(),
 474:         moves: [],
 475:         moveIndex: 0,
 476:       });
 477:       setLastMove(null);
 478:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 479:       setUserArrows([]);
 480:       setNotice("Position loaded. Reset Board returns to this diagram position.");
 481:       return true;
 482:     } catch (cause) {
 483:       setError(`Invalid chess position: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 484:       return false;
 485:     }
 486:   }

 488:   function analyzeManualPosition(fen: string): boolean {
 489:     const loaded = moveToPosition(fen);
 490:     if (!loaded) return false;
 491:     setEngineScore(null);
 492:     setEngineMessage("");
 493:     if (!engineEnabled) {
 494:       toggleEngine();
 495:     } else {
 496:       engineRef.current?.analyze(fen, engineDepth);
 497:     }
 498:     setNotice("Manual position loaded. Stockfish analysis started.");
 499:     return true;
 500:   }

 515:   function resetSelectedCrop() {
 516:     const baseline = cropBaselineRef.current;
 517:     if (!baseline || !session) return;
 518:     patchSession((current) => {

 536:         return {

 538:           candidatesByPage: {

 540:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>

 551:   async function openTransfer(candidate: Candidate) {
 552:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 553:     if (!canvas || canvas.width === 0 || canvas.height === 0) {
 554:       setError("The rendered page image is unavailable. Rerender the page before using this crop.");
 555:       return;
 556:     }
 557:     let preview: HTMLCanvasElement;
 558:     try {
 559:       const crop = cropToPixels(candidate, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 560:       preview = document.createElement("canvas");
 561:       preview.width = crop.width;
 562:       preview.height = crop.height;
 563:       const context = preview.getContext("2d");
 564:       if (!context) throw new Error("Could not prepare a crop preview in this browser.");
 565:       context.drawImage(canvas, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height);
 566:     } catch (cause) {
 567:       setError(`Could not create the crop preview: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 568:       return;
 569:     }
 570:     setTransferCandidate(candidate);
 571:     setTransferPreview(preview.toDataURL("image/png"));
 572:     setTransferFen("");
 573:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 574:         setRecognitionError("");
 575:         const requestId = ++transferRequestRef.current;
 576:     setRecognitionStatus("loading");
 577:     try {
 578:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 579:         preview.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("Could not encode the selected crop.")), "image/png");
 580:       });
 581:       const form = new FormData();
 582:       form.append("image", image, `board-crop-${candidate.id}.png`);
 583:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/recognize`, { method: "POST", body: form });
 584:       const result = await response.json() as RecognitionResult & { detail?: string };
 585:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.detail ?? `Recognition service returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 586:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 587:       setTransferFen(result.fen);
 588:       setRecognitionResult(result);
 589:       setRecognitionStatus("complete");
 590:       // A successful scan immediately becomes the active analysis position.
 591:       // Keep the review dialog open so the user can correct uncertain squares;
 592:       // the explicit confirmation button remains available for corrected FENs.
 593:       if (moveToPosition(result.fen)) {
 594:         setNotice("Scanned position loaded automatically onto the analysis board. Review the diagram and correct any uncertain squares before continuing.");
 595:       }
 596:     } catch (cause) {
 597:       if (requestId !== transferRequestRef.current) return;
 598:       setRecognitionStatus("failed");
 599:       setRecognitionError(messageOf(cause));
 600:     }
 601:   }
 602: 
 603:   function closeTransfer() {
 604:     transferRequestRef.current += 1;
 605:     setTransferCandidate(null);
 606:     setTransferPreview("");
 607:     setTransferFen("");
 608:     setRecognitionStatus("idle");
 609:     setRecognitionResult(null);
 610:     setRecognitionError("");
 611:       }

 614:   function updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame: Chess) {
 615:     if (currentGame.isCheckmate()) {
 616:       setGameEndOverlay({
 617:         title: "Checkmate",
 618:         message: `${currentGame.turn() === "w" ? "Black" : "White"} wins.`,
 619:       });
 620:     } else if (currentGame.isStalemate()) {
 621:       setGameEndOverlay({
 622:         title: "Stalemate",
 623:         message: "The side to move has no legal moves, but its king is not in check. The game is a draw.",
 624:       });
 625:     } else if (currentGame.isDraw()) {
 626:       let message = "The game is drawn.";
 627:       if (currentGame.isThreefoldRepetition()) message = "Draw by threefold repetition.";
 628:       else if (currentGame.isInsufficientMaterial()) message = "Draw by insufficient material.";
 629:       else if (currentGame.isDrawByFiftyMoves()) message = "Draw by the fifty-move rule.";
 630:       else if (currentGame.isDraw()) message = "Draw by a draw rule.";
 631:       setGameEndOverlay({ title: "Draw", message });
 632:     } else {
 633:       setGameEndOverlay(null);
 634:     }
 635:   }

 637:   function completePromotion(piece: "q" | "r" | "b" | "n") {
 638:     if (!promotionRequest || !session) return;
 639:     try {
 640:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 641:       const result = currentGame.move({
 642:         from: promotionRequest.from,
 643:         to: promotionRequest.to,
 644:         promotion: piece,
 645:       });
 646:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 647:       patchSession({
 648:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 649:         moves: nextMoves,
 650:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 651:       });
 652:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 653:       setLastMove({ from: promotionRequest.from, to: promotionRequest.to });
 654:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 655:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 656:       setError("");
 657:     } catch {
 658:       setError("Unable to complete pawn promotion.");
 659:       setPromotionRequest(null);
 660:     }
 661:   }
 662: 
 663:   function makeMove(from: Square, to: Square) {
 664:     if (!session) return;
 665:     try {
 666:       const currentGame = new Chess(session.currentFen);
 667:       const mover = currentGame.get(from);
 668:       const promote = mover?.type === "p" && (to.endsWith("8") || to.endsWith("1"));
 669:       if (promote) {
 670:         setPromotionRequest({ from, to });
 671:         return;
 672:       }
 673:       const result = currentGame.move({ from, to });
 674:       const nextMoves = [...session.moves.slice(0, session.moveIndex), result.san];
 675:       patchSession({
 676:         currentFen: currentGame.fen(),
 677:         moves: nextMoves,
 678:         moveIndex: nextMoves.length,
 679:       });
 680:       updateGameEndOverlay(currentGame);
 681:       setLastMove({ from, to });
 682:       setSelectedSquare(null);
 683:       setError("");
 684:     } catch {
 685:       const piece = game.get(to);
 686:       if (piece && piece.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(to);
 687:       else setSelectedSquare(null);
 688:     }
 689:   }
 690: 
 691:   function handleSquareClick(square: Square) {
 692:     // A left-click removes the red highlight from that square.
 693:     setRedSquares([]);
 694:     
 695:     if (!annotationMode && (userArrows.length > 0 || arrowStart !== null)) {
 696:       setUserArrows([]);
 697:       setArrowStart(null);
 698:       setArrowHover(null);
 699:       return;
 700:     }
 701: if (!session) return;
 702:     if (annotationMode) {
 703:       if (!arrowStart) {
 704:         setArrowStart(square);
 705:         return;
 706:       }
 707:       if (arrowStart !== square) setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from: arrowStart, to: square }));
 708:       setArrowStart(null);
 709:       setArrowHover(null);
 710:       return;
 711:     }
 712:     if (selectedSquare && legalTargets.has(square)) {
 713:       makeMove(selectedSquare, square);
 714:       return;
 715:     }
 716:     const piece = game.get(square);
 717:     if (piece?.color === game.turn()) setSelectedSquare(square);
 718:     else setSelectedSquare(null);
 719:   }

 721:   function boardArrowPointerDown(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 722:   if (event.button !== 2 || !boardRef.current) return;
 723: 
 724:   event.preventDefault();
 725: 
 726:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 727:   const square = boardSquareAtPoint(
 728:     event.clientX,
 729:     event.clientY,
 730:     bounds,
 731:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 732:   );
 733: 
 734:   if (!square) return;
 735: 
 736:   // Only suppress the context menu if an arrow is actually drawn.
 737:   suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 738:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 739:   arrowGestureRef.current = square;
 740:   setArrowStart(square);
 741:   setArrowHover(square);
 742: 
 743:   event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 744: }
 745: 
 746:   function boardArrowPointerMove(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 747:     if (!arrowGestureRef.current || !boardRef.current) return;
 748:     const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 749:     const square = boardSquareAtPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY, bounds, Boolean(session?.flipped));
 750:     if (square && square !== arrowGestureRef.current) arrowGestureMovedRef.current = true;
 751:     setArrowHover(square);
 752:   }
 753: 
 754:   function boardArrowPointerUp(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 755:   const from = arrowGestureRef.current;
 756: 
 757:   if (!from || !boardRef.current) return;
 758: 
 759:   const bounds = boardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
 760:   const to = boardSquareAtPoint(
 761:     event.clientX,
 762:     event.clientY,
 763:     bounds,
 764:     Boolean(session?.flipped),
 765:   );
 766: 
 767:   if (to && to !== from) {
 768:     setUserArrows((arrows) => toggleArrow(arrows, { from, to }));
 769:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = true;
 770:   } else {
 771:     suppressBoardContextMenuRef.current = false;
 772:   }
 773: 
 774:   arrowGestureRef.current = null;
 775:   arrowGestureMovedRef.current = false;
 776:   setArrowStart(null);
 777:   setArrowHover(null);
 778: }

 782:     setArrowStart(null);
 783:     setArrowHover(null);

 813:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;

 815:     setDetecting(false);

 817:

 819:       ...current,
 820:       candidatesByPage: {

 824:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 825:     }));

 829:   function clearBoardScan() {
 830:     // Invalidate any pending response before aborting the request.
 831:     ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 832: 
 833:     const controller = scanAbortControllerRef.current;
 834:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 835:     controller?.abort();
 836:

 838:     setManualMode(false);
 839:     setDragSelection(null);
 840:     setCropEditingId(null);
 841:     cropEditStartRef.current = null;
 842:     dragStartRef.current = null;
 843: 
 844:     patchSession((current) => ({
 845:       ...current,
 846:       candidatesByPage: {
 847:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 848:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 849:       },
 850:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 851:     }));
 852: 
 853:     setError("");
 854:     setNotice("Board detection cleared.");
 855:   }
 856:   async function detectBoards() {
 857:     if (detecting) {
 858:       stopBoardScan();
 859:       return;
 860:     }
 861: 
 862:     if (!canvasRef.current || !session) return;
 863:     if (!API_BASE) {
 864:       setError("Board detection API is not configured. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL and start the optional CV service.");
 865:       return;
 866:     }
 867: 
 868:     scanAbortControllerRef.current?.abort();
 869:     const abortController = new AbortController();
 870:     scanAbortControllerRef.current = abortController;
 871:     const requestId = ++scanRequestIdRef.current;
 872: 
 873:     setDetecting(true);
 874:     setError("");
 875:     setNotice("Scanning current page...");
 876:     patchSession((current) => ({
 877:       ...current,
 878:       candidatesByPage: {
 879:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
 880:         [String(current.page)]: [],
 881:       },
 882:       selectedDiagramId: null,
 883:     }));
 884: 
 885:     try {
 886:       const image = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
 887:         canvasRef.current?.toBlob(
 888:           (blob) => blob
 889:             ? resolve(blob)
 890:             : reject(new Error("Could not encode rendered PDF page.")),
 891:           "image/png",
 892:         );
 893:       });
 894: 
 895:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 896: 
 897:       const form = new FormData();
 898:       form.append("image", image, `page-${session.page}.png`);
 899: 
 900:       const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/detect`, {
 901:         method: "POST",
 902:         body: form,
 903:         signal: abortController.signal,
 904:       });
 905: 
 906:       if (!response.ok) {
 907:         throw new Error(`Detector returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 908:       }
 909: 
 910:       const data = await response.json() as { candidates?: CandidateInput[] };
 911:       const candidates = (data.candidates ?? []).map(
 912:         (item, index) => normalizedCandidate({ ...item, source: "automatic" }, index),
 913:       );
 914: 
 915:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 916: 
 917:       patchSession((current) => ({
 918:         ...current,
 919:         candidatesByPage: {
 920:           ...current.candidatesByPage,
 921:           [String(current.page)]: candidates,
 922:         },
 923:         selectedDiagramId: null,
 924:       }));
 925: 
 926:       setNotice(
 927:         candidates.length
 928:           ? `Found ${candidates.length} board candidate${candidates.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Select a candidate to recognize its chess position and load it onto the analysis board.`
 929:           : "No board candidates found.",
 930:       );
 931:     } catch (cause) {
 932:       if (requestId !== scanRequestIdRef.current) return;
 933: 
 934:       if (abortController.signal.aborted) {
 935:         setNotice("Scan cancelled.");
 936:       } else {
 937:         setError(`Board detection failed: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
 938:       }
 939:     } finally {
 940:       if (requestId === scanRequestIdRef.current) {
 941:         scanAbortControllerRef.current = null;
 942:         setDetecting(false);
 943:       }
 944:     }
 945:   }
 946:   function pointerPosition(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }) {
 947:     const box = canvasRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();

 951:   function startCropEdit(
 952:     event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
 953:     candidate: Candidate,
 954:     handle: CropHandle,
 955:   ) {
 956:     event.stopPropagation();
 957:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 958:     const stage = pageStageRef.current;
 959:     if (!point || !stage) return;
 960:     cropEditStartRef.current = { candidate, handle, point };
 961:     stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
