 964:   function startRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 965:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) return;
 966:     if (!manualMode) return;
 967: const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 968: if (!canvas) return;
 969: const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
 970: if (target.closest(".diagram-overlay, .crop-handle")) return;
 971: const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 972: if (
 973:   event.clientX < bounds.left ||
 974:   event.clientX > bounds.right ||
 975:   event.clientY < bounds.top ||
 976:   event.clientY > bounds.bottom
 977: ) return;
 978:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
 979:     if (!point) return;
 980:     dragStartRef.current = point;
 981:     const selection = { ...point, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
 982:     dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
 983:     setDragSelection(selection);
 984:     event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
 985:   }

 987:   function moveRegion(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
 988:     const edit = cropEditStartRef.current;
 989:     if (edit) {
 990:       const point = pointerPosition(event);
 991:       if (!point || !session) return;
 992:       const next = editCrop(edit.candidate, edit.handle, point.x - edit.point.x, point.y - edit.point.y);
 993:       patchSession((current) => {
 994:         const pageKey = String(current.page);
 995:         return {
 996:           ...current,
 997:           candidatesByPage: {
 998:             ...current.candidatesByPage,
 999:             [pageKey]: (current.candidatesByPage[pageKey] ?? []).map((candidate) =>
1000:               candidate.id === edit.candidate.id ? { ...candidate, ...next } : candidate),
1001:           },
1002:         };
1003:       });
1004:       return;
1005:     }
1006:     if (!dragStartRef.current) return;
1007:     const point = pointerPosition(event);
1008:     if (point) {
1009:       const selection = { ...dragStartRef.current, x2: point.x, y2: point.y };
1010:       dragCurrentRef.current = selection;
1011:       setDragSelection(selection);
1012:     }
1013:   }

1015:   function finishRegion() {
1016:     if (cropEditStartRef.current) {
1017:       cropEditStartRef.current = null;
1018:       return;
1019:     }
1020:     const selection = dragCurrentRef.current;
1021:     if (!dragStartRef.current || !selection || !session) return;
1022:     const x = Math.min(selection.x, selection.x2);
1023:     const y = Math.min(selection.y, selection.y2);
1024:     const width = Math.abs(selection.x2 - selection.x);
1025:     const height = Math.abs(selection.y2 - selection.y);
1026:     dragStartRef.current = null;
1027:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1028:     setDragSelection(null);
1029:     if (width < 0.025 || height < 0.025) return;
1030:     const candidate: Candidate = {
1031:       id: `manual-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
1032:       x, y, width, height,
1033:       relativeScore: 1,
1034:       source: "manual",
1035:     };
1036:     patchSession((current) => ({
1037:       ...current,
1038:       candidatesByPage: {
1039:         ...current.candidatesByPage,
1040:         [String(current.page)]: [...(current.candidatesByPage[String(current.page)] ?? []), candidate],
1041:       },
1042:       selectedDiagramId: candidate.id,
1043:     }));
1044:     setManualMode(false);
1045:     setNotice("Manual crop selected. Adjust its boundary, then use it on the board when ready.");
1046:   }

1051:     dragCurrentRef.current = null;
1052:     setDragSelection(null);

1055:   async function fitPage(mode: "width" | "page") {
1056:     if (!pdf || !session || !pageStageRef.current) return;

1058:       const page = await pdf.getPage(session.page);
1059:       const base = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
1060:       const renderScale = Math.min(1.4, 1100 / base.width);
1061:       const availableWidth = Math.max(200, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? base.width) - 44;
1062:       const availableHeight = Math.max(250, pageStageRef.current.parentElement?.clientHeight ?? base.height) - 52;
1063:       const scale = mode === "width"
1064:         ? availableWidth / (base.width * renderScale)
1065:         : Math.min(availableWidth / base.width, availableHeight / base.height) / renderScale;
1066:       patchSession({ zoom: Math.max(0.45, Math.min(1.8, scale)) });
1067:     } catch (cause) {
1068:       setError(`Could not fit PDF page: ${messageOf(cause)}`);
1069:     }
1070:   }

  34: export function boardSquareAtPoint(
  35:   clientX: number,
  36:   clientY: number,
  37:   rect: Pick<DOMRect, "left" | "top" | "width" | "height">,
  38:   flipped = false,
  39: ): Square | null {
  40:   if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) return null;
  41:   const x = clientX - rect.left;
  42:   const y = clientY - rect.top;
  43:   if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= rect.width || y >= rect.height) return null;
  44:   const column = Math.floor((x / rect.width) * 8);
  45:   const row = Math.floor((y / rect.height) * 8);

  48:   return ("abcdefgh"[file] + rank) as Square;
  49: }

  51: export function squareCenter(square: Square, flipped = false): { x: number; y: number } {

  54:   return {
  55:     x: (flipped ? 7 - file : file) + 0.5,
  56:     y: (flipped ? rank : 7 - rank) + 0.5,
  57:   };

  65: export function toggleArrow(arrows: BoardArrow[], next: BoardArrow): BoardArrow[] {
  66:   const existing = arrows.findIndex((arrow) => arrow.from === next.from && arrow.to === next.to);
  67:   if (existing < 0) return [...arrows, next];
  68:   if (next.color && arrows[existing].color !== next.color) {
  69:     return arrows.map((arrow, index) => (index === existing ? next : arrow));
  70:   }
  71:   return arrows.filter((_, index) => index !== existing);
  72: }

  76:   square: Square,
  77:   color: string = ANNOTATION_COLORS.red,

  87: export function getArrowPath(
  88:   fromSquare: Square,
  89:   toSquare: Square,
  90:   flipped = false,
  91:   shaftWidth = 0.22,
  92:   headLength = 0.36,
  93:   headWidth = 0.50,
  94: ): string {
  95:   const from = squareCenter(fromSquare, flipped);
  96:   const to = squareCenter(toSquare, flipped);
  97:   const dx = to.x - from.x;
  98:   const dy = to.y - from.y;
  99:   const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
 100:   if (len < 0.2) return "";
 101: 
 102:   const ux = dx / len;
 103:   const uy = dy / len;
 104:   const nx = -uy;
 105:   const ny = ux;
 106: 
 107:   const actualHeadLen = len < 0.7 ? len * 0.48 : headLength;
 108:   const actualHeadWidth = len < 0.7 ? len * 0.65 : headWidth;
 109:   const actualShaftWidth = len < 0.7 ? len * 0.28 : shaftWidth;
 110: 
 111:   const hs = actualShaftWidth / 2;
 112:   const hw = actualHeadWidth / 2;
 113: 
 114:   const bx = to.x - actualHeadLen * ux;
 115:   const by = to.y - actualHeadLen * uy;
 116: 
 117:   const tipX = to.x;
 118:   const tipY = to.y;
 119: 
 120:   const headLeftX = bx + hw * nx;
 121:   const headLeftY = by + hw * ny;
 122:   const headRightX = bx - hw * nx;
 123:   const headRightY = by - hw * ny;
 124: 
 125:   const shaftEndLeftX = bx + hs * nx;
 126:   const shaftEndLeftY = by + hs * ny;
 127:   const shaftEndRightX = bx - hs * nx;
 128:   const shaftEndRightY = by - hs * ny;
 129: 
 130:   const shaftStartLeftX = from.x + hs * nx;
 131:   const shaftStartLeftY = from.y + hs * ny;
 132:   const shaftStartRightX = from.x - hs * nx;
 133:   const shaftStartRightY = from.y - hs * ny;
 134: 
 135:   return [
 136:     "M " + shaftStartLeftX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftStartLeftY.toFixed(4),
 137:     "L " + shaftEndLeftX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftEndLeftY.toFixed(4),
 138:     "L " + headLeftX.toFixed(4) + " " + headLeftY.toFixed(4),

 140:     "L " + headRightX.toFixed(4) + " " + headRightY.toFixed(4),

 143:     "A " + hs.toFixed(4) + " " + hs.toFixed(4) + " 0 0 0 " + shaftStartLeftX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftStartLeftY.toFixed(4),

  34: export function boardSquareAtPoint(

  37:   rect: Pick<DOMRect, "left" | "top" | "width" | "height">,
  38:   flipped = false,
  39: ): Square | null {
  40:   if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) return null;
  41:   const x = clientX - rect.left;
  42:   const y = clientY - rect.top;

  44:   const column = Math.floor((x / rect.width) * 8);
  45:   const row = Math.floor((y / rect.height) * 8);
  46:   const file = flipped ? 7 - column : column;
  47:   const rank = flipped ? row + 1 : 8 - row;
  48:   return ("abcdefgh"[file] + rank) as Square;

  51: export function squareCenter(square: Square, flipped = false): { x: number; y: number } {
  52:   const file = square.charCodeAt(0) - 97;
  53:   const rank = Number(square[1]) - 1;
  54:   return {
  55:     x: (flipped ? 7 - file : file) + 0.5,
  56:     y: (flipped ? rank : 7 - rank) + 0.5,
  57:   };

  65: export function toggleArrow(arrows: BoardArrow[], next: BoardArrow): BoardArrow[] {
  66:   const existing = arrows.findIndex((arrow) => arrow.from === next.from && arrow.to === next.to);
  67:   if (existing < 0) return [...arrows, next];
  68:   if (next.color && arrows[existing].color !== next.color) {
  69:     return arrows.map((arrow, index) => (index === existing ? next : arrow));
  70:   }
  71:   return arrows.filter((_, index) => index !== existing);
  72: }

  75:   highlights: SquareHighlight[],
  76:   square: Square,
  77:   color = ANNOTATION_COLORS.red,

  79:   const existing = highlights.findIndex((h) => h.square === square);
  80:   if (existing < 0) return [...highlights, { square, color }];
  81:   if (highlights[existing].color !== color) {
  82:     return highlights.map((h, index) => (index === existing ? { square, color } : h));
  83:   }

  87: export function getArrowPath(
  88:   fromSquare: Square,
  89:   toSquare: Square,
  90:   flipped = false,
  91:   shaftWidth = 0.22,
  92:   headLength = 0.36,
  93:   headWidth = 0.50,
  94: ): string {
  95:   const from = squareCenter(fromSquare, flipped);
  96:   const to = squareCenter(toSquare, flipped);
  97:   const dx = to.x - from.x;
  98:   const dy = to.y - from.y;
  99:   const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
 100:   if (len < 0.2) return "";
 101: 
 102:   const ux = dx / len;
 103:   const uy = dy / len;
 104:   const nx = -uy;
 105:   const ny = ux;
 106: 
 107:   const actualHeadLen = len < 0.7 ? len * 0.48 : headLength;
 108:   const actualHeadWidth = len < 0.7 ? len * 0.65 : headWidth;
 109:   const actualShaftWidth = len < 0.7 ? len * 0.28 : shaftWidth;
 110: 
 111:   const hs = actualShaftWidth / 2;
 112:   const hw = actualHeadWidth / 2;
 113: 
 114:   const bx = to.x - actualHeadLen * ux;
 115:   const by = to.y - actualHeadLen * uy;
 116: 
 117:   const tipX = to.x;
 118:   const tipY = to.y;
 119: 
 120:   const headLeftX = bx + hw * nx;
 121:   const headLeftY = by + hw * ny;
 122:   const headRightX = bx - hw * nx;
 123:   const headRightY = by - hw * ny;
 124: 
 125:   const shaftEndLeftX = bx + hs * nx;
 126:   const shaftEndLeftY = by + hs * ny;
 127:   const shaftEndRightX = bx - hs * nx;
 128:   const shaftEndRightY = by - hs * ny;
 129: 
 130:   const shaftStartLeftX = from.x + hs * nx;
 131:   const shaftStartLeftY = from.y + hs * ny;
 132:   const shaftStartRightX = from.x - hs * nx;
 133:   const shaftStartRightY = from.y - hs * ny;
 134: 
 135:   return [
 136:     "M " + shaftStartLeftX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftStartLeftY.toFixed(4),
 137:     "L " + shaftEndLeftX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftEndLeftY.toFixed(4),
 138:     "L " + headLeftX.toFixed(4) + " " + headLeftY.toFixed(4),
 139:     "L " + tipX.toFixed(4) + " " + tipY.toFixed(4),
 140:     "L " + headRightX.toFixed(4) + " " + headRightY.toFixed(4),
 141:     "L " + shaftEndRightX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftEndRightY.toFixed(4),
 142:     "L " + shaftStartRightX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftStartRightY.toFixed(4),
 143:     "A " + hs.toFixed(4) + " " + hs.toFixed(4) + " 0 0 0 " + shaftStartLeftX.toFixed(4) + " " + shaftStartLeftY.toFixed(4),
 144:     "Z",
 145:   ].join(" ");
 146: }

   1: import { Chess } from "chess.js";
   2: 
   3: export function makePosition(baseFen: string, moves: string[], moveIndex: number): Chess {
   4:   const game = new Chess(baseFen);
   5:   for (const san of moves.slice(0, moveIndex)) {
   6:     const result = game.move(san);
   7:     if (!result) throw new Error(`Saved move could not be replayed: ${san}`);
   8:   }
   9:   return game;
  10: }
  11: 
  12: export function fenWithTurn(fen: string, turn: "w" | "b"): string {
  13:   const fields = fen.split(/\s+/);
  14:   if (fields.length !== 6) throw new Error("FEN must contain six fields.");
  15:   fields[1] = turn;
  16:   fields[3] = "-";
  17:   fields[4] = "0";
  18:   return fields.join(" ");
  19: }

  13:   return next;

SOURCE FILE: src\crop-geometry.ts (2060 bytes)
================================================================================
   1: export type CropBounds = { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number };
   2: export type CropHandle = "move" | "n" | "s" | "e" | "w" | "ne" | "nw" | "se" | "sw";
   3: 
   4: export function pointOnCanvas(
   5:   clientX: number,
   6:   clientY: number,
   7:   rect: Pick<DOMRect, "left" | "top" | "width" | "height">,
   8: ): { x: number; y: number } | null {
   9:   if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) return null;
  10:   return {
  11:     x: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (clientX - rect.left) / rect.width)),
  12:     y: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (clientY - rect.top) / rect.height)),
  13:   };
  14: }
  15: 
  16: export function editCrop(
  17:   start: CropBounds,
  18:   handle: CropHandle,
  19:   deltaX: number,
  20:   deltaY: number,
  21:   minimum = 0.04,
  22: ): CropBounds {
  23:   if (handle === "move") {
  24:     const x = Math.max(0, Math.min(1 - start.width, start.x + deltaX));
  25:     const y = Math.max(0, Math.min(1 - start.height, start.y + deltaY));
  26:     return { ...start, x, y };
  27:   }
  28:   let left = start.x;
  29:   let top = start.y;
  30:   let right = start.x + start.width;
  31:   let bottom = start.y + start.height;
  32:   if (handle.includes("w")) left = Math.max(0, Math.min(right - minimum, left + deltaX));
  33:   if (handle.includes("e")) right = Math.min(1, Math.max(left + minimum, right + deltaX));
  34:   if (handle.includes("n")) top = Math.max(0, Math.min(bottom - minimum, top + deltaY));
  35:   if (handle.includes("s")) bottom = Math.min(1, Math.max(top + minimum, bottom + deltaY));
  36:   return { x: left, y: top, width: right - left, height: bottom - top };
  37: }
  38: 
  39: export function cropToPixels(bounds: CropBounds, sourceWidth: number, sourceHeight: number) {
  40:   const x = Math.max(0, Math.min(sourceWidth - 1, Math.floor(bounds.x * sourceWidth)));
  41:   const y = Math.max(0, Math.min(sourceHeight - 1, Math.floor(bounds.y * sourceHeight)));
  42:   const right = Math.max(x + 1, Math.min(sourceWidth, Math.ceil((bounds.x + bounds.width) * sourceWidth - 1e-7)));
  43:   const bottom = Math.max(y + 1, Math.min(sourceHeight, Math.ceil((bounds.y + bounds.height) * sourceHeight - 1e-7)));
  44:   return { x, y, width: right - x, height: bottom - y };
  45: }

 246: const PIECE_UNICODE: Record<string, string> = {
 247:   K: "♔", Q: "♕", R: "♖", B: "♗", N: "♘", P: "♙",
 248:   k: "♚", q: "♛", r: "♜", b: "♝", n: "♞", p: "♟",
 249: };
 250: 
 251: function parseFenBoard(fen: string): (string | null)[][] {
 252:   const placement = fen.split(" ")[0];
 253:   return placement.split("/").map((row) => {
 254:     const squares: (string | null)[] = [];
 255:     for (const ch of row) {
 256:       if (ch >= "1" && ch <= "8") {
 257:         const emptyCount = parseInt(ch, 10);
 258:         for (let i = 0; i < emptyCount; i++) squares.push(null);
 259:       } else {
 260:         squares.push(ch);
 261:       }
 262:     }
 263:     return squares;
 264:   });
 265: }
 266: 
 267: function getSquareName(rowIdx: number, colIdx: number): string {
 268:   const files = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h"];
 269:   return `${files[colIdx]}${8 - rowIdx}`;
 270: }

 273:   const [selectedPly, setSelectedPly] = useState<number>(21);
 274:   const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<ReviewTab>("review");
 275:   const [flipped, setFlipped] = useState<boolean>(false);
 276: 
 277:   const currentMove: ReviewedMove | null = useMemo(() => {

 285:   useEffect(() => {

 287:       if (e.target instanceof HTMLInputElement || e.target instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement) return;
 288:       if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") {
 289:         e.preventDefault();
 290:         setSelectedPly((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1));
 291:       } else if (e.key === "ArrowRight") {
 292:         e.preventDefault();
 293:         setSelectedPly((prev) => Math.min(SAMPLE_MOVES.length, prev + 1));
 294:       } else if (e.key === "Home") {
 295:         e.preventDefault();
 296:         setSelectedPly(0);
 297:       } else if (e.key === "End") {
 298:         e.preventDefault();
 299:         setSelectedPly(SAMPLE_MOVES.length);
 300:       }
 301:     };
 302:     window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
 303:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
 304:   }, []);
 305: 
 306:   const movePairs = useMemo(() => {
 307:     const pairs: { moveNumber: number; white?: ReviewedMove; black?: ReviewedMove }[] = [];
 308:     for (const move of SAMPLE_MOVES) {
 309:       let existing = pairs.find((p) => p.moveNumber === move.moveNumber);
 310:       if (!existing) {
 311:         existing = { moveNumber: move.moveNumber };
 312:         pairs.push(existing);
 313:       }
 314:       if (move.color === "w") existing.white = move;
 315:       else existing.black = move;
 316:     }
 317:     return pairs;
 318:   }, []);

 324:     ];
 325:     return types.map((type) => ({
 326:       type,
 327:       meta: CLASSIFICATION_META[type],
 328:       white: SAMPLE_MOVES.filter((m) => m.color === "w" && m.classification === type).length,
 329:       black: SAMPLE_MOVES.filter((m) => m.color === "b" && m.classification === type).length,
 330:     }));
 331:   }, []);
 332:

 334:     () => SAMPLE_MOVES.filter((m) => ["brilliant", "great", "mistake", "blunder", "missed-win"].includes(m.classification)),
 335:     []
 336:   );
 337:

 341: 
 342:   const fromSquare = currentMove ? currentMove.uci.slice(0, 2) : null;

  30: export function isChessNotationText(text: string): { isNotation: boolean; kind: NotationHighlightKind } {
  31:   const trimmed = text.trim();
  32:   if (!trimmed || trimmed.length < 2) return { isNotation: false, kind: "continuous" };
  33: 
  34:   const hasMoveNum = MOVE_NUMBER_REGEX.test(trimmed);
  35:   const hasSan = SAN_MOVE_REGEX.test(trimmed);
  36:   const hasFigurine = FIGURINE_REGEX.test(trimmed) || FIGURINE_MOVE_REGEX.test(trimmed);
  37:   const hasSymbol = CHESS_SYMBOL_REGEX.test(trimmed);
  38:   const hasProse = CHESS_PROSE_REGEX.test(trimmed);
  39: 
  40:   if (trimmed.startsWith("(") || (trimmed.includes("(") && (hasSan || hasFigurine))) {

  44:   if (hasMoveNum && (hasSan || hasFigurine)) {
  45:     return { isNotation: true, kind: "continuous" };
  46:   }
  47: 
  48:   if (hasSan && (hasFigurine || hasSymbol || trimmed.split(/\s+/).length >= 2)) {
  49:     return { isNotation: true, kind: "continuous" };
  50:   }
  51: 
  52:   if (hasFigurine && (hasSan || hasSymbol || hasMoveNum)) {
  53:     return { isNotation: true, kind: "continuous" };
  54:   }
  55: 
  56:   if (hasProse && (hasMoveNum || hasSan || hasFigurine || trimmed.toLowerCase().includes("diagram"))) {
  57:     return { isNotation: true, kind: "prose" };
  58:   }
  59: 
  60:   return { isNotation: false, kind: "continuous" };

  63: type NormalizedTextLine = {
  64:   text: string;

  72: export function extractNotationHighlights(
  73:   items: PDFTextItemInput[],
  74:   viewport: { width: number; height: number; convertToViewportPoint?: (x: number, y: number) => [number, number] },
  75:   candidates: Candidate[],
  76: ): NotationHighlight[] {
  77:   if (!items.length || !candidates.length || viewport.width <= 0 || viewport.height <= 0) {
  78:     return [];
  79:   }
  80: 
  81:   const textItems: { text: string; x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }[] = [];
  82: 
  83:   for (const item of items) {
  84:     if (!item.str || !item.str.trim()) continue;
  85:     const tx = item.transform[4];
  86:     const ty = item.transform[5];
  87:     const w = item.width || Math.abs(item.transform[0]) || 8;
  88:     const h = item.height || Math.abs(item.transform[3]) || 10;
  89: 
  90:     let x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number;
  91:     if (typeof viewport.convertToViewportPoint === "function") {
  92:       [x1, y1] = viewport.convertToViewportPoint(tx, ty + h);
  93:       [x2, y2] = viewport.convertToViewportPoint(tx + w, ty);
  94:     } else {
  95:       x1 = tx;
  96:       y1 = viewport.height - (ty + h);
  97:       x2 = tx + w;
  98:       y2 = viewport.height - ty;
  99:     }
 100: 
 101:     const normX = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Math.min(x1, x2) / viewport.width));
 102:     const normY = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Math.min(y1, y2) / viewport.height));
 103:     const normW = Math.max(0.005, Math.min(1 - normX, Math.abs(x2 - x1) / viewport.width));
 104:     const normH = Math.max(0.005, Math.min(1 - normY, Math.abs(y2 - y1) / viewport.height));
 105: 
 106:     textItems.push({
 107:       text: item.str,
 108:       x: normX,
 109:       y: normY,
 110:       width: normW,
 111:       height: normH,
 112:     });
 113:   }
 114: 
 115:   if (!textItems.length) return [];
 116: 
 117:   textItems.sort((a, b) => (Math.abs(a.y - b.y) < 0.008 ? a.x - b.x : a.y - b.y));
 118: 
 119:   const lines: NormalizedTextLine[] = [];
 120:   let currentGroup: typeof textItems = [];
 121: 
 122:   function flushGroup() {
 123:     if (!currentGroup.length) return;
 124:     const text = currentGroup.map((i) => i.text).join(" ").trim();
 125:     const { isNotation, kind } = isChessNotationText(text);
 126: 
 127:     if (isNotation) {
 128:       const minX = Math.min(...currentGroup.map((i) => i.x));
 129:       const minY = Math.min(...currentGroup.map((i) => i.y));
 130:       const maxX = Math.max(...currentGroup.map((i) => i.x + i.width));
 131:       const maxY = Math.max(...currentGroup.map((i) => i.y + i.height));
 132:       lines.push({
 133:         text,
 134:         x: Math.max(0, minX - 0.003),
 135:         y: Math.max(0, minY - 0.002),
 136:         width: Math.min(1 - minX, (maxX - minX) + 0.006),
 137:         height: Math.min(1 - minY, (maxY - minY) + 0.004),
 138:         kind,
 139:       });
 140:     }
 141:     currentGroup = [];
 142:   }
 143: 
 144:   for (const item of textItems) {
 145:     if (!currentGroup.length) {
 146:       currentGroup.push(item);
 147:     } else {
 148:       const last = currentGroup[currentGroup.length - 1];
 149:       const sameLine = Math.abs(item.y - last.y) < 0.01;
 150:       const nearbyX = item.x - (last.x + last.width) < 0.08;
 151:       if (sameLine && nearbyX) {
 152:         currentGroup.push(item);
 153:       } else {
 154:         flushGroup();
 155:         currentGroup.push(item);
 156:       }
 157:     }
 158:   }
 159:   flushGroup();
 160: 
 161:   if (!lines.length) return [];
 162: 
 163:   const result: NotationHighlight[] = [];
 164: 
 165:   for (let index = 0; index < lines.length; index++) {
 166:     const line = lines[index];
 167:     let bestCandidate = candidates[0];
 168:     let bestDistance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
 169: 
 170:     for (const candidate of candidates) {
 171:       const candBottom = candidate.y + candidate.height;
 172:       const candTop = candidate.y;
 173:       const candCenterX = candidate.x + candidate.width / 2;
 174:       const lineCenterX = line.x + line.width / 2;
 175: 
 176:       const isBelow = line.y >= candTop - 0.02 && line.y <= candBottom + 0.35;
 177:       const xDist = Math.abs(lineCenterX - candCenterX);
 178:       const yDist = line.y >= candBottom ? (line.y - candBottom) : Math.abs(line.y - candTop);
 179: 
 180:       const score = (isBelow ? 0 : 10) + yDist * 2 + xDist * 1.5;
 181: 
 182:       if (score < bestDistance) {
 183:         bestDistance = score;
 184:         bestCandidate = candidate;
 185:       }
 186:     }
 187: 
 188:     result.push({
 189:       id: "highlight-" + bestCandidate.id + "-" + (index + 1),
 190:       candidateId: bestCandidate.id,
 191:       kind: line.kind,
 192:       text: line.text,
 193:       x: line.x,
 194:       y: line.y,
 195:       width: line.width,
 196:       height: line.height,
 197:     });
 198:   }
 199: 
 200:   return result;

   5: 
   6: const FILES = "abcdefgh";
   7: const PIECES: Record<string, string> = {
   8:   wk:"♔", wq:"♕", wr:"♖", wb:"♗", wn:"♘", wp:"♙",
   9:   bk:"♚", bq:"♛", br:"♜", bb:"♝", bn:"♞", bp:"♟"
  10: };

  12: function parseLine(input: string) {
  13:   const chess = new Chess();
  14:   const cleaned = input
  15:     .replace(/\{[^}]*\}/g, " ")
  16:     .replace(/\([^)]*\)/g, " ")
  17:     .replace(/^\s*\[.*\]\s*$/gm, " ")
  18:     .replace(/\d+\.(\.\.)?/g, " ")
  19:     .replace(/\$\d+/g, " ")
  20:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
  21:     .trim();
  22: 
  23:   const tokens = cleaned.split(" ").filter(Boolean)
  24:     .filter((x) => !["1-0", "0-1", "1/2-1/2", "*"].includes(x));
  25: 
  26:   const moves: string[] = [];
  27:   for (const token of tokens) {
  28:     try {
  29:       const move = chess.move(token);
  30:       moves.push(move.san);
  31:     } catch {
  32:       throw new Error(`Invalid or illegal move: ${token}`);
  33:     }
  34:   }
  35:   return moves;
  36: }
  37:

  42:   const [error, setError] = useState("");
  43:   const [flipped, setFlipped] = useState(false);

  47: 
  48:

  52:     for (const san of moves) {
  53:       game.move(san);
  54:       result.push(game.fen());
  55:     }

  58:

  61:     if (!selectedSquare) return [];

  10: export type OpeningExplorerStats = {
  11:   white: number;
  12:   draws: number;
  13:   black: number;
  14:   total: number;
  15:   moves: OpeningExplorerMove[];
  16:   opening?: { eco?: string; name: string } | null;
  17: };
  18: 
  19: function count(value: unknown): number {
  20:   return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0
  21:     ? value
  22:     : 0;
  23: }
  24: 
  25: function opening(value: unknown): OpeningExplorerStats["opening"] {
  26:   if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return null;
  27:   const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  28:   if (typeof item.name !== "string") return null;
  29:   return {
  30:     name: item.name,
  31:     ...(typeof item.eco === "string" ? { eco: item.eco } : {}),
  32:   };
  33: }
  34: 
  35: export async function fetchOpeningExplorerStats(
  36:   uciMoves: string[],
  37:   signal?: AbortSignal,
  38: ): Promise<OpeningExplorerStats> {
  39:   const query = new URLSearchParams();
  40:   query.set("variant", "standard");
  41:   query.set("moves", "8");
  42:   if (uciMoves.length) query.set("play", uciMoves.join(","));
  43: 
  44:   const response = await fetch(
  45:     `/api/lichess/opening-explorer?${query.toString()}`,
  46:     {
  47:       method: "GET",
  48:       credentials: "same-origin",
  49:       headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
  50:       signal,
  51:     },
  52:   );
  53: 
  54:   if (!response.ok) {
  55:     throw new Error(`Opening Explorer request failed (${response.status}).`);
  56:   }
  57: 
  58:   const raw: unknown = await response.json();
  59:   if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") {
  60:     throw new Error("Opening Explorer returned an invalid response.");
  61:   }
  62: 
  63:   const data = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  64:   const white = count(data.white);
  65:   const draws = count(data.draws);
  66:   const black = count(data.black);
  67: 
  68:   const moves: OpeningExplorerMove[] = Array.isArray(data.moves)
  69:     ? data.moves.flatMap((entry): OpeningExplorerMove[] => {
  70:         if (!entry || typeof entry !== "object") return [];
  71:         const item = entry as Record<string, unknown>;
  72:         if (typeof item.uci !== "string" || typeof item.san !== "string") return [];
  73:         return [{
  74:           uci: item.uci,
  75:           san: item.san,
  76:           white: count(item.white),
  77:           draws: count(item.draws),
  78:           black: count(item.black),
  79:           opening: opening(item.opening),
  80:         }];
  81:       })
  82:     : [];
  83: 
  84:   return {
  85:     white,
  86:     draws,
  87:     black,
  88:     total: white + draws + black,
  89:     moves,
  90:     opening: opening(data.opening),
  91:   };
  92: }

  95:   connected: boolean;

  98: 
  99: export async function getLichessConnectionStatus(
 100:   signal?: AbortSignal,
 101: ): Promise<LichessConnectionStatus> {
 102:   const response = await fetch("/api/lichess/status", {
 103:     method: "GET",
 104:     credentials: "same-origin",
 105:     headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
 106:     cache: "no-store",
 107:     signal,
 108:   });
 109:   if (!response.ok) {
 110:     throw new Error(`Connection status request failed (${response.status}).`);
 111:   }
 112:   const value: unknown = await response.json();
 113:   if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 114:     throw new Error("Invalid connection status response.");
 115:   }
 116:   const status = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 117:   return {
 118:     connected: status.connected === true,
 119:     configured: status.configured === true,
 120:   };
 121: }
 122: 
 123: export async function disconnectLichess(): Promise<void> {
 124:   const response = await fetch("/api/lichess/disconnect", {
 125:     method: "POST",
 126:     credentials: "same-origin",
 127:     headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
 128:   });
 129:   if (!response.ok) {
 130:     throw new Error(`Disconnect request failed (${response.status}).`);
 131:   }
 132: }

   3: export type OpeningLineResult = {
   4:   fen: string;
   5:   sanMoves: string[];
   6:   uciMoves: string[];
   7:   error: string | null;

  10: export function parseOpeningLine(input: string): OpeningLineResult {
  11:   const chess = new Chess();
  12:   const sanMoves: string[] = [];
  13:   const uciMoves: string[] = [];
  14: 
  15:   const tokens = input
  16:     .replace(/\{[^}]*\}/g, " ")
  17:     .replace(/\([^)]*\)/g, " ")
  18:     .replace(/\d+\.(\.\.)?/g, " ")
  19:     .replace(/\$\d+/g, " ")
  20:     .split(/\s+/)
  21:     .filter(Boolean)
  22:     .filter((token) => !["1-0", "0-1", "1/2-1/2", "*"].includes(token));
  23: 
  24:   for (const token of tokens) {
  25:     try {
  26:       const uci = token.match(/^([a-h][1-8])([a-h][1-8])([qrbn])?$/i);
  27:       const move = uci
  28:         ? chess.move({
  29:             from: uci[1].toLowerCase() as Square,
  30:             to: uci[2].toLowerCase() as Square,
  31:             promotion: uci[3]?.toLowerCase(),
  32:           })
  33:         : chess.move(token);
  34: 
  35:       sanMoves.push(move.san);
  36:       uciMoves.push(`${move.from}${move.to}${move.promotion ?? ""}`);
  37:     } catch {
  38:       return {
  39:         fen: chess.fen(),
  40:         sanMoves,
  41:         uciMoves,
  42:         error: `Invalid or illegal move: ${token}`,
  43:       };
  44:     }
  45:   }
  46: 
  47:   return { fen: chess.fen(), sanMoves, uciMoves, error: null };
  48: }
  49: 
  50: export function openingPositionAt(input: string, ply: number): OpeningLineResult {
  51:   const parsed = parseOpeningLine(input);
  52:   if (parsed.error) return parsed;
  53: 
  54:   const limit = Math.max(0, Math.min(parsed.sanMoves.length, Math.floor(ply)));
  55:   const chess = new Chess();
  56:   const sanMoves: string[] = [];
  57:   const uciMoves: string[] = [];
  58: 
  59:   for (let i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
  60:     const move = chess.move(parsed.sanMoves[i]);
  61:     sanMoves.push(move.san);
  62:     uciMoves.push(`${move.from}${move.to}${move.promotion ?? ""}`);
  63:   }
  64: 
  65:   return { fen: chess.fen(), sanMoves, uciMoves, error: null };
  66: }

  11: export function parsePgn(pgn: string): ImportedPgn {
  12:   const source = pgn.trim();
  13: 
  14:   if (!source) {
  15:     throw new Error("Paste or select a PGN game first.");
  16:   }
  17: 
  18:   const parsed = new Chess();
  19: 
  20:   try {
  21:     parsed.loadPgn(source);
  22:   } catch (cause) {
  23:     const detail = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unknown PGN error";
  24:     throw new Error(`Invalid PGN: ${detail}`);
  25:   }
  26: 
  27:   const headers = parsed.getHeaders();
  28:   const customFen = headers.FEN?.trim();
  29:   const lineBaseFen = customFen || START_FEN;
  30: 
  31:   let replay: Chess;
  32: 
  33:   try {
  34:     replay = new Chess(lineBaseFen);
  35:   } catch {
  36:     throw new Error("The PGN contains an invalid starting FEN.");
  37:   }
  38: 
  39:   const moves = parsed.history();
  40: 
  41:   if (moves.length === 0) {
  42:     throw new Error("The PGN contains no moves.");
  43:   }
  44: 
  45:   try {
  46:     for (const san of moves) {
  47:       replay.move(san);
  48:     }
  49:   } catch (cause) {
  50:     const detail = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unknown move error";
  51:     throw new Error(`Could not replay the imported game: ${detail}`);
  52:   }
  53: 
  54:   if (replay.fen() !== parsed.fen()) {
  55:     throw new Error("The imported PGN could not be reproduced from its starting position.");
  56:   }
  57: 
  58:   return {
  59:     headers,
  60:     lineBaseFen,
  61:     moves,
  62:     finalFen: replay.fen(),
  63:   };
  64: }

  24: export function parseFenPlacement(placement: string): string[][] | null {
  25:   const ranks = placement.split("/");
  26:   if (ranks.length !== 8) return null;
  27:   const board: string[][] = [];
  28:   for (const rank of ranks) {
  29:     const squares: string[] = [];
  30:     for (const token of rank) {
  31:       if (/^[1-8]$/.test(token)) squares.push(...Array(Number(token)).fill(""));
  32:       else if (PIECE_CODES.test(token)) squares.push(token);
  33:       else return null;
  34:     }
  35:     if (squares.length !== 8) return null;
  36:     board.push(squares);
  37:   }
  38:   return board;
  39: }
  40: 
  41: export function serializeFenPlacement(board: string[][]): string {
  42:   if (board.length !== 8 || board.some((rank) => rank.length !== 8)) {
  43:     throw new Error("A chess position must contain exactly 64 squares.");
  44:   }
  45:   return board.map((rank) => {
  46:     let result = "";
  47:     let empty = 0;
  48:     for (const piece of rank) {
  49:       if (!piece) {
  50:         empty += 1;
  51:       } else {
  52:         if (!PIECE_CODES.test(piece)) throw new Error(`Invalid chess piece code: ${piece}`);
  53:         if (empty) result += empty;
  54:         empty = 0;
  55:         result += piece;
  56:       }
  57:     }
  58:     if (empty) result += empty;
  59:     return result;
  60:   }).join("/");
  61: }

  63: export function setFenPiece(placement: string, row: number, col: number, piece: string): string {

  73: export function moveFenPiece(placement: string, fromRow: number, fromCol: number, toRow: number, toCol: number): string {

 116: export function sanitizeCastlingRights(board: string[][], currentCastling: string): string {
 117:   if (!currentCastling || currentCastling === "-") return "-";
 118:   let result = "";
 119:   // White king must be on e1 (row 7, col 4)
 120:   const whiteKingOnE1 = board[7]?.[4] === "K";
 121:   if (whiteKingOnE1) {
 122:     if (currentCastling.includes("K") && board[7]?.[7] === "R") result += "K";
 123:     if (currentCastling.includes("Q") && board[7]?.[0] === "R") result += "Q";
 124:   }
 125:   // Black king must be on e8 (row 0, col 4)
 126:   const blackKingOnE8 = board[0]?.[4] === "k";
 127:   if (blackKingOnE8) {
 128:     if (currentCastling.includes("k") && board[0]?.[7] === "r") result += "k";
 129:     if (currentCastling.includes("q") && board[0]?.[0] === "r") result += "q";
 130:   }

 134: export function buildFullFen(

 153: export function validatePositionFen(fen: string): { isValid: boolean; error?: string } {
 154:   const trimmed = fen.trim();
 155:   if (!trimmed) {
 156:     return { isValid: false, error: "Position FEN cannot be empty." };
 157:   }
 158:   const fields = trimmed.split(/\s+/);
 159:   if (fields.length !== 6) {
 160:     return { isValid: false, error: "FEN must contain exactly 6 space-separated fields." };
 161:   }
 162:   const [placement, turn] = fields;
 163:   const board = parseFenPlacement(placement);
 164:   if (!board) {
 165:     return { isValid: false, error: "Invalid board piece placement." };
 166:   }
 167: 
 168:   let whiteKings = 0;
 169:   let blackKings = 0;
 170:   let invalidPawns = 0;
 171:   for (let r = 0; r < 8; r++) {
 172:     for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
 173:       const piece = board[r][c];
 174:       if (piece === "K") whiteKings += 1;
 175:       if (piece === "k") blackKings += 1;
 176:       if ((r === 0 || r === 7) && (piece === "P" || piece === "p")) {
 177:         invalidPawns += 1;
 178:       }
 179:     }
 180:   }
 181: 
 182:   if (whiteKings === 0) {
 183:     return { isValid: false, error: "Position is missing a White king (K)." };
 184:   }
 185:   if (whiteKings > 1) {
 186:     return { isValid: false, error: `Position has ${whiteKings} White kings. Exactly one is required.` };
 187:   }
 188:   if (blackKings === 0) {
 189:     return { isValid: false, error: "Position is missing a Black king (k)." };
 190:   }
 191:   if (blackKings > 1) {
 192:     return { isValid: false, error: `Position has ${blackKings} Black kings. Exactly one is required.` };
 193:   }
 194:   if (invalidPawns > 0) {
 195:     return { isValid: false, error: "Pawns cannot be placed on the first or eighth rank." };
 196:   }
 197:   if (turn !== "w" && turn !== "b") {
 198:     return { isValid: false, error: "Side to move must be 'w' (White) or 'b' (Black)." };
 199:   }
 200: 
 201:   const result = validateFen(trimmed);
 202:   if (!result.ok) {
 203:     return { isValid: false, error: result.error || "Invalid chess position." };
 204:   }
 205: 
 206:   try {
 207:     new Chess(trimmed);
 208:   } catch (err: unknown) {
 209:     return { isValid: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) };
 210:   }
 211: 
 212:   return { isValid: true };
 213: }

 122:     }
 123:     if (this.latestScore) {

 127:     this.onStatus("ready");
 128:   }
 129: 
 130:   private startQueuedAnalysis(): void {
 131:     if (!this.ready || this.searching || !this.queued) return;

   7: function openDatabase(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
   8:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   9:     const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
  10:     request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
  11:       const db = request.result;
  12:       if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("books")) {
  13:         db.createObjectStore("books", { keyPath: "id" });
  14:       }
  15:       if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("sessions")) {
  16:         db.createObjectStore("sessions", { keyPath: "bookId" });
  17:       }
  18:       if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("settings")) {
  19:         db.createObjectStore("settings", { keyPath: "key" });
  20:       }
  21:     };
  22:     request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
  23:     request.onerror = () => reject(request.error ?? new Error("Could not open local library."));
  24:   });
  25: }
  26: 
  27: async function transact<T>(
  28:   storeName: string,
  29:   mode: IDBTransactionMode,
  30:   run: (store: IDBObjectStore) => IDBRequest<T>,
  31: ): Promise<T> {
  32:   const db = await openDatabase();
  33:   try {
  34:     return await new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
  35:       const transaction = db.transaction(storeName, mode);
  36:       let outcome: { value: T } | null = null;
  37:       transaction.oncomplete = () => {
  38:         if (outcome) resolve(outcome.value);
  39:         else reject(new Error("Local library transaction completed without a result."));
  40:       };
  41:       transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error ?? new Error("Local library transaction failed."));
  42:       transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error ?? new Error("Local library transaction aborted."));
  43:       const request = run(transaction.objectStore(storeName));
  44:       request.onsuccess = () => { outcome = { value: request.result }; };
  45:       request.onerror = () => reject(request.error ?? new Error("Local library operation failed."));
  46:     });
  47:   } finally {
  48:     db.close();
  49:   }
  50: }

  38:         db.createObjectStore(STORE, { keyPath: "id" });

 127:   useEffect(() => {
 128:     if (!selected || draft === selected.content) return;
 129:     const item = selected;
 130:     const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
 131:       setSaving(true);
 132:       void writeItem({ ...item, content: draft, updatedAt: Date.now() })
 133:         .then(() => {
 134:           setItems(current => current.map(entry =>
 135:             entry.id === item.id
 136:               ? { ...entry, content: draft, updatedAt: Date.now() }
 137:               : entry
 138:           ));
 139:           setError("");
 140:         })
 141:         .catch(() => setError("Autosave failed. Copy your text before leaving this document."))
 142:         .finally(() => setSaving(false));
 143:     }, 350);
 144:     return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
 145:   }, [draft, selected?.id, selected?.content]);
 146: 
 147:   const visibleItems = useMemo(() => {
 148:     const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();
 149:     return items
 150:       .filter(item => item.parentId === folderId)
 151:       .filter(item => !query || item.name.toLowerCase().includes(query))
 152:       .sort((a, b) =>
 153:         a.kind === b.kind ? a.name.localeCompare(b.name) : a.kind === "folder" ? -1 : 1
 154:       );
 155:   }, [items, folderId, search]);
 156: 
 157:   async function createItem(kind: "folder" | "text") {
 158:     const defaultName = kind === "folder" ? "New folder" : "Untitled notes";
 159:     const name = window.prompt(kind === "folder" ? "Folder name" : "Document name", defaultName)?.trim();
 160:     if (!name) return;
 161:     const item: StudyItem = {
 162:       id: makeId(),
 163:       kind,
 164:       name,
 165:       parentId: folderId,
 166:       content: "",
 167:       updatedAt: Date.now()
 168:     };
 169:     try {
 170:       await writeItem(item);
 171:       await refresh(kind === "text" ? item.id : undefined);
 172:       setError("");
 173:     } catch {
 174:       setError("Could not create the item.");
 175:     }
 176:   }
 177: 
 178:   async function renameItem(item: StudyItem) {
 179:     const name = window.prompt("Rename", item.name)?.trim();
 180:     if (!name || name === item.name) return;
 181:     try {
 182:       const renamed = { ...item, name, updatedAt: Date.now() };
 183:       await writeItem(renamed);
 184:       setItems(current => current.map(entry => entry.id === item.id ? renamed : entry));
 185:     } catch {
 186:       setError("Could not rename this item.");
 187:     }
 188:   }
 189: 
 190:   async function removeItem(item: StudyItem) {
 191:     const descendants = (id: string): StudyItem[] => {
 192:       const children = items.filter(entry => entry.parentId === id);
 193:       return [...children, ...children.flatMap(child => descendants(child.id))];
 194:     };
 195:     const deleting = item.kind === "folder" ? [item, ...descendants(item.id)] : [item];
 196:     const message = item.kind === "folder"
 197:       ? `Delete "${item.name}" and its ${deleting.length - 1} contained item(s)? This cannot be undone.`
 198:       : `Delete "${item.name}"? This cannot be undone.`;
 199:     if (!window.confirm(message)) return;
 200: 
 201:     try {
 202:       for (const entry of deleting) await deleteItem(entry.id);
 203:       if (deleting.some(entry => entry.id === selectedId)) {
 204:         setSelectedId(null);
 205:         setDraft("");
 206:       }
 207:       await refresh();
 208:     } catch {
 209:       setError("Could not delete the item.");
 210:     }
 211:   }
 212: 
 213:   function openText(item: StudyItem) {
 214:     setSelectedId(item.id);
 215:     setDraft(item.content);
 216:   }
 217: 
 218:   function exportText(item: StudyItem) {
 219:     const blob = new Blob([item.content], { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8" });
 220:     const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
 221:     const anchor = document.createElement("a");
 222:     anchor.href = url;
 223:     anchor.download = `${item.name.replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*]/g, "_")}.txt`;
 224:     anchor.click();
 225:     URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
 226:   }
 227: 
 228:   async function importText(file?: File) {
 229:     if (!file) return;
 230:     try {
 231:       const content = await file.text();
 232:       const item: StudyItem = {
 233:         id: makeId(),
 234:         kind: "text",
 235:         name: file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "") || "Imported notes",
 236:         parentId: folderId,
 237:         content,
 238:         updatedAt: Date.now()
 239:       };
 240:       await writeItem(item);
 241:       await refresh(item.id);
 242:       setError("");
 243:     } catch {
 244:       setError("Could not import this text file.");
 245:     }
 246:   }
 247: 
 248:   return (
 249:     <div className="study-library">
 250:       <div className="study-library-toolbar">
 251:         <button title="New document" aria-label="New document" onClick={() => void createItem("text")}><FilePlus2 size={16} /></button>
 252:         <button title="New folder" aria-label="New folder" onClick={() => void createItem("folder")}><FolderPlus size={16} /></button>
 253:         <label className="study-tool-button" title="Import text file" aria-label="Import text file">
 254:           <Upload size={16} />
 255:           <input type="file" accept=".txt,.md,text/plain,text/markdown" onChange={event => {
 256:             void importText(event.target.files?.[0]);
 257:             event.currentTarget.value = "";
 258:           }} />
 259:         </label>
 260:         <button title="Export selected document" aria-label="Export selected document" disabled={!selected} onClick={() => selected && exportText({ ...selected, content: draft })}><Download size={16} /></button>
 261:       </div>
 262: 
 263:       <label className="study-search">
 264:         <Search size={14} />
 265:         <input value={search} onChange={event => setSearch(event.target.value)} placeholder="Search documents" />
 266:       </label>
 267: 
 268:       <div className="study-breadcrumb">
 269:         <button onClick={() => setFolderId(null)}><Home size={13} /> Studies</button>
 270:         {folderId && (
 271:           <>
 272:             <ChevronRight size={13} />
 273:             <span>{items.find(item => item.id === folderId)?.name ?? "Folder"}</span>
 274:             <button className="study-up-button" onClick={() => setFolderId(items.find(item => item.id === folderId)?.parentId ?? null)}>Up</button>
 275:           </>
 276:         )}
 277:       </div>
 278: 
 279:       {loading ? <div className="study-empty">Loading studies…</div> : (
 280:         <div className="study-item-list">
 281:           {visibleItems.map(item => (
 282:             <div className={`study-item ${selectedId === item.id ? "study-item-active" : ""}`} key={item.id}>
 283:               <button className="study-item-open" onClick={() => item.kind === "folder" ? setFolderId(item.id) : openText(item)}>
 284:                 {item.kind === "folder" ? <Folder size={16} /> : <FileText size={16} />}
 285:                 <span>{item.name}</span>
 286:               </button>
 287:               <details className="study-item-menu">
 288:                 <summary aria-label={`Options for ${item.name}`}>⋯</summary>
 289:                 <div>
 290:                   {item.kind === "text" && <button onClick={() => exportText(item)}>Export .txt</button>}
 291:                   <button onClick={() => void renameItem(item)}><Pencil size={13} /> Rename</button>
 292:                   <button className="study-delete-action" onClick={() => void removeItem(item)}><Trash2 size={13} /> Delete</button>
 293:                 </div>
 294:               </details>
 295:             </div>
 296:           ))}
 297:           {!visibleItems.length && <div className="study-empty">No items here yet. Use + to create a document or folder.</div>}
 298:         </div>
 299:       )}
 300: 
 301:       {selected && (
 302:         <div className="study-editor">
 303:           <div className="study-editor-heading">
 304:             <FileText size={15} />
 305:             <strong>{selected.name}</strong>
 306:             <span>{saving ? "Saving…" : <><Check size={12} /> Saved</>}</span>
 307:           </div>
 308:           <textarea
 309:             aria-label="Study document content"
 310:             value={draft}
 311:             onChange={event => setDraft(event.target.value)}
 312:             placeholder="Write your ideas, opening traps, endgame plans…"
 313:             spellCheck
 314:           />
 315:           {error && <div className="study-error" role="alert">{error}</div>}
 316:         </div>
 317:       )}
 318:       {error && !selected && <div className="study-error" role="alert">{error}</div>}
 319:       <div className="study-library-footer">Stored locally in this browser · Export documents to keep a separate .txt copy.</div>
 320:     </div>
 321:   );
 322: }
